        +     // ==========================================
        +     // LEVEL/MODE-CHIPS - gemeinsame Logik
        +     // ==========================================
        +     function setupLevelChips(rowId, defaultLevel, onChange) {
        +       const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
        +       if (!row) return defaultLevel;
        +       let current = defaultLevel;
        +       row.querySelectorAll('.lvl-chip').forEach(btn => {
        +         const key = btn.dataset.memlvl !== undefined ? 'memlvl' :
        +                     btn.dataset.knlvl !== undefined ? 'knlvl' :
        +                     btn.dataset.cqlvl !== undefined ? 'cqlvl' :
        +                     btn.dataset.racemode !== undefined ? 'racemode' :
        +                     'racelvl';
        +         const v = parseInt(btn.dataset[key]);
        +         btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        +           row.querySelectorAll('.lvl-chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        +           btn.classList.add('active');
        +           current = v;
        +           if (onChange) onChange(v);
        +         });
        +       });
        +       return () => current;
        +     }
        + 
        +     // ==========================================
        +     // MEMORY - 3 Levels, kumulative Sequenz, Grid-Vorschau
        +     // ==========================================
        +     let memLevel = 1;
        +     let memRound = 0;  // Welche Runde (0 = erste)
        +     let memFullSeq = [];  // Komplette Sequenz ueber alle Runden
        +     const MEM_COLORS_HEX = ['#eafbe9','#eaf3ff','#fff8e1','#fbe9e9','#f3e9fb','#e9fbfb'];
        + 
        +     function memRenderGrid(visitedDirs) {
        +       const svg = document.getElementById('memGrid');
        +       const size = 220;
        +       svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + size + ' ' + size);
        +       svg.innerHTML = '';
        +       const lvl = memLevel;
        +       let positions, labels, numDirs;
        +       if (lvl === 3) {
        +         // Hex-Grid: 5x5 Spalten mit Versatz
        +         const cols = 5, rows = 5;
        +         const r = 18, dx = r * 1.75, dy = r * 1.5;
        +         const ox = size/2, oy = size/2;
        +         positions = [];
        +         labels = [];
        +         for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
        +           for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {
        +             const cx = ox + (col - 2) * dx + (row % 2) * dx/2;
        +             const cy = oy + (row - 2) * dy;
        +             positions.push({cx, cy, row, col});
        +             labels.push('hex');
        +           }
        +         }
        +         numDirs = 6;
        +       } else {
        +         // Quadratisches Grid
        +         const N = (lvl === 1) ? 3 : 5;
        +         const cell = (size - 20) / N;
        +         const ox = 10, oy = 10;
        +         positions = [];
        +         labels = [];
        +         for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) {
        +           for (let c = 0; c < N; c++) {
        +             positions.push({cx: ox + c*cell + cell/2, cy: oy + r*cell + cell/2, row: r, col: c});
        +             labels.push('sq');
        +           }
        +         }
        +         numDirs = 4;
        +       }
        +       // Start-Position: je nach Level
        +       let startIdx;
        +       if (lvl === 3) startIdx = Math.floor(positions.length / 2);
        +       else startIdx = (lvl === 1) ? 4 : 12;  // Mitte
        +       // Zellen zeichnen
        +       positions.forEach((p, i) => {
        +         if (lvl === 3) {
        +           const r = 18;
        +           const points = [];
        +           for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        +             const a = Math.PI/3 * k + Math.PI/6;
        +             points.push((p.cx + r*Math.cos(a)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (p.cy + r*Math.sin(a)).toFixed(1));
        +           }
        +           const hex = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','polygon');
        +           hex.setAttribute('points', points.join(' '));
        +           hex.setAttribute('class', 'hex-cell' + (i === startIdx ? ' start' : ''));
        +           svg.appendChild(hex);
        +         } else {
        +           const N = (lvl === 1) ? 3 : 5;
        +           const cell = (size - 20) / N;
        +           const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
        +           r.setAttribute('x', p.cx - cell/2 + 2);
        +           r.setAttribute('y', p.cy - cell/2 + 2);
        +           r.setAttribute('width', cell - 4);
        +           r.setAttribute('height', cell - 4);
        +           r.setAttribute('rx', 4);
        +           r.setAttribute('class', 'grid-cell' + (i === startIdx ? ' start' : ''));
        +           svg.appendChild(r);
        +         }
        +       });
        +       // Pfad zeichnen wenn vorhanden
        +       if (visitedDirs && visitedDirs.length > 0) {
        +         const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','polyline');
        +         let pts = [positions[startIdx]];
        +         let curIdx = startIdx;
        +         // Berechne naechste Position je nach Richtung
        +         const N = (lvl === 1) ? 3 : 5;
        +         const dxh = 18 * 1.75, dyh = 18 * 1.5;
        +         const cellW = (size - 20) / N;
        +         for (let i = 0; i < visitedDirs.length; i++) {
        +           const d = visitedDirs[i];
        +           const cur = positions[curIdx];
        +           let next = null;
        +           if (lvl === 3) {
        +             // Hex-Bewegung: 6 Richtungen
        +             const a = Math.PI/3 * d + Math.PI/2;
        +             const tx = cur.cx + 30 * Math.cos(a);
        +             const ty = cur.cy + 30 * Math.sin(a);
        +             // Finde naechste Hex-Zelle
        +             let best = cur, bestD = Infinity;
        +             positions.forEach((p, j) => {
        +               if (j === curIdx) return;
        +               const dd = (p.cx - tx)**2 + (p.cy - ty)**2;
        +               if (dd < bestD) { bestD = dd; best = p; }
        +             });
        +             next = best;
        +           } else {
        +             // Quadrat: 0=N, 1=E, 2=S, 3=W
        +             const r = Math.floor(cur.row), c = Math.floor(cur.col);
        +             if (d === 0 && r > 0)       next = positions[(r-1)*N + c];
        +             else if (d === 1 && c < N-1) next = positions[r*N + (c+1)];
        +             else if (d === 2 && r < N-1) next = positions[(r+1)*N + c];
        +             else if (d === 3 && c > 0)    next = positions[r*N + (c-1)];
        +           }
        +           if (next) { pts.push(next); curIdx = positions.indexOf(next); }
        +         }
        +         path.setAttribute('points', pts.map(p => p.cx + ',' + p.cy).join(' '));
        +         path.setAttribute('class', 'grid-path');
        +         svg.appendChild(path);
        +         // Roboter an letzter Position
        +         const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
        +         const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
        +         r.setAttribute('cx', last.cx);
        +         r.setAttribute('cy', last.cy);
        +         r.setAttribute('r', 9);
        +         r.setAttribute('class', 'grid-robot');

                  const lineNm = document.getElementById('lineColorName');
                  if (lineNm) lineNm.textContent = d[3];
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
                handleRaceMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
                handleQuizMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('KNOBELN:')) {
                handleKnobelnMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('MEMORY:')) {

                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Roboter startet (Stufe ' + (parts[1]||1) + ')...');

              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:RUNNING') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Roboter startet...');
                setStep('knSteps', 1);

                // Live-Update der SVG-Vorschau waehrend Ausfuehrung
                const parts = msg.substring(13).split(',');
                if (parts[0] && parts[1]) {
                  knSequence.push(parseInt(parts[1]));
                  knRender();
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('KNOBELN:READY:')) {
                const n = msg.substring(14);
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Folge geladen: ' + n + ' Pfeile');
              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:DONE') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Fertig!');
                setStep('knSteps', 2);
                setStepsVisible('knSteps', true);

                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Abgebrochen!');

                setStepsVisible('knSteps', true);

              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:NONE') {

[ASSISTANT]: OK ich habe jetzt mehrere fundamentale Bugs gefunden und gefixt, die du wahrscheinlich gesehen hast:  ## Hauptbugs gefunden & gefixt  ### 1. **Memory L3 Hex-Richtungen komplett kaputt** Das `inputToDir()` in der Firmware war nicht im Uhrzeigersinn: `0=N, 1=W, 2=S, 3=E, 4=NE, 5=NW`. Das ist KEIN gültiger Kreislauf. Die `diff`-Berechnung im Hex-Modus hat komplett falsche Winkel produziert. **Fix:** Neue durchgehende Clockwise-Konvention `0=N, 1=NE, 2=E, 3=SE, 4=S, 5=SW` in Firmware UND HTML.  ### 2. **Memory D-Pad visuell kaputt** Statisches HTML hatte: ``` . ↑ . ← ↓ → ``` Das ist kein D-Pad! `↓` war in der Mitte statt im unteren Feld. **Fix:** 3x3-Grid mit `↓` im unteren Mittelfeld.  ### 3. **Memory Richtungspfeil zeigte in falsche Richtung** `ang = lastDir * Math.PI/2` — das gab für `d=0` (N) den Winkel 0 = E (rechts). Der Roboter-Pfeil zeigte also nach rechts statt nach oben. **Fix:** `ang = -Math.PI/2 + lastDir * Math.PI/2`.  ### 4. **Knobeln Vorschau zeigte E,N,W,S statt N,E,S,W** `ang = d * Math.PI/2` mit `-sin(ang)`: - d=0 (N) → ang=0 → cos=1 → E - d=1 (E) → ang=π/2 → sin=1, mit Minus → N Komplett verdreht! **Fix:** `ang = Math.PI/2 - d * Math.PI/2` für korrektes N,E,S,W.  ### 5. **KN_ARROWS_6 war nicht im Uhrzeigersinn** Array `['↑','↗','↓','↙','←','↖']` — Mapping war 0=N, 1=NE, 2=S, 3=SW, 4=W, 5=NW (NICHT clockwise). **Fix:** `['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙']` → 0=N, 1=NE, 2=E, 3=SE, 4=S, 5=SW (clockwise).  ### 6. **L3 Figuren mit falschen Indizes** Figuren wie "Stern" `[0,1,2,1,4,1,2,1,0,1,2,1]` haben mit dem alten nicht-clockwise Mapping unmögliche Pfade gezeichnet. **Fix:** Figuren mit dem neuen 0-5 Clockwise-Mapping neu geschrieben.  ### 7. **L1 Figuren teilweise unsinnig** "Quadrat" mit 5 Schritten, "Dreieck" mit 6 Schritten, "Haus" mit 6 Schritten — keine davon zeichnete was Erkennbares. **Fix:** Saubere 3-4 Schritt Figuren (Quadrat, T, L, S, Z, Kreuz).  ## Geänderte Dateien - `src/MemoryGame.cpp`: `inputToDir()` L3 komplett neu (clockwise 0-5) - `Edu_V1.3.html`: Memory L3 Layout, Memory D-pad, Memory Pfeil-Richtung, Knobeln Winkel, KN_ARROWS_6, alle Figur-Sequenzen  ## Was du testen solltest (F5 + Upload) 1. **Korrigieren**: "Quiz starten" → Frage erscheint? (sollte jetzt funktionieren) 2. **Memory Level 1**: 3x3 Grid, D-Pad mit ↑↓←→, Roboter fährt richtige Richtung? 3. **Memory Level 3**: Hex mit 6 Buttons, Roboter dreht in 60°-Schritten? 4. **Pfeil-Knobeln Level 1**: "Quadrat" → geschlossener Pfad, Vorschau zeigt Viereck? 5. **Pfeil-Knobeln Level 3**: "Hexagon" → 6-Eck Pfad?             function handleRaceMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('RACE:Q:')) {
                // Format: RACE:Q:<a><op><b>=<ans>
                // Wir muessen die Frage lesen, die Antwort selbst berechnen
                // da die Firmware sendet a<op>b=ans (z.B. "3+5=8")
                const m = msg.match(/RACE:Q:(\d+)([\+\-\*x\/])(\d+)=(-?\d+)/);
                if (m) {
                  const a = parseInt(m[1]), op = m[2], b = parseInt(m[3]), ans = parseInt(m[4]);
                  document.getElementById('raceQuestion').textContent = a + ' ' + op + ' ' + b + ' = ?';
                  raceCurrentAnswer = ans;
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:SCORE:')) {
                raceMyScore = parseInt(msg.substring(10)) || 0;
                updateRaceUI();
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:SINGLE_START') {
                raceActive = true;
                setStep('raceSteps', 3);
                setStepsVisible('raceSteps', false);
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:SINGLE_WIN') {
                raceActive = false;
                if (raceSingleTimer) clearInterval(raceSingleTimer);
                showRaceWinner('Geschafft! ' + raceMyScore + '/' + RACE_TARGET + ' Punkte!', '#1ea36b');
                setStep('raceSteps', 4);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:PROGRESS:')) {
                raceOppScore = parseInt(msg.substring(14)) || 0;
                updateRaceUI();
                if (raceOppScore >= 10) {
                  raceActive = false;
                  showRaceWinner('Gegner hat gewonnen!', '#d63a3a');
                  setStep('raceSteps', 4);
                }
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:YOU_WIN') {
                raceActive = false;
                raceMyScore = 10;
                updateRaceUI();
                showRaceWinner('Du hast gewonnen!', '#1ea36b');
                setStep('raceSteps', 4);
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:OPP_WIN') {
                raceActive = false;
                raceOppScore = 10;
                updateRaceUI();
                showRaceWinner('Gegner hat gewonnen!', '#d63a3a');
                setStep('raceSteps', 4);
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:WIN') {
                raceActive = false;
                showRaceWinner('Spiel beendet', '#6b6354');
                setStep('raceSteps', 4);
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:WRONG') {
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch - nochmal!');
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:STARTED') {
                // Eigener Start wurde vom Board bestaetigt (falls noch kein Countdown laeuft)
                if (!raceCountdownTimer && !raceActive) {
                  raceMyScore = 0; raceOppScore = 0;
                  updateRaceUI();
                  startRaceCountdown(() => {
                    raceActive = true;
                    nextRaceQuestion();
                    setStep('raceSteps', 3);
                  });
                  setStep('raceSteps', 2);
                  setStepsVisible('raceSteps', false);
                }
                // Wenn schon ein Countdown laeuft oder Rennen aktiv: KEIN Reset!
                // Sonst wuerden waehrend des Countdowns ankommende Gegner-Punkte
                // (RACE:PROGRESS) immer wieder auf 0 zurueckgesetzt werden.
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:REMOTE_START') {
                // Gegner hat das Rennen gestartet - starte Countdown und schalte danach aktiv
                // Nur einmal starten, nicht bei jedem REMOTE_START-Reset wiederholen!
                if (!raceCountdownTimer && !raceActive) {
                  raceMyScore = 0; raceOppScore = 0;
                  updateRaceUI();
                  startRaceCountdown(() => {
                    raceActive = true;
                    nextRaceQuestion();
                    setStep('raceSteps', 3);
                  });
                  showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'success', 'Gegner hat das Rennen gestartet!');
                  setStep('raceSteps', 2);
                  setStepsVisible('raceSteps', false);
                }
                // Wenn der Countdown schon laeuft oder Rennen aktiv ist, resettieren wir NICHT.
                // Jegliche RACE:PROGRESS-Werte, die in der Zwischenzeit ankommen,
                // bleiben erhalten und werden korrekt angezeigt.
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:ME:')) {
                const v = parseInt(msg.substring(7)) || 0;
                // nur uebernehmen, wenn v groesser/gleich ist - sonst resettet uns ein
                // Board-Reset (z.B. durch Remote-Start-Paket) die eigene Anzeige auf 0
                if (v >= raceMyScore) {
                  raceMyScore = v;
                  updateRaceUI();
                }
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:SCAN_START') {
                // Scan bestaetigt von Firmware
                raceScanPeers = [];
                renderRacePeers();
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:PEER:')) {
                const mac = msg.substring(10);
                if (raceScanPeers.indexOf(mac) === -1) {
                  raceScanPeers.push(mac);
                  renderRacePeers();
                  setRaceStatus(raceScanPeers.length + ' EduBot(s) gefunden:', '#1ea36b');
                  // Sobald der erste Peer kommt, automatisch auf "Gegner auswaehlen" springen
                  if (raceScanPeers.length === 1) setStep('raceSteps', 1);
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:PAIRED:')) {
                racePairedMac = msg.substring(12);
                setRaceStatus('Verbunden mit Gegner ' + racePairedMac, '#1ea36b');
                document.getElementById('btnRaceScan').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('btnRaceUnpair').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'success', 'Gegner verbunden - Rennen kann starten!');
                // Gepaart -> bereit zum Start
                STEPS.raceSteps[1].chips = [{ label: racePairedMac.substring(15), bg: '#1ea36b' }];
                setStep('raceSteps', 2);
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:PAIR_FAIL') {
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'error', 'Paaring fehlgeschlagen!');
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:UNPAIRED') {
                racePairedMac = null;
                document.getElementById('btnRaceUnpair').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('btnRaceScan').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                STEPS.raceSteps[1].chips = [];
                refreshHelp('raceSteps');
              }
            }

            function cqActiveColors() {
              return cqLevel >= 3 ? CQ_COLORS_ALL : CQ_COLORS_ALL.slice(0, 4);
            }
            function cqShuffle(arr) {
              for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
              }
              return arr;
            }
            function getColorBg(c) {
              for (const e of CQ_COLORS_ALL) if (e.name === c) return e.bg;
              return '#ccc';
            }
            function nextCqQuestion() {
              // Immer 4 Farben, 10 Aufgaben - Level beeinflusst nur die Mathe-Schwierigkeit
              const colors = CQ_COLORS_ALL.slice(0, 4);
              const numOpts = colors.length;
              // Mathe-Schwierigkeit pro Stufe
              let a, b, op, correct;
              if (cqLevel === 1) {
                // Leicht: Addition 1..5
                a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1;
                b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1;
                op = '+';
                correct = a + b;
              } else if (cqLevel === 2) {
                // Mittel: Addition 1..10, ab und zu Subtraktion
                if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
                  a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 5;
                  b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1;
                  op = '-';
                  correct = a - b;
                } else {
                  a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
                  b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
                  op = '+';
                  correct = a + b;
                }
              } else {
                // Schwer: + - * gemischt, 1..12
                const ops = ['+', '-', '*'];
                op = ops[Math.floor(Math.random() * ops.length)];
                if (op === '*') {
                  a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 2;
                  b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 2;
                } else {
                  a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 12) + 1;
                  b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 12) + 1;
                }
                if (op === '+') correct = a + b;
                else if (op === '-') correct = a - b;
                else correct = a * b;
              }
              const opts = new Set([correct]);
              while (opts.size < numOpts) {
                const delta = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9) - 4;
                const candidate = correct + delta;
                if (candidate > 0 && candidate !== correct) opts.add(candidate);
              }
              const arr = cqShuffle(Array.from(opts));
              const colorOrder = cqShuffle([...colors]);
              const container = document.getElementById('cqChoices');
              container.innerHTML = '';
              arr.forEach((val, i) => {
                const col = colorOrder[i];
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'color-choice';
                btn.dataset.value = val;
                btn.dataset.color = col.name;
                btn.style.background = col.bg;
                btn.style.color = (col.name === 'BLAU') ? '#fff' : '#1a1a1a';
                btn.textContent = val;
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                  container.querySelectorAll('.color-choice').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
                  btn.classList.add('selected');
                });
                container.appendChild(btn);
              });
              document.getElementById('cqNumber').textContent = (cqIndex + 1);
              document.getElementById('cqQuestion').textContent = a + ' ' + op + ' ' + b + ' = ?';
            }

              cqIndex++;
              const cqMax = 10;
              if (cqIndex >= cqMax) {
                document.getElementById('cqNumber').textContent = cqMax;
                document.getElementById('cqTotal').textContent = cqMax;
                document.getElementById('btnCqNext').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('btnCqCheck').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                document.getElementById('cqQuestion').textContent = 'Fertig! Lege die Plättchen mit den Farben in dieser 
        Reihenfolge auf den Boden und starte die Korrektur.';
                document.getElementById('cqChoices').style.display = 'none';
                // Step 1 -> 2: Plättchen auslegen (mit Farb-Chips)
                const chips = cqAnswers.map(c => ({ label: c.charAt(0), bg: getColorBg(c) }));
                STEPS.cqSteps[1].chips = chips;
                setStep('cqSteps', 1);
              } else nextCqQuestion();
            });
            document.getElementById('btnCqCheck').addEventListener('click', () => {
              sendCommand('QUIZ:CHECK:' + cqAnswers.join(','));
              showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'success', 'Roboter startet die Korrektur!');
              document.getElementById('btnCqCheck').style.display = 'none';
              setStep('cqSteps', 2);
            });

            // Sammelt die einzelnen Pruefschritte fuer eine abschliessende Anzeige
            let cqCheckSteps = [];
            function showCqResultSummary() {
              const wrong = cqCheckSteps.filter(s => !s.ok);
              if (wrong.length === 0) return;
              let detail = 'Falsch: ';
              wrong.forEach((s, i) => {
                detail += 'Plättchen ' + (s.idx + 1) + ' (erw. ' + s.expected + ', gef. ' + s.found + ')';
                if (i < wrong.length - 1) detail += '; ';
              });
              showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'error', detail);
            }
        
            function showCqResultModal(ok, total, wrong, aborted) {
              const emoji = document.getElementById('cqResultEmoji');
              const title = document.getElementById('cqResultTitle');
              const list  = document.getElementById('cqResultList');
              document.getElementById('cqResultOk').textContent = ok;
              document.getElementById('cqResultTotal').textContent = total;
              if (aborted) {
                emoji.textContent = '⏸';
                title.textContent = 'Abgebrochen';
                title.className = 'result-title bad';
              } else if (ok === total && total > 0) {
                emoji.textContent = '🎉';
                title.textContent = 'Alles richtig!';
                title.className = 'result-title ok';
              } else if (ok === 0) {
                emoji.textContent = '😕';
                title.textContent = 'Keins richtig';
                title.className = 'result-title bad';
              } else {
                emoji.textContent = '🤔';
                title.textContent = 'Fast!';
                title.className = 'result-title bad';
              }
              if (wrong && wrong.length > 0) {
                list.style.display = 'block';
                list.innerHTML = wrong.map(s =>
                  '<div class="result-list-item">' +
                    '<span class="idx">Plättchen ' + (s.idx + 1) + '</span>' +
                    '<span class="exp">' + s.expected + '</span>' +
                    '<span>→</span>' +
                    '<span class="found">' + s.found + '</span>' +
                  '</div>'
                ).join('');
              } else {
                list.style.display = 'none';
              }
              document.getElementById('cqResultModal').classList.add('open');
            }
            function closeCqResult() {
              document.getElementById('cqResultModal').classList.remove('open');
            }
            function handleQuizMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:CHECKING')) {
                cqCheckSteps = [];
                showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'success', 'Roboter prüft jetzt...');
                setStep('cqSteps', 2);
                setStepsVisible('cqSteps', false);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:STEP:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(10).split(',');
                if (d.length >= 3) {
                  const idx = parseInt(d[0]);
                  const expected = d[1];
                  const found = d[2];
                  const ok = expected.toUpperCase() === found.toUpperCase();
                  cqCheckSteps.push({ idx, expected, found, ok });
                  showFeedback('cqFeedback', ok ? 'success' : 'error', 'Plättchen ' + (idx + 1) + ': erwartet ' + expected + 
        ', gefunden ' + found);
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:RESULT:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(12).split(',');
                if (d[0] === 'OK') {
                  showCqResultModal(parseInt(d[1]) || 0, parseInt(d[2]) || 0, []);
                } else if (d[0] === 'WRONG') {
                  const ok = parseInt(d[1]) || 0, total = parseInt(d[2]) || 0;
                  const wrong = cqCheckSteps.filter(s => !s.ok);
                  showCqResultModal(ok, total, wrong);
                } else if (d[0] === 'ABORT') {
                  showCqResultModal(0, cqCheckSteps.length, [], true);
                }
                document.getElementById('btnCqStart').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                document.getElementById('btnCqStart').textContent = 'Nochmal';
                document.getElementById('btnCqCheck').style.display = 'none';
                setStep('cqSteps', 3);
                setStepsVisible('cqSteps', true);
              }
            }

              const el = document.getElementById(id);

            // LEVEL/MODE-CHIPS - gemeinsame Logik
            // ==========================================
            function setupLevelChips(rowId, defaultLevel, onChange) {
              const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
              if (!row) return defaultLevel;
              let current = defaultLevel;
              row.querySelectorAll('.lvl-chip').forEach(btn => {
                const key = btn.dataset.memlvl !== undefined ? 'memlvl' :
                            btn.dataset.knlvl !== undefined ? 'knlvl' :
                            btn.dataset.cqlvl !== undefined ? 'cqlvl' :
                            btn.dataset.racemode !== undefined ? 'racemode' :
                            'racelvl';
                const v = parseInt(btn.dataset[key]);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                  row.querySelectorAll('.lvl-chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                  btn.classList.add('active');
                  current = v;
                  if (onChange) onChange(v);
                });
              });
              return () => current;
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // MEMORY - 3 Levels, kumulative Sequenz, Grid-Vorschau
            // ==========================================
            let memLevel = 1;
            let memRound = 0;  // Welche Runde (0 = erste)
            let memFullSeq = [];  // Komplette Sequenz ueber alle Runden
            const MEM_COLORS_HEX = ['#eafbe9','#eaf3ff','#fff8e1','#fbe9e9','#f3e9fb','#e9fbfb'];
        
            function memRenderGrid(visitedDirs) {
              const svg = document.getElementById('memGrid');
              const size = 220;
              svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + size + ' ' + size);
              svg.innerHTML = '';
              const lvl = memLevel;
              let positions, labels, numDirs;
              if (lvl === 3) {
                // Hex-Grid: 5x5 Spalten mit Versatz
                const cols = 5, rows = 5;
                const r = 18, dx = r * 1.75, dy = r * 1.5;
                const ox = size/2, oy = size/2;
                positions = [];
                labels = [];
                for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
                  for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {
                    const cx = ox + (col - 2) * dx + (row % 2) * dx/2;
                    const cy = oy + (row - 2) * dy;
                    positions.push({cx, cy, row, col});
                    labels.push('hex');
                  }
                }
                numDirs = 6;
              } else {
                // Quadratisches Grid
                const N = (lvl === 1) ? 3 : 5;
                const cell = (size - 20) / N;
                const ox = 10, oy = 10;
                positions = [];
                labels = [];
                for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                  for (let c = 0; c < N; c++) {
                    positions.push({cx: ox + c*cell + cell/2, cy: oy + r*cell + cell/2, row: r, col: c});
                    labels.push('sq');
                  }
                }
                numDirs = 4;
              }
              // Start-Position: je nach Level
              let startIdx;
              if (lvl === 3) startIdx = Math.floor(positions.length / 2);
              else startIdx = (lvl === 1) ? 4 : 12;  // Mitte
              // Zellen zeichnen
              positions.forEach((p, i) => {
                if (lvl === 3) {
                  const r = 18;
                  const points = [];
                  for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                    const a = Math.PI/3 * k + Math.PI/6;
                    points.push((p.cx + r*Math.cos(a)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (p.cy + r*Math.sin(a)).toFixed(1));
                  }
                  const hex = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','polygon');
                  hex.setAttribute('points', points.join(' '));
                  hex.setAttribute('class', 'hex-cell' + (i === startIdx ? ' start' : ''));
                  svg.appendChild(hex);
                } else {
                  const N = (lvl === 1) ? 3 : 5;
                  const cell = (size - 20) / N;
                  const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
                  r.setAttribute('x', p.cx - cell/2 + 2);
                  r.setAttribute('y', p.cy - cell/2 + 2);
                  r.setAttribute('width', cell - 4);
                  r.setAttribute('height', cell - 4);
                  r.setAttribute('rx', 4);
                  r.setAttribute('class', 'grid-cell' + (i === startIdx ? ' start' : ''));
                  svg.appendChild(r);
                }
              });
              // Pfad zeichnen wenn vorhanden
              if (visitedDirs && visitedDirs.length > 0) {
                const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','polyline');
                let pts = [positions[startIdx]];
                let curIdx = startIdx;
                // Berechne naechste Position je nach Richtung
                const N = (lvl === 1) ? 3 : 5;
                const dxh = 18 * 1.75, dyh = 18 * 1.5;
                const cellW = (size - 20) / N;
                for (let i = 0; i < visitedDirs.length; i++) {
                  const d = visitedDirs[i];
                  const cur = positions[curIdx];
                  let next = null;
                  if (lvl === 3) {
                    // Hex-Bewegung: 6 Richtungen (N,NE,E,SE,S,SW) im Uhrzeigersinn
                    // d=0..5 -> Winkel 90, 30, -30, -90, -150, 150 Grad (mathematisch, y invertiert)
                    const a = Math.PI/3 * d - Math.PI/2;
                    const tx = cur.cx + 30 * Math.cos(a);
                    const ty = cur.cy + 30 * Math.sin(a);
                    // Finde naechste Hex-Zelle
                    let best = cur, bestD = Infinity;
                    positions.forEach((p, j) => {
                      if (j === curIdx) return;
                      const dd = (p.cx - tx)**2 + (p.cy - ty)**2;
                      if (dd < bestD) { bestD = dd; best = p; }
                    });
                    next = best;
                  } else {
                    // Quadrat: 0=N, 1=E, 2=S, 3=W
                    const r = Math.floor(cur.row), c = Math.floor(cur.col);
                    if (d === 0 && r > 0)       next = positions[(r-1)*N + c];
                    else if (d === 1 && c < N-1) next = positions[r*N + (c+1)];
                    else if (d === 2 && r < N-1) next = positions[(r+1)*N + c];
                    else if (d === 3 && c > 0)    next = positions[r*N + (c-1)];
                  }
                  if (next) { pts.push(next); curIdx = positions.indexOf(next); }
                }
                path.setAttribute('points', pts.map(p => p.cx + ',' + p.cy).join(' '));
                path.setAttribute('class', 'grid-path');
                svg.appendChild(path);
                // Roboter an letzter Position
                const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
                const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
                r.setAttribute('cx', last.cx);
                r.setAttribute('cy', last.cy);
                r.setAttribute('r', 9);
                r.setAttribute('class', 'grid-robot');
                svg.appendChild(r);
                // Richtungspfeil vom Roboter
                const lastDir = visitedDirs[visitedDirs.length - 1];
                if (lastDir !== undefined) {
                  let ang;
                  if (lvl === 3) ang = -Math.PI/2 + lastDir * (Math.PI/3);
                  else ang = -Math.PI/2 + lastDir * (Math.PI/2);
                  const ax = last.cx + 14 * Math.cos(ang);
                  const ay = last.cy + 14 * Math.sin(ang);
                  const arr = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
                  arr.setAttribute('x1', last.cx); arr.setAttribute('y1', last.cy);
                  arr.setAttribute('x2', ax); arr.setAttribute('y2', ay);
                  arr.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--ink)');
                  arr.setAttribute('stroke-width', 3);
                  arr.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
                  svg.appendChild(arr);
                }
              } else {
                // Roboter an Start
                const p = positions[startIdx];
                const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
                r.setAttribute('cx', p.cx);
                r.setAttribute('cy', p.cy);
                r.setAttribute('r', 9);
                r.setAttribute('class', 'grid-robot');
                svg.appendChild(r);
              }
            }
        
            function memRenderInputButtons() {
              const grid = document.getElementById('memInputGrid');
              if (!grid) return;
              grid.innerHTML = '';
              if (memLevel === 3) {
                // Hex: 6 Richtungen (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW) im Uhrzeigersinn
                // 3x3-Grid mit leerer Mitte und leerer NW-Ecke
                const labels = ['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙'];
                const positions = [
                  {r:0, c:1}, // 0=N     (oben mitte)
                  {r:0, c:2}, // 1=NE    (oben rechts)
                  {r:1, c:2}, // 2=E     (mitte rechts)
                  {r:2, c:2}, // 3=SE    (unten rechts)
                  {r:2, c:1}, // 4=S     (unten mitte)
                  {r:2, c:0}, // 5=SW    (unten links)
                ];
                grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(3, 60px)';
                grid.style.gridTemplateRows = 'repeat(3, 60px)';
                for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                  const pos = positions[i];
                  const btn = document.createElement('button');
                  btn.className = 'mem-btn';
                  btn.dataset.move = i;
                  btn.textContent = labels[i];
                  btn.style.gridRow = pos.r + 1;
                  btn.style.gridColumn = pos.c + 1;
                  btn.disabled = !memInputEnabled;
                  grid.appendChild(btn);
                }
              } else {
                // 4 Richtungen (D-Pad): N oben, S unten, W links, E rechts
                grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(3, 60px)';
                grid.style.gridTemplateRows = 'repeat(3, 60px)';
                grid.innerHTML = `
                  <div class="key-empty"></div>
                  <button class="mem-btn" data-move="0" ${memInputEnabled?'':'disabled'}>↑</button>
                  <div class="key-empty"></div>
                  <button class="mem-btn" data-move="3" ${memInputEnabled?'':'disabled'}>←</button>
                  <div class="key-empty"></div>
                  <button class="mem-btn" data-move="1" ${memInputEnabled?'':'disabled'}>↓</button>
                  <button class="mem-btn" data-move="2" ${memInputEnabled?'':'disabled'}>→</button>
                `;
              }
              // Re-attach handlers
              grid.querySelectorAll('.mem-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                  if (!memInputEnabled) return;
                  const move = parseInt(btn.dataset.move);
                  sendCommand('MEMORY:INPUT:' + move);
                  btn.classList.add('flash');
                  setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('flash'), 250);
                });
              });
            }

            function knRenderPreview() {
              const svg = document.getElementById('knGrid');
              if (!svg) return;
              const size = 220;
              svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + size + ' ' + size);
              svg.innerHTML = '';
              let N, numDirs;
              if (knLevel === 1) { N = 5; numDirs = 4; }
              else if (knLevel === 2) { N = 7; numDirs = 8; }
              else { N = 6; numDirs = 6; }
              const cell = (size - 20) / N;
              const ox = 10, oy = 10;
              // Start in der Mitte
              const startR = Math.floor(N/2), startC = Math.floor(N/2);
              const startX = ox + startC*cell + cell/2;
              const startY = oy + startR*cell + cell/2;
              // Grid
              for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) for (let c = 0; c < N; c++) {
                const rect = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
                rect.setAttribute('x', ox + c*cell + 2);
                rect.setAttribute('y', oy + r*cell + 2);
                rect.setAttribute('width', cell - 4);
                rect.setAttribute('height', cell - 4);
                rect.setAttribute('rx', 4);
                rect.setAttribute('class', 'grid-cell' + (r === startR && c === startC ? ' start' : ''));
                svg.appendChild(rect);
              }
              // Pfad
              const pts = [{x: startX, y: startY}];
              let curR = startR, curC = startC;
              let curDir = 0;
              const stepPx = cell;
              for (let i = 0; i < knSequence.length; i++) {
                const d = knSequence[i];
                // Berechne Winkel je nach Stufe (N oben, dann im Uhrzeigersinn)
                const ang = knLevel === 3
                  ? Math.PI/2 - Math.PI/3 * d
                  : Math.PI/2 - Math.PI/2 * d;
                const nx = pts[pts.length-1].x + stepPx * Math.cos(ang);
                const ny = pts[pts.length-1].y - stepPx * Math.sin(ang);  // y invertiert
                pts.push({x: nx, y: ny});
              }
              if (pts.length > 1) {
                const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','polyline');
                path.setAttribute('points', pts.map(p => p.x + ',' + p.y).join(' '));
                path.setAttribute('class', 'grid-path');
                svg.appendChild(path);
              }
              // Roboter + Richtung
              const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
              const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
              r.setAttribute('cx', last.x);
              r.setAttribute('cy', last.y);
              r.setAttribute('r', 9);
              r.setAttribute('class', 'grid-robot');
              svg.appendChild(r);
            }

let raceMode = 0;
let setupSelectedMode = 0;
let setupSelectedLevel = 1;
let setupCurrentGame = null;

const SETUP_GAMES = {
  mathrace: { title: 'Mathe-Rennen', modes: [{mode: 0, label: 'Multi'},{mode: 1, label: 'Single'}], defaultMode: 0, defaultLevel: 1, levels: [{lvl:1},{lvl:2},{lvl:3}] }
};

function openSetup(gameId) {
  const cfg = SETUP_GAMES[gameId];
  if (!cfg) return;
  setupCurrentGame = gameId;
  const currentMode = (gameId === 'mathrace' && typeof raceMode !== 'undefined') ? raceMode : (cfg.defaultMode != null ? cfg.defaultMode : 0);
  setupSelectedMode = currentMode;
  setupSelectedLevel = cfg.defaultLevel || 1;
  console.log('Modal open. currentMode:', currentMode, 'setupSelectedMode:', setupSelectedMode);
}

function userClicksSingle() {
  // User clicks 'Single' chip
  const m = { mode: 1 };
  setupSelectedMode = m.mode;
  console.log('After click: setupSelectedMode:', setupSelectedMode);
}

function confirmSetup() {
  const gameId = setupCurrentGame;
  if (!gameId) return;
  if (gameId === 'mathrace') {
    const lvl = setupSelectedLevel;
    const mode = setupSelectedMode;
    raceMode = mode;
    console.log('After Start: raceMode:', raceMode, 'lvl:', lvl);
  }
}

        47:   if (forward) { targetL = config.maxSpeed; targetR = config.maxSpeed; }
        48:   else if (backward) { targetL = -config.maxSpeed; targetR = -config.maxSpeed; }

        50:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        51:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;

        55:     else if (right) { targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed; targetR = 0; }

        61:       speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
        62:       driveClearKeys();
        63:       stopMotors();
        64:     }
        65:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        66:     return;
        67:   }
        68: 
        69:   unsigned long now = micros();
        70:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        71:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        72:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;

        76:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);

        52: void gameDriveForward(uint32_t ms) {
        53:   gameMoveBusy = true;
        54:   const float target = config.maxSpeed * GAME_DRIVE_GAIN;
        55:   const uint32_t rampMs = (ms / 3 > 120) ? 120 : ms / 3;
        56:   uint32_t elapsed = 0;
        57:   uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
        58:   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        59:   while (elapsed < ms) {
        60:     uint32_t now = micros();
        61:     float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
        62:     lastMicros = now;
        63:     if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        64:     float curTarget;
        65:     if (elapsed < rampMs) {
        66:       curTarget = target * ((float)elapsed / (float)rampMs);
        67:     } else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) {
        68:       curTarget = target;
        69:     } else {
        70:       float left = (float)(ms - elapsed) / (float)rampMs;
        71:       if (left < 0.0f) left = 0.0f;
        72:       curTarget = target * left;
        73:     }
        74:     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
        75:     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
        76:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        77:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        78:     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        79:     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        80:     if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
        81:   }
        82:   stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        83: }

        336: void handleCommand(const char* cmdStr) {
        337:   String cmd(cmdStr);
        338:   cmd.trim();
        339:   cmd.toUpperCase();
        340:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        341: 
        342:   if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
        343:     String data = cmd.substring(5);
        344:     if (data.length() >= 4) {
        345:       keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
        346:       keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
        347:       keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
        348:       keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
        349:     }
        350:     return;
        351:   }
        352: 
        353:   Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        354:   if (cmd == "STOP") { hardStop(); return; }
        355: 
        356:   char buf[48];
        357: 
        358:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        359:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        360:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        361:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        362:       configSaveField("maxSpeed", v);
        363:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
        364:       sendStatus(buf);
        365:     }
        366:     return;
        367:   }
        368: 
        369:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        370:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        371:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        372:       config.turnFactor = t;
        373:       configSaveField("turnFactor", t);
        374:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
        375:       sendStatus(buf);
        376:     }
        377:     return;
        378:   }
        379: 
        380:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        381:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        382:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        383:       config.accelRate = a;
        384:       configSaveField("accelRate", a);
        385:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
        386:       sendStatus(buf);
        387:     }
        388:     return;
        389:   }
        390: 
        391:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        392:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        393:     configSaveUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        394:     configSaveUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        395:     configSaveUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        396:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        397:     return;
        398:   }
        399:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        400:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        401:     configSaveUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        402:     configSaveUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        403:     configSaveUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        404:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        405:     return;
        406:   }
        407: 
        408:   // KNOBELN
        409:   if (cmd.startsWith("KNOBELN:")) {
        410:     String sub = cmd.substring(8);
        411:     if (sub.startsWith("SET:")) {
        412:       String rest = sub.substring(4);
        413:       int colon = rest.indexOf(':');
        414:       if (colon < 0) return;
        415:       uint8_t len = (uint8_t)rest.substring(0, colon).toInt();
        416:       String arr = rest.substring(colon + 1);
        417:       if (len == 0 || len > KNOBELN_MAX) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:BADLEN"); return; }
        418:       knobelnLen = 0;
        419:       int start = 0;
        420:       while (knobelnLen < len) {
        421:         int comma = arr.indexOf(',', start);
        422:         String part = (comma < 0) ? arr.substring(start) : arr.substring(start, comma);
        423:         int v = part.toInt();
        424:         if (v < 0 || v > 3) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:BADARROW"); return; }
        425:         knobelnSeq[knobelnLen++] = (uint8_t)v;
        426:         if (comma < 0) break;
        427:         start = comma + 1;
        428:       }
        429:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "KNOBELN:READY:%u", knobelnLen);
        430:       sendStatus(buf);
        431:     } else if (sub == "RUN") {
        432:       knobelnExecute();
        433:     } else if (sub == "STOP") {
        434:       currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        435:       stopMotors();
        436:       sendStatus("KNOBELN:STOPPED");
        437:     }
        438:     return;
        439:   }
        440: 
        441:   // KORRIGIEREN
        442:   if (cmd.startsWith("QUIZ:")) {
        443:     String sub = cmd.substring(5);
        444:     if (sub.startsWith("CHECK:")) {
        445:       String arr = sub.substring(6);
        446:       korrigierenLen = 0;
        447:       int start = 0;
        448:       while (korrigierenLen < KORRIGIEREN_MAX) {
        449:         int comma = arr.indexOf(',', start);
        450:         String part = (comma < 0) ? arr.substring(start) : arr.substring(start, comma);
        451:         part.trim();
        452:         part.toUpperCase();
        453:         strlcpy(korrigierenExpected[korrigierenLen], part.c_str(), sizeof(korrigierenExpected[0]));
        454:         korrigierenLen++;
        455:         if (comma < 0) break;
        456:         start = comma + 1;
        457:       }
        458:       korrigierenExecute();
        459:     } else if (sub == "STOP") {
        460:       currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        461:       korrigierenRunning = false;
        462:       stopMotors();
        463:       sendStatus("QUIZ:STOPPED");
        464:     }
        465:     return;
        466:   }

[ASSISTANT]: Jetzt das Implementierungsfile. Ich nutze eine asynchrone Schleife (nicht blockierend), die im loop läuft. Da der Roboter nur einen einzelnen Farbsensor hat (kein Array), realisiere ich das folgen mit einer alternativen Strategie: er fährt geradeaus solange er Schwarz sieht, sucht bei Verlust durch kleine Richtungsänderungen.

    [TOOL: write | completed]
      Datei: C:\Users\livio\Livio Scherrer\Codes VS\Edu_V1.3\src\LineFollower.cpp
      Inhalt (188 Zeilen):
        // EduBot V1.3 - Linienfolge-Implementierung
        // Folgt einer schwarzen Linie auf hellem Untergrund mit dem TCS34725.
        // Da nur ein einzelner Farbsensor vorhanden ist, wird eine Such-Strategie
        // verwendet: fahre geradeaus solange Schwarz erkannt wird; beim Verlust
        // der Linie: kurzes Stoppen, dann abwechselnd rechts/links Such-Drehungen.
        // Laeuft nicht-blockierend ueber lineFollowerTick() in der Main-Loop.
        #include "LineFollower.h"
        #include "Motor.h"
        #include "ColorSensor.h"
        #include "Config.h"
        
        bool lineFollowerActive = false;
        
        namespace {
          // Zustands-Automat
          enum LineState : uint8_t {
            LS_IDLE = 0,   // nicht aktiv
            LS_FORWARD,   // Linie erkannt -> geradeaus
            LS_LOST,       // Linie verloren -> Such-Phase
            LS_SEARCH_L,   // Suche links (Drehung)
            LS_SEARCH_R    // Suche rechts (Drehung)
          };
          LineState lsState = LS_IDLE;
        
          // Timing
          uint32_t lsStateEnterMs = 0;  // wann der aktuelle Zustand begann
          uint32_t lsLastSeenMs = 0;    // wann Schwarz zuletzt erkannt wurde
        
          // Konfiguration
          // Geschwindigkeit beim Folgen (geradeaus)
          const float LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED = 380.0f;
          // Geschwindigkeit beim Suchen (Drehen)
          const float LINE_SEARCH_SPEED = 320.0f;
          // Wie lange ohne Linie geradeaus weiterfahren, bevor Suche beginnt
          const uint32_t LINE_GRACE_MS = 80;
          // Such-Drehungen: Dauer und maximale Versuche pro Seite
          const uint32_t LINE_SEARCH_TURN_MS = 140;
          const uint8_t  LINE_SEARCH_MAX_TRIES = 4;   // pro Seite
          uint8_t lsSearchTries = 0;                  // Zaehler der Such-Versuche
        
          // Gepufferte Sensorablesung (nicht blockierend)
          bool lineDetected = false;
        
          void changeState(LineState next) {
            lsState = next;
            lsStateEnterMs = millis();
          }
        
          bool readLineDetected() {
            // Schmidt-Trigger: einmal "schwarz" ->总值 < COLOR_LOW阈值
            // Wir nehmen den aktuellsten sensorName aus der Task. Das ist sicher
            // nicht-blockierend, da String ueber Semaphore kopiert wird.
            char nm[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
            getCurrentColorName(nm, sizeof(nm));
            return (strcasecmp(nm, "SCHWARZ") == 0);
          }
        
          void motorsForward(float v) {
            speedL = v; speedR = v;
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
          }
          void motorsTurnLeft(float v) {
            speedL = -v; speedR = v;
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
          }
          void motorsTurnRight(float v) {
            speedL = v; speedR = -v;
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
          }
          void motorsOff() {
            speedL = 0.0f; speedR = 0.0f;
            stopMotors();
          }
        }
        
        void lineFollowerStart() {
          if (lineFollowerActive) return;
          lineFollowerActive = true;
          lsSearchTries = 0;
          lsLastSeenMs = millis();
          motorsForward(LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED);
          changeState(LS_FORWARD);
          Serial.println("[LINE] Folge starten");
        }
        
        void lineFollowerStop() {
          if (!lineFollowerActive) return;
          motorsOff();
          lineFollowerActive = false;
          lsState = LS_IDLE;
          lsSearchTries = 0;
          Serial.println("[LINE] Gestoppt");
        }
        
        void lineFollowerTick() {
          if (!lineFollowerActive) return;
        
          // Sensordaten aktualisieren (eine Ablesung pro Tick)
          lineDetected = readLineDetected();
          uint32_t now = millis();
        
          if (lineDetected) {
            lsLastSeenMs = now;
            lsSearchTries = 0;
          }
        
          switch (lsState) {
            case LS_IDLE:
              // Sollte bei aktiven Modus nicht vorkommen, aber sicherheitshalber
              motorsOff();
              break;
        
            case LS_FORWARD: {
              if (lineDetected) {
                // Weiter geradeaus - Status bleibt, aber Last-Seen aktualisieren
                // (ggf. Geschwindigkeit auffrischen, falls von Suche kommend)
                if (speedL != LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED || speedR != LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED) {
                  motorsForward(LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED);
                }
              } else {
                // Linie verloren -> kurz geradeaus (Grace), dann Suche beginnen
                if (now - lsLastSeenMs > LINE_GRACE_MS) {
                  motorsOff();
                  lsSearchTries = 0;
                  changeState(LS_LOST);
                }
              }
              break;
            }
        
            case LS_LOST: {
              // Kurz stoppen, dann abwechselnd links/rechts suchen
              // Start mit links (erster Versuch)
              if (now - lsStateEnterMs > 60) {
                lsSearchTries = 0;
                motorsTurnLeft(LINE_SEARCH_SPEED);
                changeState(LS_SEARCH_L);
              }
              break;
            }
        
            case LS_SEARCH_L: {
              if (lineDetected) {
                // Linie wieder da -> vorwaerts
                motorsForward(LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED);
                changeState(LS_FORWARD);
              } else if (now - lsStateEnterMs > LINE_SEARCH_TURN_MS) {
                lsSearchTries++;
                if (lsSearchTries >= LINE_SEARCH_MAX_TRIES) {
                  // chẳng: jetzt rechts suchen (zuerst voll zurueck rechts,
                  // dann weiter nach rechts suchen)
                  lsSearchTries = 0;
                  motorsTurnRight(LINE_SEARCH_SPEED);
                  changeState(LS_SEARCH_R);
                } else {
                  // nochmal links drehen
                  motorsTurnLeft(LINE_SEARCH_SPEED);
                  changeState(LS_SEARCH_L);
                }
              }
              break;
            }
        
            case LS_SEARCH_R: {
              if (lineDetected) {
                motorsForward(LINE_FOLLOW_SPEED);
                changeState(LS_FORWARD);
              } else if (now - lsStateEnterMs > LINE_SEARCH_TURN_MS) {
                lsSearchTries++;
                if (lsSearchTries >= LINE_SEARCH_MAX_TRIES * 2) {
                  // Linie endgueltig verloren -> anhalten, melden
                  motorsOff();
                  lineFollowerActive = false;
                  lsState = LS_IDLE;
                  Serial.println("[LINE] Linie verloren - Stopp");
                  // Status-Meldung wird in main via extern gemacht
                } else {
                  motorsTurnRight(LINE_SEARCH_SPEED);
                  changeState(LS_SEARCH_R);
                }
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        // EduBot V1.3 - Drive-Implementierung
        #include "Drive.h"
        #include "Motor.h"
        #include "Config.h"
        
        bool keyW = false;
        bool keyA = false;
        bool keyS = false;
        bool keyD = false;
        
        float speedL = 0.0;
        float speedR = 0.0;
        
        unsigned long lastCommandTime = 0;
        unsigned long lastUpdateMicros = 0;
        
        void driveClearKeys() {
          keyW = false; keyA = false; keyS = false; keyD = false;
        }
        
        void driveHardStop() {
          driveClearKeys();
          speedL = 0.0;
          speedR = 0.0;
          stopMotors();
        }
        
        void driveResetDt() {
          lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        }
        
        void driveUpdate() {
          // Waehrend ein Spiel aktiv ist, wird die Bewegung von der Spiel-Engine
          // blockierend gesteuert - KEYS: vom Frontend werden ignoriert.
          // (Der Aufrufer in main entscheidet, ob driveUpdate() aufgerufen wird.)
          extern bool driveLockedByGame();
          if (driveLockedByGame()) return;
        
          float targetL = 0.0;
          float targetR = 0.0;
        
          bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
          bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
          bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
          bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        
          if (forward) { targetL = config.maxSpeed; targetR = config.maxSpeed; }
          else if (backward) { targetL = -config.maxSpeed; targetR = -config.maxSpeed; }
          if (forward || backward) {
            if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
            if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
          }
          if (!forward && !backward) {
            if (left)  { targetL = 0; targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed; }
            else if (right) { targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed; targetR = 0; }
          }
        
          if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
            targetL = 0.0; targetR = 0.0;
            if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
              speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
              driveClearKeys();
              stopMotors();
            }
            lastUpdateMicros = micros();
            return;
          }
        
          unsigned long now = micros();
          float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
          lastUpdateMicros = now;
          if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        
          float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
          if (newSpeedL != speedL) { speedL = newSpeedL; setMotorSpeed(0, speedL); }
          float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
          if (newSpeedR != speedR) { speedR = newSpeedR; setMotorSpeed(1, speedR); }
        }

        // EduBot V1.3 - Motor-Modul (DRV8834 Stepper, Bresenham-Timer)
        #pragma once
        
        #include <Arduino.h>
        #include <driver/timer.h>
        #include "soc/gpio_struct.h"
        
        // Stepper-Pins (Xiao ESP32-S3)
        #define PIN_DIR_L   3
        #define PIN_STEP_L  4
        #define PIN_DIR_R   1
        #define PIN_STEP_R  2
        #define PIN_ENABLE  7
        
        #define STEP_BIT_L  (1UL << PIN_STEP_L)
        #define STEP_BIT_R  (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)
        
        // Stepper-Timing
        constexpr uint32_t STEP_TIMER_US      = 10;
        constexpr uint32_t MIN_STEP_INTERVAL  = 50;
        constexpr uint32_t MAX_STEP_INTERVAL  = 50000;
        constexpr uint32_t STEP_PERIOD_US     = 1000000UL;
        
        extern portMUX_TYPE stepperMux;
        
        // Geschwindigkeiten (fuer Drive/GameLogic lesbar)
        extern volatile uint32_t stepIntervalL, stepIntervalR;
        
        // Motor ansteuern (Geschwindigkeit in "steps/s", Vorzeichen = Richtung)
        void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed);
        // Beide Motoren sofort stoppen

    [TOOL: local-files_read_text_file | completed]
      path: C:\Users\livio\Livio Scherrer\Codes VS\Edu_V1.3\src\Motor.cpp
      Ausgabe:
        // EduBot V1.3 - Motor-Implementierung
        #include "Motor.h"
        #include "Config.h"
        
        portMUX_TYPE stepperMux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
        
        uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        volatile uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        volatile uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        
        static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        
        bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
          if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
          if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        
          if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
            stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
            if (stepFracAccumL >= 0x10000UL) {
              stepFracAccumL -= 0x10000UL;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
              stepPhaseL = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumL = 0;
          }
          if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
            stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
            if (stepFracAccumR >= 0x10000UL) {
              stepFracAccumR -= 0x10000UL;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
              stepPhaseR = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumR = 0;
          }
          return false;
        }
        
        void initStepperTimer() {
          timer_config_t cfg = {};
          cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
          cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
          cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
          cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
          cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
          cfg.divider = 80;
        
          timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
          timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
          timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
          timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
          timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
          timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        }
        
        void IRAM_ATTR setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
          const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        
          float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        
          if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
          } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
            actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
          } else {
            if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
            else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
            GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
            portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
            return;
          }
        
          uint32_t speedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
          if (speedInt < 1) speedInt = 1;
        
          uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / speedInt;
          if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
          if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        
          uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * 0x10000UL) / interval;
        
          if (motorIdx == 0) {
            stepIntervalL = interval;
            stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
            stepFracAccumL = 0;
          } else {
            stepIntervalR = interval;
            stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
            stepFracAccumR = 0;
          }
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        void IRAM_ATTR stopMotors() {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          stepIntervalL = 0;
          stepIntervalR = 0;
          stepFracAddL = 0;
          stepFracAddR = 0;
          stepFracAccumL = 0;
          stepFracAccumR = 0;
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
          float diff = target - current;
          if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
            return target;
          }
          float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
          if (diff > 0) {
            current += maxChange;
            if (current > target) current = target;
          } else {
            current -= maxChange;
            if (current < target) current = target;
          }
          return current;
        }
