        const uint32_t GAME_DRIVE_MS     = GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 3;  // ~270ms Vor/Rueck
        const uint32_t GAME_KNOBELN_MS   = GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4;  // ~360ms Pfeil-Knobeln
        const uint32_t GAME_QUIZ_MS      = GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 3;  // ~270ms Korrigieren/Race
        
        bool gameMoveBusy = false;
        
        void gameDriveForward(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          const float target = config.maxSpeed * GAME_DRIVE_GAIN;
          const uint32_t rampMs = (ms / 3 > 120) ? 120 : ms / 3;
          uint32_t elapsed = 0;
          uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
          speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          while (elapsed < ms) {
            uint32_t now = micros();
            float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
            lastMicros = now;
            if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
            float curTarget;
            if (elapsed < rampMs) {
              curTarget = target * ((float)elapsed / (float)rampMs);
            } else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) {
              curTarget = target;
            } else {
              float left = (float)(ms - elapsed) / (float)rampMs;
              if (left < 0.0f) left = 0.0f;
              curTarget = target * left;
            }
            speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
            speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
            elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
            if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameDriveBackward(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          const float target = -config.maxSpeed * GAME_DRIVE_GAIN;
          const uint32_t rampMs = (ms / 3 > 120) ? 120 : ms / 3;
          uint32_t elapsed = 0;
          uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
          speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          while (elapsed < ms) {
            uint32_t now = micros();
            float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
            lastMicros = now;
            if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
            float curTarget;
            if (elapsed < rampMs) {
              curTarget = target * ((float)elapsed / (float)rampMs);
            } else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) {
              curTarget = target;
            } else {
              float left = (float)(ms - elapsed) / (float)rampMs;
              if (left < 0.0f) left = 0.0f;
              curTarget = target * left;
            }
            speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
            speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
            elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
            if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameTurnLeft(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          const float target = config.turnOnlySpeed;  // positive Geschwindigkeit, Richtung ueber Vorzeichen
          const uint32_t rampMs = (ms / 3 > 120) ? 120 : ms / 3;
          uint32_t elapsed = 0;
          uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
          speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          while (elapsed < ms) {
            uint32_t now = micros();
            float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
            lastMicros = now;
            if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
            float curTarget;
            if (elapsed < rampMs) {
              curTarget = target * ((float)elapsed / (float)rampMs);
            } else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) {
              curTarget = target;
            } else {
              float left = (float)(ms - elapsed) / (float)rampMs;
              if (left < 0.0f) left = 0.0f;
              curTarget = target * left;
            }
            speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, -curTarget, dt);  // Links rueckwaerts
            speedR = rampSpeed(speedR,  curTarget, dt);  // Rechts vorwaerts -> Drehung links
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
            elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
            if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameTurnRight(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          const float target = config.turnOnlySpeed;
          const uint32_t rampMs = (ms / 3 > 120) ? 120 : ms / 3;
          uint32_t elapsed = 0;
          uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
          speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          while (elapsed < ms) {
            uint32_t now = micros();
            float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
            lastMicros = now;
            if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
            float curTarget;
            if (elapsed < rampMs) {
              curTarget = target * ((float)elapsed / (float)rampMs);
            } else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) {
              curTarget = target;
            } else {
              float left = (float)(ms - elapsed) / (float)rampMs;
              if (left < 0.0f) left = 0.0f;
              curTarget = target * left;
            }
            speedL = rampSpeed(speedL,  curTarget, dt);  // Links vorwaerts
            speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, -curTarget, dt);  // Rechts rueckwaerts -> Drehung rechts
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
            elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
            if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameStop(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(ms));
          gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // KNOBELN (Pfeil-Sequenz abfahren)
        // =====================================================
        constexpr uint8_t KNOBELN_MAX = 32;
        uint8_t knobelnSeq[KNOBELN_MAX];
        uint8_t knobelnLen = 0;
        
        void knobelnExecute() {
          if (knobelnLen == 0) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:NONE"); return; }
          currentGame = GAME_KNOBELN;
          sendStatus("KNOBELN:RUNNING");
          for (uint8_t i = 0; i < knobelnLen; i++) {
            if (currentGame != GAME_KNOBELN) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:ABORT"); return; }
            switch (knobelnSeq[i]) {
              case 0: gameDriveForward(GAME_KNOBELN_MS); break;
              case 1: gameTurnRight(GAME_TURN_MS); break;
              case 2: gameDriveBackward(GAME_KNOBELN_MS); break;
              case 3: gameTurnLeft(GAME_TURN_MS); break;
            }
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(80));
          }
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          sendStatus("KNOBELN:DONE");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // KORRIGIEREN (Farb-Quiz)
        // =====================================================
        constexpr uint8_t KORRIGIEREN_MAX = 16;
        char korrigierenExpected[KORRIGIEREN_MAX][16];
        char korrigierenFound[KORRIGIEREN_MAX][16];
        uint8_t korrigierenLen = 0;
        bool korrigierenRunning = false;
        
        void korrigierenExecute() {
          if (korrigierenLen == 0) { sendStatus("QUIZ:RESULT:OK,0,0"); return; }
          korrigierenRunning = true;
          currentGame = GAME_KORRIGIEREN;
          sendStatus("QUIZ:CHECKING");
          uint8_t okCount = 0;
          for (uint8_t i = 0; i < korrigierenLen; i++) {
            if (currentGame != GAME_KORRIGIEREN) { sendStatus("QUIZ:RESULT:ABORT"); return; }
            gameDriveForward(GAME_QUIZ_MS);
            gameStop(GAME_COLOR_READ_MS);
            char found[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
            getCurrentColorName(found, sizeof(found));
            strlcpy(korrigierenFound[i], found, sizeof(korrigierenFound[i]));
            if (strcasecmp(korrigierenExpected[i], found) == 0) okCount++;
            char part[48];
            snprintf(part, sizeof(part), "QUIZ:STEP:%u,%s,%s", i, korrigierenExpected[i], found);
            sendStatus(part);
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          korrigierenRunning = false;
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          char result[48];
          if (okCount == korrigierenLen)
            snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:OK,%u,%u", okCount, korrigierenLen);
          else
            snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:WRONG,%u,%u", okCount, korrigierenLen);
          sendStatus(result);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // RENNEN (Multiplayer)
        // =====================================================
        int  raceMyScore = 0;
        volatile int  raceOppScore = 0;
        volatile bool raceActive = false;
        bool quizActive = false;
        
        void raceExecuteStart(bool remote = false) {
          currentGame = GAME_RENNEN;
          raceMyScore = 0;
          raceOppScore = 0;
          raceActive = true;
          sendStatus(remote ? "RACE:REMOTE_START" : "RACE:STARTED");
        }
        
        void raceForwardStep() {
          if (!raceActive) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; return; }
          gameDriveForward(GAME_QUIZ_MS);
          if (!raceActive) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; }
        }
        
        void onRacePacket(const RacePacket* pkt) {
          if (pkt->flags & RACE_FLAG_WINNER || pkt->score >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE) {
            raceOppScore = pkt->score;
            raceActive = false;
            currentGame = GAME_NONE;
            stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
            sendStatus("RACE:OPP_WIN");
          } else {
            if (!raceActive) raceExecuteStart(true);
            raceOppScore = pkt->score;
            char msg[32];
            snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "RACE:PROGRESS:%u", raceOppScore);
            sendStatus(msg);
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // BLE-CONNECT/DISCONNECT-HANDLER
        // =====================================================
        void onBleConnected() {
          deviceConnected = true;
          lastCommandTime = millis();
          driveResetDt();
          Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
          sendStatus("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
        }
        
        void onBleDisconnected() {
          deviceConnected = false;
          driveClearKeys();
          speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
          stopMotors();
          raceActive = false;
          quizActive = false;
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          knobelnLen = 0;
          korrigierenLen = 0;
          korrigierenRunning = false;
          memoryStop();
          Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt - Werbung gestartet");
          BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
          espNowEnsureChannel();
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // COMMAND-HANDLER
        // =====================================================
        void hardStop() {
          driveClearKeys();
          speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
          stopMotors();
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          knobelnLen = 0;
          korrigierenLen = 0;
          korrigierenRunning = false;
          raceActive = false;
          memoryStop();
          sendStatus("STOP");
        }
        
        void handleCommand(const char* cmdStr) {
          String cmd(cmdStr);
          cmd.trim();
          cmd.toUpperCase();
          lastCommandTime = millis();
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
            String data = cmd.substring(5);
            if (data.length() >= 4) {
              keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
              keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
              keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
              keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
            }
            return;
          }
        
          Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
          if (cmd == "STOP") { hardStop(); return; }
        
          char buf[48];
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
            float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
              config.maxSpeed = v;
              configSaveField("maxSpeed", v);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
            float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
            if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
              config.turnFactor = t;
              configSaveField("turnFactor", t);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
            float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
              config.accelRate = a;
              configSaveField("accelRate", a);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
            config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
            configSaveUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
            configSaveUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
            configSaveUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
            sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
            return;
          }
          if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
            config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
            configSaveUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
            configSaveUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
            configSaveUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
            sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
            return;
          }
        
          // KNOBELN
          if (cmd.startsWith("KNOBELN:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(8);
            if (sub.startsWith("SET:")) {
              String rest = sub.substring(4);
              int colon = rest.indexOf(':');
              if (colon < 0) return;
              uint8_t len = (uint8_t)rest.substring(0, colon).toInt();
              String arr = rest.substring(colon + 1);
              if (len == 0 || len > KNOBELN_MAX) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:BADLEN"); return; }
              knobelnLen = 0;
              int start = 0;
              while (knobelnLen < len) {
                int comma = arr.indexOf(',', start);
                String part = (comma < 0) ? arr.substring(start) : arr.substring(start, comma);
                int v = part.toInt();
                if (v < 0 || v > 3) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:BADARROW"); return; }
                knobelnSeq[knobelnLen++] = (uint8_t)v;
                if (comma < 0) break;
                start = comma + 1;
              }
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "KNOBELN:READY:%u", knobelnLen);
              sendStatus(buf);
            } else if (sub == "RUN") {
              knobelnExecute();
            } else if (sub == "STOP") {
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              stopMotors();
              sendStatus("KNOBELN:STOPPED");
            }
            return;
          }
        
          // KORRIGIEREN
          if (cmd.startsWith("QUIZ:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(5);
            if (sub.startsWith("CHECK:")) {
              String arr = sub.substring(6);
              korrigierenLen = 0;
              int start = 0;
              while (korrigierenLen < KORRIGIEREN_MAX) {
                int comma = arr.indexOf(',', start);
                String part = (comma < 0) ? arr.substring(start) : arr.substring(start, comma);
                part.trim();
                part.toUpperCase();
                strlcpy(korrigierenExpected[korrigierenLen], part.c_str(), sizeof(korrigierenExpected[0]));
                korrigierenLen++;
                if (comma < 0) break;
                start = comma + 1;
              }
              korrigierenExecute();
            } else if (sub == "STOP") {
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              korrigierenRunning = false;
              stopMotors();
              sendStatus("QUIZ:STOPPED");
            }
            return;
          }
        
          // RENNEN
          if (cmd.startsWith("RACE:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(5);
            if (sub == "START") {
              raceExecuteStart();
              raceSendPacket(0, false);
            } else if (sub == "STEP") {
              if (!raceActive) return;
              raceMyScore++;
              raceForwardStep();
              if (!raceActive) return;
              raceSendPacket((uint8_t)raceMyScore, raceMyScore >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "RACE:ME:%d", raceMyScore);
              sendStatus(buf);
              if (raceMyScore >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE) {
                raceActive = false;
                currentGame = GAME_NONE;
                stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
                sendStatus("RACE:YOU_WIN");
              }
            } else if (sub == "WIN") {
              raceActive = false;
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
              raceSendPacket((uint8_t)RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE, true);
            } else if (sub == "LOSE") {
              raceActive = false;
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
              raceSendPacket((uint8_t)raceMyScore, false);
            } else if (sub == "SCAN") {
              raceSendHello();
              sendStatus("RACE:SCAN_START");
            } else if (sub == "UNPAIR") {
              raceUnpair();
              sendStatus("RACE:UNPAIRED");
            } else if (sub.startsWith("PAIR:")) {
              String macStr = sub.substring(5);
              uint8_t mac[6] = {0,0,0,0,0,0};
              int idx = 0;
              int pos = 0;
              while (idx < 6 && pos < macStr.length()) {
                String hexByte = macStr.substring(pos, pos + 2);
                mac[idx++] = (uint8_t)strtol(hexByte.c_str(), nullptr, 16);
                pos += 3;
              }
              if (idx == 6) {
                racePairWith(mac);
                char conf[48];
                snprintf(conf, sizeof(conf), "RACE:PAIRED:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
                  mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
                sendStatus(conf);
              } else {
                sendStatus("RACE:PAIR_FAIL");
              }
            } else if (sub.startsWith("PROGRESS:")) {
              raceOppScore = sub.substring(9).toInt();
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "RACE:PROGRESS:%d", raceOppScore);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          // MEMORY (A1)
          if (cmd.startsWith("MEMORY:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(7);
            if (sub == "START") {
              currentGame = GAME_MEMORY;
              memoryStart(3);
            } else if (sub.startsWith("START:")) {
              uint8_t n = (uint8_t)sub.substring(6).toInt();
              if (n < 3) n = 3;
              if (n > MEMORY_MAX_LEN) n = MEMORY_MAX_LEN;
              currentGame = GAME_MEMORY;
              memoryStart(n);
            } else if (sub == "STOP") {
              memoryStop();
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
            } else if (sub.startsWith("INPUT:")) {
              uint8_t m = (uint8_t)sub.substring(6).toInt();
              memoryInput(m);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          sendStatus((String("UNKNOWN:") + cmd).c_str());
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // SETUP
        // =====================================================
        void setup() {
          Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
          Serial.println("\n======================================");
          Serial.println("EduBot V1.3 - Modular");
          Serial.println("======================================");
        
          esp_task_wdt_init(10000, true);
          esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        
          configLoad();
        
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_L, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_STEP_L, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_R, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_STEP_R, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW);
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        
          lastCommandTime = millis();
          driveResetDt();
        
          initStepperTimer();
          Serial.println("[TIMER] Hardware-Timer gestartet (10 us)");
        
          colorSetup();
          if (colorSensorOk) {
            xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(
              colorSensorTask, "ColorSensor",
              STACK_COLOR_SENSOR, NULL, TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR, NULL, CORE_SENSOR
            );
            Serial.println("[TASK] ColorSensor-Task gestartet (Core 0)");
          }
        
          espNowInit();
          bleSetup();
          espNowEnsureChannel();
          Serial.println("======================================\n");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // LOOP
        // =====================================================
        unsigned long lastColorNotify = 0;
        void loop() {
          esp_task_wdt_reset();
          bleProcessEvents();
          memoryTick();
          if (!driveLockedByGame()) driveUpdate();
          if (deviceConnected && millis() - lastColorNotify > COLOR_NOTIFY_MS) {
            lastColorNotify = millis();
            sendColorToWebsite();
          }
          configSaveIfDirty();
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(LOOP_DELAY_MS));
        }

        <content>
        1: ### Designdefinition: Hand-Drawn Sketch-System (EduBot V1.3)
        2: 
        3: #### 1. Stil-Philosophie
        4: Das Design verfolgt einen **"DIY / Anti-AI-Polish"**-Ansatz. Es vermeidet symmetrische, glatte Glas- oder Claymorphism-Effekte zugunsten eines handgezeichneten, organischen Looks. Das Interface wirkt wie auf Papier skizziert, mit bewussten Imperfektionen.
        5: 
        6: #### 2. Visuelle Tokens (CSS-Variablen-Struktur)
        7: *   **Farbpalette:** Warmes, erdige Tonalität basierend auf Teal (`--teal-50` bis `900`) und Amber (`--amber-50` bis `700`).
        8:     *   `--paper`: `#f5efe1` (Hintergrund-Grundton)
        9:     *   `--ink`: `#1f1a14` (Primäre Kontur- und Textfarbe)
        10: *   **Typografie:** Kursive Handschrift-Fonts (`Caveat`, `Patrick Hand`, `Marker Felt`, `Comic Sans MS` als Fallback).
        11: *   **Strichstärken:** `--ink-line` (2.5px), `--ink-line-bold` (3px) für Outlines.
        12: *   **Schatten-System:** **Kein Blur-Blur-Effekt**. Ausschließlich harte **Offset-Schatten** (`3px 3px 0 var(--ink)`).
        13: 
        14: #### 3. Layout-Elemente
        15: *   **Hintergrund:** Kombinierter Hintergrund aus CSS-Linien (`repeating-linear-gradient`) und einem SVG-Noise-Overlay (Fractal Noise) zur Simulation von Papiertextur.
        16: *   **Tiles (Cards):**
        17:     *   `border-radius`: Asymmetrisch (z.B. `14px 18px 14px 20px`), um einen handgezeichneten Eindruck zu erzeugen.
        18:     *   `border`: 2.5px solid Ink.
        19:     *   `box-shadow`: Harter Offset (`3px 3px 0 var(--ink)`).
        20:     *   `transform`: Leichte Rotation (`rotate(-.4deg)` oder `.3deg`), um die Karten nicht perfekt horizontal auszurichten.
        21: *   **Buttons:**
        22:     *   Outlined, Offset-Schatten.
        23:     *   Scribble-Akzente: Pseudo-Elemente (`::before`) mit kleinen, rotierten Linien oben links, um den Bleistift-Look zu verstärken.
        24: *   **Feedback (Post-it Look):**
        25:     *   Dicke Outlines, Offset-Schatten, leichtes `@keyframes popIn` mit Rotation für einen "hingeklebten" Effekt.
        26: 
        27: #### 4. Interaktions-Logik
        28: *   **Hover:** `transform: translate(-1px, -1px)` und der Offset-Schatten vergrößert sich auf `4px 4px 0 var(--ink)`.
        29: *   **Active:** `transform: translate(3px, 3px)` – der Button bewegt sich "in den Schatten hinein", der Schatten verschwindet (`box-shadow: 0 0 0`), was einen haptischen, mechanischen Klick-Effekt erzeugt.
        30: 
        31: #### 5. Spezielle CSS-Implementierungen
        32: *   **Header:**
        33:     *   Dekorative Washi-Tape-Leiste (`repeating-linear-gradient` mit Streifen) oben am Header.
        34:     *   `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` und halb-transparente Hintergründe (`rgba(255,255,255,.12)`) für Status-Badges und Buttons.
        35: *   **Container/Arena:**
        36:     *   Hand-gezeichnete Boxen mit asymmetrischem Border-Radius.
        37:     *   Gestrichelte Border (`border: 2px dashed var(--ink)`) für Hinweise, um einen Notizblock-Charakter zu erzeugen.

        <div class="help-modal" id="helpModal">
          <div class="help-modal-card">

            <div class="help-modal-body">
              <p><b>Wofuer ist diese Seite?</b><br>
                Du kannst hier Fahrgeschwindigkeit und Beschleunigung direkt am Roboter einstellen und in einem A/B-Vergleich herausfinden, was sich am besten anfuehlt.</p>
        
              <p><b>Was kann ich einstellen?</b></p>
              <ul>
                <li><b>MAX Speed</b> – maximale Schrittgeschwindigkeit in steps/s (200–2500). Hoeher = schneller.</li>
                <li><b>ACC</b> – Beschleunigungsrate in steps/s² (100–10000). Hoeher = schnelleres Anfahren.</li>
                <li><b>TURN-Faktor</b> – wie stark der innere Motor beim Kurvenfahren verlangsamt wird (0 = ohne Kurve, 0.9 = enge Kurve).</li>
                <li><b>TURN-Only Speed</b> – Geschwindigkeit, mit der der Roboter auf der Stelle dreht.</li>
              </ul>
        
              <p><b>Was ist fest im Code?</b><br>
                Die Dauer pro Schritt (ca. <code>270 ms</code> fuer game drive, <code>320 ms</code> fuer Drehungen, <code>360 ms</code> fuer Knobeln) und der GAME_DRIVE_GAIN (0.65) sind im Arduino-Sketch als <code>constexpr</code> hinterlegt. Sie werden automatisch persistent im NVS gespeichert, sobald du sie per <code>MAX:</code>, <code>ACC:</code> oder <code>TURN:</code> ueberträgst.</p>
        
              <p><b>So testest du:</b></p>
              <ul>
                <li>Stelle in A und B verschiedene Werte ein.</li>
                <li>Druecke <b>Anwenden</b>, um die Werte an den Roboter zu senden (MAX:/TURN:/ACC:).</li>
                <li>Druecke <b>Test 1 Schritt</b>, um den Roboter einen Schritt mit dieser Konfiguration fahren zu lassen.</li>
                <li>Markiere am Boden, wie weit er gefahren ist.</li>
                <li>Vergib Sterne fuer die Variante, die sich besser angefuehlt hat.</li>
                <li>Die hoeher bewertete Variante gewinnt - du kannst sie am Ende auf den Roboter speichern.</li>
              </ul>
        
              <p><b>Tipp:</b> Miss die zurueckgelegte Strecke pro Schritt bei verschiedenen MAX-Werten. So findest du heraus, welche Geschwindigkeit pro Schritt die gewuenschte Spielfeld-Groesse trifft.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          // =====================================================
          // BLE - gleiche UUIDs wie EduBot V1.3 Hauptseite
          // =====================================================
          const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
          const CMD_UUID     = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
          const STATUS_UUID  = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        
          let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
          let connected = false, reconnecting = false;
          let writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
        
          // Keys-Frame sendet die WASD-Position
          const keys = { w:0, a:0, s:0, d:0 };
          let keysSending = false;
          let lastSentKeys = '0000';
        
          // =====================================================
          // LOG
          // =====================================================
          const logBox = document.getElementById('logBox');
          function logLine(msg, kind) {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'row';
            const t = new Date();
            const ts = String(t.getHours()).padStart(2,'0') + ':' +
                       String(t.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0') + ':' +
                       String(t.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0');
            const tsEl = document.createElement('span'); tsEl.className = 'ts'; tsEl.textContent = ts;
            const msgEl = document.createElement('span'); msgEl.className = 'msg' + (kind ? ' ' + kind : ''); msgEl.textContent = msg;
            row.appendChild(tsEl); row.appendChild(msgEl);
            logBox.appendChild(row);
            logBox.scrollTop = logBox.scrollHeight;
          }
        
          // =====================================================
          // BLE - Connect / Disconnect
          // =====================================================
          function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
            const dot = document.getElementById('connDot');
            const txt = document.getElementById('connText');
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnConnect');
            dot.classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
            txt.textContent = text;
            btn.textContent = isConn ? 'Verbunden' : 'Verbinden';
            btn.disabled = isConn;
          }
        
          async function connectGatt() {
            if (!device || !device.gatt.connected) {
              const server = await device.gatt.connect();
              const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
              cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
              statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
              await statusChar.startNotifications();
              statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
                handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
              });
            }
            connected = true;
            updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
            startKeysLoop();
            logLine('BLE verbunden', 'ok');
          }
        
          async function connectBLE() {
            try {
              if (!navigator.bluetooth) {
                alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth (Chrome/Edge noetig).');
                return;
              }
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
        
              if (device && device.gatt.connected) {
                await connectGatt();
                return;
              }
        
              device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
                filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
                optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
              });
              device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', onDisconnected);
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Verbinde...');
              await connectGatt();
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('[BLE]', e);
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
              logLine('BLE Fehler: ' + e.message, 'err');
            }
          }
        
          async function onDisconnected() {
            connected = false;
            stopKeysLoop();
            resetKeys();
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
            logLine('BLE getrennt', 'err');
        
            if (!device) return;
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
              reconnecting = true;
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Reconnect ' + (i+1) + '...');
              await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
              try {
                await connectGatt();
                reconnecting = false;
                return;
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[BLE] Reconnect fehlgeschlagen:', e);
              }
            }
            reconnecting = false;
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
          }
        
          async function sendCommand(cmd) {
            if (!connected || !cmdChar) {
              logLine('Sende ohne Verbindung: ' + cmd, 'err');
              return;
            }
            if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
            writing = true;
            try {
              await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd));
            } catch (e) {
              console.warn('[BLE] send error', e);
              logLine('Sende-Fehler: ' + e.message, 'err');
            }
            writing = false;
            if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
          }
        
          // =====================================================
          // STATUS-NACHRICHTEN AUSWERTEN
          // =====================================================
          function handleStatusMessage(raw) {
            const lines = raw.split('\n');
            for (const ln of lines) {
              const m = ln.trim();
              if (!m) continue;
              logLine('← ' + m, 'info');
        
              if (m.startsWith('MAX=')) {
                const v = parseFloat(m.substring(4));
                if (!isNaN(v)) document.getElementById('liveMax').textContent = v.toFixed(0);
              } else if (m.startsWith('TURN=')) {
                const v = parseFloat(m.substring(5));
                if (!isNaN(v)) document.getElementById('liveTurn').textContent = v.toFixed(2);
              } else if (m.startsWith('ACC=')) {
                const v = parseFloat(m.substring(4));
                if (!isNaN(v)) document.getElementById('liveAcc').textContent = v.toFixed(0);
              } else if (m.startsWith('KNOBELN:')) {
                showFeedback('stepFeedback', 'success', 'Schritt gesendet - beobachte den Roboter');
              } else if (m.startsWith('STOP')) {
                showFeedback('manualFeedback', 'info', 'Roboter gestoppt');
              }
            }
          }
        
          // =====================================================
          // TURN-Only ist nicht direkt auswertbar, deshalb zeigen wir
          // einfach den zuletzt gesetzten Wert an (Slider-Default).
          // =====================================================
          document.getElementById('liveTurnOnly').textContent = '550';
        
          // =====================================================
          // FEEDBACK
          // =====================================================
          function showFeedback(elId, kind, text) {
            const el = document.getElementById(elId);
            el.className = 'feedback-msg show feedback-' + kind;
            el.textContent = text;
            setTimeout(() => { el.classList.remove('show'); }, 2200);
          }
        
          // =====================================================
          // MANUELLER LIVE-TEST (WASD)
          // =====================================================
          function resetKeys() { keys.w = keys.a = keys.s = keys.d = 0; }
        
          function startKeysLoop() {
            if (keysSending) return;
            keysSending = true;
            (function tick() {
              if (!keysSending) return;
              const packed = '' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
              if (packed !== lastSentKeys) {
                lastSentKeys = packed;
                sendCommand('KEYS:' + packed);
              }
              requestAnimationFrame(tick);
            })();
          }
          function stopKeysLoop() { keysSending = false; }
        
          document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(btn => {
            const k = btn.dataset.key;
            const press = () => { if (!connected) return; keys[k] = 1; btn.classList.add('active'); };
            const release = () => { keys[k] = 0; btn.classList.remove('active'); };
            btn.addEventListener('mousedown', press);
            btn.addEventListener('mouseup', release);
            btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', release);
            btn.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); press(); });
            btn.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); release(); });
          });
          window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
            if (k in keys && connected) {
              keys[k] = 1;
              const b = document.querySelector('.key-btn[data-key="'+k+'"]');
              if (b) b.classList.add('active');
            }
          });
          window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
            const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
            if (k in keys) {
              keys[k] = 0;
              const b = document.querySelector('.key-btn[data-key="'+k+'"]');
              if (b) b.classList.remove('active');
            }
          });
        
          // Speed-Slider (global)
          const speedSlider = document.getElementById('speedSlider');
          const speedDisplay = document.getElementById('speedDisplay');
          speedSlider.addEventListener('input', e => {
            speedDisplay.textContent = e.target.value;
          });
          speedSlider.addEventListener('change', e => {
            sendCommand('MAX:' + e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('liveMax').textContent = e.target.value;
            showFeedback('manualFeedback', 'success', 'MAX = ' + e.target.value + ' gesendet');
          });
        
          // Stop
          document.getElementById('btnStop').addEventListener('click', () => {
            resetKeys();
            sendCommand('STOP');
            showFeedback('manualFeedback', 'info', 'STOP gesendet');
          });
          document.getElementById('btnConnect').addEventListener('click', connectBLE);
        
          // =====================================================
          // SCHRITT-TEST
          // =====================================================
          document.querySelectorAll('.step-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              if (!connected) {
                showFeedback('stepFeedback', 'error', 'Nicht verbunden');
                return;
              }
              const cmd = btn.dataset.cmd;
              sendCommand(cmd);
              // direkt danach RUN ausfuehren
              setTimeout(() => sendCommand('KNOBELN:RUN'), 60);
              showFeedback('stepFeedback', 'info', btn.textContent.trim() + ' wird ausgefuehrt');
            });
          });
        
          // =====================================================
          // PRESETS
          // =====================================================
          const PRESETS = {
            slow:       { a:{max:500,  acc:4000, turn:0.20, turnOnly:400}, b:{max:650,  acc:4500, turn:0.20, turnOnly:450} },
            normal:     { a:{max:900,  acc:5000, turn:0.25, turnOnly:550}, b:{max:1000, acc:5500, turn:0.25, turnOnly:550} },
            fast:       { a:{max:1300, acc:6500, turn:0.30, turnOnly:600}, b:{max:1500, acc:7000, turn:0.30, turnOnly:650} },
            aggressive: { a:{max:1900, acc:8500, turn:0.35, turnOnly:700}, b:{max:2200, acc:9000, turn:0.40, turnOnly:750} },
          };
        
          function applySlotConfig(slot, cfg) {
            document.querySelector(`.ab-speed[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value = cfg.max;
            document.getElementById(slot.toLowerCase() + 'SpeedDisplay').textContent = cfg.max;
            document.querySelector(`.ab-acc[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value = cfg.acc;
            document.getElementById(slot.toLowerCase() + 'AccDisplay').textContent = cfg.acc;
            document.querySelector(`.ab-turn[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value = cfg.turn;
            document.getElementById(slot.toLowerCase() + 'TurnDisplay').textContent = cfg.turn.toFixed(2);
            document.querySelector(`.ab-turnonly[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value = cfg.turnOnly;
            document.getElementById(slot.toLowerCase() + 'TurnOnlyDisplay').textContent = cfg.turnOnly;
            updateConfigText(slot);
          }
        
          function updateConfigText(slot) {
            const s = slot.toLowerCase();
            const max = document.querySelector(`.ab-speed[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            const acc = document.querySelector(`.ab-acc[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            const turn = parseFloat(document.querySelector(`.ab-turn[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value).toFixed(2);
            const to = document.querySelector(`.ab-turnonly[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            document.getElementById(s + 'Config').innerHTML =
              `<b>${slot}:</b> MAX=${max}, ACC=${acc}, TURN=${turn}, TURNonly=${to}`;
          }
        
          document.querySelectorAll('.preset-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const p = PRESETS[btn.dataset.preset];
              if (!p) return;
              applySlotConfig('A', p.a);
              applySlotConfig('B', p.b);
              // reset ratings
              ['A','B'].forEach(resetStars);
              hideWinner();
              logLine('Preset geladen: ' + btn.dataset.preset, 'info');
            });

              const turn = document.querySelector(`.ab-turn[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;

              const slot = btn.dataset.slot;
              // zuerst Werte anwenden, dann 1 Schritt fahren
              const max = document.querySelector(`.ab-speed[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
              const acc = document.querySelector(`.ab-acc[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
              const turn = document.querySelector(`.ab-turn[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
              sendCommand('MAX:' + max);
              setTimeout(() => sendCommand('ACC:' + acc), 25);
              setTimeout(() => sendCommand('TURN:' + turn), 50);
              setTimeout(() => {
                sendCommand('KNOBELN:SET:1:0');
                setTimeout(() => sendCommand('KNOBELN:RUN'), 50);
              }, 110);
              showFeedback('stepFeedback', 'info', 'Test-Schritt (' + slot + ') wird ausgefuehrt');
            });
          });
        
          // =====================================================
          // STARS / RATING
          // =====================================================
          const ratings = { A: 0, B: 0 };
        
          function setStars(slot, val) {
            ratings[slot] = val;
            const starEls = document.querySelectorAll(`.stars[data-slot="${slot}"] .star`);
            starEls.forEach((s, i) => {
              const on = (i < val);
              s.classList.toggle('on', on);
            });
            updateSummary();
          }
        
          function resetStars(slot) {
            ratings[slot] = 0;
            document.querySelectorAll(`.stars[data-slot="${slot}"] .star`).forEach(s => s.classList.remove('on'));
          }
        
          document.querySelectorAll('.stars').forEach(group => {
            const slot = group.dataset.slot;
            group.querySelectorAll('.star').forEach(star => {
              const val = parseInt(star.dataset.val);
              star.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // toggle: gleiche Bewertung loeschen
                if (ratings[slot] === val) { setStars(slot, 0); return; }
                // kleine Pop-Animation
                star.classList.add('pop');
                setTimeout(() => star.classList.remove('pop'), 350);
                setStars(slot, val);
              });
            });
          });
        
          function hideWinner() {
            document.getElementById('winA').classList.remove('show');
            document.getElementById('winB').classList.remove('show');
            document.getElementById('summaryRow').style.display = 'none';
          }
        
          function updateSummary() {
            if (ratings.A === 0 && ratings.B === 0) { hideWinner(); return; }
            if (ratings.A > ratings.B) {
              document.getElementById('winA').classList.add('show');
              document.getElementById('winB').classList.remove('show');
              showSummary('A');
            } else if (ratings.B > ratings.A) {
              document.getElementById('winB').classList.add('show');
              document.getElementById('winA').classList.remove('show');
              showSummary('B');
            } else {
              hideWinner();
            }
          }
        
          function showSummary(slot) {
            const max = document.querySelector(`.ab-speed[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            const acc = document.querySelector(`.ab-acc[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            const turn = parseFloat(document.querySelector(`.ab-turn[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value).toFixed(2);
            const to = document.querySelector(`.ab-turnonly[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            document.getElementById('summaryWinner').textContent = `Variante ${slot} (${ratings[slot]}/5 ★)`;
            document.getElementById('summaryConfig').textContent = `MAX=${max}  ACC=${acc}  TURN=${turn}  TURNonly=${to}`;
            document.getElementById('summaryRow').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('btnApplyWinner').dataset.slot = slot;
          }
        
          document.getElementById('btnApplyWinner').addEventListener('click', e => {
            const slot = e.currentTarget.dataset.slot;
            if (!slot) return;
            const max = document.querySelector(`.ab-speed[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            const acc = document.querySelector(`.ab-acc[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            const turn = document.querySelector(`.ab-turn[data-slot="${slot}"]`).value;
            if (!connected) { showFeedback('stepFeedback', 'error', 'Nicht verbunden'); return; }
            sendCommand('MAX:' + max);
            setTimeout(() => sendCommand('ACC:' + acc), 30);
            setTimeout(() => sendCommand('TURN:' + turn), 60);
            logLine(`Gewinner ${slot} auf Roboter gespeichert`, 'ok');
            showFeedback('stepFeedback', 'success', `Gewinner ${slot} gespeichert (MAX=${max}, ACC=${acc}, TURN=${turn})`);
          });
        
          // =====================================================
          // HELP-MODAL
          // =====================================================
          document.getElementById('helpFab').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('helpModal').classList.add('open');
          });
          document.getElementById('helpClose').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('helpModal').classList.remove('open');
          });
          document.getElementById('helpModal').addEventListener('click', e => {
            if (e.target.id === 'helpModal') document.getElementById('helpModal').classList.remove('open');
          });
        
          // =====================================================
          // INIT
          // =====================================================
          updateConfigText('A');
          updateConfigText('B');
          logLine('Tuning-Bereit. Bitte verbinden.', 'info');
        </script>

        void configLoad() {
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          config.maxSpeed      = prefs.getFloat("maxSpeed", static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT));
          config.turnFactor    = prefs.getFloat("turnFactor", TURN_DEFAULT);
          config.turnOnlySpeed = prefs.getFloat("turnOnlySpeed", 550.0f);
          config.accelRate     = prefs.getFloat("accelRate", ACCEL_DEFAULT);
          config.blackR        = prefs.getUShort("blackR", 152);
          config.blackG        = prefs.getUShort("blackG", 137);
          config.blackB        = prefs.getUShort("blackB", 98);
          config.whiteR        = prefs.getUShort("whiteR", 4143);
          config.whiteG        = prefs.getUShort("whiteG", 4258);
          config.whiteB        = prefs.getUShort("whiteB", 3036);
          // Schutz: zu kleine white-Werte -> default Kalibrierung
          if (config.whiteR < 200 || config.whiteG < 200 || config.whiteB < 200) {
            config.blackR = 152; config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
            config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
          }
          Serial.printf("[NVS] maxSpeed=%.0f accelRate=%.0f turnFactor=%.2f\n",
                        config.maxSpeed, config.accelRate, config.turnFactor);
          configValidate();
          prefs.end();
        }
        
        void configValidate() {
          bool changed = false;
          if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
            config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
          }
          if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
            config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
          }
          if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
            config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
          }
          if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
            config.blackR = 152; config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
            config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
            changed = true;
          }
          if (changed) {
            prefs.begin("edubot", false);
            prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
            prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
            prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
            prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
            prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
            prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
            prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
            prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
            prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
            prefs.end();
            Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");
          }
        }
        
        void configSaveField(const char* key, float value) {
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          prefs.putFloat(key, value);
          prefs.end();
        }
        
        void configSaveUShort(const char* key, uint16_t value) {
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          prefs.putUShort(key, value);
          prefs.end();
        }
        
        void configSaveIfDirty() {
          if (!configDirty) return;
          configDirty = false;
          // Platzhalter fuer zukuenftige "dirty"-basierte Persistenz
        }

        114: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        115:   float diff = target - current;
        116:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        117:     return target;
        118:   }
        119:   // Beschleunigen mit accelRate, Bremsen mit decelRate (getrennt einstellbar)
        120:   float rate = (diff > 0) ? config.accelRate : config.decelRate;
        121:   float maxChange = rate * dt;
        122:   if (diff > 0) {
        123:     current += maxChange;
        124:     if (current > target) current = target;
        125:   } else {
        126:     current -= maxChange;
        127:     if (current < target) current = target;
        128:   }
        129:   return current;
        130: }

      NACHHER (+):
        + void gameStop(uint32_t ms) {
        +   gameMoveBusy = true;
        +   stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        +   vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(ms));
        +   gameMoveBusy = false;
        + }
        + 
        + // =====================================================
        + // DISTANZ-FAHRT (steps-basiert, mit Rampe und Timeout)
        + // Blockierend, lockt currentGame auf GAME_DIST
        + // direction: +1 = vorwaerts, -1 = rueckwaerts
        + // =====================================================
        + void driveBySteps(int direction, uint32_t steps) {
        +   if (steps == 0) return;
        +   currentGame = GAME_DIST;
        +   gameMoveBusy = true;
        +   motorResetStepCount();
        + 
        +   const float maxSpeed = config.maxSpeed * DIST_DRIVE_GAIN;
        +   const float signedTarget = (direction > 0) ? maxSpeed : -maxSpeed;
        +   const uint32_t rampMs = 120;
        +   // Wieviele Steps braucht die Rampe? speed * (rampMs/1000)
        +   const uint32_t rampSteps = (uint32_t)(maxSpeed * (rampMs / 1000.0f) + 0.5f);
        +   // Verzoegerte Decel-Phase: wir starten das Bremsen sobald rampSteps uebrig sind
        +   // (klassisches Trapez-Profil)
        +   const uint32_t decelStartCount = (steps > rampSteps) ? (steps - rampSteps) : 0;
        + 
        +   uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
        +   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        +   uint32_t elapsed = 0;
        + 
        +   while (elapsed < DIST_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        +     uint32_t count = motorGetStepCountAvg();
        +     if (count >= steps) break;
        + 
        +     if (currentGame != GAME_DIST) {
        +       stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        +       sendStatus("DIST:ABORT");
        +       return;
        +     }
        + 
        +     uint32_t now = micros();
        +     float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
        +     lastMicros = now;
        +     if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        + 
        +     // Zielgeschwindigkeit je nach Phase
        +     float curTarget;
        +     if (count < decelStartCount) {
        +       // Konstantfahrt (mit ramp-up am Anfang)
        +       curTarget = signedTarget;
        +     } else {
        +       // Rampe runter proportional zu verbleibenden Steps
        +       uint32_t stepsToGo = (count < steps) ? (steps - count) : 0;
        +       float frac = (float)stepsToGo / (float)rampSteps;
        +       if (frac < 0.0f) frac = 0.0f;
        +       if (frac > 1.0f) frac = 1.0f;
        +       curTarget = signedTarget * frac;
        +     }
        + 
        +     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
        +     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
        +     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        +     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        + 
        +     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        +     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        +   }
        + 
        +   stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        +   gameMoveBusy = false;
        +   currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        +   char buf[32];
        +   if (elapsed >= DIST_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        +     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "DIST:TIMEOUT:%lu", (unsigned long)steps);
        +   } else {
        +     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "DIST:DONE:%lu", (unsigned long)steps);
        +   }
        +   sendStatus(buf);
        + }

        218:   // (klassisches Trapez-Profil)
        219:   const uint32_t decelStartCount = (steps > rampSteps) ? (steps - rampSteps) : 0;
        220: 
        221:   uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
        222:   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        223:   uint32_t elapsed = 0;
        224: 
        225:   while (elapsed < DIST_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        226:     uint32_t count = motorGetStepCountAvg();
        227:     if (count >= steps) break;
        228: 
        229:     if (currentGame != GAME_DIST) {
        230:       stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        231:       sendStatus("DIST:ABORT");
        232:       return;
        233:     }
        234: 
        235:     uint32_t now = micros();
        236:     float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
        237:     lastMicros = now;
        238:     if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;

        240:     // Zielgeschwindigkeit je nach Phase
        241:     float curTarget;
        242:     if (count < decelStartCount) {
        243:       // Konstantfahrt (mit ramp-up am Anfang)
        244:       curTarget = signedTarget;
        245:     } else {
        246:       // Rampe runter proportional zu verbleibenden Steps
        247:       uint32_t stepsToGo = (count < steps) ? (steps - count) : 0;
        248:       float frac = (float)stepsToGo / (float)rampSteps;
        249:       if (frac < 0.0f) frac = 0.0f;
        250:       if (frac > 1.0f) frac = 1.0f;
        251:       curTarget = signedTarget * frac;
        252:     }
        253: 
        254:     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
        255:     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
        256:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        257:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        258: 
        259:     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        260:     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        261:   }
        262: 
        263:   stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        264:   gameMoveBusy = false;
        265:   currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        266:   char buf[32];
        267:   if (elapsed >= DIST_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        268:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "DIST:TIMEOUT:%lu", (unsigned long)steps);
        269:   } else {
        270:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "DIST:DONE:%lu", (unsigned long)steps);
        271:   }
        272:   sendStatus(buf);
        273: }

        283:   if (knobelnLen == 0) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:NONE"); return; }
        284:   currentGame = GAME_KNOBELN;

        -       <p><b>Was ist fest im Code?</b><br>

[ASSISTANT]: ok, die probleme:  1. **Rampe macht's schlimmer**: bei step Motors gibt es bei sehr kleinen geschwindigkeiten (unterhalb des gültigen Bereichs) oft ein "rattern", weil `setMotorSpeed` sinnvoll erst ab einem gewissen speed läuft. bei zu kleinen werten greift der "else" ast (speed < 0.5), schaltet den motor aus, gleich wieder an usw.  2. **`stopMotors()` am ende ist trotzdem hart**: es wird immer noch nullgesetzt, trotz rampe.  ich mache es einfacher: weniger stufen, keine extrem niedrigen werte, und stelle sicher dass die baudere/gain angepasst ist. vielleicht ist's besser, die **geschwindigkeit** zu senken statt eine rampe zu bauen — das ist robuster und die eigentliche ursache des ruckelns.  fragen an dich:

[ASSISTANT]: Ah, wichtig! beim frei fahren mit hoher geschwindigkeit ruckelt es nicht — die steppers laufen sauber. das problem ist also **nicht die rampe**, sondern dass **die niedrige geschwindigkeit von 0.6 * maxSpeed** im game-modus das ruckeln verursacht. steppers rattern bei zu niedrigem `stepInterval`.  lösung: im game-modus **höhere geschwindigkeit** (wie frei fahren) und dafür **kürzere dauer**, damit der zur zurückgelegte strecke ähnlich bleibt (schneller, aber kürzere zeit = gleiches resultat, sauberere fahrt).  ich baue die rampe zurück und erhöhe stattdessen die game-geschwindigkeit, verkürze dafür die dauer.

        1152: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        1153:   float diff = target - current;

        +   const float target = config.maxSpeed * GAME_DRIVE_GAIN;
        +   const uint32_t total = ms;
        +   uint32_t elapsed = 0;
        +   uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
        +   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        + 
        +   // Phase 1: Sanftes Hochfahren 0 -> target, dann konstant fahren
        +   while (elapsed < total - GAME_RAMP_TICK) {
        +     uint32_t now = micros();
        +     float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
        +     lastMicros = now;
        +     if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        + 
        +     float remaining = total - GAME_RAMP_TICK - elapsed;
        +     float curTarget = (remaining > 80) ? target : target * (remaining / 80.0f);
        +     if (curTarget < 0) curTarget = 0;
        + 
        +     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
        +     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
        +     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        +     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        + 
        +     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        +     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        +     if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
        +   }
        +   // Phase 2: Letzte Millisekunden sanft auf 0
        +   while (elapsed < total) {
        +     uint32_t now = micros();
        +     float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
        +     lastMicros = now;
        +     if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        + 
        +     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, 0.0f, dt);
        +     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, 0.0f, dt);
        +     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        +     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        + 
        +     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        +     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        +     if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
        +   }
        +   stopMotors();
        +   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        +   gameMoveBusy = false;
        + }

        229: int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
        230:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        231:   long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw), static_cast<long>(blackVal), static_cast<long>(whiteVal), 0L, 255L);
        232:   value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);

        236: // Verbesserte Farbenkennung mit Schwellwert-Logik
        237: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        238:   // Erst pruefen ob ueberhaupt eine Farbe erkannt wird (sehr dunkel)
        239:   int total = r + g + b;
        240:   if (total < 60) return "SCHWARZ";
        241:   // WEISS: alle drei Kanaele hell und annaehernd gleich
        242:   if (r > COLOR_HIGH && g > COLOR_HIGH && b > COLOR_HIGH &&
        243:       abs(r - g) < 60 && abs(g - b) < 60 && abs(r - b) < 60) {
        244:     return "WEISS";
        245:   }
        246:   // dominant channel
        247:   int maxC = r > g ? (r > b ? r : b) : (g > b ? g : b);
        248:   if (maxC < 50) return "UNBEKANNT";  // zu dunkel fuer echte Farbe
        249: 
        250:   // GELB: rot und gruen hoch, blau deutlich niedriger
        251:   if (r > 100 && g > 100 && b < 80 && r > b * 1.4f && g > b * 1.4f) return "GELB";
        252: 
        253:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        254:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        255:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        256:   return "UNBEKANNT";
        257: }

        284: void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {

        287:   int failCount = 0;

        296:         failCount++;

        298:           colorSensorOk = false;
        299:         }
        300:       } else {
        301:         failCount = 0;
        302: 
        303:         int r = calibrateColor(rawR, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
        304:         int g = calibrateColor(rawG, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
        305:         int b = calibrateColor(rawB, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        306: 
        307:         const char* detected = detectColorName(r, g, b);
        308: 
        309:         // Timeout statt portMAX_DELAY - verhindert Task-Hang
        310:         if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(100)) == pdTRUE) {
        311:           sensorR = r;
        312:           sensorG = g;
        313:           sensorB = b;
        314:           strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detected, sizeof(sensorName));
        315:           xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        316:         }
        317:       }
        318:     } else {
        319:       Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
        320:       resetI2CBus();
        321:       colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        322:       if (colorSensorOk) {
        323:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
        324:         failCount = 0;
        325:       }
        326:       vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
        327:       lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        328:     }
        329:     vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
        330:   }

        671: void peerListAdd(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
        672:   // Schon in Liste?
        673:   for (uint8_t i = 0; i < peerCount; i++) {
        674:     if (memcmp(peerList[i].mac, mac, 6) == 0) {
        675:       peerList[i].lastSeen = millis();
        676:       return;
        677:     }
        678:   }
        679:   if (peerCount < MAX_PEERS) {
        680:     memcpy(peerList[peerCount].mac, mac, 6);
        681:     peerList[peerCount].lastSeen = millis();
        682:     peerCount++;
        683:     char msg[48];
        684:     snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "RACE:PEER:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
        685:       mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
        686:     sendStatus(msg);
        687:   }
        688: }

        690: void onEspNowRecv(const uint8_t* mac, const uint8_t* data, int len) {
        691:   if (len != sizeof(RacePacket)) return;
        692:   RacePacket* pkt = (RacePacket*)data;
        693:   if (pkt->magic != 0xA5) return;
        694:   Serial.printf("[ESPNOW] pkt from %02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X score=%u flags=%u\n",
        695:     pkt->senderMac[0], pkt->senderMac[1], pkt->senderMac[2],
        696:     pkt->senderMac[3], pkt->senderMac[4], pkt->senderMac[5],
        697:     pkt->score, pkt->flags);
        698:   // Eigenes Paket? (loopback - ESP-NOW macht das normalerweise nicht, aber sicherheitshalber)
        699:   if (memcmp(pkt->senderMac, myMac, 6) == 0) return;
        700: 
        701:   // Discovery-Hello empfangen -> Antwort mit PRESENT + in Liste eintragen
        702:   if (pkt->flags & RACE_FLAG_HELLO) {
        703:     peerListAdd(pkt->senderMac);
        704:     // Sender als Peer registrieren, damit wir gezielt antworten koennen
        705:     espNowAddSpecificPeer(pkt->senderMac);
        706:     // Mit PRESENT antworten (gezielt an Sender)
        707:     RacePacket resp;
        708:     resp.magic = 0xA5;
        709:     memcpy(resp.senderMac, myMac, 6);
        710:     resp.score = 0;
        711:     resp.flags = (uint8_t)RACE_FLAG_PRESENT;
        712:     esp_now_send(pkt->senderMac, (uint8_t*)&resp, sizeof(resp));
        713:     Serial.println("[ESPNOW] PRESENT gesendet");
        714:     return;
        715:   }
        716:   // PRESENT-Antwort -> nur in Liste eintragen
        717:   if (pkt->flags & RACE_FLAG_PRESENT) {
        718:     peerListAdd(pkt->senderMac);
        719:     return;
        720:   }
        721: 
        722:   // Wenn gepaart: nur Pakete vom Peer akzeptieren
        723:   if (hasPairedPeer && memcmp(pkt->senderMac, pairedPeer, 6) != 0) return;
        724: 
        725:   // Normales Rennen-Paket
        726:   if (pkt->flags & RACE_FLAG_WINNER || pkt->score >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE) {
        727:     raceOppScore = pkt->score;
        728:     raceActive = false;
        729:     currentGame = GAME_NONE;   // Roboter wieder frei steuerbar
        730:     stopMotors();
        731:     speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        732:     sendStatus("RACE:OPP_WIN");
        733:   } else {
        734:     // Wenn das Rennen lokal noch nicht aktiv ist, der Peer aber schon spielt
        735:     // -> automatisch starten (Gegner hat das Rennen begonnen)
        736:     if (!raceActive) {
        737:       raceExecuteStart(true);  // true = vom Gegner ausgeloest (setzt raceOppScore=0)
        738:     }
        739:     raceOppScore = pkt->score; // Erst nach dem Start-Reset zuweisen!
        740:     char msg[32];
        741:     snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "RACE:PROGRESS:%u", raceOppScore);
        742:     sendStatus(msg);
        743:   }
        744: }

        753: void espNowAddSpecificPeer(const uint8_t mac[6]) {

        757:   peer.encrypt = false;

        763: void espNowInit() {
        764:   WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        765:   // WiFi anhalten, Channel fixieren, dann WiFi wieder starten (ESP-NOW braucht das)
        766:   // WICHTIG: ESP-NOW broadcast funktioniert zuverlaessig, wenn beide Roboter
        767:   // auf demselben Primary-Channel sind. Wir fixieren Channel 1.
        768:   esp_wifi_stop();
        769:   esp_wifi_set_channel(1, WIFI_SECOND_CHAN_NONE);
        770:   esp_wifi_start();
        771:   esp_wifi_set_channel(1, WIFI_SECOND_CHAN_NONE);
        772: 
        773:   // Eigene MAC-Adresse lesen (zur Unterscheidung im Paket)
        774:   WiFi.macAddress(myMac);
        775:   Serial.printf("[ESPNOW] meine MAC: %02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X\n",
        776:     myMac[0], myMac[1], myMac[2], myMac[3], myMac[4], myMac[5]);
        777: 
        778:   if (esp_now_init() != ESP_OK) { Serial.println("[ESPNOW] init failed"); return; }
        779:   esp_now_register_recv_cb(onEspNowRecv);
        780:   esp_now_register_send_cb(onEspNowSend);
        781: 
        782:   // Broadcast-Peer explizit auf Channel 1
        783:   esp_now_peer_info_t peer = {};
        784:   memcpy(peer.peer_addr, espNowPeer, 6);
        785:   peer.channel = 1;            // FIXIERT - nicht 0 (auto)
        786:   peer.encrypt = false;
        787:   if (esp_now_add_peer(&peer) == ESP_OK) {
        788:     espNowReady = true;
        789:     Serial.println("[ESPNOW] bereit (broadcast peer auf channel 1)");
        790:   } else {
        791:     Serial.println("[ESPNOW] add_peer failed");
        792:   }
        793: }
        794: 
        795: // Sicherstellen, dass WiFi auf Channel 1 bleibt (BLE kann ihn verschieben).
        796: // Nur aufrufen wenn noetig - NICHT periodisch im Loop, da das ESP-NOW stoert.
        797: void espNowEnsureChannel() {
        798:   if (!espNowReady) return;
        799:   static uint8_t lastChannel = 255;
        800:   uint8_t primary;
        801:   wifi_second_chan_t second;
        802:   if (esp_wifi_get_channel(&primary, &second) == ESP_OK && primary != lastChannel) {
        803:     lastChannel = primary;
        804:     Serial.printf("[ESPNOW] channel war %u -> setze auf 1\n", primary);
        805:   }
        806:   esp_wifi_set_channel(1, WIFI_SECOND_CHAN_NONE);
        807: }

        809: void raceSendPacket(uint8_t score, bool winner) {
        810:   if (!espNowReady) return;
        811:   RacePacket pkt;
        812:   pkt.magic = 0xA5;
        813:   memcpy(pkt.senderMac, myMac, 6);
        814:   pkt.score = score;
        815:   pkt.flags = (uint8_t)(winner ? RACE_FLAG_WINNER : 0x00);
        816:   // Wenn gepaart, direkt an Peer, sonst broadcast
        817:   if (hasPairedPeer) {
        818:     esp_now_send(pairedPeer, (uint8_t*)&pkt, sizeof(pkt));
        819:   } else {
        820:     esp_now_send(espNowPeer, (uint8_t*)&pkt, sizeof(pkt));
        821:   }
        822: }

        846: void raceUnpair() {
        847:   if (hasPairedPeer) {
        848:     esp_now_del_peer(pairedPeer);
        849:     hasPairedPeer = false;

        1180: // =====================================================
        1181: // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        1182: // =====================================================
        1183: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        1184:   float diff = target - current;
        1185:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        1186:     return target;
        1187:   }
        1188:   float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
        1189:   if (diff > 0) {
        1190:     current += maxChange;
        1191:     if (current > target) current = target;
        1192:   } else {
        1193:     current -= maxChange;
        1194:     if (current < target) current = target;
        1195:   }
        1196:   return current;
        1197: }

        1199: // =====================================================
        1200: // FAHRLOGIK
        1201: // =====================================================
        1202: void updateDrive() {
        1203:   // Waehrend ein Spiel aktiv ist, wird die Bewegung von der Spiel-Engine
        1204:   // blockierend gesteuert - KEYS: vom Frontend werden ignoriert.
        1205:   if (currentGame != GAME_NONE) {
        1206:     return;
        1207:   }
        1208: 
        1209:   float targetL = 0.0;
        1210:   float targetR = 0.0;
        1211: 
        1212:   bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
        1213:   bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
        1214:   bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
        1215:   bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        1216: 
        1217:   if (forward) {
        1218:     targetL = config.maxSpeed;
        1219:     targetR = config.maxSpeed;
        1220:   } else if (backward) {
        1221:     targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
        1222:     targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
        1223:   }
        1224: 
        1225:   if (forward || backward) {
        1226:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        1227:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
        1228:   }
        1229: 
        1230:   if (!forward && !backward) {
        1231:     if (left) {
        1232:       targetL = 0;
        1233:       targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        1234:     } else if (right) {
        1235:       targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        1236:       targetR = 0;
        1237:     }
        1238:   }
        1239: 
        1240:   // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
        1241:   if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
        1242:     targetL = 0.0;
        1243:     targetR = 0.0;
        1244:     if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
        1245:       speedL = 0.0;
        1246:       speedR = 0.0;
        1247:       clearKeys();
        1248:       stopMotors();
        1249:     }
        1250:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        1251:     return;
        1252:   }
        1253: 
        1254:   unsigned long now = micros();
        1255:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        1256:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        1257:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        1258: 
        1259:   float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
        1260:   if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
        1261:     speedL = newSpeedL;
        1262:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        1263:   }
        1264: 
        1265:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
        1266:   if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
        1267:     speedR = newSpeedR;
        1268:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        1269:   }
        1270: }
