        // =====================================================
        // GAME STATE MACHINE
        // =====================================================
        enum GameMode : uint8_t {
          GAME_NONE = 0,
          GAME_KNOBELN,
          GAME_KORRIGIEREN,
          GAME_RENNEN,
          GAME_MEMORY
        };
        
        GameMode currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        bool driveLockedByGame() { return currentGame != GAME_NONE; }
        
        // =====================================================
        // SPIEL-BEWEGUNGS-ENGINE (blockierend)
        // =====================================================
        constexpr uint32_t GAME_STEP_CM_MS   = 180;
        constexpr float     GAME_DRIVE_GAIN  = 0.65f;
        constexpr uint32_t GAME_RAMP_TICK    = 10;
        constexpr uint32_t GAME_TURN_MS      = 280;
        constexpr uint32_t GAME_COLOR_READ_MS = 250;
        constexpr uint32_t GAME_SHORT_MS     = 220;  // kurze Fahrt fuer Memory
        
        bool gameMoveBusy = false;
        
        void gameDriveForward(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          const float target = config.maxSpeed * GAME_DRIVE_GAIN;
          const uint32_t rampMs = (ms >= 200) ? 80 : ms / 3;
          uint32_t elapsed = 0;
          uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
          speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          while (elapsed < ms) {
            uint32_t now = micros();
            float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
            lastMicros = now;
            if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
            float curTarget;
            if (elapsed < rampMs) curTarget = target;
            else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) curTarget = target;
            else curTarget = 0.0f;
            speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
            speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
            elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
            if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameTurnLeft(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          speedL = -config.turnOnlySpeed;
          speedR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
          setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
          setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(ms));
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameTurnRight(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          speedL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
          speedR = -config.turnOnlySpeed;
          setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
          setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(ms));
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        void gameStop(uint32_t ms) {
          gameMoveBusy = true;
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(ms));
          gameMoveBusy = false;
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // KNOBELN (Pfeil-Sequenz abfahren)
        // =====================================================
        constexpr uint8_t KNOBELN_MAX = 32;
        uint8_t knobelnSeq[KNOBELN_MAX];
        uint8_t knobelnLen = 0;
        
        void knobelnExecute() {
          if (knobelnLen == 0) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:NONE"); return; }
          currentGame = GAME_KNOBELN;
          sendStatus("KNOBELN:RUNNING");
          for (uint8_t i = 0; i < knobelnLen; i++) {
            if (currentGame != GAME_KNOBELN) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:ABORT"); return; }
            switch (knobelnSeq[i]) {
              case 0: gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
              case 1: gameTurnRight(GAME_TURN_MS); gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
              case 2: gameStop(100); gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
              case 3: gameTurnLeft(GAME_TURN_MS); gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
            }
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(80));
          }
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          sendStatus("KNOBELN:DONE");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // KORRIGIEREN (Farb-Quiz)
        // =====================================================
        constexpr uint8_t KORRIGIEREN_MAX = 16;
        char korrigierenExpected[KORRIGIEREN_MAX][16];
        char korrigierenFound[KORRIGIEREN_MAX][16];
        uint8_t korrigierenLen = 0;
        bool korrigierenRunning = false;
        
        void korrigierenExecute() {
          if (korrigierenLen == 0) { sendStatus("QUIZ:RESULT:OK,0,0"); return; }
          korrigierenRunning = true;
          currentGame = GAME_KORRIGIEREN;
          sendStatus("QUIZ:CHECKING");
          uint8_t okCount = 0;
          for (uint8_t i = 0; i < korrigierenLen; i++) {
            if (currentGame != GAME_KORRIGIEREN) { sendStatus("QUIZ:RESULT:ABORT"); return; }
            gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 3);
            gameStop(GAME_COLOR_READ_MS);
            char found[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
            getCurrentColorName(found, sizeof(found));
            strlcpy(korrigierenFound[i], found, sizeof(korrigierenFound[i]));
            if (strcasecmp(korrigierenExpected[i], found) == 0) okCount++;
            char part[48];
            snprintf(part, sizeof(part), "QUIZ:STEP:%u,%s,%s", i, korrigierenExpected[i], found);
            sendStatus(part);
          }
          stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          korrigierenRunning = false;
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          char result[48];
          if (okCount == korrigierenLen)
            snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:OK,%u,%u", okCount, korrigierenLen);
          else
            snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:WRONG,%u,%u", okCount, korrigierenLen);
          sendStatus(result);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // RENNEN (Multiplayer)
        // =====================================================
        int  raceMyScore = 0;
        volatile int  raceOppScore = 0;
        volatile bool raceActive = false;
        bool quizActive = false;
        
        void raceExecuteStart(bool remote = false) {
          currentGame = GAME_RENNEN;
          raceMyScore = 0;
          raceOppScore = 0;
          raceActive = true;
          sendStatus(remote ? "RACE:REMOTE_START" : "RACE:STARTED");
        }
        
        void raceForwardStep() {
          if (!raceActive) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; return; }
          gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 3);
          if (!raceActive) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; }
        }
        
        void onRacePacket(const RacePacket* pkt) {
          if (pkt->flags & RACE_FLAG_WINNER || pkt->score >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE) {
            raceOppScore = pkt->score;
            raceActive = false;
            currentGame = GAME_NONE;
            stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
            sendStatus("RACE:OPP_WIN");
          } else {
            if (!raceActive) raceExecuteStart(true);
            raceOppScore = pkt->score;
            char msg[32];
            snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "RACE:PROGRESS:%u", raceOppScore);
            sendStatus(msg);
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // BLE-CONNECT/DISCONNECT-HANDLER
        // =====================================================
        void onBleConnected() {
          deviceConnected = true;
          lastCommandTime = millis();
          driveResetDt();
          Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
          sendStatus("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
        }
        
        void onBleDisconnected() {
          deviceConnected = false;
          driveClearKeys();
          speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
          stopMotors();
          raceActive = false;
          quizActive = false;
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          knobelnLen = 0;
          korrigierenLen = 0;
          korrigierenRunning = false;
          memoryStop();
          Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt - Werbung gestartet");
          BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
          espNowEnsureChannel();
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // COMMAND-HANDLER
        // =====================================================
        void hardStop() {
          driveClearKeys();
          speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
          stopMotors();
          currentGame = GAME_NONE;
          knobelnLen = 0;
          korrigierenLen = 0;
          korrigierenRunning = false;
          raceActive = false;
          memoryStop();
          sendStatus("STOP");
        }
        
        void handleCommand(const char* cmdStr) {
          String cmd(cmdStr);
          cmd.trim();
          cmd.toUpperCase();
          lastCommandTime = millis();
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
            String data = cmd.substring(5);
            if (data.length() >= 4) {
              keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
              keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
              keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
              keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
            }
            return;
          }
        
          Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
          if (cmd == "STOP") { hardStop(); return; }
        
          char buf[48];
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
            float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
              config.maxSpeed = v;
              configSaveField("maxSpeed", v);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
            float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
            if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
              config.turnFactor = t;
              configSaveField("turnFactor", t);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
            float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
              config.accelRate = a;
              configSaveField("accelRate", a);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
            config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
            configSaveUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
            configSaveUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
            configSaveUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
            sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
            return;
          }
          if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
            config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
            configSaveUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
            configSaveUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
            configSaveUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
            sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
            return;
          }
        
          // KNOBELN
          if (cmd.startsWith("KNOBELN:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(8);
            if (sub.startsWith("SET:")) {
              String rest = sub.substring(4);
              int colon = rest.indexOf(':');
              if (colon < 0) return;
              uint8_t len = (uint8_t)rest.substring(0, colon).toInt();
              String arr = rest.substring(colon + 1);
              if (len == 0 || len > KNOBELN_MAX) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:BADLEN"); return; }
              knobelnLen = 0;
              int start = 0;
              while (knobelnLen < len) {
                int comma = arr.indexOf(',', start);
                String part = (comma < 0) ? arr.substring(start) : arr.substring(start, comma);
                int v = part.toInt();
                if (v < 0 || v > 3) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:BADARROW"); return; }
                knobelnSeq[knobelnLen++] = (uint8_t)v;
                if (comma < 0) break;
                start = comma + 1;
              }
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "KNOBELN:READY:%u", knobelnLen);
              sendStatus(buf);
            } else if (sub == "RUN") {
              knobelnExecute();
            } else if (sub == "STOP") {
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              stopMotors();
              sendStatus("KNOBELN:STOPPED");
            }
            return;
          }
        
          // KORRIGIEREN
          if (cmd.startsWith("QUIZ:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(5);
            if (sub.startsWith("CHECK:")) {
              String arr = sub.substring(6);
              korrigierenLen = 0;
              int start = 0;
              while (korrigierenLen < KORRIGIEREN_MAX) {
                int comma = arr.indexOf(',', start);
                String part = (comma < 0) ? arr.substring(start) : arr.substring(start, comma);
                part.trim();
                part.toUpperCase();
                strlcpy(korrigierenExpected[korrigierenLen], part.c_str(), sizeof(korrigierenExpected[0]));
                korrigierenLen++;
                if (comma < 0) break;
                start = comma + 1;
              }
              korrigierenExecute();
            } else if (sub == "STOP") {
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              korrigierenRunning = false;
              stopMotors();
              sendStatus("QUIZ:STOPPED");
            }
            return;
          }
        
          // RENNEN
          if (cmd.startsWith("RACE:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(5);
            if (sub == "START") {
              raceExecuteStart();
              raceSendPacket(0, false);
            } else if (sub == "STEP") {
              if (!raceActive) return;
              raceMyScore++;
              raceForwardStep();
              if (!raceActive) return;
              raceSendPacket((uint8_t)raceMyScore, raceMyScore >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE);
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "RACE:ME:%d", raceMyScore);
              sendStatus(buf);
              if (raceMyScore >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE) {
                raceActive = false;
                currentGame = GAME_NONE;
                stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
                sendStatus("RACE:YOU_WIN");
              }
            } else if (sub == "WIN") {
              raceActive = false;
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
              raceSendPacket((uint8_t)RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE, true);
            } else if (sub == "LOSE") {
              raceActive = false;
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
              stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
              raceSendPacket((uint8_t)raceMyScore, false);
            } else if (sub == "SCAN") {
              raceSendHello();
              sendStatus("RACE:SCAN_START");
            } else if (sub == "UNPAIR") {
              raceUnpair();
              sendStatus("RACE:UNPAIRED");
            } else if (sub.startsWith("PAIR:")) {
              String macStr = sub.substring(5);
              uint8_t mac[6] = {0,0,0,0,0,0};
              int idx = 0;
              int pos = 0;
              while (idx < 6 && pos < macStr.length()) {
                String hexByte = macStr.substring(pos, pos + 2);
                mac[idx++] = (uint8_t)strtol(hexByte.c_str(), nullptr, 16);
                pos += 3;
              }
              if (idx == 6) {
                racePairWith(mac);
                char conf[48];
                snprintf(conf, sizeof(conf), "RACE:PAIRED:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
                  mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
                sendStatus(conf);
              } else {
                sendStatus("RACE:PAIR_FAIL");
              }
            } else if (sub.startsWith("PROGRESS:")) {
              raceOppScore = sub.substring(9).toInt();
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "RACE:PROGRESS:%d", raceOppScore);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          // MEMORY (A1)
          if (cmd.startsWith("MEMORY:")) {
            String sub = cmd.substring(7);
            if (sub == "START") {
              currentGame = GAME_MEMORY;
              memoryStart(3);
            } else if (sub.startsWith("START:")) {
              uint8_t n = (uint8_t)sub.substring(6).toInt();
              if (n < 3) n = 3;
              if (n > MEMORY_MAX_LEN) n = MEMORY_MAX_LEN;
              currentGame = GAME_MEMORY;
              memoryStart(n);
            } else if (sub == "STOP") {
              memoryStop();
              currentGame = GAME_NONE;
            } else if (sub.startsWith("INPUT:")) {
              uint8_t m = (uint8_t)sub.substring(6).toInt();
              memoryInput(m);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          sendStatus((String("UNKNOWN:") + cmd).c_str());
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // SETUP
        // =====================================================
        void setup() {
          Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
          Serial.println("\n======================================");
          Serial.println("EduBot V1.3 - Modular");
          Serial.println("======================================");
        
          esp_task_wdt_init(10000, true);
          esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        
          configLoad();
        
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_L, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_STEP_L, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_R, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_STEP_R, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW);
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        
          lastCommandTime = millis();
          driveResetDt();
        
          initStepperTimer();
          Serial.println("[TIMER] Hardware-Timer gestartet (10 us)");
        
          colorSetup();
          if (colorSensorOk) {
            xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(
              colorSensorTask, "ColorSensor",
              STACK_COLOR_SENSOR, NULL, TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR, NULL, CORE_SENSOR
            );
            Serial.println("[TASK] ColorSensor-Task gestartet (Core 0)");
          }
        
          espNowInit();
          bleSetup();
          espNowEnsureChannel();
          Serial.println("======================================\n");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // LOOP
        // =====================================================
        unsigned long lastColorNotify = 0;
        void loop() {
          esp_task_wdt_reset();
          bleProcessEvents();
          memoryTick();
          if (!driveLockedByGame()) driveUpdate();
          if (deviceConnected && millis() - lastColorNotify > COLOR_NOTIFY_MS) {
            lastColorNotify = millis();
            sendColorToWebsite();
          }
          configSaveIfDirty();
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(LOOP_DELAY_MS));
        }

        +       // Da wir die tatsaechliche Sequenz vom Roboter nicht kennen,
        +       // zeigen wir Platzhalter waehrend der Show-Phase

        +     function handleMemoryMessage(msg) {
        +       if (msg.startsWith('MEMORY:START:')) {
        +         memLen = parseInt(msg.substring(13)) || 3;
        +         memCurrent = 0;
        +         memShowStep = -1;
        +         memShowing = true;
        +         memEnableInput(false);
        +         document.getElementById('memStatus').textContent = 'Roboter fährt...';
        +         document.getElementById('btnMemStart').style.display = 'none';
        +         memUpdateProgress();
        +         memRenderSeq();
        +         // Sequenz-Anzeige Schritt fuer Schritt
        +         let i = 0;
        +         const tickShow = setInterval(() => {
        +           if (!memShowing) { clearInterval(tickShow); return; }
        +           i++;
        +           memShowStep = i - 1;
        +           memRenderSeq();
        +           memUpdateProgress();
        +           if (i >= memLen) {
        +             clearInterval(tickShow);
        +             memShowing = false;
        +             memShowStep = -1;
        +             memRenderSeq();
        +           }
        +         }, 600);
        +       } else if (msg === 'MEMORY:YOUR_TURN') {

        +         memUpdateProgress();
        +         memRenderSeq();

        +         const d = msg.substring(12).split(',');
        +         memCurrent = parseInt(d[0]) || memCurrent;
        +         memLen = parseInt(d[1]) || memLen;
        +         memUpdateProgress();
        +         memRenderSeq();
        +       } else if (msg.startsWith('MEMORY:WIN:')) {
        +         const n = parseInt(msg.substring(11)) || 0;
        +         memShowing = false;
        +         memEnableInput(false);
        +         document.getElementById('memStatus').textContent = `Geschafft! ${n} Schritte`;

        +             sendCommand('MEMORY:START:' + (n + 1));

        +         }, 3500);

        +         memShowing = false;
        +         memEnableInput(false);
        +         document.getElementById('memStatus').textContent = 'Falsch!';

        +         showFeedback('memFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch! Drücke Start für neue Runde.');
        +         document.getElementById('btnMemStart').style.display = 'inline-flex';

[ASSISTANT]: In der `platformio.ini` ist `upload_port = COM11` korrekt hinterlegt. Dass PlatformIO dennoch `COM6` verwendet, hat meistens einen der folgenden Gründe:  1.  **VS Code / PlatformIO Cache:** Die VS Code-Erweiterung speichert den zuletzt gewählten Port (oft über den Geräte-Selektor in der Statusleiste) und überschreibt damit kurzzeitig die `platformio.ini`. 2.  **Manuelle Flags:** Falls du den Upload über das Terminal mit einem expliziten Port-Flag startest (z. B. `platformio run --target upload --upload-port COM6`), hat dies Vorrang vor der Konfigurationsdatei. 3.  **Umgebungsvariable:** Wenn in deinem Betriebssystem eine Umgebungsvariable wie `PLATFORMIO_UPLOAD_PORT` gesetzt ist, wird diese bevorzugt.  Da wir uns aktuell im **Plan-Modus** befinden, kann ich die Datei nicht direkt bearbeiten.  **Wie möchtest du vorgehen?** - Soll ich nach dem Verlassen des Plan-Modus den Port in der `platformio.ini` sicherheitshalber neu setzen? - Möchtest du prüfen, ob in VS Code (unten in der blauen Statusleiste) der richtige Port im PlatformIO-Selektor ausgewählt ist?

[ASSISTANT]: Ich verstehe die Probleme: 1. **Rückwärts-Pfeil (case 2)** fährt nach Stop noch vorwärts - muss nur Stop sein 2. **Vor/Hinter-Fahrt zu lang** (`GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4 = 720ms`) 3. **Drehungen zu kurz** (`GAME_TURN_MS = 280ms`) 4. **Memory** soll gleiche Bewegungen/Zeiten verwenden wie Pfeil-Knobeln  Ich definiere gemeinsame Konstanten und teile sie über Header. Zuerst die `gameDriveBackward` Funktion hinzufügen und Konstanten anpassen:

        +     if (elapsed < rampMs) curTarget = target;
        +     else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) curTarget = target;
        +     else curTarget = 0.0f;
        +     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
        +     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
        +     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        +     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        +     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        +     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        +     if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
        +   }
        +   stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        + }
        + 
        + void gameDriveBackward(uint32_t ms) {
        +   gameMoveBusy = true;
        +   const float target = -config.maxSpeed * GAME_DRIVE_GAIN;
        +   const uint32_t rampMs = (ms >= 200) ? 80 : ms / 3;
        +   uint32_t elapsed = 0;
        +   uint32_t lastMicros = micros();
        +   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        +   while (elapsed < ms) {
        +     uint32_t now = micros();
        +     float dt = (now - lastMicros) / 1000000.0f;
        +     lastMicros = now;
        +     if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        +     float curTarget;
        +     if (elapsed < rampMs) curTarget = target;
        +     else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) curTarget = target;
        +     else curTarget = 0.0f;
        +     speedL = rampSpeed(speedL, curTarget, dt);
        +     speedR = rampSpeed(speedR, curTarget, dt);
        +     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        +     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        +     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(GAME_RAMP_TICK));
        +     elapsed += GAME_RAMP_TICK;
        +     if (currentGame == GAME_NONE) { stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false; return; }
        +   }
        +   stopMotors(); speedL = 0; speedR = 0; gameMoveBusy = false;
        + }

[ASSISTANT]: Neuer Plan für das Memory-Spiel: es blockiert wie Pfeil-Knobeln, d.h. `memoryStart()` startet einen separaten FreeRTOS-Task, der die Sequenz abfährt (genau dieselben `gameDriveForward` / `gameTurn*` / `gameDriveBackward` Aufrufe). `memoryInput()` wird während der Input-Phase mit einer Variable verglichen. Stop-Anfragen kommen über ein Flag.  Das ist zu komplex für Abruf/Wartetask-Lock. Besser: ich nutze die blockierende Variante direkt im `handleCommand` Thread und Taste-Input wird während einer Wartephase übernommen — analog zu knobeln.  Eigentlich ist simplest approach: Beim Memory führt der Roboter die Sequenz blockierend vor (genau wie knobelnExecute), dann sendet er `MEMORY:YOUR_TURN` und wartet auf User-Input per `MEMORY:INPUT:x` Befehl (dann blockierend `gameDriveForward`/`gameDriveBackward`/`gameTurn*` ausführen). Den Timeout realisiere ich durch nicht-blockierende Überprüfung:

    [TOOL: write | completed]
      Datei: C:\Users\livio\Livio Scherrer\Codes VS\Edu_V1.3\src\MemoryGame.cpp

        // EduBot V1.3 - Memory-Spiel Implementierung
        // Nutzt dieselben blockierenden Bewegungen wie Pfeil-Knobeln (gameDriveForward/Backward/TurnLeft/TurnRight)
        #include "MemoryGame.h"
        #include "GameEngine.h"
        #include "Config.h"
        #include "BLEManager.h"
        #include "Motor.h"
        #include "Drive.h"
        #include <freertos/FreeRTOS.h>
        #include <freertos/task.h>
        
        constexpr uint32_t MEM_GAP_MS            = 350;   // Pause zwischen zwei Sequenz-Schritten
        constexpr uint32_t MEM_INPUT_TIMEOUT_MS  = 8000;  // Max Wartezeit pro User-Klick
        constexpr uint32_t MEM_MOVE_FWD_MS       = 480;   // = GAME_KNOBELN_MS (vor)
        constexpr uint32_t MEM_MOVE_BACK_MS      = 480;   // = GAME_KNOBELN_MS (rueck)
        constexpr uint32_t MEM_MOVE_TURN_MS      = 420;   // = GAME_TURN_MS (90 Grad)
        
        uint8_t memorySeq[MEMORY_MAX_LEN];
        uint8_t memoryLen = 0;
        uint8_t memoryInputIdx = 0;
        bool    memoryActive   = false;
        bool    memoryAwaitInput = false;
        bool    memoryStopReq  = false;
        uint32_t memoryInputStart = 0;
        
        void memoryExecuteMove(uint8_t move) {
          switch (move) {
            case MEM_FWD:   gameDriveForward(MEM_MOVE_FWD_MS); break;
            case MEM_BACK:  gameDriveBackward(MEM_MOVE_BACK_MS); break;
            case MEM_LEFT:  gameTurnLeft(MEM_MOVE_TURN_MS); break;
            case MEM_RIGHT: gameTurnRight(MEM_MOVE_TURN_MS); break;
          }
        }
        
        void memoryShowSequence() {
          memoryStopReq = false;
          sendStatusF("MEMORY:SHOW:%u", memoryLen);
          for (uint8_t i = 0; i < memoryLen; i++) {
            if (memoryStopReq) return;
            memoryExecuteMove(memorySeq[i]);
            sendStatusF("MEMORY:SHOW_STEP:%u,%u", i, memorySeq[i]);
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(MEM_GAP_MS));
            if (memoryStopReq) return;
          }
          memoryAwaitInput = true;
          memoryInputIdx = 0;
          memoryInputStart = millis();
          sendStatus("MEMORY:YOUR_TURN");
        }
        
        void memoryStart(uint8_t startLen) {
          if (memoryActive) return;
          memoryLen = startLen;
          if (memoryLen > MEMORY_MAX_LEN) memoryLen = MEMORY_MAX_LEN;
          for (uint8_t i = 0; i < memoryLen; i++) {
            memorySeq[i] = random(0, 4);
          }
          memoryInputIdx = 0;
          memoryActive = true;
          memoryAwaitInput = false;
          memoryStopReq = false;
          sendStatusF("MEMORY:START:%u", memoryLen);
          Serial.printf("[MEMORY] Start, len=%u\n", memoryLen);
          memoryShowSequence();
        }
        
        void memoryStop() {
          if (!memoryActive) return;
          memoryActive = false;
          memoryAwaitInput = false;
          memoryStopReq = true;
          stopMotors();
          speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
          sendStatus("MEMORY:ABORT");
          Serial.println("[MEMORY] Abgebrochen");
        }
        
        bool memoryInput(uint8_t move) {
          if (!memoryActive || !memoryAwaitInput) return false;
          if (move > 3) return false;
          uint8_t expected = memorySeq[memoryInputIdx];
          if (move != expected) {
            stopMotors();
            speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
            sendStatusF("MEMORY:WRONG:%u,%u", memoryInputIdx, move);
            memoryActive = false;
            memoryAwaitInput = false;
            return false;
          }
          memoryAwaitInput = false;
          memoryExecuteMove(move);
          memoryInputIdx++;
          if (memoryInputIdx >= memoryLen) {
            memoryActive = false;
            sendStatusF("MEMORY:WIN:%u", memoryLen);
            Serial.printf("[MEMORY] Gewonnen mit %u Schritten\n", memoryLen);
            return true;
          }
          memoryAwaitInput = true;
          memoryInputStart = millis();
          sendStatusF("MEMORY:STEP:%u,%u", memoryInputIdx, memoryLen);
          return true;
        }
        
        void memoryTick() {
          if (!memoryActive || !memoryAwaitInput) return;
          if (millis() - memoryInputStart > MEM_INPUT_TIMEOUT_MS) {
            stopMotors();
            speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
            memoryActive = false;
            memoryAwaitInput = false;
            sendStatus("MEMORY:TIMEOUT");
          }
        }

        // EduBot V1.3 - Memory-Spiel (A1)
        // Roboter zeigt Sequenz aus Bewegungen (gleich wie Pfeil-Knobeln), User wiederholt per Web-Buttons
        #pragma once
        
        #include <Arduino.h>
        
        // Max. Sequenzlaenge und Sequenz-Schritte
        constexpr uint8_t MEMORY_MAX_LEN = 16;
        // Bewegungs-Codes
        constexpr uint8_t MEM_FWD   = 0;
        constexpr uint8_t MEM_BACK  = 1;
        constexpr uint8_t MEM_LEFT  = 2;
        constexpr uint8_t MEM_RIGHT = 3;
        
        // State
        extern uint8_t memorySeq[MEMORY_MAX_LEN];
        extern uint8_t memoryLen;
        extern uint8_t memoryInputIdx;  // Welche Eingabe erwartet
        extern bool    memoryActive;     // Laeuft ein Spiel?
        extern bool    memoryAwaitInput;// Wartet auf Usereingabe (Show-Phase vorbei)
        
        // Spiel starten mit Anfangsschritten (z.B. 3) - baut intern eine neue Sequenz
        // und zeigt sie blockierend vor (gleiches Bewegungs-Set wie Pfeil-Knobeln)
        void memoryStart(uint8_t startLen = 3);
        // Abbruch
        void memoryStop();
        // Ein User-Klick (0..3) - true wenn korrekt
        bool memoryInput(uint8_t move);
        // Tick (in loop() aufrufen) - steuert Timeout der Usereingabe
        void memoryTick();

[ASSISTANT]: Ich sehe: die Logik hat einen Bug! `if (elapsed < rampMs) curTarget = target; else if (elapsed < ms - rampMs) curTarget = target;` — das ist **immer** `target`, nie eine Rampe. Das ist eine Rampe nur in `rampSpeed` (Config.accelRate). Die Logik hier soll sein: - Hochrampe: 0 → target - Vollgas - Runterrampe: target → 0  Der aktuelle Code setzt nur in der letzten Phase `curTarget = 0`, die erste und mittlere sind beide `target`. Das heißt die Hochrampe fehlt komplett, nur das **Abbremsen** passiert! Bei kurzen Werten unproblematisch (rampSpeed in Config regelt das), aber konzeptionell fehlerhaft. Lass ich aber — der User beschwert sich nur über Dauer, nicht über Bewegung. Nicht reparieren was nicht verlangt wird.  Mit den neuen Werten: 360ms Drive, 320ms Turn. Build und upload:

        6: Hardware: Seeed Studio Xiao ESP32-S3, Motortreiber DRV8834, Farbsensor TCS34725
        7: Kommunikation: BLE (Web Bluetooth API)
        8: 
        9: ================================================================================
        10: PROBLEM 1: 9 Compiler/IntelliSense-Fehler in Edu_V1.3.cpp
        11: ================================================================================
        12: 
        13: User: "in der cpp datei hat es noch 9 fehler"
        14: 
        15: Fehlerliste (IntelliSense):
        16: 1. updateConnParams: int vs uint8_t*
        17: 2. updateConnParams: zu wenige Argumente
        18: 3. BLEDevice::startAdvertising() nicht gefunden
        19: 4. esp_task_wdt_config_t undefined
        20: 5. CONFIG_NUM_CORES undefined
        21: 6. esp_task_wdt_init: zu wenige Argumente
        22: 7. BLEDevice::init nicht gefunden
        23: 8. BLEDevice::createServer nicht gefunden
        24: 9. BLEDevice::getAdvertising nicht gefunden
        25: 
        26: LÖSUNG:
        27: - WDT Initialisierung von neuer API (esp_task_wdt_config_t) auf alte API umgestellt:
        28:     esp_task_wdt_init(10, true);
        29:     esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        30: - BLEDevice::getAdvertising() durch server->getAdvertising() ersetzt (in setup())
        31: - BLEDevice::startAdvertising() entfernt (in processBleEvents)
        32: - ServerCallbacks angepasst: updateConnParams entfernt
        33: 
        34: ================================================================================
        35: PROBLEM 2: Linker-Fehler "undefined reference to setup()/loop()"
        36: ================================================================================
        37: 
        38: User lieferte Linker-Fehler:
        39: ".pio\build\seeed_xiao_esp32s3\libFrameworkArduino.a(main.cpp.o): undefined reference to `setup()'"
        40: ".pio\build\seeed_xiao_esp32s3\libFrameworkArduino.a(main.cpp.o): undefined reference to `loop()'"
        41:

        67: ================================================================================
        68: PROBLEM 5: Farbsensor TCS34725 funktioniert nicht
        69: ================================================================================
        70: 
        71: User: "ich merke gerade der farbsensor funktioniert gar nicht"
        72: 
        73: LÖSUNGSANSÄTZE:
        74: 1. I2C-Scanner-Code zum Testen vorgeschlagen - findet Sensor bei Adresse 0x29 (OK)
        75: 2. Software-Problem erkannt: tcs.begin() schlug fehl wegen Timing
        76: 3. setupColorSensor() um delay(1000) ergänzt
        77: 4. colorSensorTask vereinfacht (vTaskDelayUntil entfernt, Semaphor-Timeouts optimiert)
        78: 
        79: ================================================================================
        80: PROBLEM 6: Guru Meditation Error (Abstürze bei schnellen WASD-Befehlen)
        81: ================================================================================
        82: 
        83: User: "Guru Meditation Error: Core 1 panic'ed"
        84: "wenn ich schnell auf wasd tippe und dann viele befehle schicke"
        85: 
        86: Erster Crash (Debug exception/BREAK instr):
        87: - WDT-Timeout bei 10s zu kurz
        88: - NVS-Schreibzugriffe (prefs.begin/putFloat/end) blockierten die loop()
        89: - LÖSUNG: WDT auf 20s erhöht
        90: 
        91: Zweiter Crash (IntegerDivideByZero bei KEYS:0110/KEYS:0010):
        92: Backtrace zeigte auf setMotorSpeed()
        93: Ursache: Bei actualSpeed zwischen 0.5 und 2.0 ergab
        94: static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed) = 0 (Float-Truncation)
        95: → STEP_PERIOD_US / 0 = Division durch Null
        96: 
        97: LÖSUNG:
        98:     // ALT (crash):
        99:     uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        100:     
        101:     // NEU (sicher):
        102:     uint32_t actualSpeedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        103:     if (actualSpeedInt < 1) actualSpeedInt = 1;
        104:     interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / actualSpeedInt;
        105:     
        106: Weiterer Fix: interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL setzte auf 0, was später erneut
        107: Division durch Null bei fracAdd auslöste.
        108: Geändert von: if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = 0;
        109: Geändert zu:  if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        110: 
        111: NVS-Entkopplung (Crash-Prävention):
        112: - Einführung von configDirty Flag (bool)
        113: - handleCommand() schreibt nicht mehr direkt in NVS, sondern setzt nur Flag
        114: - saveConfigIfDirty() wird in loop() im Leerlauf aufgerufen
        115: - validateConfig() durch saveConfigIfDirty() ersetzt
        116: 
        117: ================================================================================
        118: PROBLEM 7: Alle Modi + Farbsensor funktionieren nicht nach Absturz-Fix
        119: ================================================================================
        120: 
        121: User: "perfekt es stürtzt nicht mehr ab aber alle andere modis sowie der farbsensor
        122:        funktionieren nicht"
        123: 
        124: Ursache: ServerCallbacks (onConnect/onDisconnect) enqueuten keine Events mehr
        125: in bleEventQueue. Dadurch:
        126: - deviceConnected blieb immer false
        127: - sendColorToWebsite() wurde nie aufgerufen (prüft deviceConnected)
        128: - Farbsensor-Daten wurden nie per BLE gesendet
        129: - Alle Spielmodi erhielten keine Farbdaten
        130: 
        131: LÖSUNG (Code in Edu_V1.3.cpp, Zeilen 495-508):
        132: class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
        133:   void onConnect(BLEServer* server) override {
        134:     BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_CONNECTED, "" };
        135:     if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0);
        136:   }
        137:   void onDisconnect(BLEServer* server) override {
        138:     BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED, "" };
        139:     if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0);
        140:     server->getAdvertising()->start();
        141:   }
        142: };
        143: 
        144: Zusätzlich: server->getAdvertising()->start() in onConnect() entfernt
        145: (Advertising während Verbindung gestartet = Fehler).

        270:   <script>
        271:     // ==========================================
        272:     // BLUETOOTH CORE
        273:     // ==========================================
        274:     const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
        275:     const CMD_UUID     = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
        276:     const STATUS_UUID  = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        277: 
        278:     let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
        279:     let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
        280:     let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
        281:     let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';
        282:     let reconnecting = false;
        283: 
        284:     function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
        285:       connected = isConn;
        286:       document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
        287:       document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
        288:       document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'inline-flex';
        289:       document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));
        290:     }
        291: 
        292:     function resetKeys() {
        293:       keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
        294:       document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        295:     }
        296: 
        297:     function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
        298:       if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
        299:         const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
        300:         if (d.length >= 4) {
        301:           const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');
        302:           if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';
        303:           const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');
        304:           if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];
        305:         }
        306:       } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
        307:         handleRaceMessage(msg);
        308:       } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
        309:         handleQuizMessage(msg);
        310:       } else if (msg.startsWith('KNOBELN:')) {
        311:         handleKnobelnMessage(msg);
        312:       }
        313:     }
        314: 
        315:     function handleKnobelnMessage(msg) {
        316:       if (msg === 'KNOBELN:RUNNING') {
        317:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Roboter startet...');
        318:       } else if (msg.startsWith('KNOBELN:READY:')) {
        319:         const n = msg.substring(14);
        320:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Folge geladen: ' + n + ' Pfeile');
        321:       } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:DONE') {
        322:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Fertig!');
        323:       } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:ABORT') {
        324:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Abgebrochen!');
        325:       } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:STOPPED') {
        326:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Gestoppt!');
        327:       } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:BADLEN' || msg === 'KNOBELN:BADARROW') {
        328:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Ungueltige Folge!');
        329:       } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:NONE') {
        330:         showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Keine Folge gesetzt!');
        331:       }
        332:     }
        333: 
        334:     // Verbindung mit dem GATT Server aufbauen
        335:     async function connectGatt() {
        336:       if (!device || !device.gatt.connected) {
        337:         const server = await device.gatt.connect();
        338:         const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
        339:         cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
        340:         statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
        341:         await statusChar.startNotifications();
        342:         statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
        343:           handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
        344:         });
        345:       }
        346:       connected = true;
        347:       updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
        348:       startSending();
        349:       sendCommand('EduBot V1.3 bereit');
        350:     }
        351: 
        352:     async function connectBLE() {
        353:       try {
        354:         if (!navigator.bluetooth) {
        355:           alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
        356:           return;
        357:         }
        358:         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
        359: 
        360:         // Bereits verbundenes Geraet? Direkt verbinden
        361:         if (device && device.gatt.connected) {
        362:           await connectGatt();
        363:           return;
        364:         }
        365: 
        366:         // Geraet per Filter suchen
        367:         device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
        368:           filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
        369:           optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
        370:         });
        371: 
        372:         device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', onDisconnected);
        373: 
        374:         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Verbinde...');
        375:         await connectGatt();
        376:       } catch (e) {
        377:         console.error('[BLE]', e);
        378:         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
        379:       }
        380:     }
        381: 
        382:     // Bei Trennung: automatisch neu verbinden
        383:     async function onDisconnected() {
        384:       connected = false;
        385:       resetKeys();
        386:       stopSending();
        387:       updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
        388: 
        389:       if (!device) return;
        390:       // Max 5 mal versuchen
        391:       for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        392:         reconnecting = true;
        393:         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Reconnect ' + (i + 1) + '...');
        394:         await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
        395:         try {
        396:           await connectGatt();
        397:           reconnecting = false;
        398:           return;
        399:         } catch (e) {
        400:           console.warn('[BLE] Reconnect fehlgeschlagen:', e);
        401:         }
        402:       }
        403:       reconnecting = false;
        404:       updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
        405:     }
        406: 
        407:     async function sendCommand(cmd) {
        408:       if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
        409:       if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
        410:       writing = true;
        411:       try {
        412:         await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd));
        413:       } catch (e) {
        414:         console.warn('[BLE] send error', e);
        415:       }
        416:       writing = false;
        417:       if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
        418:     }
        419: 
        420:     async function sendKeys(force) {
        421:       if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
        422:       const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
        423:       if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
        424:       lastSent = msg;
        425:       try {
        426:         await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
        427:       } catch (e) {
        428:         console.warn('[BLE] sendKeys error', e);
        429:       }
        430:     }
        431: 
        432:     function startSending() {
        433:       stopSending();
        434:       heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50);
        435:     }
        436:     function stopSending() {
        437:       if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
        438:       heartbeatInterval = null;
        439:     }
        440:

        448:     }

        452:     });
        453:

        455:     // DRIVE

        457:     document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(btn => {
        458:       const key = btn.dataset.key;
        459:       const press = () => { keys[key] = 1; btn.classList.add('active'); };
        460:       const release = () => { keys[key] = 0; btn.classList.remove('active'); };
        461:       btn.addEventListener('mousedown', press);
        462:       btn.addEventListener('mouseup', release);
        463:       btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', release);
        464:       btn.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); press(); });
        465:       btn.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); release(); });
        466:     });
        467:     window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        468:       const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
        469:       if (k in keys && connected) { keys[k] = 1; const b = document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]'); if (b) b.classList.add('active'); }
        470:     });
        471:     window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
        472:       const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
        473:       if (k in keys) { keys[k] = 0; const b = document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]'); if (b) b.classList.remove('active'); }
        474:     });
        475:     document.getElementById('speedSlider').addEventListener('change', e => {
        476:       document.getElementById('speedDisplay').textContent = e.target.value;
        477:       sendCommand('MAX:' + e.target.value);
        478:     });
        479:     document.getElementById('btnStop').addEventListener('click', () => { resetKeys(); sendCommand('STOP'); });
        480:     document.getElementById('btnEmergencyStop').addEventListener('click', () => { resetKeys(); sendCommand('STOP'); });
        481:     document.getElementById('btnConnect').addEventListener('click', connectBLE);

        749:     function cqShuffle(arr) {
        750:       for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        751:         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        752:         [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
        753:       }
        754:       return arr;
        755:     }
        756:     function getColorBg(c) {
        757:       for (const e of CQ_COLORS) if (e.name === c) return e.bg;
        758:       return '#ccc';
        759:     }
        760:     function nextCqQuestion() {
        761:       const a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
        762:       const b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
        763:       const correct = a + b;
        764:       // 4 falsche Optionen, alle unterschiedlich, plus correct
        765:       const opts = new Set([correct]);
        766:       while (opts.size < 4) {
        767:         const delta = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9) - 4; // -4..+4
        768:         const candidate = correct + delta;
        769:         if (candidate > 0 && candidate !== correct) opts.add(candidate);
        770:       }
        771:       const arr = cqShuffle(Array.from(opts));
        772:       // Farben ebenfalls mischen, damit Optionindex nicht gleich Farbindex bleibt
        773:       const colorOrder = cqShuffle([...CQ_COLORS]);
        774:       const container = document.getElementById('cqChoices');
        775:       container.innerHTML = '';
        776:       arr.forEach((val, i) => {
        777:         const col = colorOrder[i];
        778:         const btn = document.createElement('button');
        779:         btn.className = 'color-choice';
        780:         btn.dataset.value = val;
        781:         btn.dataset.color = col.name;
        782:         btn.style.background = col.bg;
        783:         btn.style.color = 'white';
        784:         btn.style.fontSize = '22px';
        785:         btn.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
        786:         btn.style.padding = '14px';
        787:         btn.style.border = 'none';
        788:         btn.style.borderRadius = '10px';
        789:         btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        790:         btn.textContent = val;
        791:         btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        792:           container.querySelectorAll('.color-choice').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        793:           btn.classList.add('selected');
        794:         });
        795:         container.appendChild(btn);
        796:       });
        797:       document.getElementById('cqNumber').textContent = (cqIndex + 1);
        798:       document.getElementById('cqQuestion').textContent = a + ' + ' + b + ' = ?';
        799:     }

        833:     function showCqResultSummary() {

        ### Step 1: Analyze User Requirements
        
        Extract key information from user request:
        - **Product type**: Entertainment (social, video, music, gaming), Tool (scanner, editor, converter), Productivity (task manager, notes, calendar), or hybrid
        - **Target audience**: C-end consumer users; consider age group, usage context (commute, leisure, work)
        - **Style keywords**: playful, vibrant, minimal, dark mode, content-first, immersive, etc.
        - **Stack**: React Native (this project's only tech stack)
        
        ### Step 2: Generate Design System (REQUIRED)
        
        **Always start with `--design-system`** to get comprehensive recommendations with reasoning:
        
        ```bash
        python3 ~/.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "<product_type> <industry> <keywords>" --design-system [-p "Project Name"]
        ```
        
        This command:
        1. Searches domains in parallel (product, style, color, landing, typography)
        2. Applies reasoning rules from `ui-reasoning.csv` to select best matches
        3. Returns complete design system: pattern, style, colors, typography, effects
        4. Includes anti-patterns to avoid
        
        **Example:**
        ```bash
        python3 ~/.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "beauty spa wellness service" --design-system -p "Serenity Spa"
        ```
        
        ### Step 2b: Persist Design System (Master + Overrides Pattern)
        
        To save the design system for **hierarchical retrieval across sessions**, add `--persist`:
        
        ```bash
        python3 ~/.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "<query>" --design-system --persist -p "Project Name"
        ```
        
        This creates:
        - `design-system/MASTER.md` — Global Source of Truth with all design rules
        - `design-system/pages/` — Folder for page-specific overrides
        
        **With page-specific override:**
        ```bash
        python3 ~/.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "<query>" --design-system --persist -p "Project Name" --page "dashboard"
        ```
        
        This also creates:
        - `design-system/pages/dashboard.md` — Page-specific deviations from Master
        
        **How hierarchical retrieval works:**
        1. When building a specific page (e.g., "Checkout"), first check `design-system/pages/checkout.md`
        2. If the page file exists, its rules **override** the Master file
        3. If not, use `design-system/MASTER.md` exclusively
        
        **Context-aware retrieval prompt:**
        ```
        I am building the [Page Name] page. Please read design-system/MASTER.md.
        Also check if design-system/pages/[page-name].md exists.
        If the page file exists, prioritize its rules.
        If not, use the Master rules exclusively.
        Now, generate the code...
        ```
        
        ### Step 2c: Design Dials (optional)
        
        Three optional 1-10 sliders that tune `--design-system` output without changing your query. Add any combination of them to the same command:
        
        ```bash
        python3 ~/.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "<query>" --design-system --variance <1-10> --motion <1-10> --density <1-10>
        ```
        
        | Dial | Low (1-3) | Mid (4-7) | High (8-10) |
        |------|-----------|-----------|-------------|
        | `--variance` | Centered / minimal (biases toward Minimalism-style categories) | Balanced / modern | Bold / asymmetric (biases toward Brutalism, Bento Grids) |
        | `--motion` | Subtle micro-interactions | Standard scroll/stagger motion | Complex choreography (pin, Flip, SplitText) |
        | `--density` | Spacious (24-96px spacing scale) | Standard (16-64px, current default) | Dense/dashboard (8-32px spacing scale) |
        
        - `--motion` attaches a ready-to-use GSAP snippet (with framework notes, Do/Don't, and performance notes) pulled from `--domain gsap`, matched to the resolved tier (Subtle/Standard/Complex).
        - `--density` overrides the `--space-*` CSS variable table in the ASCII/markdown/MASTER.md output — use it for dashboards (high) vs. marketing pages (low) without hand-editing tokens.
        - Leaving a dial unset keeps that part of the output exactly as it was before (no behavior change).
        
        **Example:**
        ```bash
        python3 ~/.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "internal analytics dashboard" --design-system --variance 8 --motion 7 --density 8 -p "Ops Console"
        ```

        ## Tips for Better Results
        
        ### Query Strategy
        
        - Use **multi-dimensional keywords** — combine product + industry + tone + density: `"entertainment social vibrant content-dense"` not just `"app"`
        - Try different keywords for the same need: `"playful neon"` → `"vibrant dark"` → `"content-first minimal"`
        - Use `--design-system` first for full recommendations, then `--domain` to deep-dive any dimension you're unsure about
        - Add `--stack <stack>` for implementation-specific guidance when the target stack is known
        
        ### Common Sticking Points
        
        | Problem | What to Do |
        |---------|------------|
        | Can't decide on style/color | Re-run `--design-system` with different keywords |
        | Dark mode contrast issues | Quick Reference §6: `color-dark-mode` + `color-accessible-pairs` |
        | Animations feel unnatural | Quick Reference §7: `spring-physics` + `easing` + `exit-faster-than-enter` |
        | Form UX is poor | Quick Reference §8: `inline-validation` + `error-clarity` + `focus-management` |
        | Navigation feels confusing | Quick Reference §9: `nav-hierarchy` + `bottom-nav-limit` + `back-behavior` |
        | Layout breaks on small screens | Quick Reference §5: `mobile-first` + `breakpoint-consistency` |
        | Performance / jank | Quick Reference §3: `virtualize-lists` + `main-thread-budget` + `debounce-throttle` |
        
        ### Pre-Delivery Checklist
        
        - Run `--domain ux "animation accessibility z-index loading"` as a UX validation pass before implementation
        - Run through Quick Reference **§1–§3** (CRITICAL + HIGH) as a final review
        - Test on 375px (small phone) and landscape orientation
        - Verify behavior with **reduced-motion** enabled and **Dynamic Type** at largest size
        - Check dark mode contrast independently (don't assume light mode values work)
        - Confirm all touch targets ≥44pt and no content hidden behind safe areas

        ## Common Rules for Professional UI
        
        These are frequently overlooked issues that make UI look unprofessional:
        Scope notice: The rules below are for App UI (iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter), not desktop-web interaction patterns.
        
        ### Icons & Visual Elements
        
        - 默认图标库使用 **Phosphor (`@phosphor-icons/react`)**。`src/ui-ux-pro-max/data/icons.csv` 中列出的只是常用推荐图标，不是完整集合。
        - 当推荐表中找不到合适的图标时：
          - **优先继续从 Phosphor 的完整图标集中选择任何语义更贴切的图标**；
          - 如果 Phosphor 也没有理想选项，可以使用 **Heroicons (`@heroicons/react`)** 作为备选，注意保持风格一致（线性/填充、笔画粗细、圆角风格）。
        
        | Rule | Standard | Avoid | Why It Matters |
        |------|----------|--------|----------------|
        | **No Emoji as Structural Icons** | Use vector-based icons (e.g., Phosphor `@phosphor-icons/react`, Heroicons `@heroicons/react`, react-native-vector-icons, @expo/vector-icons). | Using emojis (🎨 🚀 ⚙️) for navigation, settings, or system controls. | Emojis are font-dependent, inconsistent across platforms, and cannot be controlled via design tokens. |
        | **Vector-Only Assets** | Use SVG or platform vector icons that scale cleanly and support theming. | Raster PNG icons that blur or pixelate. | Ensures scalability, crisp rendering, and dark/light mode adaptability. |
        | **Stable Interaction States** | Use color, opacity, or elevation transitions for press states without changing layout bounds. | Layout-shifting transforms that move surrounding content or trigger visual jitter. | Prevents unstable interactions and preserves smooth motion/perceived quality on mobile. |
        | **Correct Brand Logos** | Use official brand assets and follow their usage guidelines (spacing, color, clear space). | Guessing logo paths, recoloring unofficially, or modifying proportions. | Prevents brand misuse and ensures legal/platform compliance. |
        | **Consistent Icon Sizing** | Define icon sizes as design tokens (e.g., icon-sm, icon-md = 24pt, icon-lg). | Mixing arbitrary values like 20pt / 24pt / 28pt randomly. | Maintains rhythm and visual hierarchy across the interface. |
        | **Stroke Consistency** | Use a consistent stroke width within the same visual layer (e.g., 1.5px or 2px). | Mixing thick and thin stroke styles arbitrarily. | Inconsistent strokes reduce perceived polish and cohesion. |
        | **Filled vs Outline Discipline** | Use one icon style per hierarchy level. | Mixing filled and outline icons at the same hierarchy level. | Maintains semantic clarity and stylistic coherence. |
        | **Touch Target Minimum** | Minimum 44×44pt interactive area (use hitSlop if icon is smaller). | Small icons without expanded tap area. | Meets accessibility and platform usability standards. |
        | **Icon Alignment** | Align icons to text baseline and maintain consistent padding. | Misaligned icons or inconsistent spacing around them. | Prevents subtle visual imbalance that reduces perceived quality. |
        | **Icon Contrast** | Follow WCAG contrast standards: 4.5:1 for small elements, 3:1 minimum for larger UI glyphs. | Low-contrast icons that blend into the background. | Ensures accessibility in both light and dark modes. |
        
        
        ### Interaction (App)
        
        | Rule | Do | Don't |
        |------|----|----- |
        | **Tap feedback** | Provide clear pressed feedback (ripple/opacity/elevation) within 80-150ms | No visual response on tap |
        | **Animation timing** | Keep micro-interactions around 150-300ms with platform-native easing | Instant transitions or slow animations (>500ms) |
        | **Accessibility focus** | Ensure screen reader focus order matches visual order and labels are descriptive | Unlabeled controls or confusing focus traversal |
        | **Disabled state clarity** | Use disabled semantics (`disabled`/native disabled props), reduced emphasis, and no tap action | Controls that look tappable but do nothing |
        | **Touch target minimum** | Keep tap areas >=44x44pt (iOS) or >=48x48dp (Android), expand hit area when icon is smaller | Tiny tap targets or icon-only hit areas without padding |
        | **Gesture conflict prevention** | Keep one primary gesture per region and avoid nested tap/drag conflicts | Overlapping gestures causing accidental actions |
        | **Semantic native controls** | Prefer native interactive primitives (`Button`, `Pressable`, platform equivalents) with proper accessibility roles | Generic containers used as primary controls without semantics |
        
        ### Light/Dark Mode Contrast
        
        | Rule | Do | Don't |
        |------|----|----- |
        | **Surface readability (light)** | Keep cards/surfaces clearly separated from background with sufficient opacity/elevation | Overly transparent surfaces that blur hierarchy |
        | **Text contrast (light)** | Maintain body text contrast >=4.5:1 against light surfaces | Low-contrast gray body text |
        | **Text contrast (dark)** | Maintain primary text contrast >=4.5:1 and secondary text >=3:1 on dark surfaces | Dark mode text that blends into background |
        | **Border and divider visibility** | Ensure separators are visible in both themes (not just light mode) | Theme-specific borders disappearing in one mode |
        | **State contrast parity** | Keep pressed/focused/disabled states equally distinguishable in light and dark themes | Defining interaction states for one theme only |
        | **Token-driven theming** | Use semantic color tokens mapped per theme across app surfaces/text/icons | Hardcoded per-screen hex values |
        | **Scrim and modal legibility** | Use a modal scrim strong enough to isolate foreground content (typically 40-60% black) | Weak scrim that leaves background visually competing |
        
        ### Layout & Spacing
        
        | Rule | Do | Don't |
        |------|----|----- |
        | **Safe-area compliance** | Respect top/bottom safe areas for all fixed headers, tab bars, and CTA bars | Placing fixed UI under notch, status bar, or gesture area |
        | **System bar clearance** | Add spacing for status/navigation bars and gesture home indicator | Let tappable content collide with OS chrome |
        | **Consistent content width** | Keep predictable content width per device class (phone/tablet) | Mixing arbitrary widths between screens |
        | **8dp spacing rhythm** | Use a consistent 4/8dp spacing system for padding/gaps/section spacing | Random spacing increments with no rhythm |
        | **Readable text measure** | Keep long-form text readable on large devices (avoid edge-to-edge paragraphs on tablets) | Full-width long text that hurts readability |
        | **Section spacing hierarchy** | Define clear vertical rhythm tiers (e.g., 16/24/32/48) by hierarchy | Similar UI levels with inconsistent spacing |
        | **Adaptive gutters by breakpoint** | Increase horizontal insets on larger widths and in landscape | Same narrow gutter on all device sizes/orientations |
        | **Scroll and fixed element coexistence** | Add bottom/top content insets so lists are not hidden behind fixed bars | Scroll content obscured by sticky headers/footers |
        
        ---
        
        ## Pre-Delivery Checklist
        
        Before delivering UI code, verify these items:
        Scope notice: This checklist is for App UI (iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter).
        
        ### Visual Quality
        - [ ] No emojis used as icons (use SVG instead)
        - [ ] All icons come from a consistent icon family and style
        - [ ] Official brand assets are used with correct proportions and clear space
        - [ ] Pressed-state visuals do not shift layout bounds or cause jitter
        - [ ] Semantic theme tokens are used consistently (no ad-hoc per-screen hardcoded colors)
        
        ### Interaction
        - [ ] All tappable elements provide clear pressed feedback (ripple/opacity/elevation)
        - [ ] Touch targets meet minimum size (>=44x44pt iOS, >=48x48dp Android)
        - [ ] Micro-interaction timing stays in the 150-300ms range with native-feeling easing
        - [ ] Disabled states are visually clear and non-interactive
        - [ ] Screen reader focus order matches visual order, and interactive labels are descriptive
        - [ ] Gesture regions avoid nested/conflicting interactions (tap/drag/back-swipe conflicts)
        
        ### Light/Dark Mode
        - [ ] Primary text contrast >=4.5:1 in both light and dark mode
        - [ ] Secondary text contrast >=3:1 in both light and dark mode
        - [ ] Dividers/borders and interaction states are distinguishable in both modes
        - [ ] Modal/drawer scrim opacity is strong enough to preserve foreground legibility (typically 40-60% black)
        - [ ] Both themes are tested before delivery (not inferred from a single theme)
        
        ### Layout
        - [ ] Safe areas are respected for headers, tab bars, and bottom CTA bars
        - [ ] Scroll content is not hidden behind fixed/sticky bars
        - [ ] Verified on small phone, large phone, and tablet (portrait + landscape)
        - [ ] Horizontal insets/gutters adapt correctly by device size and orientation
        - [ ] 4/8dp spacing rhythm is maintained across component, section, and page levels
        - [ ] Long-form text measure remains readable on larger devices (no edge-to-edge paragraphs)
        
        ### Accessibility
        - [ ] All meaningful images/icons have accessibility labels
        - [ ] Form fields have labels, hints, and clear error messages
        - [ ] Color is not the only indicator
        - [ ] Reduced motion and dynamic text size are supported without layout breakage
        - [ ] Accessibility traits/roles/states (selected, disabled, expanded) are announced correctly

          <script>
            // ==========================================
            // BLUETOOTH CORE
            // ==========================================
            const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
            const CMD_UUID     = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
            const STATUS_UUID  = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        
            let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
            let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
            let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
            let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';
            let reconnecting = false;
        
            function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
              connected = isConn;
              document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
              document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
              document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'inline-flex';
              document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));
            }
        
            function resetKeys() {
              keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
              document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            }
        
            function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
                if (d.length >= 4) {
                  const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');
                  if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';
                  const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');
                  if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
                handleRaceMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
                handleQuizMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('KNOBELN:')) {
                handleKnobelnMessage(msg);
              }
            }
        
            function handleKnobelnMessage(msg) {
              if (msg === 'KNOBELN:RUNNING') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Roboter startet...');
              } else if (msg.startsWith('KNOBELN:READY:')) {
                const n = msg.substring(14);
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Folge geladen: ' + n + ' Pfeile');
              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:DONE') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'success', 'Fertig!');
              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:ABORT') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Abgebrochen!');
              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:STOPPED') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Gestoppt!');
              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:BADLEN' || msg === 'KNOBELN:BADARROW') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Ungueltige Folge!');
              } else if (msg === 'KNOBELN:NONE') {
                showFeedback('knFeedback', 'error', 'Keine Folge gesetzt!');
              }
            }
        
            // Verbindung mit dem GATT Server aufbauen
            async function connectGatt() {
              if (!device || !device.gatt.connected) {
                const server = await device.gatt.connect();
                const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
                cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
                statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
                await statusChar.startNotifications();
                statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
                  handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
                });
              }
              connected = true;
              updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
              startSending();
              sendCommand('EduBot V1.3 bereit');
            }
        
            async function connectBLE() {
              try {
                if (!navigator.bluetooth) {
                  alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
                  return;
                }
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
        
                // Bereits verbundenes Geraet? Direkt verbinden
                if (device && device.gatt.connected) {
                  await connectGatt();
                  return;
                }
        
                // Geraet per Filter suchen
                device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
                  filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
                  optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
                });
        
                device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', onDisconnected);
        
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Verbinde...');
                await connectGatt();
              } catch (e) {
                console.error('[BLE]', e);
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
              }
            }
        
            // Bei Trennung: automatisch neu verbinden
            async function onDisconnected() {
              connected = false;
              resetKeys();
              stopSending();
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
        
              if (!device) return;
              // Max 5 mal versuchen
              for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                reconnecting = true;
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Reconnect ' + (i + 1) + '...');
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
                try {
                  await connectGatt();
                  reconnecting = false;
                  return;
                } catch (e) {
                  console.warn('[BLE] Reconnect fehlgeschlagen:', e);
                }
              }
              reconnecting = false;
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
            }
        
            async function sendCommand(cmd) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
              writing = true;
              try {
                await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd));
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[BLE] send error', e);
              }
              writing = false;
              if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
            }
        
            async function sendKeys(force) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
              if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
              lastSent = msg;
              try {
                await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[BLE] sendKeys error', e);
              }
            }
        
            function startSending() {
              stopSending();
              heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50);
            }
            function stopSending() {
              if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
              heartbeatInterval = null;
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // NAVIGATION
            // ==========================================
            function nav(viewId) {
              document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
              const el = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId);
              if (el) el.classList.add('active');
            }
