[ASSISTANT]: ## Analyse der bestehenden Spiele & was gemacht werden muss  **Stand der Stubs in der Firmware:** - `RACE:` → nur Status-Weiterleitung (keine echte Motorsteuerung) - `QUIZ:CHECK:` → sendet nur "QUIZ:CHECKING", prüft keine Farben - Memory/Farb-Folge → rein Frontend, keine Roboter-Interaktion  **Was die drei neuen Spiele brauchen:**  1. **Knobeln** (Pfeil-Sequenz, Länge steigt um 1): Frontend generiert Folge → Firmware fährt die Pfeile ab (Pfeile = Richtungsbefehle, die der Roboter nacheinander ausführt) → bei Erfolg: eine Pfeil-Länge mehr. 2. **Korrigieren** (Quiz, Roboter als Korrektor): Frontend sendet erwartete Farb-Folge an Firmware → Roboter fährt über Plättchen → liest pro Plättchen Farbe → vergleicht → meldet Ergebnis. 3. **Multiplayer Rennen** (ESP-NOW): Roboter löst Aufgaben = fährt vorwärts; wenn ein anderer Roboter fertig ist → er empfängt via ESP-NOW → Rennen-Ende.  ---  ## Schritt 1: Firmware erweitern  Ich ergänze die Firmware um eine **spielübergreifende Zustandsmaschine**, ESP-NOW für Multiplayer, und eigentliche Ausführungslogik für die Spiele.

        + // =====================================================
        + void knobelnExecute() {
        +   if (knobelnLen == 0) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:NONE"); return; }
        +   currentGame = GAME_KNOBELN;
        +   sendStatus("KNOBELN:RUNNING");
        +   Serial.printf("[KNOBELN] Start, len=%u\n", knobelnLen);
        + 
        +   for (uint8_t i = 0; i < knobelnLen; i++) {
        +     if (currentGame != GAME_KNOBELN) { sendStatus("KNOBELN:ABORT"); return; }
        +     uint8_t arrow = knobelnSeq[i];
        +     Serial.printf("[KNOBELN] step %u = %u\n", i, arrow);
        +     switch (arrow) {
        +       case 0: gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
        +       case 1: gameTurnRight(GAME_TURN_MS); gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
        +       case 2: gameStop(100); gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break; // runter wie vorwaerts (einfach)
        +       case 3: gameTurnLeft(GAME_TURN_MS); gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 4); break;
        +       default: break;
        +     }
        +     vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(80));
        +   }
        +   currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        +   sendStatus("KNOBELN:DONE");
        +   Serial.println("[KNOBELN] Done");
        + }
        + 
        + // =====================================================
        + // SPIEL: KORRIGIEREN (Roboter faehrt ueber Plättchen)
        + // =====================================================
        + void korrigierenExecute() {
        +   if (korrigierenLen == 0) { sendStatus("QUIZ:RESULT:OK,0,0"); return; }
        +   korrigierenRunning = true;
        +   currentGame = GAME_KORRIGIEREN;
        +   sendStatus("QUIZ:CHECKING");
        +   Serial.printf("[KORRIGIEREN] Start, len=%u\n", korrigierenLen);
        + 
        +   uint8_t okCount = 0;
        +   for (uint8_t i = 0; i < korrigierenLen; i++) {
        +     if (currentGame != GAME_KORRIGIEREN) { sendStatus("QUIZ:RESULT:ABORT"); return; }
        +     korrigierenIdx = i;
        +     // ein Stueck vorwaerts zum naechsten Plättchen
        +     gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 3);
        +     // kurz warten bis zur stabilen Messung
        +     gameStop(GAME_COLOR_READ_MS);
        +     char found[8] = "UNBEKANNT";
        +     getCurrentColorName(found, sizeof(found));
        +     strlcpy(korrigierenFound[i], found, sizeof(korrigierenFound[i]));
        +     Serial.printf("[KORRIGIEREN] %u: erwartet=%s gefunden=%s\n", i, korrigierenExpected[i], found);
        +     if (strcasecmp(korrigierenExpected[i], found) == 0) okCount++;
        +     char part[48];
        +     snprintf(part, sizeof(part), "QUIZ:STEP:%u,%s,%s", i, korrigierenExpected[i], found);
        +     sendStatus(part);
        +   }
        +   // am Ende stoppen
        +   stopMotors();
        +   speedL = 0; speedR = 0;
        +   korrigierenRunning = false;
        +   currentGame = GAME_NONE;
        +   char result[48];
        +   if (okCount == korrigierenLen) {
        +     snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:OK,%u,%u", okCount, korrigierenLen);
        +   } else {
        +     snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:WRONG,%u,%u", okCount, korrigierenLen);
        +   }
        +   sendStatus(result);
        +   Serial.printf("[KORRIGIEREN] Done: %u/%u\n", okCount, korrigierenLen);
        + }
        + 
        + // =====================================================
        + // ESP-NOW (Multiplayer Rennen)
        + // =====================================================
        + void onEspNowRecv(const uint8_t* mac, const uint8_t* data, int len) {
        +   if (len != sizeof(RacePacket)) return;
        +   RacePacket* pkt = (RacePacket*)data;
        +   if (pkt->magic != 0xA5) return;
        +   Serial.printf("[ESPNOW] pkt sender=%u score=%u flags=%u\n", pkt->sender, pkt->score, pkt->flags);
        +   if (pkt->sender == 1) {
        +     // Paket vom Gegner
        +     raceOppScore = pkt->score;
        +     if (pkt->flags & 0x01 || pkt->score >= RENNEN_TARGET_SCORE) {
        +       raceActive = false;
        +       sendStatus("RACE:LOSE");
        +     } else {
        +       char msg[32];
        +       snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "RACE:PROGRESS:%u", raceOppScore);
        +       sendStatus(msg);
        +     }
        +   }
        + }
        + 
        + void onEspNowSend(const uint8_t* mac, esp_now_send_status_t status) {
        +   (void)mac; (void)status;
        + }
        + 
        + void espNowInit() {
        +   WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        +   if (esp_now_init() != ESP_OK) { Serial.println("[ESPNOW] init failed"); return; }
        +   esp_now_register_recv_cb(onEspNowRecv);
        +   esp_now_register_send_cb(onEspNowSend);
        + 
        +   esp_now_peer_info_t peer = {};
        +   memcpy(peer.peer_addr, espNowPeer, 6);
        +   peer.channel = 0;
        +   peer.encrypt = false;
        +   if (esp_now_add_peer(&peer) == ESP_OK) {
        +     espNowReady = true;
        +     Serial.println("[ESPNOW] bereit (broadcast peer)");
        +   } else {
        +     Serial.println("[ESPNOW] add_peer failed");
        +   }
        + }
        + 
        + void raceSendPacket(uint8_t score, bool winner) {
        +   if (!espNowReady) return;
        +   RacePacket pkt = {0xA5, 0, score, winner ? 0x01 : 0x00};
        +   esp_now_send(espNowPeer, (uint8_t*)&pkt, sizeof(pkt));
        + }
        + 
        + // =====================================================
        + // SPIEL: RENNEN (Multiplayer)
        + // =====================================================
        + void raceExecuteStart() {
        +   currentGame = GAME_RENNEN;
        +   raceMyScore = 0;
        +   raceOppScore = 0;
        +   raceActive = true;
        +   raceStartTime = millis();
        +   sendStatus("RACE:STARTED");
        +   Serial.println("[RENNEN] Start");
        + }
        + 
        + void raceForwardStep() {
        +   // Ein "Schritt vorwaerts" pro richtig geloester Aufgabe
        +   gameDriveForward(GAME_STEP_CM_MS * 3);
        + }

        113: bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {

        162: void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
        163:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        164:   const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
        165:   const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        166: 
        167:   float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        168: 
        169:   if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
        170:     digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
        171:   } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
        172:     digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
        173:     actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
        174:   } else {
        175:     if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
        176:     else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
        177:     GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
        178:     portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        179:     return;
        180:   }
        181: 
        182:   uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        183:   if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
        184:   if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = 0;
        185: 
        186:   uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * 0x10000UL) / interval;
        187: 
        188:   if (motorIdx == 0) {
        189:     stepIntervalL = interval;
        190:     stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
        191:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        192:   } else {
        193:     stepIntervalR = interval;
        194:     stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
        195:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        196:   }
        197:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        198: }

        233:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        234:   long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw), static_cast<long>(blackVal), static_cast<long>(whiteVal), 0L, 255L);
        235:   value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);

        239: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        240:   if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
        241:   if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
        242:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        243:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        244:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        245:   if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
        246:   return "UNBEKANNT";

        439:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        440:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        441:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        442:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        443:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        444:       prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        445:       prefs.end();
        446:       sendStatus((String("MAX=") + String(config.maxSpeed)).c_str());
        447:     }
        448:     return;
        449:   }
        450: 
        451:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        452:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        453:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        454:       config.turnFactor = t;
        455:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        456:       prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        457:       prefs.end();
        458:       sendStatus((String("TURN=") + String(config.turnFactor)).c_str());
        459:     }
        460:     return;
        461:   }
        462: 
        463:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        464:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        465:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        466:       config.accelRate = a;
        467:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        468:       prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        469:       prefs.end();
        470:       sendStatus((String("ACC=") + String(config.accelRate)).c_str());
        471:     }
        472:     return;
        473:   }
        474: 
        475:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        476:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        477:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        478:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        479:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        480:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        481:     prefs.end();
        482:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        483:     return;
        484:   }
        485: 
        486:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        487:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        488:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        489:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        490:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        491:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        492:     prefs.end();
        493:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        494:     return;

        530: void processBleEvents() {
        531:   BleEvent evt;
        532:   while (bleEventQueue && xQueueReceive(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0) == pdTRUE) {
        533:     switch (evt.type) {
        534:       case BLE_EVT_CONNECTED:
        535:         deviceConnected = true;
        536:         lastCommandTime = millis();
        537:         Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
        538:         sendStatus("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
        539:         break;
        540:       case BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED:
        541:         deviceConnected = false;
        542:         clearKeys();
        543:         speedL = 0.0;
        544:         speedR = 0.0;
        545:         stopMotors();
        546:         Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt - Werbung gestartet");
        547:         BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        548:         break;
        549:       case BLE_EVT_COMMAND:
        550:         handleCommand(String(evt.cmd));
        551:         break;
        552:     }
        553:   }
        554: }

        556: // =====================================================
        557: // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        558: // =====================================================
        559: 
        560: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        561:   float diff = target - current;
        562:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        563:     return target;
        564:   }
        565:   float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
        566:   if (diff > 0) {
        567:     current += maxChange;
        568:     if (current > target) current = target;
        569:   } else {
        570:     current -= maxChange;
        571:     if (current < target) current = target;
        572:   }
        573:   return current;
        574: }

        576: // =====================================================
        577: // FAHRLOGIK
        578: // =====================================================
        579: 
        580: void updateDrive() {
        581:   float targetL = 0.0;
        582:   float targetR = 0.0;
        583: 
        584:   bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
        585:   bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
        586:   bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
        587:   bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        588: 
        589:   if (forward) {
        590:     targetL = config.maxSpeed;
        591:     targetR = config.maxSpeed;
        592:   } else if (backward) {
        593:     targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
        594:     targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
        595:   }
        596: 
        597:   if (forward || backward) {
        598:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        599:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
        600:   }
        601: 
        602:   if (!forward && !backward) {
        603:     if (left) {
        604:       targetL = 0;
        605:       targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        606:     } else if (right) {
        607:       targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        608:       targetR = 0;
        609:     }
        610:   }
        611: 
        612:   // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
        613:   if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
        614:     targetL = 0.0;
        615:     targetR = 0.0;
        616:     if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
        617:       speedL = 0.0;
        618:       speedR = 0.0;
        619:       clearKeys();
        620:       stopMotors();
        621:     }
        622:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        623:     return;
        624:   }
        625: 
        626:   unsigned long now = micros();
        627:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        628:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        629:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        630: 
        631:   float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
        632:   if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
        633:     speedL = newSpeedL;
        634:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        635:   }
        636: 
        637:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
        638:   if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
        639:     speedR = newSpeedR;
        640:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        641:   }
        642: }
        643:

        648: void validateConfig() {
        649:   bool changed = false;
        650:   if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        651:     config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
        652:   }
        653:   if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
        654:     config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        655:   }
        656:   if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
        657:     config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        658:   }
        659:   if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
        660:     config.blackR = 152; config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
        661:     config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
        662:     changed = true;
        663:   }
        664:   if (changed) {
        665:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        666:     prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        667:     prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        668:     prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        669:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        670:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        671:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        672:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        673:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        674:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);

        676:     Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");

        129: // =====================================================
        130: // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        131: // =====================================================
        132: // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        133: // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        134: // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        135: // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        136: 
        137: uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        138: uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        139: uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        140: uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        141: uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        142: uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        143: 
        144: static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        145: static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        146: 
        147: bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
        148:   if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
        149:   if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        150: 
        151:   if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
        152:     stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
        153:     if (stepFracAccumL >= FRAC_SCALE) {
        154:       stepFracAccumL -= FRAC_SCALE;
        155:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
        156:       stepPhaseL = 1;
        157:     }
        158:   } else {
        159:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        160:   }
        161: 
        162:   if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
        163:     stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
        164:     if (stepFracAccumR >= FRAC_SCALE) {
        165:       stepFracAccumR -= FRAC_SCALE;
        166:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
        167:       stepPhaseR = 1;
        168:     }
        169:   } else {
        170:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        171:   }
        172:   return false;
        173: }
        174: 
        175: void initStepperTimer() {
        176:   timer_config_t cfg = {};
        177:   cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
        178:   cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
        179:   cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
        180:   cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
        181:   cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
        182:   cfg.divider = 80;
        183: 
        184:   timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
        185:   timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
        186:   timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
        187:   timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        188:   timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
        189:   timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        190: }

        192: // =====================================================
        193: // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)
        194: // =====================================================
        195: 
        196: void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
        197:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        198:   const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
        199:   const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        200: 
        201:   float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        202: 
        203:   if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
        204:     digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
        205:   } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
        206:     digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
        207:     actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
        208:   } else {
        209:     if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
        210:     else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
        211:     GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
        212:     portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        213:     return;
        214:   }
        215: 
        216:   uint32_t interval;
        217:   uint32_t actualSpeedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        218:   if (actualSpeedInt < 1) actualSpeedInt = 1;
        219:   interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / actualSpeedInt;
        220:   if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
        221:   if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        222: 
        223:   uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * FRAC_SCALE) / interval;
        224: 
        225:   if (motorIdx == 0) {
        226:     stepIntervalL = interval;
        227:     stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
        228:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        229:   } else {
        230:     stepIntervalR = interval;
        231:     stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
        232:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        233:   }
        234:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        235: }
        236: 
        237: void stopMotors() {
        238:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        239:   stepIntervalL = 0;
        240:   stepIntervalR = 0;
        241:   stepFracAddL = 0;
        242:   stepFracAddR = 0;
        243:   stepFracAccumL = 0;
        244:   stepFracAccumR = 0;
        245: 
        246:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        247:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        248: }
        249: 
        250: // =====================================================
        251: // FARBSENSOR (TCS34725)
        252: // =====================================================
        253: 
        254: Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(
        255:   TCS34725_INTEGRATIONTIME_50MS,
        256:   TCS34725_GAIN_4X
        257: );
        258: 
        259: volatile int sensorR = 0;
        260: volatile int sensorG = 0;
        261: volatile int sensorB = 0;
        262: volatile uint16_t rawSensorR = 0, rawSensorG = 0, rawSensorB = 0, rawSensorC = 0;
        263: volatile char sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
        264: 
        265: SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        266: bool colorSensorOk = false;
        267: 
        268: // Kalibrierung: Rohwerte -> 0-255
        269: int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
        270:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        271:   float value = (static_cast<float>(raw) - blackVal) * 255.0f / (whiteVal - blackVal);
        272:   if (value < 0.0f) value = 0.0f;
        273:   if (value > 255.0f) value = 255.0f;
        274:   return static_cast<int>(value + 0.5f);
        275: }
        276: 
        277: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        278:   if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
        279:   if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
        280:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        281:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        282:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        283:   if (r > config.yellowRmin && g > config.yellowGmin && b < config.yellowBmax) return "GELB";
        284:   return "UNBEKANNT";
        285: }
        286: 
        287: void setupColorSensor() {
        288:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        289:   delay(1000); // Mehr Zeit zum Initialisieren
        290:   
        291:   if (tcs.begin()) {
        292:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
        293:     colorSensorOk = true;
        294:   } else {
        295:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden!");
        296:     colorSensorOk = false;
        297:   }
        298:   colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
        299:   if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        300: }
        301: 
        302: void resetI2CBus() {
        303:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
        304:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
        305:   for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        306:     digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
        307:     pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
        308:     digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
        309:   }
        310:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
        311:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
        312:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        313: }
        314: 
        315: void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
        316:   TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        317:   const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
        318:   int failCount = 0;
        319: 
        320:   while (true) {
        321:     if (colorSensorOk) {
        322:       uint16_t r, g, b, c;
        323:       tcs.getRawData(&r, &g, &b, &c);
        324: 
        325:       if (r == 0 && g == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0) {
        326:         failCount++;
        327:         if (failCount >= 3) {
        328:           colorSensorOk = false;
        329:           Serial.println("[SENSOR] 3x Null-Daten -> Sensor als offline markiert");
        330:         }
        331:       } else {
        332:         failCount = 0;
        333:         rawSensorR = r; rawSensorG = g; rawSensorB = b; rawSensorC = c;
        334: 
        335:         if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) == pdTRUE) {
        336:           int calR = calibrateColor(r, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
        337:           int calG = calibrateColor(g, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
        338:           int calB = calibrateColor(b, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        339: 
        340:           sensorR = calR; sensorG = calG; sensorB = calB;
        341:           strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detectColorName(calR, calG, calB), sizeof(sensorName));
        342:           xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        343:         }
        344:       }
        345:     } else {
        346:       Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
        347:       resetI2CBus();
        348:       if (tcs.begin()) {
        349:         colorSensorOk = true;
        350:         failCount = 0;
        351:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
        352:       } else {
        353:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery fehlgeschlagen");
        354:       }
        355:       vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
        356:       lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        357:       continue;
        358:     }
        359:     vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
        360:   }
        361: }

        431: void sendStatus(const char* msg) {
        432:   Serial.printf("[BLE] %s\n", msg);
        433:   if (statusChar != nullptr && deviceConnected) {
        434:     statusChar->setValue(msg);
        435:     statusChar->notify();
        436:   }
        437: }

        439: void sendColorToWebsite() {
        440:   int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
        441:   char name[16] = {};
        442: 
        443:   if (colorSem == nullptr) return;
        444:   if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
        445:     r = sensorR;
        446:     g = sensorG;
        447:     b = sensorB;
        448:     strlcpy(name, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(name));
        449:     xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        450:   } else {
        451:     return;
        452:   }
        453: 
        454:   char msg[64];
        455:   snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "COLOR:%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name);
        456:   sendStatus(msg);
        457: 
        458:   // Optional: Farbereignis an Mesh weiterleiten (deaktivierbar)
        459:   EduMesh::sendColor(r, g, b, name);
        460: }

        465: 
        466: void clearKeys() {
        467:   keyW = false;
        468:   keyA = false;
        469:   keyS = false;
        470:   keyD = false;
        471: }
        472: 
        473: void hardStop() {
        474:   clearKeys();
        475:   speedL = 0.0;
        476:   speedR = 0.0;
        477:   stopMotors();
        478:   sendStatus("STOP");
        479: }
        480: 
        481: void handleCommand(String cmd) {
        482:   cmd.trim();
        483:   cmd.toUpperCase();
        484:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        485: 
        486:   Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        487: 
        488:   if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
        489:     String data = cmd.substring(5);
        490:     if (data.length() >= 4) {
        491:       keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
        492:       keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
        493:       keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
        494:       keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
        495:     }
        496:     if (isLeaderMode) EduMesh::sendCmd(cmd.c_str(), cmd.length());
        497:     return;
        498:   }
        499: 
        500:   if (cmd == "STOP") {
        501:     hardStop();
        502:     return;
        503:   }
        504: 
        505:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        506:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        507:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        508:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        509:       configDirty = true;
        510:       char buf[32];
        511:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
        512:       sendStatus(buf);
        513:     }
        514:     return;
        515:   }
        516: 
        517:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        518:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        519:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        520:       config.turnFactor = t;
        521:       configDirty = true;
        522:       char buf[32];
        523:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
        524:       sendStatus(buf);
        525:     }
        526:     return;
        527:   }
        528: 
        529:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        530:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        531:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        532:       config.accelRate = a;
        533:       configDirty = true;
        534:       char buf[32];
        535:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
        536:       sendStatus(buf);
        537:     }
        538:     return;
        539:   }
        540: 
        541:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        542:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        543:     configDirty = true;
        544:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        545:     return;
        546:   }
        547: 
        548:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        549:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        550:     configDirty = true;
        551:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        552:     return;
        553:   }
        554: 
        555:   // --- Mesh-Kommandos ---
        556: 
        557:   if (cmd.startsWith("MESH:NAME:")) {
        558:     String name = cmd.substring(10);
        559:     if (name.length() > 0 && name.length() < sizeof(g_robotName)) {
        560:       strlcpy(g_robotName, name.c_str(), sizeof(g_robotName));
        561:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        562:       prefs.putString("robotName", String(g_robotName));
        563:       prefs.end();
        564:       char buf[48];
        565:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH:NAME=%s", g_robotName);
        566:       sendStatus(buf);
        567:     }
        568:     return;
        569:   }
        570: 
        571:   if (cmd.startsWith("MESHMSG:")) {
        572:     String text = cmd.substring(8);
        573:     bool ok = EduMesh::sendMsg(text.c_str(), text.length());
        574:     sendStatus(ok ? "MESHMSG:OK" : "MESHMSG:FAIL");
        575:     return;
        576:   }
        577: 
        578:   if (cmd.startsWith("MESHSEND:")) {
        579:     // Format: MESHSEND:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF,Nachricht
        580:     String rest = cmd.substring(9);
        581:     int comma = rest.indexOf(',');
        582:     if (comma < 0) { sendStatus("MESHSEND:FORMAT"); return; }
        583:     String macStr = rest.substring(0, comma);
        584:     String text = rest.substring(comma + 1);
        585: 
        586:     uint8_t mac[6];
        587:     if (sscanf(macStr.c_str(), "%hhx:%hhx:%hhx:%hhx:%hhx:%hhx",
        588:                &mac[0], &mac[1], &mac[2], &mac[3], &mac[4], &mac[5]) != 6) {
        589:       sendStatus("MESHSEND:BADMAC");
        590:       return;
        591:     }
        592:     // Direkt an Peer senden - sicherstellen, dass Peer existiert
        593:     if (!esp_now_is_peer_exist(mac)) {
        594:       esp_now_peer_info_t info = {};
        595:       memcpy(info.peer_addr, mac, 6);
        596:       info.channel = EduMesh::MESH_CHANNEL;
        597:       info.encrypt = false;
        598:       esp_now_add_peer(&info);
        599:     }
        600:     bool ok = EduMesh::sendMsg(text.c_str(), text.length());
        601:     sendStatus(ok ? "MESHSEND:OK" : "MESHSEND:FAIL");
        602:     return;
        603:   }
        604: 
        605:   if (cmd == "MESHPEERS") {
        606:     EduMesh::Peer peers[EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS];
        607:     size_t count = 0;
        608:     EduMesh::getPeers(peers, EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS, &count);
        609:     char buf[64];
        610:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESHPEERS:%u", (unsigned)count);
        611:     sendStatus(buf);
        612:     for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        613:       char line[80];
        614:       unsigned age = (millis() - peers[i].lastSeen) / 1000;
        615:       snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "PEER:%s,%s,%us",
        616:                EduMesh::macString(peers[i].mac).c_str(),
        617:                peers[i].name, age);
        618:       sendStatus(line);
        619:     }
        620:     return;
        621:   }
        622: 
        623:   if (cmd == "MESHPING") {
        624:     bool ok = EduMesh::sendPing(nullptr);
        625:     sendStatus(ok ? "MESHPING:OK" : "MESHPING:FAIL");
        626:     return;
        627:   }
        628: 
        629:   if (cmd == "FORMATION:ON") {
        630:     formationMode = true;
        631:     sendStatus("FORMATION:ON");
        632:     return;
        633:   }
        634: 
        635:   if (cmd == "FORMATION:OFF") {
        636:     formationMode = false;
        637:     clearKeys();
        638:     sendStatus("FORMATION:OFF");
        639:     return;
        640:   }
        641: 
        642:   if (cmd == "MODE:LEADER") {
        643:     isLeaderMode = true; isFollowerMode = false; formationMode = false;
        644:     clearKeys();
        645:     sendStatus("MODE:LEADER");
        646:     return;
        647:   }
        648:   if (cmd == "MODE:FOLLOWER") {
        649:     isFollowerMode = true; isLeaderMode = false; formationMode = false;
        650:     clearKeys();
        651:     sendStatus("MODE:FOLLOWER");
        652:     return;
        653:   }
        654:   if (cmd == "MODE:NORMAL") {
        655:     isLeaderMode = false; isFollowerMode = false; formationMode = false;
        656:     clearKeys();
        657:     sendStatus("MODE:NORMAL");
        658:     return;
        659:   }
        660: 
        661:   // === MATHE-RENNEN ===
        662:   if (cmd.startsWith("RACE:PROGRESS:")) {
        663:     String scoreStr = cmd.substring(14);
        664:     int s = scoreStr.toInt();
        665:     if (s >= 0 && s <= 10) {
        666:       raceScore = s;
        667:       // Fahre proportional zur Punktzahl (0=nichts, 10=max)
        668:       float fraction = raceScore / 10.0f;
        669:       int driveMs = (int)(fraction * 2000);
        670:       if (driveMs > 0) {
        671:         keyW = true; keyA = false; keyS = false; keyD = false;
        672:         raceDriveUntil = millis() + driveMs;
        673:       }
        674:       // An Mesh weiterleiten
        675:       EduMesh::sendCmd(cmd.c_str(), cmd.length());
        676:     }
        677:     sendStatus(cmd.c_str());
        678:     return;
        679:   }
        680: 
        681:   if (cmd == "RACE:WIN") {
        682:     raceScore = 10;
        683:     EduMesh::sendCmd(cmd.c_str(), cmd.length());
        684:     sendStatus("RACE:WIN");
        685:     return;
        686:   }
        687: 
        688:   // === FARBEN-QUIZ ===
        689:   if (cmd.startsWith("QUIZ:CHECK:")) {
        690:     String seq = cmd.substring(11);
        691:     quizExpectedLen = 0;
        692:     quizIndex = 0;
        693:     // Parse: "ROT,GRUEN,BLAU,GELB,ROT"
        694:     int start = 0;
        695:     while (start < (int)seq.length() && quizExpectedLen < 10) {
        696:       int comma = seq.indexOf(',', start);
        697:       if (comma < 0) comma = seq.length();
        698:       String c = seq.substring(start, comma);
        699:       c.trim();
        700:       if (c.length() > 0) {
        701:         quizExpected[quizExpectedLen] = c;
        702:         quizReadColors[quizExpectedLen] = "";
        703:         quizExpectedLen++;
        704:       }
        705:       start = comma + 1;
        706:     }
        707:     if (quizExpectedLen > 0) {
        708:       quizState = QUIZ_DRIVE;
        709:       quizStepTime = millis();
        710:       clearKeys();
        711:       sendStatus("QUIZ:START");
        712:     } else {
        713:       sendStatus("QUIZ:EMPTY");
        714:     }
        715:     return;
        716:   }
        717: 
        718:   if (cmd == "QUIZ:STOP") {
        719:     quizState = QUIZ_IDLE;
        720:     hardStop();
        721:     sendStatus("QUIZ:STOP");
        722:     return;
        723:   }
        724: 
        725:   char buf[80];
        726:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "UNKNOWN:%s", cmd.c_str());
        727:   sendStatus(buf);
        728: }
        729:

        770:   }
        771: };

        774:   void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* characteristic) override {
        775:     std::string rxValue = characteristic->getValue();
        776:     if (!rxValue.empty()) {
        777:       String cmd = String(rxValue.c_str());
        778:       handleCommand(cmd);
        779:     }
        780:   }
        781: };

        816: // =====================================================
        817: // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        818: // =====================================================
        819: 
        820: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        821:   float diff = target - current;
        822:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        823:     return target;
        824:   }
        825:   float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
        826:   if (diff > 0) {
        827:     current += maxChange;
        828:     if (current > target) current = target;
        829:   } else {
        830:     current -= maxChange;
        831:     if (current < target) current = target;
        832:   }
        833:   return current;
        834: }
        835: 
        836: // =====================================================
        837: // FAHRLOGIK
        838: // =====================================================
        839: 
        840: void updateDrive() {
        841:   float targetL = 0.0;
        842:   float targetR = 0.0;
        843: 
        844:   bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
        845:   bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
        846:   bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
        847:   bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        848: 
        849:   if (forward) {
        850:     targetL = config.maxSpeed;
        851:     targetR = config.maxSpeed;
        852:   } else if (backward) {
        853:     targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
        854:     targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
        855:   }
        856: 
        857:   if (forward || backward) {
        858:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        859:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
        860:   }
        861: 
        862:   if (!forward && !backward) {
        863:     if (left) {
        864:       targetL = 0;
        865:       targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        866:     } else if (right) {
        867:       targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        868:       targetR = 0;
        869:     }
        870:   }
        871: 
        872:   // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
        873:   if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
        874:     targetL = 0.0;
        875:     targetR = 0.0;
        876:     if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
        877:       speedL = 0.0;
        878:       speedR = 0.0;
        879:       clearKeys();
        880:       stopMotors();
        881:     }
        882:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        883:     return;
        884:   }
        885: 
        886:   unsigned long now = micros();
        887:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        888:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        889:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        890: 
        891:   float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
        892:   if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
        893:     speedL = newSpeedL;
        894:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        895:   }
        896: 
        897:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
        898:   if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
        899:     speedR = newSpeedR;
        900:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        901:   }
        902: }
        903: 
        904: void validateConfig() {
        905:   bool changed = false;
        906: 
        907:   if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        908:     config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
        909:   }
        910:   if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
        911:     config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        912:   }
        913:   if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
        914:     config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        915:   }
        916:   if (config.turnOnlySpeed < 50.0f || config.turnOnlySpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        917:     config.turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f; changed = true;
        918:   }
        919:   if (config.leftSign != -1 && config.leftSign != 1) {
        920:     config.leftSign = -1; changed = true;
        921:   }
        922:   if (config.rightSign != -1 && config.rightSign != 1) {
        923:     config.rightSign = -1; changed = true;
        924:   }
        925:   if (config.commandTimeoutMs < 100 || config.commandTimeoutMs > 10000) {
        926:     config.commandTimeoutMs = 500; changed = true;
        927:   }
        928:   if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
        929:     config.blackR = 152;  config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
        930:     config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
        931:     changed = true;
        932:   }
        933: 
        934:   if (changed) {
        935:     configDirty = true;
        936:     Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");
        937:   }
        938: }
        939: 
        940: void saveConfigIfDirty() {
        941:   if (configDirty) {
        942:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        943:     prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        944:     prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        945:     prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        946:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        947:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        948:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        949:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        950:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        951:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        952:     prefs.end();
        953:     configDirty = false;
        954:     Serial.println("[NVS] Config saved");
        955:   }
        956: }

        958: // =====================================================
        959: // MESH (ESP-NOW Inter-Roboter Kommunikation)
        960: // =====================================================
        961: 
        962: void onMeshMessage(const uint8_t* fromMac, uint8_t opcode, const char* text, size_t len) {
        963:   String fromStr = EduMesh::macString(fromMac);
        964:   switch (opcode) {
        965:     case EduMesh::MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT:
        966:       // Stille Pflege; Peers werden in mesh.cpp verwaltet
        967:       break;
        968:     case EduMesh::MESH_OP_MSG: {
        969:       char buf[96];
        970:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH_MSG:%s,%s", fromStr.c_str(), text);
        971:       Serial.printf("[MESH] MSG von %s: %s\n", fromStr.c_str(), text);
        972:       sendStatus(buf);
        973:       break;
        974:     }
        975:     case EduMesh::MESH_OP_CMD: {
        976:       // Weitergeleitetes Kommando lokal ausfuehren
        977:       Serial.printf("[MESH] CMD von %s: %s\n", fromStr.c_str(), text);
        978:       if (isFollowerMode) {
        979:         String cmd = String(text);
        980:         handleCommand(cmd);
        981:       }
        982:       break;
        983:     }
        984:     case EduMesh::MESH_OP_COLOR: {
        985:       // Farbereignis weiterleiten
        986:       Serial.printf("[MESH] COLOR von %s: %s\n", fromStr.c_str(), text);
        987:       char buf[96];
        988:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH_COLOR:%s,%s", fromStr.c_str(), text);
        989:       sendStatus(buf);
        990:       break;
        991:     }
        992:     case EduMesh::MESH_OP_PING: {
        993:       Serial.printf("[MESH] PING von %s\n", fromStr.c_str());
        994:       char buf[48];
        995:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH_PING:%s", fromStr.c_str());
        996:       sendStatus(buf);
        997:       break;
        998:     }
        999:     case EduMesh::MESH_OP_PONG: {
        1000:       Serial.printf("[MESH] PONG von %s\n", fromStr.c_str());
        1001:       break;
        1002:     }
        1003:     default:
        1004:       Serial.printf("[MESH] unbekannt opcode=%u von %s\n", opcode, fromStr.c_str());
        1005:       break;
        1006:   }
        1007: }
        1008: 
        1009: // =====================================================
        1010: // FORMATIONS-LOGIK (Peer-basiert)
        1011: // =====================================================
        1012: void updateFormation() {
        1013:   // Wenn Tasten gedrückt sind, manuelle Steuerung priorisieren
        1014:   if (keyW || keyA || keyS || keyD) return;
        1015: 
        1016:   EduMesh::Peer peers[EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS];
        1017:   size_t count = 0;
        1018:   EduMesh::getPeers(peers, EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS, &count);
        1019: 
        1020:   if (count == 0) {
        1021:     // Keine Peers in Reichweite: stehend suchen (nicht fahren)
        1022:     keyW = false;
        1023:     return;
        1024:   }
        1025: 
        1026:   // Peer gefunden: wir sind "zusammen"
        1027:   keyW = false;
        1028: }

        1030: // =====================================================
        1031: 
        1032: void setup() {
        1033:   Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
        1034:   vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
        1035:   Serial.println("\n======================================");
        1036:   Serial.println("EduBot V1.3 – Xiao ESP32-S3 + DRV8834");
        1037:   Serial.println("======================================");
        1038: 
        1039:     // esp_task_wdt_config_t wdt_config = {
        1040:   //   .timeout_ms = 10000,
        1041:   //   .idle_core_mask = (1 << CONFIG_NUM_CORES) - 1, 
        1042:   //   .trigger_panic = true,
        1043:   // };
        1044:   // esp_task_wdt_init(&wdt_config);
        1045:   // esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        1046:   
        1047:   esp_task_wdt_init(20, true);
        1048:   esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        1049: 
        1050:   // NVS-Konfiguration laden und validieren
        1051:   prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        1052:   config.maxSpeed      = prefs.getFloat("maxSpeed", static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT));
        1053:   config.turnFactor    = prefs.getFloat("turnFactor", TURN_DEFAULT);
        1054:   config.turnOnlySpeed = prefs.getFloat("turnOnlySpeed", 550.0f);
        1055:   config.accelRate     = prefs.getFloat("accelRate", ACCEL_DEFAULT);
        1056:   config.blackR        = prefs.getUShort("blackR", 152);
        1057:   config.blackG        = prefs.getUShort("blackG", 137);
        1058:   config.blackB        = prefs.getUShort("blackB", 98);
        1059:   config.whiteR        = prefs.getUShort("whiteR", 4143);
        1060:   config.whiteG        = prefs.getUShort("whiteG", 4258);
        1061:   config.whiteB        = prefs.getUShort("whiteB", 3036);
        1062:   String savedName    = prefs.getString("robotName", "EduBot-01");
        1063:   strlcpy(g_robotName, savedName.c_str(), sizeof(g_robotName));
        1064:   Serial.printf("[NVS] maxSpeed=%.0f accelRate=%.0f turnFactor=%.2f name=%s\n",
        1065:                 config.maxSpeed, config.accelRate, config.turnFactor, g_robotName);
        1066:   validateConfig();
        1067:   saveConfigIfDirty();
        1068:   prefs.end();
        1069: 
        1070:   // Pins initialisieren
        1071:   pinMode(PIN_DIR_L, OUTPUT);
        1072:   pinMode(PIN_STEP_L, OUTPUT);
        1073:   pinMode(PIN_DIR_R, OUTPUT);
        1074:   pinMode(PIN_STEP_R, OUTPUT);
        1075:   pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
        1076: 
        1077:   digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW);
        1078:   digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
        1079:   digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L, LOW);
        1080:   digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R, LOW);
        1081:   digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW); // DRV8834 aktivieren
        1082: 
        1083:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        1084: 
        1085:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        1086:   lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        1087: 
        1088:   // Hardware-Timer starten
        1089:   initStepperTimer();
        1090:   Serial.println("[TIMER] Hardware-Timer gestartet (10 µs)");
        1091: 
        1092:   // Farbsensor
        1093:   setupColorSensor();
        1094:   if (colorSensorOk) {
        1095:     xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(
        1096:       colorSensorTask,
        1097:       "ColorSensor",
        1098:       STACK_COLOR_SENSOR,
        1099:       NULL,
        1100:       TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR,
        1101:       NULL,
        1102:       CORE_SENSOR
        1103:     );
        1104:     Serial.println("[TASK] ColorSensor-Task gestartet (Core 0)");
        1105:   }
        1106: 
        1107:   // BLE-Queue (deaktiviert - Callbacks verarbeiten jetzt direkt)
        1108:   // bleEventQueue = xQueueCreate(BLE_QUEUE_LENGTH, sizeof(BleEvent));
        1109:   // if (bleEventQueue == NULL) {
        1110:   //   Serial.println("[BLE] Fehler: Queue konnte nicht erstellt werden!");
        1111:   // }
        1112: 
        1113:   // BLE VOR WiFi initialisieren (Espressif-Empfehlung fuer Koexistenz)
        1114:   BLEDevice::init("EduBot");
        1115: 
        1116:   BLEServer* server = BLEDevice::createServer();
        1117:   server->setCallbacks(new ServerCallbacks());
        1118: 
        1119:   BLEService* service = server->createService(SERVICE_UUID);
        1120: 
        1121:   BLECharacteristic* cmdChar = service->createCharacteristic(
        1122:     CMD_UUID,
        1123:     BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE_NR
        1124:   );
        1125:   cmdChar->setCallbacks(new CommandCallbacks());
        1126: 
        1127:   statusChar = service->createCharacteristic(
        1128:     STATUS_UUID,
        1129:     BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_READ | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_NOTIFY
        1130:   );
        1131:   statusChar->addDescriptor(new BLE2902());
        1132:   statusChar->setValue(FIRMWARE_VERSION);
        1133: 
        1134:   service->start();
        1135: 
        1136:   BLEAdvertising* advertising = server->getAdvertising();
        1137:   advertising->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
        1138:   advertising->setScanResponse(true);
        1139:   advertising->setMinPreferred(0x06); // Helps with iPhone connections issue
        1140:   advertising->setMaxPreferred(0x12);
        1141:   advertising->start();
        1142: 
        1143:   Serial.println("[BLE] Werbung gestartet (EduBot)");
        1144: 
        1145:   // --- Debug: BLE-Status prüfen ---
        1146:   logUUIDs();
        1147:   logBLEStatus();
        1148: 
        1149:   // --- Mesh/ESP-NOW vorerst DEAKTIVIERT ---
        1150:   // Grund: WiFi+BLE Coexistence auf ESP32-S3 macht die
        1151:   // BLE-Verbindung (Web Bluetooth) instabil. Mesh bleibt im
        1152:   // Source erhalten und wird spaeter wieder aktiviert.
        1153:   // Wenn aktiviert: VOR BLEDevice::init starten oder
        1154:   // WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA) VOR BLE-Inits setzen, dann
        1155:   // advertising->start() neu aufrufen.
        1156:   //  if (EduMesh::begin(g_robotName, onMeshMessage)) {
        1157:   //    Serial.println("[MESH] ESP-NOW aktiv");
        1158:   //  } else {
        1159:   //    Serial.println("[MESH] ESP-NOW NICHT aktivierbar");
        1160:   //  }
        1161:   //  advertising->start();
        1162:   //  Serial.println("[BLE] Advertising erneut gestartet nach WiFi-Init");
        1163: 
        1164:   Serial.println("[SETUP] Setup abgeschlossen (Mesh deaktiviert)");
        1165: }
        1166: 
        1167: // =====================================================
        1168: // LOOP
        1169: // =====================================================
        1170: 
        1171: void loop() {
        1172:   esp_task_wdt_reset();
        1173: 
        1174:   // BLE-Events werden jetzt direkt in den Callbacks verarbeitet
        1175:   // processBleEvents();
        1176: 
        1177:   // Config in NVS speichern (nur wenn nötig, entkoppelt von BLE-Befehlen)
        1178:   if (configDirty) {
        1179:     saveConfigIfDirty();
        1180:   }
        1181: 
        1182:   // Fahrlogik aktualisieren
        1183:   updateDrive();
        1184: 
        1185:   // Farbsensor-Daten senden (~10 Hz)
        1186:   if (deviceConnected && millis() - lastColorNotify > COLOR_NOTIFY_MS) {
        1187:     lastColorNotify = millis();
        1188:     sendColorToWebsite();
        1189:   }
        1190: 
        1191:   // Mesh-Heartbeat und Peer-Pflege
        1192:   // (Mesh vorerst deaktiviert - siehe setup())
        1193:   // EduMesh::loop();
        1194: 
        1195:   // Formation: Roboter finden sich gegenseitig (RSSI-basiert)
        1196:   if (formationMode) {
        1197:     updateFormation();
        1198:   }
        1199: 
        1200:   // Quiz-Statusmaschine (non-blocking)
        1201:   if (quizState == QUIZ_DRIVE) {
        1202:     unsigned long elapsed = millis() - quizStepTime;
        1203:     if (elapsed < (unsigned long)quizStepMs) {
        1204:       // Vorwaerts fahren
        1205:       keyW = true; keyA = false; keyS = false; keyD = false;
        1206:     } else {
        1207:       // Anhalten und Farbe lesen
        1208:       keyW = false;
        1209:       char colorName[16];
        1210:       if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
        1211:         strlcpy(colorName, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(colorName));
        1212:         xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        1213:       } else {
        1214:         strlcpy(colorName, "UNBEKANNT", sizeof(colorName));
        1215:       }
        1216:       Serial.printf("[QUIZ] Tile %d: %s (erwartet: %s)\n", quizIndex, colorName, quizExpected[quizIndex].c_str());
        1217:       quizReadColors[quizIndex] = String(colorName);
        1218:       quizIndex++;
        1219:       quizStepTime = millis();
        1220:       if (quizIndex >= quizExpectedLen) {
        1221:         quizState = QUIZ_DONE;
        1222:         // Ergebnis auswerten
        1223:         int correct = 0;
        1224:         for (int i = 0; i < quizExpectedLen; i++) {
        1225:           if (quizReadColors[i] == quizExpected[i]) correct++;
        1226:         }
        1227:         char result[64];
        1228:         if (correct == quizExpectedLen) {
        1229:           snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:OK,%d,%d", correct, quizExpectedLen);
        1230:         } else {
        1231:           int firstWrong = -1;
        1232:           for (int i = 0; i < quizExpectedLen; i++) {
        1233:             if (quizReadColors[i] != quizExpected[i]) { firstWrong = i; break; }
        1234:           }
        1235:           snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:WRONG,%s,%s,%d,%d",
        1236:                    quizExpected[firstWrong].c_str(), quizReadColors[firstWrong].c_str(),
        1237:                    correct, quizExpectedLen);
        1238:         }
        1239:         sendStatus(result);
        1240:         EduMesh::sendCmd(result, strlen(result));
        1241:         hardStop();
        1242:       } else {
        1243:         quizState = QUIZ_DRIVE;
        1244:       }
        1245:     }
        1246:   }
        1247: 
        1248:   // Race-Drive-Timeout
        1249:   if (raceDriveUntil > 0 && millis() > raceDriveUntil) {
        1250:     raceDriveUntil = 0;
        1251:     if (quizState == QUIZ_IDLE && !formationMode) {
        1252:       clearKeys();
        1253:     }
        1254:   }
        1255:

        27:   char buf[24];
        28:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
        29:            mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
        30:   return String(buf);

        32: 
        33: static Peer* findPeer(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
        34:   for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) {
        35:     if (!s_peers[i].active) continue;
        36:     if (memcmp(s_peers[i].mac, mac, 6) == 0) return &s_peers[i];
        37:   }
        38:   return nullptr;
        39: }

        42:   Peer* p = findPeer(mac);
        43:   if (p) {
        44:     p->lastSeen = millis();
        45:     return p;
        46:   }
        47:   for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) {
        48:     if (!s_peers[i].active) {
        49:       memcpy(s_peers[i].mac, mac, 6);
        50:       if (name && name[0]) strlcpy(s_peers[i].name, name, sizeof(s_peers[i].name));
        51:       s_peers[i].lastSeen = millis();
        52:       s_peers[i].active   = true;

        54:     }
        55:   }

        57: }

        61:   for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) if (s_peers[i].active) n++;
        62:   return n;
        63: }
        64:

        68:     if (s_peers[i].active) {

        70:       n++;
        71:     }

        89:     return false;

        111: }

        113: // --- Peer-Registrierung (ESP-NOW) --------------------------------------
        114: 
        115: static bool ensurePeerRegistered(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
        116:   if (findPeer(mac) != nullptr) return true; // schon in der Peer-Tabelle
        117:   if (esp_now_is_peer_exist(mac)) return true; // schon bei ESP-NOW registriert
        118: 
        119:   esp_now_peer_info_t info = {};
        120:   memcpy(info.peer_addr, mac, 6);
        121:   info.channel = MESH_CHANNEL;
        122:   info.encrypt = false;
        123:   esp_err_t err = esp_now_add_peer(&info);
        124:   if (err != ESP_OK && err != ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_EXIST) {
        125:     Serial.printf("[MESH] add_peer fehlgeschlagen: %d\n", err);
        126:     return false;
        127:   }
        128:   return true;

        131: // --- ESP-NOW Empfangs-Callback -----------------------------------------
        132: 
        133: static void IRAM_ATTR onDataRecvStatic(const uint8_t* mac, const uint8_t* data, int len) {
        134:   if (len < 1 || mac == nullptr || data == nullptr) return;
        135: 
        136:   uint8_t opcode = data[0];
        137:   const uint8_t* payload = &data[1];
        138:   size_t payloadLen = static_cast<size_t>(len) - 1;
        139: 
        140:   // Peer registrieren (Broadcast-Empfaenger immer vorhanden)
        141:   ensurePeerRegistered(mac);
        142:   
        143:   // Heartbeat enthaelt den Roboter-Namen im payload
        144:   char peerName[16] = {};
        145:   if ((opcode == MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT) && payloadLen > 0 && payloadLen < sizeof(peerName)) {
        146:     memcpy(peerName, payload, payloadLen);
        147:     peerName[payloadLen] = '\0';
        148:   }
        149: 
        150:   Peer* p = addPeer(mac, peerName);
        151:   if (p) {
        152:     // RSSI in dieser API-Version nicht direkt verfuegbar.
        153:     // Wir nutzen einen Platzhalter: Empfang = Peer in Reichweite.
        154:     p->rssi = -60; // Approximation: Empfangen => ca. -60 dBm Bereich
        155:   }
        156: 
        157:   // User-Callback
        158:   if (s_onMessage) {
        159:     char text[MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD] = {};
        160:     size_t copyLen = (payloadLen < sizeof(text) - 1) ? payloadLen : sizeof(text) - 1;
        161:     memcpy(text, payload, copyLen);
        162:     text[copyLen] = '\0';
        163:     s_onMessage(mac, opcode, text, copyLen);
        164:   }
        165: }
        166: 
        167: // --- Send-Callback (optional Logging) ----------------------------------
        168: 
        169: static void onDataSentStatic(const uint8_t* mac, esp_now_send_status_t status) {
        170:   if (status != ESP_NOW_SEND_SUCCESS) {
        171:     Serial.printf("[MESH] send status fail\n");
        172:   }
        173: }
        174: 
        175: // --- Loop / Heartbeat --------------------------------------------------
        176: 
        177: void loop() {
        178:   unsigned long now = millis();
        179: 
        180:   // Heartbeat (Broadcast an alle)
        181:   if (now - s_lastHeartbeat >= MESH_HEARTBEAT_MS) {
        182:     s_lastHeartbeat = now;
        183:     sendRaw((const uint8_t*)"\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff", MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT,
        184:             (const uint8_t*)s_robotName, strlen(s_robotName));
        185:   }
        186: 
        187:   // Abgelaufene Peers entfernen
        188:   if (now - s_lastPeerSweep >= 5000) {
        189:     s_lastPeerSweep = now;
        190:     for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) {
        191:       if (!s_peers[i].active) continue;
        192:       if (now - s_peers[i].lastSeen > MESH_PEER_EXPIRE_MS) {
        193:         Serial.printf("[MESH] Peer entfernt: %s\n", macString(s_peers[i].mac).c_str());
        194:         if (esp_now_is_peer_exist(s_peers[i].mac)) {
        195:           esp_now_del_peer(s_peers[i].mac);
        196:         }
        197:         s_peers[i].active = false;
        198:         s_peers[i].name[0] = '\0';
        199:       }
        200:     }
        201:   }
        202: }
        203: 
        204: // --- begin -------------------------------------------------------------
        205: 
        206: bool begin(const char* robotName, MeshMessageCallback onMessage) {
        207:   strlcpy(s_robotName, robotName ? robotName : "EduBot", sizeof(s_robotName));
        208:   s_onMessage = onMessage;
        209:   memset(s_peers, 0, sizeof(s_peers));
        210: 
        211:   // --- WiFi fuer ESP-NOW initialisieren ---
        212:   // WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA) MUSS vor esp_now_init() aufgerufen werden,
        213:   // sonst schlaegt esp_now_init fehl oder BLE-Coexistenz ist instabil.
        214:   // Wichtig: WiFi.mode() darf NICHT nach BLEDevice::init() aufgerufen
        215:   // werden, sonst stoert es BLE-Advertising auf ESP32-S3.
        216:   // Fuer Mesh+BLE: WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA) VOR BLE-Init setzen.
        217:   WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        218: 
        219:   if (esp_now_init() != ESP_OK) {
        220:     Serial.println("[MESH] esp_now_init fehlgeschlagen");
        221:     return false;
        222:   }
        223:   esp_now_register_recv_cb(onDataRecvStatic);
        224:   esp_now_register_send_cb(onDataSentStatic);
        225: 
        226:   // Kanal fuer ESP-NOW setzen
        227:   esp_wifi_set_channel(MESH_CHANNEL, WIFI_SECOND_CHAN_NONE);
        228: 
        229:   // Broadcast-Peer anlegen, damit wir senden koennen
        230:   esp_now_peer_info_t broadcast = {};
        231:   memset(broadcast.peer_addr, 0xFF, 6);
        232:   broadcast.channel = MESH_CHANNEL;
        233:   broadcast.encrypt = false;
        234:   esp_now_add_peer(&broadcast);
        235: 
        236:   String mac = WiFi.macAddress();
        237:   Serial.printf("[MESH] gestartet: name=%s channel=%u mac=%s\n",
        238:                 s_robotName, MESH_CHANNEL, mac.c_str());
        239:   return true;
        240: }

        // =====================================================
        // EduBot Mesh - Inter-Roboter Kommunikation via ESP-NOW
        // =====================================================
        // Hardware:  Seeed Studio Xiao ESP32-S3
        // Protokoll: ESP-NOW (verbindungslos, Broadcast an Peers)
        // Nutzung:   Freie Text-Nachrichten zwischen mehreren EduBots
        // =====================================================
        
        #pragma once
        
        #include <Arduino.h>
        #include <esp_now.h>
        #include <WiFi.h>
        #include <Preferences.h>
        
        namespace EduMesh {
        
        // --- Konstanten ---------------------------------------------------------
        
        constexpr size_t MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD       = 200;     // max Bytes pro Nachricht
        constexpr size_t MESH_MAX_PEERS         = 8;       // maximale Peer-Anzahl
        constexpr uint32_t MESH_CHANNEL         = 6;       // WiFi-Kanal (fuer alle gleich)
        constexpr unsigned long MESH_PEER_EXPIRE_MS = 60000; // Peers ohne Heartbeat entfernen
        constexpr unsigned long MESH_HEARTBEAT_MS   = 2000;  // eigene Heartbeat-Rate
        constexpr unsigned long MESH_FORWARD_HOP_LIMIT = 4;  // max Weiterleitungs-Spruenge
        
        // Opcodes (1 Byte payload[0])
        enum MeshOpcode : uint8_t {
          MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT = 1,  // heartbeat (name als payload)
          MESH_OP_MSG       = 2,  // freie Text-Nachricht
          MESH_OP_CMD       = 3,  // weiterzuleitendes Kommando
          MESH_OP_COLOR     = 4,  // Farb-Ereignis weiterleiten
          MESH_OP_PING      = 5,
          MESH_OP_PONG      = 6
        };
        
        // --- Peer-Tabelle -------------------------------------------------------
        
        struct Peer {
          uint8_t mac[6];
          char    name[16];
          unsigned long lastSeen;
          bool    active;
          int     rssi;
        };
        
        // --- Callback-Typen -----------------------------------------------------
        
        typedef void (*MeshMessageCallback)(const uint8_t* fromMac, uint8_t opcode, const char* text, size_t len);
        
        // --- API ----------------------------------------------------------------
        
        bool   begin(const char* robotName, MeshMessageCallback onMessage);
        void   loop();
        bool   isReady();
        bool   sendMsg(const char* text, size_t len);
        bool   sendCmd(const char* text, size_t len);
        bool   sendColor(int r, int g, int b, const char* name);
        bool   sendPing(const uint8_t mac[6]);
        size_t peerCount();
        void   getPeers(Peer* outPeers, size_t maxCount, size_t* outCount);
        String macString(const uint8_t mac[6]);
        
        } // namespace EduMesh
