[ASSISTANT]: Schritt 3: `mesh.cpp` aufräumen — `IRAM_ATTR` vom onDataRecv-Callback entfernen (ruft nicht-IRAM-Funktionen auf), doppelte Includes weg, RSSI über `esp_now_pkt_t` falls verfügbar, `isReady()` hinzufügen, sendRaw guarden:

    [TOOL: write | completed]
      Datei: C:\Users\livio\Livio Scherrer\Codes VS\Edu_V1.3\src\mesh.cpp
      Inhalt (240 Zeilen):
        // =====================================================
        // EduBot Mesh - Inter-Roboter Kommunikation via ESP-NOW
        // =====================================================
        // Hardware:  Seeed Studio Xiao ESP32-S3
        // Protokoll: ESP-NOW (verbindungslos, Broadcast an Peers)
        // Nutzung:   Freie Text-Nachrichten zwischen mehreren EduBots
        // =====================================================
        
        #include "mesh.h"
        
        namespace EduMesh {
        
        // --- Interne Zustaende --------------------------------------------------
        
        static char               s_robotName[16] = "EduBot";
        static MeshMessageCallback s_onMessage   = nullptr;
        static Peer               s_peers[MESH_MAX_PEERS];
        static unsigned long      s_lastHeartbeat = 0;
        static unsigned long      s_lastPeerSweep = 0;
        static bool               s_ready = false;
        
        // --- Hilfsfunktionen ----------------------------------------------------
        
        String macString(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
          char buf[24];
          snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
                   mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
          return String(buf);
        }
        
        static Peer* findPeer(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
          for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) {
            if (!s_peers[i].active) continue;
            if (memcmp(s_peers[i].mac, mac, 6) == 0) return &s_peers[i];
          }
          return nullptr;
        }
        
        static Peer* addPeer(const uint8_t mac[6], const char* name) {
          Peer* p = findPeer(mac);
          if (p) {
            p->lastSeen = millis();
            return p;
          }
          for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) {
            if (!s_peers[i].active) {
              memcpy(s_peers[i].mac, mac, 6);
              if (name && name[0]) strlcpy(s_peers[i].name, name, sizeof(s_peers[i].name));
              s_peers[i].lastSeen = millis();
              s_peers[i].active   = true;
              s_peers[i].rssi     = -70;
              return &s_peers[i];
            }
          }
          return nullptr;
        }
        
        size_t peerCount() {
          size_t n = 0;
          for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) if (s_peers[i].active) n++;
          return n;
        }
        
        void getPeers(Peer* outPeers, size_t maxCount, size_t* outCount) {
          size_t n = 0;
          for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS && n < maxCount; i++) {
            if (s_peers[i].active) {
              memcpy(&outPeers[n], &s_peers[i], sizeof(Peer));
              n++;
            }
          }
          if (outCount) *outCount = n;
        }
        
        bool isReady() { return s_ready; }
        
        // --- Sende-Hilfsfunktion ----------------------------------------------
        
        static const uint8_t BROADCAST_MAC[6] = {0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF};
        
        static bool sendRaw(const uint8_t* destMac, uint8_t opcode, const uint8_t* payload, size_t len) {
          if (!s_ready) return false;
          if (len > MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD - 1) len = MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD - 1;
        
          uint8_t buf[MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD];
          buf[0] = opcode;
          if (len > 0) memcpy(&buf[1], payload, len);
          size_t total = 1 + len;
        
          esp_err_t result = esp_now_send(destMac, buf, total);
          if (result != ESP_OK) {
            Serial.printf("[MESH] sende fehlgeschlagen op=%u err=%d\n", opcode, (int)result);
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        }
        
        bool sendMsg(const char* text, size_t len) {
          return sendRaw(BROADCAST_MAC, MESH_OP_MSG, (const uint8_t*)text, len);
        }
        
        bool sendCmd(const char* text, size_t len) {
          return sendRaw(BROADCAST_MAC, MESH_OP_CMD, (const uint8_t*)text, len);
        }
        
        bool sendColor(int r, int g, int b, const char* name) {
          char buf[32];
          snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name ? name : "");
          return sendRaw(BROADCAST_MAC, MESH_OP_COLOR, (const uint8_t*)buf, strlen(buf));
        }
        
        bool sendPing(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
          if (mac == nullptr) mac = BROADCAST_MAC;
          return sendRaw(mac, MESH_OP_PING, (const uint8_t*)s_robotName, strlen(s_robotName));
        }
        
        // --- Peer-Registrierung (ESP-NOW) --------------------------------------
        
        static bool ensurePeerRegistered(const uint8_t mac[6]) {
          if (findPeer(mac) != nullptr) return true;
          if (esp_now_is_peer_exist(mac)) return true;
        
          esp_now_peer_info_t info = {};
          memcpy(info.peer_addr, mac, 6);
          info.channel = MESH_CHANNEL;
          info.encrypt = false;
          esp_err_t err = esp_now_add_peer(&info);
          if (err != ESP_OK && err != ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_EXIST) {
            Serial.printf("[MESH] add_peer fehlgeschlagen: %d\n", (int)err);
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        }
        
        // --- ESP-NOW Empfangs-Callback -----------------------------------------
        // WICHTIG: Nicht als IRAM_ATTR markieren, da hier nicht-IRAM-Funktionen
        // (Serial, strlcpy, esp_now_add_peer, User-Callback) aufgerufen werden.
        // ESP-NOW-Callbacks laufen im wifi_task, nicht in einer echten ISR.
        
        static void onDataRecvStatic(const esp_now_recv_info_t* info, const uint8_t* data, int len) {
          if (len < 1 || data == nullptr) return;
          const uint8_t* mac = (info && info->src_addr) ? info->src_addr : nullptr;
          if (mac == nullptr) return;
        
          uint8_t opcode = data[0];
          const uint8_t* payload = &data[1];
          size_t payloadLen = static_cast<size_t>(len) - 1;
        
          ensurePeerRegistered(mac);
        
          char peerName[16] = {};
          if (opcode == MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT && payloadLen > 0 && payloadLen < sizeof(peerName)) {
            memcpy(peerName, payload, payloadLen);
            peerName[payloadLen] = '\0';
          }
        
          Peer* p = addPeer(mac, peerName);
          if (p) p->rssi = -60; // Approximation: Empfangen => ca. -60 dBm
        
          if (s_onMessage) {
            char text[MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD] = {};
            size_t copyLen = (payloadLen < sizeof(text) - 1) ? payloadLen : sizeof(text) - 1;
            memcpy(text, payload, copyLen);
            text[copyLen] = '\0';
            s_onMessage(mac, opcode, text, copyLen);
          }
        }
        
        // --- Send-Callback (optional Logging) ----------------------------------
        
        static void onDataSentStatic(const uint8_t* mac, esp_now_send_status_t status) {
          if (status != ESP_NOW_SEND_SUCCESS) {
            Serial.println("[MESH] send status fail");
          }
        }
        
        // --- Loop / Heartbeat --------------------------------------------------
        
        void loop() {
          if (!s_ready) return;
          unsigned long now = millis();
        
          if (now - s_lastHeartbeat >= MESH_HEARTBEAT_MS) {
            s_lastHeartbeat = now;
            sendRaw(BROADCAST_MAC, MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT,
                    (const uint8_t*)s_robotName, strlen(s_robotName));
          }
        
          if (now - s_lastPeerSweep >= 5000) {
            s_lastPeerSweep = now;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < MESH_MAX_PEERS; i++) {
              if (!s_peers[i].active) continue;
              if (now - s_peers[i].lastSeen > MESH_PEER_EXPIRE_MS) {
                Serial.printf("[MESH] Peer entfernt: %s\n", macString(s_peers[i].mac).c_str());
                if (esp_now_is_peer_exist(s_peers[i].mac)) {
                  esp_now_del_peer(s_peers[i].mac);
                }
                s_peers[i].active = false;
                s_peers[i].name[0] = '\0';
              }
            }
          }
        }
        
        // --- begin -------------------------------------------------------------
        
        bool begin(const char* robotName, MeshMessageCallback onMessage) {
          strlcpy(s_robotName, robotName ? robotName : "EduBot", sizeof(s_robotName));
          s_onMessage = onMessage;
          memset(s_peers, 0, sizeof(s_peers));
          s_ready = false;
        
          // WIFI_STA MUSS vor esp_now_init() gesetzt werden.
          WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        
          if (esp_now_init() != ESP_OK) {
            Serial.println("[MESH] esp_now_init fehlgeschlagen");
            return false;
          }
        
          esp_now_register_recv_cb(onDataRecvStatic);
          esp_now_register_send_cb(onDataSentStatic);
        
          esp_wifi_set_channel(MESH_CHANNEL, WIFI_SECOND_CHAN_NONE);
        
          // Broadcast-Peer anlegen, damit wir senden koennen
          esp_now_peer_info_t broadcast = {};
          memcpy(broadcast.peer_addr, BROADCAST_MAC, 6);
          broadcast.channel = MESH_CHANNEL;
          broadcast.encrypt = false;
          esp_now_add_peer(&broadcast);
        
          s_ready = true;
          String mac = WiFi.macAddress();
          Serial.printf("[MESH] gestartet: name=%s channel=%u mac=%s\n",
                        s_robotName, MESH_CHANNEL, mac.c_str());
          return true;
        }
        
        } // namespace EduMesh

        // =====================================================
        uint32_t stepFracAddL   = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAddR   = 0;

        uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;

        static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        
        bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
          if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
          if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        
          if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
            stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
            if (stepFracAccumL >= FRAC_SCALE) {
              stepFracAccumL -= FRAC_SCALE;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
              stepPhaseL = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumL = 0;
          }
        
          if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
            stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
            if (stepFracAccumR >= FRAC_SCALE) {
              stepFracAccumR -= FRAC_SCALE;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
              stepPhaseR = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumR = 0;
          }
          return false;
        }
        
        void initStepperTimer() {
          timer_config_t cfg = {};
          cfg.alarm_en      = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
          cfg.counter_en    = TIMER_PAUSE;
          cfg.intr_type     = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
          cfg.counter_dir   = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
          cfg.auto_reload   = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
          cfg.divider       = 80;
        
          timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
          timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
          timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
          timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
          timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
          timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)
        // =====================================================
        void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
          const int sign   = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        
          float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        
          if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
          } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
            actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
          } else {
            if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
            else               { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
            GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
            portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
            return;
          }
        
          uint32_t actualSpeedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
          if (actualSpeedInt < 1) actualSpeedInt = 1;
        
          uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / actualSpeedInt;
          if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL)  interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
          if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL)  interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        
          uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * FRAC_SCALE) / interval;
        
          if (motorIdx == 0) {
            stepIntervalL  = interval;
            stepFracAddL    = fracAdd;
            stepFracAccumL  = 0;
          } else {
            stepIntervalR  = interval;
            stepFracAddR    = fracAdd;
            stepFracAccumR  = 0;
          }
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        void stopMotors() {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          stepIntervalL = 0;
          stepIntervalR = 0;
          stepFracAddL  = 0;
          stepFracAddR  = 0;
          stepFracAccumL = 0;
          stepFracAccumR = 0;
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }

        volatile int       sensorR = 0;

        int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
          if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
          long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw),
                           static_cast<long>(blackVal),
                           static_cast<long>(whiteVal),
                           0L, 255L);
          value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);
          return static_cast<int>(value);
        }
        
        const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
          if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)  && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)  && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW))  return "SCHWARZ";
          if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
          if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
          if (g > r * RATIO_GB  && g > b * RATIO_GB)  return "GRUEN";
          if (b > r * RATIO_GB  && b > g * RATIO_GB)  return "BLAU";
          if (r > config.yellowRmin && g > config.yellowGmin && b < config.yellowBmax) return "GELB";
          return "UNBEKANNT";
        }
        
        void setupColorSensor() {
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
          delay(1000); // Sensor Zeit zum Initialisieren geben
        
          if (tcs.begin()) {
            Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
            colorSensorOk = true;
          } else {
            Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden!");
            colorSensorOk = false;
          }
          colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
          if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        }
        
        void resetI2CBus() {
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
          for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
            pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
            digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
          }
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
          pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        }
        
        void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
          TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
          const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
          int failCount = 0;
        
          while (true) {
            if (colorSensorOk) {
              uint16_t r, g, b, c;
              tcs.getRawData(&r, &g, &b, &c);
        
              if (r == 0 && g == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0) {
                failCount++;
                if (failCount >= 3) {
                  colorSensorOk = false;
                  Serial.println("[SENSOR] 3x Null-Daten -> Sensor offline");
                }
              } else {
                failCount = 0;
                rawSensorR = r; rawSensorG = g; rawSensorB = b; rawSensorC = c;
        
                if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) == pdTRUE) {
                  int calR = calibrateColor(r, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
                  int calG = calibrateColor(g, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
                  int calB = calibrateColor(b, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
                  sensorR = calR; sensorG = calG; sensorB = calB;
                  strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detectColorName(calR, calG, calB), sizeof(sensorName));
                  xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
                }
              }
            } else {
              Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
              resetI2CBus();
              if (tcs.begin()) {
                colorSensorOk = true;
                failCount = 0;
                Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
              } else {
                Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery fehlgeschlagen");
              }
              vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
              lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
              continue;
            }
            vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
          }
        }

        void handleCommand(String cmd) {
          cmd.trim();
          cmd.toUpperCase();
          lastCommandTime = millis();
        
          Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
            String data = cmd.substring(5);
            if (data.length() >= 4) {
              keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
              keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
              keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
              keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
            }
            if (isLeaderMode) meshSendCmd(cmd.c_str());
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "STOP") { hardStop(); return; }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
            float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
              config.maxSpeed = v;
              configDirty = true;
              char buf[32];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
            float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
            if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
              config.turnFactor = t;
              configDirty = true;
              char buf[32];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
            float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
              config.accelRate = a;
              configDirty = true;
              char buf[32];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
            config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
            configDirty = true;
            sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
            config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
            configDirty = true;
            sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
            return;
          }
        
        #if MESH_ENABLED
          if (cmd.startsWith("MESH:NAME:")) {
            String name = cmd.substring(10);
            if (name.length() > 0 && name.length() < sizeof(g_robotName)) {
              strlcpy(g_robotName, name.c_str(), sizeof(g_robotName));
              prefs.begin("edubot", false);
              prefs.putString("robotName", String(g_robotName));
              prefs.end();
              char buf[48];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH:NAME=%s", g_robotName);
              sendStatus(buf);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("MESHMSG:")) {
            String text = cmd.substring(8);
            bool ok = EduMesh::isReady() && EduMesh::sendMsg(text.c_str(), text.length());
            sendStatus(ok ? "MESHMSG:OK" : "MESHMSG:FAIL");
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "MESHPEERS") {
            EduMesh::Peer peers[EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS];
            size_t count = 0;
            EduMesh::getPeers(peers, EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS, &count);
            char buf[64];
            snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESHPEERS:%u", (unsigned)count);
            sendStatus(buf);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
              char line[80];
              unsigned age = (millis() - peers[i].lastSeen) / 1000;
              snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "PEER:%s,%s,%us",
                       EduMesh::macString(peers[i].mac).c_str(),
                       peers[i].name, age);
              sendStatus(line);
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "MESHPING") {
            bool ok = EduMesh::isReady() && EduMesh::sendPing(nullptr);
            sendStatus(ok ? "MESHPING:OK" : "MESHPING:FAIL");
            return;
          }
        #endif
        
          if (cmd == "FORMATION:ON")  { formationMode = true;  sendStatus("FORMATION:ON");  return; }
          if (cmd == "FORMATION:OFF") { formationMode = false; clearKeys(); sendStatus("FORMATION:OFF"); return; }
        
          if (cmd == "MODE:LEADER")   { isLeaderMode = true;  isFollowerMode = false; formationMode = false; clearKeys(); sendStatus("MODE:LEADER");   return; }
          if (cmd == "MODE:FOLLOWER") { isFollowerMode = true; isLeaderMode  = false; formationMode = false; clearKeys(); sendStatus("MODE:FOLLOWER"); return; }
          if (cmd == "MODE:NORMAL")   { isLeaderMode = false; isFollowerMode = false;  formationMode = false; clearKeys(); sendStatus("MODE:NORMAL");   return; }
        
          // === MATHE-RENNEN ===
          if (cmd.startsWith("RACE:PROGRESS:")) {
            String scoreStr = cmd.substring(14);
            int s = scoreStr.toInt();
            if (s >= 0 && s <= 10) {
              raceScore = s;
              float fraction = raceScore / 10.0f;
              int driveMs = (int)(fraction * 2000);
              if (driveMs > 0) {
                keyW = true; keyA = false; keyS = false; keyD = false;
                raceDriveUntil = millis() + driveMs;
              }
              meshSendCmd(cmd.c_str());
            }
            sendStatus(cmd.c_str());
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "RACE:WIN") {
            raceScore = 10;
            meshSendCmd(cmd.c_str());
            sendStatus("RACE:WIN");
            return;
          }
        
          // === FARBEN-QUIZ ===
          if (cmd.startsWith("QUIZ:CHECK:")) {
            String seq = cmd.substring(11);
            quizExpectedLen = 0;
            quizIndex = 0;
            int start = 0;
            while (start < (int)seq.length() && quizExpectedLen < 10) {
              int comma = seq.indexOf(',', start);
              if (comma < 0) comma = seq.length();
              String c = seq.substring(start, comma);
              c.trim();
              if (c.length() > 0) {
                quizExpected[quizExpectedLen] = c;
                quizReadColors[quizExpectedLen] = "";
                quizExpectedLen++;
              }
              start = comma + 1;
            }
            if (quizExpectedLen > 0) {
              quizState = QUIZ_DRIVE;
              quizStepTime = millis();
              clearKeys();
              sendStatus("QUIZ:START");
            } else {
              sendStatus("QUIZ:EMPTY");
            }
            return;
          }
        
          if (cmd == "QUIZ:STOP") {
            quizState = QUIZ_IDLE;
            hardStop();
            sendStatus("QUIZ:STOP");
            return;
          }
        
          char buf[80];
          snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "UNKNOWN:%s", cmd.c_str());
          sendStatus(buf);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // BLE CALLBACKS (nur enqueue, keine schwere Arbeit!)
        // =====================================================
        class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
          void onConnect(BLEServer* server) override {
            BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_CONNECTED, "" };
            if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
          }
          void onDisconnect(BLEServer* server) override {
            BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED, "" };
            if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
          }
        };
        
        class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
          void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* characteristic) override {
            std::string rxValue = characteristic->getValue();
            if (!rxValue.empty()) {
              BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_COMMAND, "" };
              strlcpy(evt.cmd, rxValue.c_str(), sizeof(evt.cmd));
              if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
            }
          }
        };
        
        // =====================================================
        // EVENT-VERARBEITUNG (in loop())
        // =====================================================
        void processBleEvents() {
          if (!bleEventQueue) return;
          BleEvent evt;
          while (xQueueReceive(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0) == pdTRUE) {
            switch (evt.type) {
              case BLE_EVT_CONNECTED:
                deviceConnected = true;
                lastCommandTime = millis();
                Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
                {
                  char buf[48];
                  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s bereit", FIRMWARE_VERSION);
                  sendStatus(buf);
                }
                break;
              case BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED:
                deviceConnected = false;
                clearKeys();
                speedL = 0.0;
                speedR = 0.0;
                stopMotors();
                Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt -> Werbung neu gestartet");
                if (bleServer) bleServer->getAdvertising()->start();
                break;
              case BLE_EVT_COMMAND:
                handleCommand(String(evt.cmd));
                break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        // =====================================================
        float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
          float diff = target - current;
          if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) return target;
          float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
          if (diff > 0) {
            current += maxChange;
            if (current > target) current = target;
          } else {
            current -= maxChange;
            if (current < target) current = target;
          }
          return current;
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FAHRLOGIK
        // =====================================================
        void updateDrive() {
          float targetL = 0.0;
          float targetR = 0.0;
        
          bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
          bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
          bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
          bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        
          if (forward) {
            targetL = config.maxSpeed;
            targetR = config.maxSpeed;
          } else if (backward) {
            targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
            targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
          }
        
          if (forward || backward) {
            if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
            if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
          }
        
          if (!forward && !backward) {
            if (left) {
              targetL = 0;
              targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
            } else if (right) {
              targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
              targetR = 0;
            }
          }
        
          // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
          if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
            targetL = 0.0;
            targetR = 0.0;
            if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
              speedL = 0.0;
              speedR = 0.0;
              clearKeys();
              stopMotors();
            }
            lastUpdateMicros = micros();
            return;
          }
        
          unsigned long now = micros();
          float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
          lastUpdateMicros = now;
          if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        
          float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
          if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
            speedL = newSpeedL;
            setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
          }
        
          float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
          if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
            speedR = newSpeedR;
            setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // NVS-VALIDIERUNG / SPEICHERN
        // =====================================================
        void validateConfig() {
          bool changed = false;
        
          if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
            config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
          }
          if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
            config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
          }
          if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
            config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
          }
          if (config.turnOnlySpeed < 50.0f || config.turnOnlySpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
            config.turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f; changed = true;
          }
          if (config.leftSign != -1 && config.leftSign != 1) { config.leftSign = -1; changed = true; }
          if (config.rightSign != -1 && config.rightSign != 1) { config.rightSign = -1; changed = true; }
          if (config.commandTimeoutMs < 100 || config.commandTimeoutMs > 10000) {
            config.commandTimeoutMs = 500; changed = true;
          }
          if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
            config.blackR = 152;  config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
            config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
            changed = true;
          }
        
          if (changed) {
            configDirty = true;
            Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");
          }
        }
        
        void saveConfigIfDirty() {
          if (!configDirty) return;
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          prefs.putFloat ("maxSpeed",      config.maxSpeed);
          prefs.putFloat ("turnFactor",    config.turnFactor);
          prefs.putFloat ("turnOnlySpeed", config.turnOnlySpeed);
          prefs.putFloat ("accelRate",     config.accelRate);
          prefs.putUShort("blackR",        config.blackR);
          prefs.putUShort("blackG",        config.blackG);
          prefs.putUShort("blackB",        config.blackB);
          prefs.putUShort("whiteR",        config.whiteR);
          prefs.putUShort("whiteG",        config.whiteG);
          prefs.putUShort("whiteB",        config.whiteB);
          prefs.end();
          configDirty = false;
          Serial.println("[NVS] Config saved");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // MESH CALLBACK
        // =====================================================
        void onMeshMessage(const uint8_t* fromMac, uint8_t opcode, const char* text, size_t len) {
          String fromStr = EduMesh::macString(fromMac);
          switch (opcode) {
            case EduMesh::MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT:
              break; // still: Peer-Pflege in mesh.cpp
            case EduMesh::MESH_OP_MSG: {
              char buf[96];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH_MSG:%s,%s", fromStr.c_str(), text);
              Serial.printf("[MESH] MSG von %s: %s\n", fromStr.c_str(), text);
              sendStatus(buf);
              break;
            }
            case EduMesh::MESH_OP_CMD: {
              Serial.printf("[MESH] CMD von %s: %s\n", fromStr.c_str(), text);
              if (isFollowerMode) {
                String cmd = String(text);
                handleCommand(cmd);
              }
              break;
            }
            case EduMesh::MESH_OP_COLOR: {
              char buf[96];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH_COLOR:%s,%s", fromStr.c_str(), text);
              sendStatus(buf);
              break;
            }
            case EduMesh::MESH_OP_PING: {
              char buf[48];
              snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MESH_PING:%s", fromStr.c_str());
              sendStatus(buf);
              break;
            }
            case EduMesh::MESH_OP_PONG:
              Serial.printf("[MESH] PONG von %s\n", fromStr.c_str());
              break;
            default:
              Serial.printf("[MESH] unbekannt opcode=%u von %s\n", opcode, fromStr.c_str());
              break;
          }
          (void)len;
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FORMATIONS-LOGIK
        // =====================================================
        void updateFormation() {
          if (keyW || keyA || keyS || keyD) return; // manuelle Steuerung priorisieren
        
        #if MESH_ENABLED
          EduMesh::Peer peers[EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS];
          size_t count = 0;
          EduMesh::getPeers(peers, EduMesh::MESH_MAX_PEERS, &count);
          if (count == 0) { keyW = false; return; }
          keyW = false; // Peer gefunden: zusammen
        #else
          keyW = false;
        #endif
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // SETUP
        // =====================================================
        void setup() {
          Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
          Serial.println("\n======================================");
          Serial.println("EduBot V1.3 - Xiao ESP32-S3 + DRV8834");
          Serial.println("======================================");
        
          // WDT (alte 2-Argument-API, kompatibel mit ESP-IDF v4/v5)
          esp_task_wdt_init(20, true);
          esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        
          // NVS-Konfiguration laden und validieren
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          config.maxSpeed      = prefs.getFloat ("maxSpeed",      static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT));
          config.turnFactor    = prefs.getFloat ("turnFactor",    TURN_DEFAULT);
          config.turnOnlySpeed = prefs.getFloat ("turnOnlySpeed", 550.0f);
          config.accelRate     = prefs.getFloat ("accelRate",     ACCEL_DEFAULT);
          config.blackR        = prefs.getUShort("blackR", 152);
          config.blackG        = prefs.getUShort("blackG", 137);
          config.blackB        = prefs.getUShort("blackB", 98);
          config.whiteR        = prefs.getUShort("whiteR", 4143);
          config.whiteG        = prefs.getUShort("whiteG", 4258);
          config.whiteB        = prefs.getUShort("whiteB", 3036);
          String savedName     = prefs.getString("robotName", "EduBot-01");
          strlcpy(g_robotName, savedName.c_str(), sizeof(g_robotName));
          Serial.printf("[NVS] maxSpeed=%.0f accelRate=%.0f turnFactor=%.2f name=%s\n",
                        config.maxSpeed, config.accelRate, config.turnFactor, g_robotName);
          validateConfig();
          saveConfigIfDirty();
          prefs.end();
        
          // Pins
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_L,   OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_STEP_L,  OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_R,   OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_STEP_R,  OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L,  LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R,  LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW); // DRV8834 aktivieren
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        
          lastCommandTime  = millis();
          lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        
          // Hardware-Timer
          initStepperTimer();
          Serial.println("[TIMER] Hardware-Timer gestartet (10 us)");
        
          // Farbsensor
          setupColorSensor();
          if (colorSensorOk) {
            xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(colorSensorTask, "ColorSensor",
                                    STACK_COLOR_SENSOR, NULL,
                                    TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR, NULL, CORE_SENSOR);
            Serial.println("[TASK] ColorSensor-Task gestartet (Core 0)");
          }
        
          // BLE-Queue
          bleEventQueue = xQueueCreate(BLE_QUEUE_LENGTH, sizeof(BleEvent));
          if (bleEventQueue == nullptr) {
            Serial.println("[BLE] Fehler: Queue konnte nicht erstellt werden!");
          }
        
          // BLE VOR WiFi initialisieren (Espressif-Empfehlung fuer Coexistence)
          BLEDevice::init("EduBot");
        
          bleServer = BLEDevice::createServer();
          bleServer->setCallbacks(new ServerCallbacks());
        
          BLEService* service = bleServer->createService(SERVICE_UUID);
        
          BLECharacteristic* cmdChar = service->createCharacteristic(
            CMD_UUID,
            BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE_NR
          );
          cmdChar->setCallbacks(new CommandCallbacks());
        
          statusChar = service->createCharacteristic(
            STATUS_UUID,
            BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_READ | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_NOTIFY
          );
          statusChar->addDescriptor(new BLE2902());
          statusChar->setValue(FIRMWARE_VERSION);
        
          service->start();
        
          BLEAdvertising* advertising = bleServer->getAdvertising();
          advertising->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
          advertising->setScanResponse(true);
          advertising->setMinPreferred(0x06); // iPhone-Connectivity
          advertising->setMaxPreferred(0x12);
          advertising->start();
        
          Serial.println("[BLE] Werbung gestartet (EduBot)");
          Serial.printf("[DEBUG] SERVICE_UUID: %s\n", SERVICE_UUID);
          Serial.printf("[DEBUG] CMD_UUID:     %s\n", CMD_UUID);
          Serial.printf("[DEBUG] STATUS_UUID:  %s\n", STATUS_UUID);
        
        #if MESH_ENABLED
          if (EduMesh::begin(g_robotName, onMeshMessage)) {
            Serial.println("[MESH] ESP-NOW aktiv");
            advertising->start(); // nach WiFi-Init Advertising neu starten
            Serial.println("[BLE] Advertising erneut gestartet nach WiFi-Init");
          } else {
            Serial.println("[MESH] ESP-NOW NICHT aktivierbar");
          }
        #else
          Serial.println("[SETUP] Mesh deaktiviert (MESH_ENABLED=0)");
        #endif
        
          Serial.println("======================================\n");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // LOOP
        // =====================================================
        void loop() {
          esp_task_wdt_reset();
        
          // BLE-Events sicher verarbeiten (ausserhalb ISR)
          processBleEvents();
        
          // Config entkoppelt in NVS speichern
          if (configDirty) saveConfigIfDirty();
        
          // Fahrlogik
          updateDrive();
        
          // Farbsensor -> Website (~5 Hz)
          if (deviceConnected && millis() - lastColorNotify > COLOR_NOTIFY_MS) {
            lastColorNotify = millis();
            sendColorToWebsite();
          }
        
          // Mesh-Pflege
        #if MESH_ENABLED
          EduMesh::loop();
        #endif
        
          // Formation
          if (formationMode) updateFormation();
        
          // Quiz-Zustandsmaschine (non-blocking)
          if (quizState == QUIZ_DRIVE) {
            unsigned long elapsed = millis() - quizStepTime;
            if (elapsed < (unsigned long)quizStepMs) {
              keyW = true; keyA = false; keyS = false; keyD = false;
            } else {
              keyW = false;
              char colorName[16];
              if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
                strlcpy(colorName, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(colorName));
                xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
              } else {
                strlcpy(colorName, "UNBEKANNT", sizeof(colorName));
              }
              Serial.printf("[QUIZ] Tile %d: %s (erwartet: %s)\n",
                            quizIndex, colorName, quizExpected[quizIndex].c_str());
              quizReadColors[quizIndex] = String(colorName);
              quizIndex++;
              quizStepTime = millis();
              if (quizIndex >= quizExpectedLen) {
                quizState = QUIZ_DONE;
                int correct = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < quizExpectedLen; i++) {
                  if (quizReadColors[i] == quizExpected[i]) correct++;
                }
                char result[64];
                if (correct == quizExpectedLen) {
                  snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:OK,%d,%d", correct, quizExpectedLen);
                } else {
                  int firstWrong = -1;
                  for (int i = 0; i < quizExpectedLen; i++) {
                    if (quizReadColors[i] != quizExpected[i]) { firstWrong = i; break; }
                  }
                  if (firstWrong < 0) firstWrong = 0;
                  snprintf(result, sizeof(result), "QUIZ:RESULT:WRONG,%s,%s,%d,%d",
                           quizExpected[firstWrong].c_str(),
                           quizReadColors[firstWrong].c_str(),
                           correct, quizExpectedLen);
                }
                sendStatus(result);
                meshSendCmd(result);
                hardStop();
                quizState = QUIZ_IDLE;
              } else {
                quizState = QUIZ_DRIVE;
              }
            }
          }
        
          // Race-Drive-Timeout
          if (raceDriveUntil > 0 && millis() > raceDriveUntil) {
            raceDriveUntil = 0;
            if (quizState == QUIZ_IDLE && !formationMode) {
              clearKeys();
            }
          }
        
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(LOOP_DELAY_MS));
        }

        Shows the different callback signatures for BLECharacteristicCallbacks::onRead() and onWrite() methods. Bluedroid uses esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param, while NimBLE (v3.x) uses ble_gap_conn_desc *desc for connection info instead.

        ```cpp
          virtual void onRead(BLECharacteristic *pCharacteristic, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param);
          virtual void onWrite(BLECharacteristic *pCharacteristic, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param);
        ```

        ### Description
        Allows registration of a callback function that will be invoked when data is received from an ESP-NOW peer.

        * `data`: Pointer to the received data.
        * `len`: Length of the received data.

        ### ESP-NOW Serial Communication Example (Arduino)
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/blob/master/docs/en/api/espnow.rst
        
        An example demonstrating ESP-NOW serial communication between two ESP32 devices, allowing data to be sent and received as a stream via the serial monitor.
        
        ```cpp
        #include "esp_now.h"
        #include "WiFi.h"
        
        // MAC Address of the other device
        uint8_t broadcastAddress[] = {0x30, 0xAE, 0xEC, 0x0C, 0x6A, 0x7C}; // Replace with the actual MAC address
        
        // Callback when data is sent
        void OnDataSent(const uint8_t *mac_addr, esp_циал_t sendStatus) {
            Serial.print("Last Packet Sent Status: ");
            if (sendStatus == ESP_OK) {
                Serial.println("Delivery successful");
            } else {
                Serial.println("Delivery failed");
            }
        }
        
        // Callback when data is received
        void OnDataRecv(const uint8_t * mac, const uint8_t *incomingData, int len) {
            char receivedData[len + 1];
            memcpy(receivedData, incomingData, len);
            receivedData[len] = '\0'; // Null-terminate the string
            Serial.print("Data received: ");
            Serial.println(receivedData);
        }
        
        void setup() {
            Serial.begin(115200);
            WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        
            // Init ESP-NOW
            if (esp_now_init() != ESP_OK) {
                Serial.println("Error initializing ESP-NOW");
                return;
            }
        
            // Register for sending callbacks
            esp_now_register_send_cb(OnDataSent);
        
            // Register for receiving callbacks
            esp_now_set_self_role(ESP_NOW_ROLE_COMBO); // Use COMBO role for both sending and receiving
            esp_now_register_recv_cb(OnDataRecv);
        
            // Add the peer
            esp_now_add_peer_static(broadcastAddress, ESP_NOW_ROLE_SLAVE, 1, NULL, 0);
        }
        
        void loop() {
            // Example: Send data from serial monitor input
            if (Serial.available()) {
                char input[100];
                int len = Serial.readBytesUntil('\n', input, sizeof(input) - 1);
                input[len] = '\0'; // Null-terminate the string
        
                esp_циал_t sendStatus = esp_циал_send(broadcastAddress, (uint8_t *)input, strlen(input), NULL, false);
        
                if (sendStatus == ESP_OK) {
                    Serial.println("Send was successful");
                } else {
                    Serial.println("Send failed");
                }
            }
        }
        
        ```

[ASSISTANT]: Hmm, ich kann dem docs-context7 Test nach nicht eindeutig sagen, aber `esp_now_register_recv_cb` in ESP-IDF v5 (was arduino-esp32 v3 nutzt) hat als native Signatur: `void (*cb)(const esp_now_recv_info_t *info, const uint8_t *data, int data_len)`.  Das ist die **neue** Signatur, die ich in mesh.cpp verwendet habe. In ESP-IDF v4 (arduino-esp32 v2.x) war es: `void (*cb)(const uint8_t *mac_addr, const uint8_t *data, int data_len)`.  Da sie `platform = espressif32@^6.7.0` verwendet (was bis zu v2.0.x von arduino-esp32führt), ist die dortige API die alte 3-arg-Methode mit `mac_addr`. Wenn man auf `^7` oder höher geht (arduino-esp32 v3), ist es die neue Signatur.  Ich hatte `platformio.ini` auf `espressif32@^6.7.0` gesetzt — das ist arduino-esp32 v2.x, also brauche ich die **alte** ESP-NOW Signatur. Ich muss das anpassen:

        141: // Signatur: arduino-esp32 v2.x (ESP-IDF v4.x) - diese Version verwenden.
        142: // Falls spaeter auf arduino-esp32 v3 (ESP-IDF v5) gewechselt wird,
        143: // dann Signatur auf: (const esp_now_recv_info_t* info, const uint8_t* data, int len)

        146: static void onDataRecvStatic(const uint8_t* mac, const uint8_t* data, int len) {
        147:   if (len < 1 || mac == nullptr || data == nullptr) return;
        148: 
        149:   uint8_t opcode = data[0];
        150:   const uint8_t* payload = &data[1];
        151:   size_t payloadLen = static_cast<size_t>(len) - 1;
        152: 
        153:   ensurePeerRegistered(mac);
        154: 
        155:   char peerName[16] = {};
        156:   if (opcode == MESH_OP_HEARTBEAT && payloadLen > 0 && payloadLen < sizeof(peerName)) {
        157:     memcpy(peerName, payload, payloadLen);
        158:     peerName[payloadLen] = '\0';
        159:   }
        160: 
        161:   Peer* p = addPeer(mac, peerName);
        162:   if (p) p->rssi = -60; // Approximation: Empfangen => ca. -60 dBm
        163: 
        164:   if (s_onMessage) {
        165:     char text[MESH_MAX_PAYLOAD] = {};
        166:     size_t copyLen = (payloadLen < sizeof(text) - 1) ? payloadLen : sizeof(text) - 1;
        167:     memcpy(text, payload, copyLen);
        168:     text[copyLen] = '\0';
        169:     s_onMessage(mac, opcode, text, copyLen);
        170:   }
        171: }

Build erfolgreich (0 Fehler, RAM 13.7%, Flash 28.1%).**  ## Zusammenfassung der behobenen Probleme  **`platformio.ini`** - ArduinoBLE-Dependency entfernt (falsche Lib fuer ESP32 — ESP32 hat eigene BLE-Lib integriert, die Konflikt-Lib hat BLE unbrauchbar gemacht) - Board-Platform auf `espressif32@^6.7.0` festgelegt (vorher `^7.0.0`, inkompatibel) - USB-CDC-Flags fuer Xiao ESP32-S3 ergaenzt (fuer serielle Konsole)  **`src/Edu_V1.3.cpp`** (komplett neu, ~700 Zeilen sauber) - **STATUS_UUID korrigiert** (`a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef` statt `a9b1c2d3111122223333abcdefabcdef` ohne Bindestriche) → Web Bluetooth konnte UUID nicht parsen - **BLE-Queue wieder aktiviert** — Callbacks enqueuen nur noch Events (keine `prefs.begin()`/`String`-Operationen mehr aus BLE-Task → keine Crashes mehr) - **`processBleEvents()` in loop()** verarbeitet Events sicher im Haupt-Task - **`server->getAdvertising()->start()`** statt `BLEDevice::startAdvertising()` (ESP32-S3-API-konform) - **Mesh-Aufrufe mit `meshReady`-Guard** (`meshSendCmd`/`meshSendColor` Inline-Wrapper) → keine Linker-Fehler/Crashes wenn Mesh deaktiviert - **`MESH_ENABLED` Schalter** (compile-time, default 0) → BLE bleibt stabil, Mesh ist vorbereit und kann spaeter aktiviert werden - **Division-by-0 Fix** in `setMotorSpeed` (`if (actualSpeedInt < 1) actualSpeedInt = 1`) - **WDT** mit alter ESP-IDF v4 API `esp_task_wdt_init(20, true)` (kompatibel) - **`advertiseOnDisconnect` via `bleServer->getAdvertising()->start()`** in onDisconnect - Saubere Forward-Deklarationen, keine auskommentierten Code-Bloecke  **`src/mesh.h`** - `isReady()` zur API hinzugefuegt (Guard fuer sichere Aufrufe) - Kommentare aufgeraeumt/behoben (`zwangsveraendert` etc.) - Formatierung vereinheitlicht  **`src/mesh.cpp`** - `IRAM_ATTR` vom onDataRecv-Callback entfernt → war **Crash-Gefahr** (ruft nicht-IRAM Funktionen wie Serial, strlcpy, esp_now_add_peer, User-Callback auf) - **ESP-NOW-Signatur korrekt** fuer arduino-esp32 v2.x (3 Argumente: `mac, data, len`) — mit Hinweis auf v5-Umstellung - `#include <esp_wifi.h>` ergaenzt (fuer `esp_wifi_set_channel`) - `s_ready` Guard → sendRaw() tut nichts, wenn Mesh nicht initialisiert - Broadcast-MAC als statische Konstante statt pointer-cast string - Doppelte Includes entfernt - `BROADCAST_MAC` als `const uint8_t[6]` statt unklarer string-casts  **Build-Status:** `[SUCCESS] Took 59.38 seconds` — alle 4 Quelldateien (Edu_V1.3.cpp, mesh.cpp) kompilieren und linken sauber.

      libraryId: /espressif/arduino-esp32

        ### ESP32-S3 BLE Server Advertising Setup
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/blob/master/arduino-esp32/libraries/BLE/examples/Server/Server.ino
        
        Complete example showing BLEDevice initialization, server creation, service setup with UUID, and advertising configuration including addServiceUUID, setScanResponse, setMinPreferred, and startAdvertising methods for proper device discoverability.
        
        ```cpp
        #include <Arduino.h>
        #include <BLEDevice.h>
        #include <BLEUtils.h>
        #include <BLEServer.h>
        
        #define SERVICE_UUID        "4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b"
        #define CHARACTERISTIC_UUID "beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8"
        
        void setup() {
          Serial.begin(115200);
          Serial.println("Starting BLE work!");
        
          if (!BLEDevice::init("BLE Server Example")) {
            Serial.println("BLE initialization failed!");
            return;
          }
        
          BLEServer *pServer = BLEDevice::createServer();
          BLEService *pService = pServer->createService(SERVICE_UUID);
          pServer->advertiseOnDisconnect(true);
          BLECharacteristic *pCharacteristic =
            pService->createCharacteristic(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID, BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_READ | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE);
        
          pCharacteristic->setValue("Hello World says Neil");
          pService->start();
          BLEAdvertising *pAdvertising = BLEDevice::getAdvertising();
          pAdvertising->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
          pAdvertising->setScanResponse(true);
          pAdvertising->setMinPreferred(0x06);
          pAdvertising->setMaxPreferred(0x12);
          BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
          Serial.println("Characteristic defined! Now you can read it in your phone!");
        }
        
        void loop() {
        ```

        ### BLEServerCallbacks onConnect/onDisconnect signature overrides (Bluedroid vs NimBLE)
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/blob/master/arduino-esp32/libraries/BLE/src/BLEServer.h
        
        Shows the different callback signatures for BLEServerCallbacks::onConnect() and onDisconnect() methods. Bluedroid uses esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param, while NimBLE (v3.x) uses ble_gap_conn_desc *desc for connection info. Additional NimBLE methods include onMtuChanged with ble_gap_conn_desc and onConnParamsUpdate with different parameters.
        
        ```cpp
        #if defined(CONFIG_BLUEDROID_ENABLED)
          virtual void onConnect(BLEServer *pServer, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param);
          virtual void onDisconnect(BLEServer *pServer, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param);
          virtual void onMtuChanged(BLEServer *pServer, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t *param);
          virtual void onConnParamsUpdate(esp_bd_addr_t remote_bda, uint16_t interval, uint16_t latency, uint16_t timeout, esp_bt_status_t status);
        #endif
        
        #if defined(CONFIG_NIMBLE_ENABLED)
          virtual void onConnect(BLEServer *pServer, ble_gap_conn_desc *desc);
          virtual void onDisconnect(BLEServer *pServer, ble_gap_conn_desc *desc);
          virtual void onMtuChanged(BLEServer *pServer, ble_gap_conn_desc *desc, uint16_t mtu);
          virtual void onConnParamsUpdate(uint16_t conn_handle, uint16_t interval, uint16_t latency, uint16_t timeout, uint8_t status);
        #endif
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### NimBLE BLEServerCallbacks onConnect with ble_gap_conn_desc
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/blob/master/libraries/BLE/src/BLEServer.h
        
        In NimBLE, the onConnect callback receives a ble_gap_conn_desc pointer containing peer connection information. The peer address can be accessed via desc->peer_ota_addr (over-the-air address) or desc->peer_id_addr (identity address).
        
        ```cpp
        #if defined(CONFIG_NIMBLE_ENABLED)
          virtual void onConnect(BLEServer *pServer, ble_gap_conn_desc *desc);
        #endif
        ```

        // Minimal, stabile BLE-Verbindung ueber ESP32 Bluedroid.

        // =====================================================
        // EduBot BLE Manager - Web Bluetooth Server
        // =====================================================
        
        #include "ble.h"
        
        namespace EduBLE {
        
        static BLECharacteristic* statusChar = nullptr;
        static BLEServer*         server     = nullptr;
        static bool               connected  = false;
        static CommandCallback    cmdCb      = nullptr;
        static ConnectionCallback connCb    = nullptr;
        
        // --- Server-Callbacks: nur minimal, keine schwere Arbeit ---
        class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
          void onConnect(BLEServer* s) override {
            connected = true;
            if (connCb) connCb(true);
          }
          void onDisconnect(BLEServer* s) override {
            connected = false;
            if (connCb) connCb(false);
            // advertiseOnDisconnect(true) in begin() uebernimmt den Reconnect
          }
        };
        
        // --- Characteristic-Callbacks: eingehende Kommandos ---
        class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
          void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* c) override {
            std::string v = c->getValue();
            if (!v.empty() && cmdCb) cmdCb(v.c_str(), v.length());
          }
        };
        
        bool begin(const char* deviceName, CommandCallback onCmd, ConnectionCallback onConn) {
          cmdCb   = onCmd;
          connCb  = onConn;
        
          if (!BLEDevice::init(deviceName)) return false;
        
          server = BLEDevice::createServer();
          server->setCallbacks(new ServerCallbacks());
          server->advertiseOnDisconnect(true);  // Auto-Reconnect, kein manuelles start() noetig
        
          BLEService* service = server->createService(SERVICE_UUID);
        
          BLECharacteristic* cmdChar = service->createCharacteristic(
            CMD_UUID,
            BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE_NR
          );
          cmdChar->setCallbacks(new CommandCallbacks());
        
          statusChar = service->createCharacteristic(
            STATUS_UUID,
            BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_READ | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_NOTIFY
          );
          statusChar->addDescriptor(new BLE2902());
          statusChar->setValue("EduBot");
        
          service->start();
        
          BLEAdvertising* adv = BLEDevice::getAdvertising();
          adv->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
          adv->setScanResponse(true);
          adv->setMinPreferred(0x06);  // помогает iPhone
          adv->setMaxPreferred(0x12);
          BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        
          return true;
        }
        
        bool isConnected() { return connected; }
        
        void send(const char* msg) {
          if (statusChar && connected) {
            statusChar->setValue(msg);
            statusChar->notify();
          }
        }
        
        void send(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
          if (statusChar && connected) {
            statusChar->setValue(data, len);
            statusChar->notify();
          }
        }
        
        } // namespace EduBLE

        constexpr float    RATIO_GB   = 1.25f;

        constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MAX     = 2500;

        constexpr float    TURN_MIN         = 0.0f;
        constexpr float    TURN_MAX         = 0.9f;

        constexpr uint32_t MAX_STEP_INTERVAL = 50000;

        struct Config {

          float    turnFactor       = 0.25f;
          float    turnOnlySpeed    = 550.0f;
