        // =====================================================
        // STEPPER-TIMER (Bresenham)
        // =====================================================
        uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0, stepFracAddR = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0, stepFracAccumR = 0;
        uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0, stepIntervalR = 0;
        static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0, stepPhaseR = 0;
        
        bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *) {
          if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
          if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        
          if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
            stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
            if (stepFracAccumL >= FRAC_SCALE) {
              stepFracAccumL -= FRAC_SCALE;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
              stepPhaseL = 1;
            }
          } else stepFracAccumL = 0;
        
          if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
            stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
            if (stepFracAccumR >= FRAC_SCALE) {
              stepFracAccumR -= FRAC_SCALE;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
              stepPhaseR = 1;
            }
          } else stepFracAccumR = 0;
        
          return false;
        }
        
        void initStepperTimer() {
          timer_config_t cfg = {};
          cfg.alarm_en    = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
          cfg.counter_en  = TIMER_PAUSE;
          cfg.intr_type   = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
          cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
          cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
          cfg.divider     = 80;
        
          timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
          timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
          timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
          timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
          timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
          timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // MOTOR (DRV8834)
        // =====================================================
        void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
          const int sign   = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
          float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        
          if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
          } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
            actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
          } else {
            if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
            else               { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
            GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
            portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
            return;
          }
        
          uint32_t speedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
          if (speedInt < 1) speedInt = 1;
        
          uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / speedInt;
          if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
          if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        
          uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * FRAC_SCALE) / interval;
        
          if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = interval; stepFracAddL = fracAdd; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
          else               { stepIntervalR = interval; stepFracAddR = fracAdd; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        void stopMotors() {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          stepIntervalL = stepIntervalR = 0;
          stepFracAddL  = stepFracAddR  = 0;
          stepFracAccumL = stepFracAccumR = 0;
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FARBSENSOR (TCS34725)
        // =====================================================
        Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(TCS34725_INTEGRATIONTIME_50MS, TCS34725_GAIN_4X);
        
        volatile int      sensorR = 0, sensorG = 0, sensorB = 0;
        volatile uint16_t rawR = 0, rawG = 0, rawB = 0, rawC = 0;
        volatile char     sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
        
        SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        bool colorSensorOk = false;
        
        int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
          if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
          long v = map((long)raw, (long)blackVal, (long)whiteVal, 0L, 255L);
          v = constrain(v, 0L, 255L);
          return (int)v;
        }
        
        const char* detectColor(int r, int g, int b) {
          if (r < COLOR_LOW  && g < COLOR_LOW  && b < COLOR_LOW)  return "SCHWARZ";
          if (r > COLOR_HIGH && g > COLOR_HIGH && b > COLOR_HIGH) return "WEISS";
          if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
          if (g > r * RATIO_GB  && g > b * RATIO_GB)  return "GRUEN";
          if (b > r * RATIO_GB  && b > g * RATIO_GB)  return "BLAU";
          if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
          return "UNBEKANNT";
        }
        
        void setupColorSensor() {
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
          delay(1000);
          colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
          Serial.println(colorSensorOk ? "[SENSOR] OK" : "[SENSOR] nicht gefunden");
          colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
          if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        }
        
        void resetI2C() {
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT); pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
          for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
            digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
            digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW);  delayMicroseconds(5);
          }
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT); pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        }
        
        void colorSensorTask(void *) {
          TickType_t lastWake = xTaskGetTickCount();
          const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
          int fails = 0;
        
          while (true) {
            if (colorSensorOk) {
              uint16_t r, g, b, c;
              tcs.getRawData(&r, &g, &b, &c);
              if (r == 0 && g == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0) {
                if (++fails >= 3) { colorSensorOk = false; Serial.println("[SENSOR] offline"); }
              } else {
                fails = 0;
                rawR = r; rawG = g; rawB = b; rawC = c;
                if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) == pdTRUE) {
                  int cR = calibrateColor(r, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
                  int cG = calibrateColor(g, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
                  int cB = calibrateColor(b, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
                  sensorR = cR; sensorG = cG; sensorB = cB;
                  strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detectColor(cR, cG, cB), sizeof(sensorName));
                  xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
                }
              }
            } else {
              Serial.println("[SENSOR] recover...");
              resetI2C();
              if (tcs.begin()) { colorSensorOk = true; fails = 0; Serial.println("[SENSOR] recovered"); }
              vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
              lastWake = xTaskGetTickCount();
              continue;
            }
            vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWake, period);
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // STEUERUNGSZUSTAND
        // =====================================================
        bool keyW = false, keyA = false, keyS = false, keyD = false;
        float speedL = 0.0, speedR = 0.0;
        unsigned long lastCmdTime = 0, lastColorNotify = 0, lastUpdateMicros = 0;
        
        void clearKeys() { keyW = keyA = keyS = keyD = false; }
        
        void hardStop() {
          clearKeys();
          speedL = speedR = 0.0;
          stopMotors();
          EduBLE::send("STOP");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // KOMMANDOS
        // =====================================================
        void handleCommand(const char* s, size_t) {
          String cmd(s);
          cmd.trim();
          cmd.toUpperCase();
          lastCmdTime = millis();
          Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
            String d = cmd.substring(5);
            if (d.length() >= 4) {
              keyW = d.charAt(0) == '1';
              keyA = d.charAt(1) == '1';
              keyS = d.charAt(2) == '1';
              keyD = d.charAt(3) == '1';
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd == "STOP") { hardStop(); return; }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
            float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
              config.maxSpeed = v; configDirty = true;
              char b[32]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
              EduBLE::send(b);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
            float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
            if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
              config.turnFactor = t; configDirty = true;
              char b[32]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
              EduBLE::send(b);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
            float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
              config.accelRate = a; configDirty = true;
              char b[32]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
              EduBLE::send(b);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
            config.blackR = rawR; config.blackG = rawG; config.blackB = rawB;
            configDirty = true; EduBLE::send("CAL:BLACK OK"); return;
          }
          if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
            config.whiteR = rawR; config.whiteG = rawG; config.whiteB = rawB;
            configDirty = true; EduBLE::send("CAL:WHITE OK"); return;
          }
        
          char b[80]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "UNKNOWN:%s", cmd.c_str());
          EduBLE::send(b);
        }
        
        void onConnection(bool connected) {
          if (connected) {
            lastCmdTime = millis();
            Serial.println("[BLE] verbunden");
            EduBLE::send("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
          } else {
            Serial.println("[BLE] getrennt");
            clearKeys();
            speedL = speedR = 0.0;
            stopMotors();
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FARBE AN WEBSITE
        // =====================================================
        void sendColorToWebsite() {
          int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
          char name[16] = {};
          if (colorSem == nullptr) return;
          if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
            r = sensorR; g = sensorG; b = sensorB;
            strlcpy(name, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(name));
            xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
          } else return;
          char msg[64];
          snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "COLOR:%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name);
          EduBLE::send(msg);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // RAMPE
        // =====================================================
        float rampSpeed(float cur, float target, float dt) {
          float diff = target - cur;
          if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) return target;
          float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
          if (diff > 0) { cur += maxChange; if (cur > target) cur = target; }
          else          { cur -= maxChange; if (cur < target) cur = target; }
          return cur;
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FAHRLOGIK
        // =====================================================
        void updateDrive() {
          float tL = 0.0, tR = 0.0;
          bool fwd = keyW && !keyS, bwd = keyS && !keyW;
          bool left = keyA && !keyD, right = keyD && !keyA;
        
          if (fwd)      { tL =  config.maxSpeed; tR =  config.maxSpeed; }
          else if (bwd) { tL = -config.maxSpeed; tR = -config.maxSpeed; }
        
          if (fwd || bwd) {
            if (left)  tL *= config.turnFactor;
            if (right) tR *= config.turnFactor;
          } else {
            if (left)       { tL = 0;                   tR =  config.turnOnlySpeed; }
            else if (right) { tL =  config.turnOnlySpeed; tR = 0;                   }
          }
        
          if (millis() - lastCmdTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
            tL = tR = 0.0;
            if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
              speedL = speedR = 0.0;
              clearKeys();
              stopMotors();
            }
            lastUpdateMicros = micros();
            return;
          }
        
          unsigned long now = micros();
          float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
          lastUpdateMicros = now;
          if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        
          float nL = rampSpeed(speedL, tL, dt);
          if (nL != speedL) { speedL = nL; setMotorSpeed(0, speedL); }
          float nR = rampSpeed(speedR, tR, dt);
          if (nR != speedR) { speedR = nR; setMotorSpeed(1, speedR); }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // NVS
        // =====================================================
        void validateConfig() {
          bool ch = false;
          if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) { config.maxSpeed = MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT; ch = true; }
          if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX)        { config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT;    ch = true; }
          if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX)      { config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT;   ch = true; }
          if (config.turnOnlySpeed < 50.0f || config.turnOnlySpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) { config.turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f; ch = true; }
          if (config.commandTimeoutMs < 100 || config.commandTimeoutMs > 10000)    { config.commandTimeoutMs = 500; ch = true; }
          if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
            config.blackR = 152;  config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
            config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
            ch = true;
          }
          if (ch) { configDirty = true; Serial.println("[NVS] config korrigiert"); }
        }
        
        void saveConfigIfDirty() {
          if (!configDirty) return;
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          prefs.putFloat ("maxSpeed",      config.maxSpeed);
          prefs.putFloat ("turnFactor",    config.turnFactor);
          prefs.putFloat ("turnOnlySpeed", config.turnOnlySpeed);
          prefs.putFloat ("accelRate",     config.accelRate);
          prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR); prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG); prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
          prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR); prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG); prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
          prefs.end();
          configDirty = false;
          Serial.println("[NVS] gespeichert");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // SETUP
        // =====================================================
        void setup() {
          Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
          Serial.println("\n== EduBot V1.3 ==");
        
          esp_task_wdt_init(20, true);
          esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        
          // NVS laden
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          config.maxSpeed      = prefs.getFloat ("maxSpeed",      MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT);
          config.turnFactor    = prefs.getFloat ("turnFactor",    TURN_DEFAULT);
          config.turnOnlySpeed = prefs.getFloat ("turnOnlySpeed", 550.0f);
          config.accelRate     = prefs.getFloat ("accelRate",     ACCEL_DEFAULT);
          config.blackR = prefs.getUShort("blackR", 152);  config.blackG = prefs.getUShort("blackG", 137); config.blackB = prefs.getUShort("blackB", 98);
          config.whiteR = prefs.getUShort("whiteR", 4143); config.whiteG = prefs.getUShort("whiteG", 4258); config.whiteB = prefs.getUShort("whiteB", 3036);
          validateConfig();
          saveConfigIfDirty();
          prefs.end();
        
          // Pins
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_L, OUTPUT);  pinMode(PIN_STEP_L, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_R, OUTPUT);  pinMode(PIN_STEP_R, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW); digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L,  LOW); digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R,  LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW);
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          lastCmdTime = millis();
          lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        
          initStepperTimer();
          setupColorSensor();
          if (colorSensorOk) {
            xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(colorSensorTask, "ColorSensor", STACK_COLOR_SENSOR,
                                    NULL, TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR, NULL, CORE_SENSOR);
          }
        
          // BLE
          EduBLE::begin("EduBot", handleCommand, onConnection);
          Serial.println("[BLE] gestartet");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // LOOP
        // =====================================================
        void loop() {
          esp_task_wdt_reset();
          if (configDirty) saveConfigIfDirty();
          updateDrive();
          if (EduBLE::isConnected() && millis() - lastColorNotify > COLOR_NOTIFY_MS) {
            lastColorNotify = millis();
            sendColorToWebsite();
          }
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(LOOP_DELAY_MS));
        }

[ASSISTANT]: Build erfolgreich — 0 Fehler, 0 Warnings.  Die 4 VS Code-Probleme lagen an den Callback-Signaturen: - `onConnect(BLEServer*)` → `onConnect(BLEServer*, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*)`  - `onDisconnect(BLEServer*)` → `onDisconnect(BLEServer*, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*)`  - `onWrite(BLECharacteristic*)` → `onWrite(BLECharacteristic*, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*)`  - 4. war wahrscheinlich der Rckgabewert- oder ein Cast-Warnung  VS Code's IntelliSense nutzt die offiziellen ESP-IDF v4 Bluedroid-Header, die die 2-Parameter-Versionen erwarten. PlatformIO kompilierte mit der 1-Parameter-Overload, aber jetzt sind beide Versionen konsistent.

        429:   <script>
        430:     // ==========================================
        431:     // BLUETOOTH CORE
        432:     // ==========================================
        433:     const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
        434:     const CMD_UUID = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
        435:     const STATUS_UUID = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        436: 
        437:     let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
        438:     let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
        439:     let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
        440:     let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';
        441: 
        442:     function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
        443:       connected = isConn;
        444:       document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
        445:       document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
        446:       document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'inline-flex';
        447:       document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));
        448:     }
        449: 
        450:     function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
        451:       if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
        452:         const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
        453:         if (d.length >= 4) {
        454:           const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');
        455:           if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';
        456:           const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');
        457:           if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];
        458:           const cs = document.getElementById('csCurrent');
        459:           if (cs) cs.textContent = d[3];
        460:         }
        461:       } else if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:') || msg.startsWith('PEER:') || msg.startsWith('MESHPEERS')) {
        462:         handleMultiplayerMessage(msg);
        463:       } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
        464:         handleRaceMessage(msg);
        465:       } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
        466:         handleQuizMessage(msg);
        467:       }
        468:     }
        469: 
        470:     async function connectBLE() {
        471:       try {
        472:         console.log('[BLE] connectBLE() gestartet');
        473:         if (!navigator.bluetooth) {
        474:           console.error('[BLE] Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
        475:           alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
        476:           return;
        477:         }
        478:         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
        479:         console.log('[BLE] Requesting Bluetooth device...');
        480:         
        481:         // Disconnect existing connection if any
        482:         if (device && device.gatt.connected) {
        483:           console.log('[BLE] Disconnecting existing connection...');
        484:           try {
        485:             await device.gatt.disconnect();
        486:             console.log('[BLE] Disconnected existing connection');
        487:           } catch (e) {
        488:             console.warn('[BLE] Disconnect failed:', e);
        489:           }
        490:         }
        491:         
        492:         // Retry loop (max 3 attempts)
        493:         let attempt = 0;
        494:         const maxAttempts = 3;
        495:         let lastError = null;
        496:         
        497:         while (attempt < maxAttempts) {
        498:           attempt++;
        499:           console.log(`[BLE] Attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts}: Requesting device...`);
        500:           try {
        501:             device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
        502:               filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
        503:               optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
        504:             });
        505:             console.log('[BLE] Device gefunden:', device.name, device.id);
        506:             
        507:             device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', () => {
        508:               console.log('[BLE] Disconnected by remote');
        509:               updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt'); 
        510:               connected = false;
        511:               stopSending();
        512:             });
        513:             
        514:             updateConnectionUI(false, `Verbinde (${attempt})...`);
        515:             console.log('[BLE] Connecting to GATT server...');
        516:             const server = await device.gatt.connect({ mtu: 512 });
        517:             console.log('[BLE] GATT server connected:', server);
        518:             
        519:             updateConnectionUI(false, 'Service...');
        520:             console.log('[BLE] Getting primary service...');
        521:             const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
        522:             console.log('[BLE] Primary service gefunden:', service);
        523:             
        524:             updateConnectionUI(false, 'Chars...');
        525:             console.log('[BLE] Getting characteristics...');
        526:             cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
        527:             console.log('[BLE] CMD characteristic:', cmdChar);
        528:             statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
        529:             console.log('[BLE] STATUS characteristic:', statusChar);
        530:             
        531:             updateConnectionUI(false, 'Notify...');
        532:             console.log('[BLE] Starting notifications...');
        533:             await statusChar.startNotifications();
        534:             statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
        535:               console.log('[BLE] Status notification:', e.target.value);
        536:               handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
        537:             });
        538:             
        539:             connected = true;
        540:             updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
        541:             startSending();
        542:             console.log('[BLE] Connection established successfully');
        543:             return; // Success
        544:             
        545:           } catch (e) {
        546:             lastError = e;
        547:             console.error(`[BLE] Attempt ${attempt} failed:`, e);
        548:             updateConnectionUI(false, `Fehler (${attempt}/${maxAttempts})`);
        549:             await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); // Wait before retry
        550:           }
        551:         }
        552:         
        553:         // All attempts failed
        554:         console.error('[BLE] Alle Versuche fehlgeschlagen:', lastError);
        555:         throw lastError;
        556:         
        557:       } catch (e) {
        558:         console.error('[BLE] FATAL:', e);
        559:         alert('Verbindung fehlgeschlagen: ' + (e.message || String(e)));
        560:         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
        561:       }
        562:     }
        563: 
        564:     async function sendCommand(cmd) {
        565:       if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
        566:       if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
        567:       writing = true;
        568:       try { 
        569:         const encoder = new TextEncoder();
        570:         await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(encoder.encode(cmd)); 
        571:       } catch (e) { connected = false; }
        572:       writing = false;
        573:       if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
        574:     }
        575: 
        576:     async function sendKeys(force) {
        577:       if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
        578:       const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
        579:       if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
        580:       lastSent = msg;
        581:       try { 
        582:         const encoder = new TextEncoder();
        583:         await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(encoder.encode(msg)); 
        584:       } catch (e) { connected = false; }
        585:     }
        586: 
        587:     function startSending() { stopSending(); heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50); }
        588:     function stopSending() { if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval); heartbeatInterval = null; }
        589:     function emergencyStop() { keys = { w:0,a:0,s:0,d:0 }; sendKeys(true); }

        669:         document.getElementById('meshPeerList').innerHTML = '';
        670:       } else if (msg.startsWith('PEER:')) {

        676:         if (!sel.querySelector('option[value="'+p[0]+'"]')) {
        677:           sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+p[0]+'">' + p[1] + '</option>';
        678:         }
        679:       }
        680:       log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
        681:     }

        718:     function nextRaceQuestion() {
        719:       const a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;

        1: // =====================================================
        2: // EduBot BLE Manager - Web Bluetooth Server
        3: // =====================================================
        4: 
        5: #include "ble.h"
        6: 
        7: namespace EduBLE {
        8: 
        9: static BLECharacteristic* statusChar = nullptr;
        10: static BLEServer*         server     = nullptr;
        11: static bool               connected  = false;
        12: static CommandCallback    cmdCb      = nullptr;
        13: static ConnectionCallback connCb    = nullptr;
        14: 
        15: // --- Server-Callbacks: nur minimal, keine schwere Arbeit ---
        16: class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
        17:   void onConnect(BLEServer* s, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*) override {
        18:     connected = true;
        19:     if (connCb) connCb(true);
        20:   }
        21:   void onDisconnect(BLEServer* s, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*) override {
        22:     connected = false;
        23:     if (connCb) connCb(false);
        24:     BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        25:   }
        26: };
        27: 
        28: // --- Characteristic-Callbacks: eingehende Kommandos ---
        29: class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
        30:   void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* c, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*) override {
        31:     std::string v = c->getValue();
        32:     if (!v.empty() && cmdCb) cmdCb(v.c_str(), v.length());
        33:   }
        34: };
        35: 
        36: void begin(const char* deviceName, CommandCallback onCmd, ConnectionCallback onConn) {
        37:   cmdCb   = onCmd;
        38:   connCb  = onConn;
        39: 
        40:   BLEDevice::init(deviceName);
        41: 
        42:   server = BLEDevice::createServer();
        43:   server->setCallbacks(new ServerCallbacks());
        44: 
        45:   BLEService* service = server->createService(SERVICE_UUID);
        46: 
        47:   BLECharacteristic* cmdChar = service->createCharacteristic(
        48:     CMD_UUID,
        49:     BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE_NR
        50:   );
        51:   cmdChar->setCallbacks(new CommandCallbacks());
        52: 
        53:   statusChar = service->createCharacteristic(
        54:     STATUS_UUID,
        55:     BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_READ | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_NOTIFY
        56:   );
        57:   statusChar->addDescriptor(new BLE2902());
        58:   statusChar->setValue("EduBot");
        59: 
        60:   service->start();
        61: 
        62:   BLEAdvertising* adv = BLEDevice::getAdvertising();
        63:   adv->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
        64:   adv->setScanResponse(true);
        65:   adv->setMinPreferred(0x06);
        66:   adv->setMaxPreferred(0x12);
        67:   BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        68: }
        69: 
        70: bool isConnected() { return connected; }
        71: 
        72: void send(const char* msg) {
        73:   if (statusChar && connected) {
        74:     statusChar->setValue(msg);
        75:     statusChar->notify();
        76:   }
        77: }
        78: 
        79: void send(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
        80:   if (statusChar && connected) {
        81:     statusChar->setValue((uint8_t*)data, len);
        82:     statusChar->notify();
        83:   }
        84: }

    [TOOL: websearch | completed]
      query: Web Bluetooth API BluetoothGATTConnection connect method signature MTU 2024
      Ausgabe:
        Title: Add Web Bluetooth API support to change MTU · Issue #284
        URL: https://github.com/WebBluetoothCG/web-bluetooth/issues/284
        Published: 2016-09-02T08:18:58.000Z
        Author: beaufortfrancois
        Highlights:
        ## Add Web Bluetooth API support to change MTU
        ...
        I've noticed Chrome OS and Android have different maximum transmission unit (MTU) when investigating https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=643591 bug and I was wondering if we could add support for requesting an MTU size used for a given connection in the Web Bluetooth API.
        ...
        Android already has this API which is really useful in my own opinion: https://developer.android.com/reference/android/bluetooth/BluetoothGatt.html#requestMtu(int)
        ...
        For info, 23 bytes seems to be the default on Android while I can reach 512 bytes on Chrome OS.
        ...
        > I haven't investigated this in the BT spec yet, but why can't we auto-negotiate the largest supported MTU?
        ...
        > BlueZ actually attempts to do the maximum possible, our default per channel is actually 672 bytes given that comes from L2CAP, so in fact it can be over 512 bytes but usually the peripheral limits the MTU. As for exposing an API to set the MTU this is quite tricky because of the following:
        > 
        > 1. The MTU shall only be negotiated once, so we might have to fail if that was already done previously.
        > 2. MTU needs to be symmetric for input and output so it might be forced to be lower than the value required.
        > 3. Usually the MTU is used to define application level fragmentation, stream/firmware transfers, etc. These are not very nice to be done over D-Bus and instead perhaps should done over e.g. a pipe passing a fd to the application where one can get the MTU of the connection and perhaps even lock the attribute so it is only accessed by that application using the fd. Note this type of application is abusing the ATT/GATT stack since the attributes were never meant to be used as stream endpoints, instead L2CAP Channels should have been used but it seems most OSes never implemented support for them leading to the current situation.
        ...
        > For the sake of completeness, here are my full findings regarding MTU size I've gathered from https://beaufortfrancois.github.io/sandbox/physical-web/fatbeacon/ when connected to a Nexus 6P in a FatBeacon demo mode.
        > 
        > | MTU Size | Chrome OS | Android | Mac |
        > | --- | :-- | :-: | :-: |
        > | User | 512 bytes | 20 bytes | 99 bytes |
        > | System | 517 bytes | | 104 bytes |
        ...
        **jyasskin** mentioned this in PR [#293: Specify that UAs should negotiate the MTU.](https://github.com/WebBluetoothCG/web-bluetooth/pull/293) · Sep 9, 2016 at 10:54pm

While this specification cites the [BLUETOOTH42] specification, it intends to also support communication among devices that only implement Bluetooth 4.0 or 4.1.

            // ==========================================
            // BLUETOOTH CORE
            // ==========================================
            const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
            const CMD_UUID     = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
            const STATUS_UUID  = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        
            let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
            let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
            let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
            let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';
            let reconnecting = false;
        
            function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
              connected = isConn;
              document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
              document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
              document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'inline-flex';
              document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));
            }
        
            function resetKeys() {
              keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
              document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            }
        
            function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
                if (d.length >= 4) {
                  const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');
                  if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';
                  const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');
                  if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
                handleRaceMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
                handleQuizMessage(msg);
              }
            }
        
            // Verbindung mit dem GATT Server aufbauen
            async function connectGatt() {
              if (!device || !device.gatt.connected) {
                const server = await device.gatt.connect();
                const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
                cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
                statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
                await statusChar.startNotifications();
                statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
                  handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
                });
              }
              connected = true;
              updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
              startSending();
              sendCommand('EduBot V1.3 bereit');
            }
        
            async function connectBLE() {
              try {
                if (!navigator.bluetooth) {
                  alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
                  return;
                }
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
        
                // Bereits verbundenes Geraet? Direkt verbinden
                if (device && device.gatt.connected) {
                  await connectGatt();
                  return;
                }
        
                // Geraet per Filter suchen
                device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
                  filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
                  optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
                });
        
                device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', onDisconnected);
        
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Verbinde...');
                await connectGatt();
              } catch (e) {
                console.error('[BLE]', e);
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
              }
            }
        
            // Bei Trennung: automatisch neu verbinden
            async function onDisconnected() {
              connected = false;
              resetKeys();
              stopSending();
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
        
              if (!device) return;
              // Max 5 mal versuchen
              for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                reconnecting = true;
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Reconnect ' + (i + 1) + '...');
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
                try {
                  await connectGatt();
                  reconnecting = false;
                  return;
                } catch (e) {
                  console.warn('[BLE] Reconnect fehlgeschlagen:', e);
                }
              }
              reconnecting = false;
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
            }
        
            async function sendCommand(cmd) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
              writing = true;
              try {
                await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd));
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[BLE] send error', e);
              }
              writing = false;
              if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
            }
        
            async function sendKeys(force) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
              if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
              lastSent = msg;
              try {
                await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[BLE] sendKeys error', e);
              }
            }
        
            function startSending() {
              stopSending();
              heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50);
            }
            function stopSending() {
              if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
              heartbeatInterval = null;
            }
        
            // ==========================================

              const el = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId);
              if (el) el.classList.add('active');
              if (viewId === 'memory') initMemoryGame();
              if (viewId === 'colorseq') initColorseqGame();
            }
            document.querySelectorAll('.tile[data-view]').forEach(t => t.addEventListener('click', () => nav(t.dataset.view)));
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b => {
              if (b.classList.contains('back-btn')) b.addEventListener('click', () => nav(b.dataset.view));
            });

            // DRIVE

            document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(btn => {
              const key = btn.dataset.key;
              const press = () => { keys[key] = 1; btn.classList.add('active'); };
              const release = () => { keys[key] = 0; btn.classList.remove('active'); };
              btn.addEventListener('mousedown', press);
              btn.addEventListener('mouseup', release);
              btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', release);
              btn.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); press(); });
              btn.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); release(); });
            });
            window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
              const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
              if (k in keys && connected) { keys[k] = 1; const b = document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]'); if (b) b.classList.add('active'); }
            });
            window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
              const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
              if (k in keys) { keys[k] = 0; const b = document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]'); if (b) b.classList.remove('active'); }
            });
            document.getElementById('speedSlider').addEventListener('change', e => {
              document.getElementById('speedDisplay').textContent = e.target.value;
              sendCommand('MAX:' + e.target.value);
            });
            document.getElementById('btnStop').addEventListener('click', () => { resetKeys(); sendCommand('STOP'); });
            document.getElementById('btnEmergencyStop').addEventListener('click', () => { resetKeys(); sendCommand('STOP'); });
            document.getElementById('btnConnect').addEventListener('click', connectBLE);

              document.getElementById('btnRaceStart').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('raceAnswer').style.display = 'block';

            document.getElementById('btnRaceAnswer').addEventListener('click', () => {

            function nextRaceQuestion() {
              const a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
              const b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
              raceCurrentAnswer = a + b;
              document.getElementById('raceQuestion').textContent = a + ' + ' + b + ' = ?';

            function updateRaceUI() {

            function handleRaceMessage(msg) {

              } else if (msg === 'RACE:WIN') {
                raceOppScore = 10; updateRaceUI();

            function getColorBg(c) {

            function handleQuizMessage(msg) {

                else if (d[0] === 'WRONG') showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'error', 'Fehler bei ' + d[1] + ' (gefunden: ' + d[2] + ') - ' + d[3] + '/' + d[4]);

            function initMemoryGame() { document.getElementById('memLevel').textContent = memLevel; }
            function genMemSequence(len) { const s = []; for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) s.push(Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)); return s; }
            function flashMemSequence(seq) {
              let i = 0;
              const iv = setInterval(() => {

                const arrow = document.getElementById('memArrow' + seq[i]);
                if (arrow) { arrow.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => arrow.classList.remove('flash'), 400); }

                memUserInput.push(idx);
              });
            });
            document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const correct = memSequence.length === memUserInput.length && memSequence.every((v, i) => v === memUserInput[i]);
              if (correct) { showFeedback('memFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig!'); memLevel++; document.getElementById('memLevel').textContent = memLevel; }
              else showFeedback('memFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch! Nochmal.');

              }
            }
            document.getElementById('btnCsStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              csSequence = []; csIndex = 0;
              for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) csSequence.push(csColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)]);

                el.style.color = 'white'; el.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
              });

            }

[ASSISTANT]: ## Objective - Fix all bugs in the EduBot V1.3 firmware (ESP32-S3 + DRV8834) and HTML frontend so BLE connection is stable, all features work, and the code compiles cleanly.  ## Important Details - **Hardware:** Seeed Studio Xiao ESP32-S3, DRV8834 motor driver, TCS34725 color sensor (I2C) - **PlatformIO framework:** `espressif32@^6.7.0` (arduino-esp32 v2.x, ESP-IDF v4.x, **Bluedroid** BLE) - **BLE library:** ESP32's built-in `ESP32 BLE Arduino @ 2.0.0` (NOT ArduinoBLE) - `BLEDevice::init()` returns **void** (not bool) in v2.x - `advertiseOnDisconnect()` does **not exist** in Bluedroid v2.x — must manually call `BLEDevice::startAdvertising()` in onDisconnect - Callback signatures for Bluedroid v2.x require `esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*` second parameter - `device.gatt.connect()` in Web Bluetooth API takes **no arguments** — MTU is auto-negotiated - Mesh system (ESP-NOW) was completely removed to reduce complexity and eliminate crash sources  ## Work State ### Completed -         // =====================================================
        // EduBot BLE Manager - Web Bluetooth Server
        // =====================================================
        // Minimal, stabile BLE-Verbindung ueber ESP32 Bluedroid.
        //   - advertisesOnDisconnect: automatischer Reconnect
        //   - CMD-Characteristic (Write): Kommandos vom Frontend
        //   - STATUS-Characteristic (Notify): Antworten an Frontend
        // =====================================================
        
        #pragma once
        
        #include <Arduino.h>
        #include <BLEDevice.h>
        #include <BLEServer.h>
        #include <BLEUtils.h>
        #include <BLE2902.h>
        
        namespace EduBLE {
        
        // UUIDs - Standardformat mit Bindestrichen (Web Bluetooth braucht das!)
        constexpr const char* SERVICE_UUID = "4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b";
        constexpr const char* CMD_UUID    = "beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8";
        constexpr const char* STATUS_UUID = "a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef";
        
        // Callback-Typ fuer eingehende Kommandos
        typedef void (*CommandCallback)(const char* cmd, size_t len);
        typedef void (*ConnectionCallback)(bool connected);
        
        // API
        void begin(const char* deviceName, CommandCallback onCmd, ConnectionCallback onConn);
        bool isConnected();
        void send(const char* msg);
        void send(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);
        
        } // namespace EduBLE

        // =====================================================
        // EduBot BLE Manager - Web Bluetooth Server
        // =====================================================
        
        #include "ble.h"
        
        namespace EduBLE {
        
        static BLECharacteristic* statusChar = nullptr;
        static BLEServer*         server     = nullptr;
        static bool               connected  = false;
        static CommandCallback    cmdCb      = nullptr;
        static ConnectionCallback connCb    = nullptr;
        
        // --- Server-Callbacks: nur minimal, keine schwere Arbeit ---
        class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
          void onConnect(BLEServer* s, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*) override {
            connected = true;
            if (connCb) connCb(true);
          }
          void onDisconnect(BLEServer* s, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*) override {
            connected = false;
            if (connCb) connCb(false);
            BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
          }
        };
        
        // --- Characteristic-Callbacks: eingehende Kommandos ---
        class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
          void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* c, esp_ble_gatts_cb_param_t*) override {
            std::string v = c->getValue();
            if (!v.empty() && cmdCb) cmdCb(v.c_str(), v.length());
          }
        };
        
        void begin(const char* deviceName, CommandCallback onCmd, ConnectionCallback onConn) {
          cmdCb   = onCmd;
          connCb  = onConn;
        
          BLEDevice::init(deviceName);
        
          server = BLEDevice::createServer();
          server->setCallbacks(new ServerCallbacks());
        
          BLEService* service = server->createService(SERVICE_UUID);
        
          BLECharacteristic* cmdChar = service->createCharacteristic(
            CMD_UUID,
            BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_WRITE_NR
          );
          cmdChar->setCallbacks(new CommandCallbacks());
        
          statusChar = service->createCharacteristic(
            STATUS_UUID,
            BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_READ | BLECharacteristic::PROPERTY_NOTIFY
          );
          statusChar->addDescriptor(new BLE2902());
          statusChar->setValue("EduBot");
        
          service->start();
        
          BLEAdvertising* adv = BLEDevice::getAdvertising();
          adv->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
          adv->setScanResponse(true);
          adv->setMinPreferred(0x06);
          adv->setMaxPreferred(0x12);
          BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        }
        
        bool isConnected() { return connected; }
        
        void send(const char* msg) {
          if (statusChar && connected) {
            statusChar->setValue(msg);
            statusChar->notify();
          }
        }
        
        void send(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
          if (statusChar && connected) {
            statusChar->setValue((uint8_t*)data, len);
            statusChar->notify();
          }
        }
        
        } // namespace EduBLE

        // =====================================================
        // EduBot V1.3R - Firmware fuer Xiao ESP32-S3 + DRV8834
        // =====================================================
        // Hardware:       Seeed Studio Xiao ESP32-S3
        // Motortreiber:   DRV8834 (STEP/DIR)
        // Farbsensor:     TCS34725 (I2C)
        // Kommunikation:  BLE (Web Bluetooth API)
        // =====================================================
        
        #include <Arduino.h>
        #include <Wire.h>
        #include <Adafruit_TCS34725.h>
        #include <Preferences.h>
        #include <driver/timer.h>
        #include "soc/gpio_struct.h"
        #include <esp_task_wdt.h>
        #include "ble.h"
        
        // =====================================================
        // PIN-KONFIGURATION
        // =====================================================
        #define PIN_DIR_L      3
        #define PIN_STEP_L     4
        #define PIN_DIR_R      1
        #define PIN_STEP_R     2
        #define PIN_ENABLE     7
        #define SDA_PIN        5
        #define SCL_PIN        6
        
        #define STEP_BIT_L (1UL << PIN_STEP_L)
        #define STEP_BIT_R (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)
        
        portMUX_TYPE stepperMux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
        
        // =====================================================
        // KONSTANTEN
        // =====================================================
        constexpr unsigned long BAUD_RATE        = 115200;
        constexpr int   STACK_COLOR_SENSOR       = 8192;
        constexpr int   TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR      = 2;
        constexpr int   CORE_SENSOR               = 0;
        constexpr uint32_t LOOP_DELAY_MS         = 5;
        constexpr unsigned long COLOR_NOTIFY_MS  = 200;
        
        constexpr uint16_t COLOR_LOW  = 40;
        constexpr uint16_t COLOR_HIGH = 200;
        constexpr float    RATIO_RED  = 1.35f;
        constexpr float    RATIO_GB   = 1.25f;
        
        constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT = 900;
        constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MIN     = 200;
        constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MAX     = 2500;
        constexpr float    TURN_DEFAULT     = 0.25f;
        constexpr float    TURN_MIN         = 0.0f;
        constexpr float    TURN_MAX         = 0.9f;
        constexpr float    ACCEL_DEFAULT    = 5000.0f;
        constexpr float    ACCEL_MIN        = 100.0f;
        constexpr float    ACCEL_MAX        = 10000.0f;
        
        constexpr uint32_t STEP_TIMER_US     = 10;
        constexpr uint32_t MIN_STEP_INTERVAL = 50;
        constexpr uint32_t MAX_STEP_INTERVAL = 50000;
        constexpr uint32_t STEP_PERIOD_US    = 1000000UL;
        constexpr uint32_t FRAC_SCALE        = 0x10000UL;
        
        // =====================================================
        // KONFIGURATION (NVS)
        // =====================================================
        struct Config {
          float    maxSpeed         = 900.0f;
          float    turnFactor       = 0.25f;
          float    turnOnlySpeed    = 550.0f;
          int8_t   leftSign        = -1;
          int8_t   rightSign       = -1;
          float    accelRate       = 5000.0f;
          uint32_t commandTimeoutMs = 500;
          uint16_t blackR = 152,  blackG = 137,  blackB = 98;
          uint16_t whiteR = 4143, whiteG = 4258, whiteB = 3036;
        };
        
        Config config;
        Preferences prefs;
        bool   configDirty = false;
        
        // =====================================================
        // STEPPER-TIMER (Bresenham)
        // =====================================================
        uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0, stepFracAddR = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0, stepFracAccumR = 0;
        uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0, stepIntervalR = 0;
        static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0, stepPhaseR = 0;
        
        bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *) {
          if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
          if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        
          if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
            stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
            if (stepFracAccumL >= FRAC_SCALE) {
              stepFracAccumL -= FRAC_SCALE;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
              stepPhaseL = 1;
            }
          } else stepFracAccumL = 0;
        
          if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
            stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
            if (stepFracAccumR >= FRAC_SCALE) {
              stepFracAccumR -= FRAC_SCALE;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
              stepPhaseR = 1;
            }
          } else stepFracAccumR = 0;
        
          return false;
        }
        
        void initStepperTimer() {
          timer_config_t cfg = {};
          cfg.alarm_en    = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
          cfg.counter_en  = TIMER_PAUSE;
          cfg.intr_type   = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
          cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
          cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
          cfg.divider     = 80;
        
          timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
          timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
          timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
          timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
          timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
          timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // MOTOR (DRV8834)
        // =====================================================
        void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
          const int sign   = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
          float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        
          if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
          } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
            actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
          } else {
            if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
            else               { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
            GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
            portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
            return;
          }
        
          uint32_t speedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
          if (speedInt < 1) speedInt = 1;
        
          uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / speedInt;
          if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
          if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        
          uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * FRAC_SCALE) / interval;
        
          if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = interval; stepFracAddL = fracAdd; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
          else               { stepIntervalR = interval; stepFracAddR = fracAdd; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        void stopMotors() {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          stepIntervalL = stepIntervalR = 0;
          stepFracAddL  = stepFracAddR  = 0;
          stepFracAccumL = stepFracAccumR = 0;
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FARBSENSOR (TCS34725)
        // =====================================================
        Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(TCS34725_INTEGRATIONTIME_50MS, TCS34725_GAIN_4X);
        
        volatile int      sensorR = 0, sensorG = 0, sensorB = 0;
        volatile uint16_t rawR = 0, rawG = 0, rawB = 0, rawC = 0;
        volatile char     sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
        
        SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        bool colorSensorOk = false;
        
        int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
          if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
          long v = map((long)raw, (long)blackVal, (long)whiteVal, 0L, 255L);
          v = constrain(v, 0L, 255L);
          return (int)v;
        }
        
        const char* detectColor(int r, int g, int b) {
          if (r < COLOR_LOW  && g < COLOR_LOW  && b < COLOR_LOW)  return "SCHWARZ";
          if (r > COLOR_HIGH && g > COLOR_HIGH && b > COLOR_HIGH) return "WEISS";
          if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
          if (g > r * RATIO_GB  && g > b * RATIO_GB)  return "GRUEN";
          if (b > r * RATIO_GB  && b > g * RATIO_GB)  return "BLAU";
          if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
          return "UNBEKANNT";
        }
        
        void setupColorSensor() {
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
          delay(1000);
          colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
          Serial.println(colorSensorOk ? "[SENSOR] OK" : "[SENSOR] nicht gefunden");
          colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
          if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        }
        
        void resetI2C() {
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT); pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
          for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
            digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
            digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW);  delayMicroseconds(5);
          }
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT); pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        }
        
        void colorSensorTask(void *) {
          TickType_t lastWake = xTaskGetTickCount();
          const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
          int fails = 0;
        
          while (true) {
            if (colorSensorOk) {
              uint16_t r, g, b, c;
              tcs.getRawData(&r, &g, &b, &c);
              if (r == 0 && g == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0) {
                if (++fails >= 3) { colorSensorOk = false; Serial.println("[SENSOR] offline"); }
              } else {
                fails = 0;
                rawR = r; rawG = g; rawB = b; rawC = c;
                if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) == pdTRUE) {
                  int cR = calibrateColor(r, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
                  int cG = calibrateColor(g, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
                  int cB = calibrateColor(b, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
                  sensorR = cR; sensorG = cG; sensorB = cB;
                  strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detectColor(cR, cG, cB), sizeof(sensorName));
                  xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
                }
              }
            } else {
              Serial.println("[SENSOR] recover...");
              resetI2C();
              if (tcs.begin()) { colorSensorOk = true; fails = 0; Serial.println("[SENSOR] recovered"); }
              vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
              lastWake = xTaskGetTickCount();
              continue;
            }
            vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWake, period);
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // STEUERUNGSZUSTAND
        // =====================================================
        bool keyW = false, keyA = false, keyS = false, keyD = false;
        float speedL = 0.0, speedR = 0.0;

        // =====================================================
        // KOMMANDOS
        // =====================================================
        void handleCommand(const char* s, size_t) {
          String cmd(s);
          cmd.trim();
          cmd.toUpperCase();
          lastCmdTime = millis();
          Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
            String d = cmd.substring(5);
            if (d.length() >= 4) {
              keyW = d.charAt(0) == '1';
              keyA = d.charAt(1) == '1';
              keyS = d.charAt(2) == '1';
              keyD = d.charAt(3) == '1';
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd == "STOP") { hardStop(); return; }
        
          if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
            float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
              config.maxSpeed = v; configDirty = true;
              char b[32]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
              EduBLE::send(b);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
            float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
            if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
              config.turnFactor = t; configDirty = true;
              char b[32]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
              EduBLE::send(b);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
            float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
            if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
              config.accelRate = a; configDirty = true;
              char b[32]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
              EduBLE::send(b);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
            config.blackR = rawR; config.blackG = rawG; config.blackB = rawB;
            configDirty = true; EduBLE::send("CAL:BLACK OK"); return;
          }
          if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
            config.whiteR = rawR; config.whiteG = rawG; config.whiteB = rawB;
            configDirty = true; EduBLE::send("CAL:WHITE OK"); return;
          }
        
          char b[80]; snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "UNKNOWN:%s", cmd.c_str());
          EduBLE::send(b);
        }
        
        void onConnection(bool connected) {
          if (connected) {
            lastCmdTime = millis();
            Serial.println("[BLE] verbunden");
            EduBLE::send("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
          } else {
            Serial.println("[BLE] getrennt");
            clearKeys();
            speedL = speedR = 0.0;
            stopMotors();
          }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FARBE AN WEBSITE
        // =====================================================
        void sendColorToWebsite() {
          int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
          char name[16] = {};
          if (colorSem == nullptr) return;
          if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
            r = sensorR; g = sensorG; b = sensorB;
            strlcpy(name, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(name));
            xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
          } else return;
          char msg[64];
          snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "COLOR:%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name);
          EduBLE::send(msg);
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // RAMPE
        // =====================================================
        float rampSpeed(float cur, float target, float dt) {
          float diff = target - cur;
          if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) return target;
          float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
          if (diff > 0) { cur += maxChange; if (cur > target) cur = target; }
          else          { cur -= maxChange; if (cur < target) cur = target; }
          return cur;
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // FAHRLOGIK
        // =====================================================
        void updateDrive() {
          float tL = 0.0, tR = 0.0;
          bool fwd = keyW && !keyS, bwd = keyS && !keyW;
          bool left = keyA && !keyD, right = keyD && !keyA;
        
          if (fwd)      { tL =  config.maxSpeed; tR =  config.maxSpeed; }
          else if (bwd) { tL = -config.maxSpeed; tR = -config.maxSpeed; }
        
          if (fwd || bwd) {
            if (left)  tL *= config.turnFactor;
            if (right) tR *= config.turnFactor;
          } else {
            if (left)       { tL = 0;                   tR =  config.turnOnlySpeed; }
            else if (right) { tL =  config.turnOnlySpeed; tR = 0;                   }
          }
        
          if (millis() - lastCmdTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
            tL = tR = 0.0;
            if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
              speedL = speedR = 0.0;
              clearKeys();
              stopMotors();
            }
            lastUpdateMicros = micros();
            return;
          }
        
          unsigned long now = micros();
          float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
          lastUpdateMicros = now;
          if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        
          float nL = rampSpeed(speedL, tL, dt);
          if (nL != speedL) { speedL = nL; setMotorSpeed(0, speedL); }
          float nR = rampSpeed(speedR, tR, dt);
          if (nR != speedR) { speedR = nR; setMotorSpeed(1, speedR); }
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // NVS
        // =====================================================
        void validateConfig() {
          bool ch = false;
          if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) { config.maxSpeed = MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT; ch = true; }
          if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX)        { config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT;    ch = true; }
          if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX)      { config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT;   ch = true; }
          if (config.turnOnlySpeed < 50.0f || config.turnOnlySpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) { config.turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f; ch = true; }
          if (config.commandTimeoutMs < 100 || config.commandTimeoutMs > 10000)    { config.commandTimeoutMs = 500; ch = true; }
          if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
            config.blackR = 152;  config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
            config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
            ch = true;
          }
          if (ch) { configDirty = true; Serial.println("[NVS] config korrigiert"); }
        }
        
        void saveConfigIfDirty() {
          if (!configDirty) return;
          prefs.begin("edubot", false);
          prefs.putFloat ("maxSpeed",      config.maxSpeed);
          prefs.putFloat ("turnFactor",    config.turnFactor);
          prefs.putFloat ("turnOnlySpeed", config.turnOnlySpeed);
          prefs.putFloat ("accelRate",     config.accelRate);
          prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR); prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG); prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
          prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR); prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG); prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
          prefs.end();
          configDirty = false;
          Serial.println("[NVS] gespeichert");
        }
        
        // =====================================================
        // SETUP
        // =====================================================
        void setup() {
          Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
          Serial.println("\n== EduBot V1.3 ==");
        
          esp_task_wdt_init(20, true);
          esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        
          // NVS laden

          config.accelRate     = prefs.getFloat ("accelRate",     ACCEL_DEFAULT);
          config.blackR = prefs.getUShort("blackR", 152);  config.blackG = prefs.getUShort("blackG", 137); config.blackB = prefs.getUShort("blackB", 98);
          config.whiteR = prefs.getUShort("whiteR", 4143); config.whiteG = prefs.getUShort("whiteG", 4258); config.whiteB = prefs.getUShort("whiteB", 3036);
          validateConfig();
          saveConfigIfDirty();
          prefs.end();
        
          // Pins
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_L, OUTPUT);  pinMode(PIN_STEP_L, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_DIR_R, OUTPUT);  pinMode(PIN_STEP_R, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
          digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW); digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L,  LOW); digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R,  LOW);
          digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW);
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          lastCmdTime = millis();
          lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        
          initStepperTimer();
          setupColorSensor();
          if (colorSensorOk) {
            xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(colorSensorTask, "ColorSensor", STACK_COLOR_SENSOR,
                                    NULL, TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR, NULL, CORE_SENSOR);
          }
        
          // BLE
          EduBLE::begin("EduBot", handleCommand, onConnection);
          Serial.println("[BLE] gestartet");
        }

        // LOOP
        // =====================================================
        void loop() {
          esp_task_wdt_reset();
          if (configDirty) saveConfigIfDirty();
          updateDrive();
          if (EduBLE::isConnected() && millis() - lastColorNotify > COLOR_NOTIFY_MS) {
            lastColorNotify = millis();
            sendColorToWebsite();
          }
          vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(LOOP_DELAY_MS));
        }

        // =====================================================
        // PIN-KONFIGURATION (Xiao ESP32-S3)
        // =====================================================
        // DRV8834 Anschlüsse:
        //   STEP_L  -> GPIO 4
        //   DIR_L   -> GPIO 3
        //   STEP_R  -> GPIO 2
        //   DIR_R   -> GPIO 1
        //   ENABLE  -> GPIO 7 (optional, LOW = aktiv)
        // TCS34725  -> I2C (SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO6)
        
        #define PIN_DIR_L      3
        #define PIN_STEP_L     4
        #define PIN_DIR_R      1
        #define PIN_STEP_R     2
        #define PIN_ENABLE     7

        #define STEP_BIT_R     (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)

        // =====================================================
        // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        // =====================================================
        // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        
        uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        
        static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        
        bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
          if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
          if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        
          if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
            stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
            if (stepFracAccumL >= 0x10000UL) {
              stepFracAccumL -= 0x10000UL;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
              stepPhaseL = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumL = 0;
          }
        
          if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
            stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
            if (stepFracAccumR >= 0x10000UL) {
              stepFracAccumR -= 0x10000UL;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
              stepPhaseR = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumR = 0;
          }
          return false;
        }
        
        void initStepperTimer() {
          timer_config_t cfg = {};
          cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
          cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
          cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
          cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
          cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
          cfg.divider = 80;
        
          timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
          timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
          timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
          timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
          timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
          timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        }

        // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)
