        ### Configure Initiator Mode
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-now/blob/master/examples/security/README.md
        
        Set the ESP-NOW mode to Initiator in the project configuration menuconfig. The initiator will then scan for responders, perform a secure handshake using ECDH, and send the application key.
        
        ```bash
        idf.py menuconfig
            Example Configuration  --->
                ESP-NOW Mode  --->
                    (X) Initiator Mode
                    () Responder Mode
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### Configure Responder Mode
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-now/blob/master/examples/security/README.md
        
        Set the ESP-NOW mode to Responder in the project configuration menuconfig. When responder devices start, they will wait to receive security information.
        
        ```bash
        idf.py menuconfig
            Example Configuration  --->
                ESP-NOW Mode  --->
                    () Initiator Mode
                    (X) Responder Mode
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### Responder Device Output Sample
        
        Source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-now/blob/master/examples/security/README.md
        
        Example output from a responder device after receiving encrypted ESP-NOW messages. It shows the reception of the APP key and subsequent encrypted messages.

        ```log
        I (550) wifi:Set ps type: 0

        I (642) wifi:mode : I (645) app_main: Uart read handle task is running
        I (645) app_main: Uart write task is running
        I (26512) espnow_sec_resp: Get APP key
        ```

        Source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-now/blob/master/examples/security/README.md
        
        This example requires at least two ESP32 series development boards. One board acts as the initiator, responsible for scanning responders, performing a secure handshake (ECDH), and sending encrypted data. The other boards function as responders, waiting to receive security information and encrypted messages.

        ### esp_now_send
        
        Source: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/release-v5.5/esp32s3/api-reference/network/esp_now.html
        
        Sends ESP-NOW data. Data can be sent to a specific peer by MAC address or to all added peers if the peer address is NULL.
        
        ```APIDOC
        ## esp_now_send
        
        ### Description
        Sends ESPNOW data. Data can be sent to a specific peer if `peer_addr` is provided, or to all peers in the list if `peer_addr` is NULL. The maximum data length is limited by `ESP_NOW_MAX_DATA_LEN`.
        
        ### Parameters
        * **peer_addr** (const uint8_t *) - peer MAC address. If NULL, data is sent to all peers.
        * **data** (const uint8_t *) - data to send.
        * **len** (size_t) - length of data.
        
        ### Returns
        * ESP_OK: succeed
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NOT_INIT: ESPNOW is not initialized
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_ARG: invalid argument
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_INTERNAL: internal error
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NO_MEM: out of memory, delay and retry.
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NOT_FOUND: peer is not found.
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_IF: current Wi-Fi interface doesn't match that of peer.
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_CHAN: current Wi-Fi channel doesn't match that of peer.
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### esp_now_add_peer
        
        Source: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/release-v5.5/esp32s3/api-reference/network/esp_now.html
        
        Adds a peer device to the ESP-NOW peer list. This is necessary before sending data to a specific peer.
        
        ```APIDOC
        ## esp_now_add_peer
        
        ### Description
        Adds a peer to the ESP-NOW peer list. This function is required to establish communication with a specific device.
        
        ### Parameters
        * **peer** (const esp_now_peer_info_t *) - peer information, including MAC address and channel.
        
        ### Returns
        * ESP_OK: succeed
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NOT_INIT: ESPNOW is not initialized
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_ARG: invalid argument
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_FULL: peer list is full
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NO_MEM: out of memory
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_EXIST: peer has already existed
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### esp_now_register_recv_cb
        
        Source: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/release-v5.5/esp32s3/api-reference/network/esp_now.html
        
        Registers a callback function to be executed when ESP-NOW data is received. This allows your application to process incoming data.
        
        ```APIDOC
        ## esp_now_register_recv_cb
        
        ### Description
        Registers a callback function for receiving ESPNOW data. This function will be invoked whenever an ESP-NOW packet is received.
        
        ### Parameters
        * **cb** (esp_now_recv_cb_t) - callback function of receiving ESPNOW data
        
        ### Returns
        * ESP_OK: succeed
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NOT_INIT: ESPNOW is not initialized
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_INTERNAL: internal error
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### esp_now_register_send_cb
        
        Source: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/release-v5.5/esp32s3/api-reference/network/esp_now.html
        
        Registers a callback function to be executed upon completion of an ESP-NOW data send operation. This callback can be used to track send status.
        
        ```APIDOC
        ## esp_now_register_send_cb
        
        ### Description
        Registers a callback function for sending ESPNOW data. This function will be called after a data send operation completes, providing status information.
        
        ### Parameters
        * **cb** (esp_now_send_cb_t) - callback function of sending ESPNOW data
        
        ### Returns
        * ESP_OK: succeed
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_NOT_INIT: ESPNOW is not initialized
        * ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_INTERNAL: internal error
        ```
        
        --------------------------------
        
        ### Send ESP-NOW Data
        
        Source: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/release-v5.5/esp32s3/api-reference/network/esp_now.html
        
        Sends ESP-NOW data and registers a callback function to receive send status. Handles data transmission and potential failures.
        
        ```APIDOC
        ## Send ESP-NOW Data
        
        ### Description
        Sends ESP-NOW data to a paired device or broadcast address. A callback function can be registered to receive notifications about the sending status.
        
        ### Functions
        - `esp_now_send(const uint8_t *mac_addr, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)`: Sends ESP-NOW data.
        - `esp_now_register_send_cb(esp_now_send_cb_t send_cb)`: Registers a callback function to be executed after sending data.
        
        ### Callback Function (`esp_now_send_cb_t`)
        - The callback function is invoked with `ESP_NOW_SEND_SUCCESS` if data is received successfully at the MAC layer, or `ESP_NOW_SEND_FAIL` otherwise.
        
        ### Notes
        - Reasons for send failure include: destination device not existing, channel mismatch, or frame loss.
        - Application layer reception is not guaranteed; consider implementing acknowledgments.
        - Maximum packet length: 250 bytes (v1.0), 1470 bytes (v2.0).
        - To avoid callback disorder, send the next packet only after the previous sending callback has returned.
        - Avoid lengthy operations within the sending callback as it runs from a high-priority Wi-Fi task.
        ```

      Inhalt (73 Zeilen):
        // =====================================================
        // EduBot Mesh Manager - ESP-NOW P2P (2 Roboter)
        // =====================================================
        // Peer-to-Peer Kommunikation zwischen genau 2 EduBots.
        // - Ein Roboter "paart" sich mit dem anderen ueber MAC
        // - send() schickt Nachrichten an den Peer
        // - recvCb wird aufgerufen wenn eine Nachricht ankommt
        // - Status-Anfragen liefern: verbunden? peer MAC?
        // =====================================================
        // WICHTIG: ESP-NOW laeuft ueber WiFi. Daher kann WiFi NICHT
        // gleichzeitig als STA/AP verbunden sein wie ESP-NOW will.
        // Wir benutzen WiFi im "STA" mode OHNE verbindung zu router.
        // =====================================================
        
        #pragma once
        
        #include <Arduino.h>
        #include <esp_now.h>
        #include <esp_wifi.h>
        #include <WiFi.h>
        
        namespace EduMesh {
        
        // Maximale Peer-Anzahl (P2P = 1, aber wir lassen Reserve)
        constexpr int MAX_PEERS = 4;
        
        // Mesh-Nachrichtentypen
        enum class MsgType : uint8_t {
          HELLO       = 0x01,   // "ich bin da"
          PEER_REQ    = 0x02,   // "wer bist du?"
          PEER_RESP   = 0x03,   // antwort mit eigener MAC
          PAIR_REQ    = 0x04,   // "lass uns paaren" (pair anfragen)
          PAIR_ACK    = 0x05,   // "ja, gepaart"
          UNPAIR      = 0x06,   // "trennen"
          HEARTBEAT   = 0x10,   // periodisch "ich lebe"
          RACE_START  = 0x20,   // Mathe-Rennen Start
          RACE_SCORE  = 0x21,   // Mathe-Rennen Fortschritt (Mein Score)
          RACE_WIN    = 0x22,   // Mathe-Rennen "Ich habe gewonnen"
          RACE_LOSE   = 0x23,   // Mathe-Rennen "Ich habe verloren"
          RACE_STOP   = 0x24,   // Mathe-Rennen Abbruch
          QUIZ_CHECK  = 0x30,   // Farben-Quiz Command
          QUIZ_RESULT = 0x31,   // Farben-Quiz Ergebnis
          CUSTOM      = 0xFF,   // selvst definiert von Frontend
        };
        
        typedef struct {
          MsgType type;
          uint8_t fromMac[6];   // Sender MAC
          uint8_t toMac[6];     // Empfaenger MAC (broadcast = ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff)
          uint8_t payloadLen;   // payload length
          uint8_t payload[32];  // flexible up to 32 bytes
        } MeshMsg;
        
        // Callback: Nachricht empfangen
        typedef void (*RecvCallback)(const MeshMsg& msg);
        // Callback: Status-Update (z.B. peer verbunden/verloren)
        typedef void (*StatusCallback)(const char* status);
        
        // API
        bool begin(const char* deviceName, RecvCallback onRecv, StatusCallback onStatus);
        bool pairWithPeer(const uint8_t peerMac[6]);
        bool unpair();
        bool isPaired();
        bool send(MsgType type, const uint8_t* payload, uint8_t len);
        bool broadcast(MsgType type, const uint8_t* payload, uint8_t len);
        void getMyMac(uint8_t mac[6]);
        void getMyMacStr(char* buf, size_t len);
        bool getPeerMac(uint8_t mac[6]);
        bool getPeerMacStr(char* buf, size_t len);
        void sendHeartbeat();
        int scanForPeers(char outList[][24], int maxEntries);
        
        } // namespace EduMesh

    [TOOL: local-files_write_file | completed]
      Datei: 
      Inhalt (213 Zeilen):
        // =====================================================
        // EduBot Mesh Manager - ESP-NOW P2P Implementation
        // =====================================================
        
        #include "mesh.h"
        #include <esp_wifi.h>
        
        namespace EduMesh {
        
        static RecvCallback   g_recvCb  = nullptr;
        static StatusCallback g_statusCb = nullptr;
        static char           g_deviceName[24] = "EduBot";
        static bool           g_paired  = false;
        static uint8_t        g_peerMac[6] = {0,0,0,0,0,0};
        static uint8_t        g_myMac[6]   = {0,0,0,0,0,0};
        static bool           g_initialized = false;
        
        // Hilfsfunktionen
        static void macToStr(const uint8_t m[6], char* buf, size_t len) {
          snprintf(buf, len, "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
                   m[0], m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5]);
        }
        
        // ----- SEND CALLBACK -----
        static void IRAM_ATTR onSendCb(const uint8_t* mac_addr, esp_now_send_status_t status) {
          // nur loggen, nichts kritisches tun
          if (status != ESP_NOW_SEND_SUCCESS) {
            Serial.printf("[MESH] send fehlgeschlagen status=%d\n", status);
          }
        }
        
        // ----- RECV CALLBACK - laeuft im WiFi Task! Nur Mini-Aktionen! -----
        static void IRAM_ATTR onRecvCb(const esp_now_recv_info_t* info, const uint8_t* data, int len) {
          if (!data || len < 1) return;
          if (len > (int)sizeof(MeshMsg)) return;
        
          MeshMsg msg;
          memset(&msg, 0, sizeof(msg));
        
          // Datenstruktur: type (1) + fromMac (6) + toMac (6) + payloadLen (1) + payload
          size_t off = 0;
          msg.type = static_cast<MsgType>(data[off++]);
          if (off + 6 <= (size_t)len) { memcpy(msg.fromMac, data + off, 6); off += 6; }
          if (off + 6 <= (size_t)len) { memcpy(msg.toMac, data + off, 6); off += 6; }
          if (off + 1 <= (size_t)len) { msg.payloadLen = data[off++]; }
          uint8_t copyLen = msg.payloadLen;
          if (copyLen > sizeof(msg.payload)) copyLen = sizeof(msg.payload);
          if (off + copyLen <= (size_t)len) { memcpy(msg.payload, data + off, copyLen); }
          if (info && info->src_addr) memcpy(msg.fromMac, info->src_addr, 6);
        
          if (g_recvCb) g_recvCb(msg);
        }
        
        // ----- BEGIN -----
        bool begin(const char* deviceName, RecvCallback onRecv, StatusCallback onStatus) {
          if (g_initialized) return true;
          g_recvCb = onRecv;
          g_statusCb = onStatus;
          if (deviceName) strlcpy(g_deviceName, deviceName, sizeof(g_deviceName));
        
          // WiFi im STA-Modus (no connection), damit ESP-NOW laeuft
          WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        
          // Kanal setzen
          esp_wifi_set_channel(1, WIFI_SECOND_CHAN_NONE);
        
          // MAC holen
          WiFi.macAddress(g_myMac);
          char macStr[24];
          macToStr(g_myMac, macStr, sizeof(macStr));
          Serial.printf("[MESH] meine MAC: %s\n", macStr);
        
          if (esp_now_init() != ESP_OK) {
            Serial.println("[MESH] esp_now_init fehlgeschlagen!");
            return false;
          }
        
          esp_now_register_send_cb(onSendCb);
          esp_now_register_recv_cb(onRecvCb);
        
          // Broadcast-Peer automatisch anlegen (fuer Peer-Discovery)
          esp_now_peer_info_t bcPeer;
          memset(&bcPeer, 0, sizeof(bcPeer));
          memset(bcPeer.peer_addr, 0xFF, 6);
          bcPeer.channel = 0;
          bcPeer.encrypt = false;
          if (esp_now_add_peer(&bcPeer) != ESP_OK) {
            Serial.println("[MESH] Broadcast-Peer konnte nicht angelegt werden");
          } else {
            Serial.println("[MESH] Broadcast-Peer OK");
          }
        
          g_initialized = true;
          if (g_statusCb) g_statusCb("MESH initialisiert");
          Serial.println("[MESH] ESP-NOW bereit");
          return true;
        }
        
        // ----- PAIR WITH PEER -----
        bool pairWithPeer(const uint8_t peerMac[6]) {
          if (!g_initialized) return false;
        
          // Falls schon gepaart, zuerst entfernen
          if (g_paired) {
            esp_now_del_peer(g_peerMac);
            g_paired = false;
          }
        
          esp_now_peer_info_t peer;
          memset(&peer, 0, sizeof(peer));
          memcpy(peer.peer_addr, peerMac, 6);
          peer.channel = 0;  // 0 = aktueller Kanal
          peer.encrypt = false;
        
          esp_err_t r = esp_now_add_peer(&peer);
          if (r == ESP_OK) {
            memcpy(g_peerMac, peerMac, 6);
            g_paired = true;
            char buf[24];
            macToStr(peerMac, buf, sizeof(buf));
            Serial.printf("[MESH] gepaart mit %s\n", buf);
            if (g_statusCb) g_statusCb("PEER verbunden");
            return true;
          } else if (r == ESP_ERR_ESPNOW_EXIST) {
            memcpy(g_peerMac, peerMac, 6);
            g_paired = true;
            Serial.println("[MESH] Peer bereits vorhanden");
            return true;
          }
          Serial.printf("[MESH] pairWithPeer fehlgeschlagen: %d\n", r);
          return false;
        }
        
        // ----- UNPAIR -----
        bool unpair() {
          if (!g_initialized || !g_paired) return false;
          esp_err_t r = esp_now_del_peer(g_peerMac);
          memset(g_peerMac, 0, 6);
          g_paired = false;
          if (g_statusCb) g_statusCb("PEER getrennt");
          Serial.println("[MESH] getrennt");
          return r == ESP_OK;
        }
        
        bool isPaired() { return g_paired; }
        
        // ----- SEND (an gepaarten Peer) -----
        static bool sendInternal(const uint8_t* mac, MsgType type, const uint8_t* payload, uint8_t len) {
          if (!g_initialized) return false;
          if (len > sizeof(MeshMsg::payload)) len = sizeof(MeshMsg::payload);
        
          uint8_t buf[sizeof(MeshMsg)];
          size_t off = 0;
          buf[off++] = static_cast<uint8_t>(type);
          memcpy(g_myMac, buf + off, 6); off += 6;            // MIST!  -> korrekt:
          // Reihenfolge: type (1), fromMac (6), toMac (6), payloadLen (1), payload
          // But for over-the-air, we just need: type + payloadLen + payload
          // (we keep it minimal to shrink OTA payload size)
        
          // Reset & build minimalistic
          off = 0;
          buf[off++] = static_cast<uint8_t>(type);
          buf[off++] = len;
          if (len > 0) { memcpy(buf + off, payload, len); off += len; }
        
          esp_err_t r = esp_now_send(mac, buf, off);
          return r == ESP_OK;
        }
        
        bool send(MsgType type, const uint8_t* payload, uint8_t len) {
          if (!g_paired) return false;
          return sendInternal(g_peerMac, type, payload, len);
        }
        
        bool broadcast(MsgType type, const uint8_t* payload, uint8_t len) {
          if (!g_initialized) return false;
          uint8_t bc[6] = {0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF};
          return sendInternal(bc, type, payload, len);
        }
        
        void getMyMac(uint8_t mac[6]) { memcpy(mac, g_myMac, 6); }
        void getMyMacStr(char* buf, size_t len) { macToStr(g_myMac, buf, len); }
        
        bool getPeerMac(uint8_t mac[6]) {
          if (!g_paired) return false;
          memcpy(mac, g_peerMac, 6);
          return true;
        }
        bool getPeerMacStr(char* buf, size_t len) {
          if (!g_paired) return false;
          macToStr(g_peerMac, buf, len);
          return true;
        }
        
        // ----- HEARTBEAT -----
        void sendHeartbeat() {
          if (!g_paired) return;
          // Sende eigenen Namen als Payload
          send(MsgType::HEARTBEAT, (const uint8_t*)g_deviceName, strlen(g_deviceName));
        }
        
        // ----- PEER SCAN -----
        // In P2P koennen wir andere EduBots detektieren, indem wir ein
        // HELLO broadcasten. Andere EduBots antworten mit ihrem Namen.
        // Das ist asynchron - die Antworten kommen ueber onRecvCb.
        // Diese Funktion schickt nur das Broadcast aus.
        int scanForPeers(char outList[][24], int maxEntries) {
          // Hinweis: nur Broadcast abschicken - Antworten asynchron.

        ## Comprehensive Codebase Analysis
        
        ### 1. Project Overview / Architecture Summary
        
        This is **EduBot V1.3** -- an educational robot project that uses a **Seeed Studio Xiao ESP32-S3** microcontroller running on PlatformIO. The robot communicates with a **web-based control interface** via **Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)** using the **Web Bluetooth API**. There is **no WebSocket, WebRTC, or HTTP server** involved anywhere in this project. The entire connection paradigm is:
        
        ```
        Web Browser (HTML/JS)  <-- BLE (GATT) -->  ESP32-S3 Robot
        ```
        
        Additionally, multiple robots can communicate with each other via **ESP-NOW** (a connectionless WiFi-based protocol) for multiplayer features.
        
        **Key subsystems:**
        - **BLE GATT Server** (ESP32): Advertises as "EduBot", exposes Service with `CMD` characteristic (write) and `STATUS` characteristic (read/notify)
        - **Web Client** (HTML page): Uses `navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice()` to connect, writes commands to `CMD` char, listens for notifications on `STATUS` char
        - **Motor control**: DRV8834 stepper driver via STEP/DIR pins, hardware timer ISR with Bresenham fractional stepping
        - **Color sensor**: TCS34725 via I2C, runs in a separate FreeRTOS task on Core 0
        - **ESP-NOW Mesh**: Inter-robot communication for multiplayer modes (Leader/Follower, Math Race, Chat)
        - **NVS (Non-Volatile Storage)**: Persists configuration (speed, turn, calibration) using Preferences API
        - **Watchdog Timer**: esp_task_wdt with 20s timeout for crash protection

        ```cpp
        class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
          void onConnect(BLEServer* server) override {
            BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_CONNECTED, "" };
            if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
          }
          void onDisconnect(BLEServer* server) override {
            BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED, "" };
            if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
          }
        };
        ```
        **Key detail**: Callbacks don't directly modify `deviceConnected` -- they enqueue events to a FreeRTOS queue to avoid ISR-context issues.
        
        #### BLE Command Callbacks (Lines 745-754) -- `CommandCallbacks`:
        ```cpp
        class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
          void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* characteristic) override {
            std::string rxValue = characteristic->getValue().c_str();
            if (!rxValue.empty()) {
              BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_COMMAND, "" };
              strlcpy(evt.cmd, rxValue.c_str(), sizeof(evt.cmd));
              if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
            }
          }
        };
        ```
        
        #### Event Processing (Lines 760-786) -- `processBleEvents()`:
        ```cpp
        void processBleEvents() {
          BleEvent evt;
          while (bleEventQueue && xQueueReceive(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0) == pdTRUE) {
            switch (evt.type) {
              case BLE_EVT_CONNECTED:
                deviceConnected = true;
                lastCommandTime = millis();
                Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
                char buf[48];
                snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s bereit", FIRMWARE_VERSION);
                sendStatus(buf);
                break;
              case BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED:
                deviceConnected = false;
                clearKeys();
                speedL = 0.0; speedR = 0.0;
                stopMotors();
                Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt -> Werbung neu gestartet");
                BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
                break;
              case BLE_EVT_COMMAND:
                handleCommand(String(evt.cmd));
                break;
            }
          }
        }
        ```
        **Connection state management**: On disconnect: (1) clears all drive keys, (2) zeros motor speeds, (3) stops motors, (4) restarts BLE advertising.

        #### BLE Connect Function (Lines 470-503):
        ```javascript
        async function connectBLE() {
          try {
            if (!navigator.bluetooth) { alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!'); return; }
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
            device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
              filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
              optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
            });
            device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', () => { 
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt'); 
              connected = false;
              stopSending();
            });
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Verbinde...');
            const server = await device.gatt.connect();
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Service...');
            const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Chars...');
            cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
            statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Notify...');
            await statusChar.startNotifications();
            statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
              handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
            });
            connected = true;
            updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
            startSending();
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('BLE Fehler:', e);
            alert('Verbindung fehlgeschlagen: ' + (e.message || e));
            updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
          }
        }
        ```
        **Connection flow**: requestDevice -> gatt.connect() -> getPrimaryService -> getCharacteristics -> startNotifications -> start heartbeat interval
        **Error handling**: try/catch around entire flow, console.error + alert on failure
        
        #### Command Sending (Lines 505-515):
        ```javascript
        async function sendCommand(cmd) {
          if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
          if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }   // Queue if busy
          writing = true;
          try { 
            const encoder = new TextEncoder();
            await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(encoder.encode(cmd)); 
          } catch (e) { connected = false; }
          writing = false;
          if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
        }
        ```
        **Write guard**: `writing` flag prevents overlapping writes. Queued commands are retried. Uses `writeValueWithoutResponse` for fast delivery.
        
        #### Key State Sending / Heartbeat (Lines 517-529):
        ```javascript
        async function sendKeys(force) {
          if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
          const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
          if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;   // Skip duplicate
          lastSent = msg;
          try { 
            const encoder = new TextEncoder();
            await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(encoder.encode(msg)); 
          } catch (e) { connected = false; }
        }
        
        function startSending() { stopSending(); heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50); }
        function stopSending() { if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval); heartbeatInterval = null; }
        function emergencyStop() { keys = { w:0,a:0,s:0,d:0 }; sendKeys(true); }
        ```
        **Heartbeat**: Sends `KEYS:????` every 50ms. Deduplication: skips if same as `lastSent`. On disconnect, `stopSending()` clears the interval.

        ### 8. ESP-NOW Mesh (Inter-Robot, Not Website)
        
        Although not the "robot-to-website" connection, the mesh is an important secondary communication layer:
        
        - `src/mesh.h` (lines 1-63): Defines `EduMesh` namespace with 6 opcodes (`HEARTBEAT`, `MSG`, `CMD`, `COLOR`, `PING`, `PONG`), max 8 peers, 200-byte payload, WiFi channel 6

        ### Summary
        
        The robot-to-website connection is a **pure BLE GATT connection** with no server-side web infrastructure, no WebSocket, and no WebRTC. The ESP32 is the BLE peripheral/server, and the web browser is the BLE central/client. The connection pipeline is:
        
        ```
        Web Browser (BLE Central)         ESP32-S3 (BLE Peripheral)
        ======================           ==========================
        connectBLE()                    BLEDevice::init("EduBot")
         -> requestDevice                -> createServer
         -> gatt.connect()               -> ServerCallbacks (onConnect/onDisconnect)
         -> getService                    -> CommandCallbacks (onWrite)
         -> cmdChar (write)              -> bleEventQueue (FreeRTOS)
         -> statusChar (notify)          -> processBleEvents() in loop()
        sendCommand("KEYS:1010")        handleCommand("KEYS:1010")
                                         -> sendStatus("COLOR:R,G,B,NAME")
        statusChar notifies              statusChar->notify()
        handleStatusMessage()            (via GATT notification)
        ```

        23: // PIN-KONFIGURATION (Xiao ESP32-S3)
        24: // =====================================================
        25: // DRV8834 Anschlüsse:
        26: //   STEP_L  -> GPIO 4
        27: //   DIR_L   -> GPIO 3
        28: //   STEP_R  -> GPIO 2
        29: //   DIR_R   -> GPIO 1
        30: //   ENABLE  -> GPIO 7 (optional, LOW = aktiv)
        31: // TCS34725  -> I2C (SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO6)
        32: 
        33: #define PIN_DIR_L      3
        34: #define PIN_STEP_L     4
        35: #define PIN_DIR_R      1
        36: #define PIN_STEP_R     2
        37: #define PIN_ENABLE     7
        38: 
        39: #define STEP_BIT_L     (1UL << PIN_STEP_L)
        40: #define STEP_BIT_R     (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)

        95: // =====================================================
        96: // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        97: // =====================================================
        98: // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        99: // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        100: // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        101: // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        102: 
        103: uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        104: uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        105: uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        106: uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        107: uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        108: uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        109: 
        110: static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        111: static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        112: 
        113: bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
        114:   if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
        115:   if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        116: 
        117:   if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
        118:     stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
        119:     if (stepFracAccumL >= 0x10000UL) {
        120:       stepFracAccumL -= 0x10000UL;
        121:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
        122:       stepPhaseL = 1;
        123:     }
        124:   } else {
        125:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        126:   }
        127: 
        128:   if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
        129:     stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
        130:     if (stepFracAccumR >= 0x10000UL) {
        131:       stepFracAccumR -= 0x10000UL;
        132:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
        133:       stepPhaseR = 1;
        134:     }
        135:   } else {
        136:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        137:   }
        138:   return false;
        139: }
        140: 
        141: void initStepperTimer() {
        142:   timer_config_t cfg = {};
        143:   cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
        144:   cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
        145:   cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
        146:   cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
        147:   cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
        148:   cfg.divider = 80;
        149: 
        150:   timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
        151:   timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
        152:   timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
        153:   timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        154:   timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
        155:   timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        156: }

        159: // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)

        161: 
        162: void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
        163:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        164:   const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
        165:   const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        166: 
        167:   float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        168: 
        169:   if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
        170:     digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
        171:   } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
        172:     digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
        173:     actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
        174:   } else {
        175:     if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
        176:     else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
        177:     GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
        178:     portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        179:     return;
        180:   }
        181: 
        182:   uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        183:   if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
        184:   if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = 0;
        185: 
        186:   uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * 0x10000UL) / interval;
        187: 
        188:   if (motorIdx == 0) {
        189:     stepIntervalL = interval;
        190:     stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
        191:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        192:   } else {
        193:     stepIntervalR = interval;
        194:     stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
        195:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        196:   }
        197:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        198: }
        199: 
        200: void stopMotors() {
        201:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        202:   stepIntervalL = 0;
        203:   stepIntervalR = 0;
        204:   stepFracAddL = 0;
        205:   stepFracAddR = 0;
        206:   stepFracAccumL = 0;
        207:   stepFracAccumR = 0;
        208: 
        209:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        210:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        211: }

        227: 
        228: SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        229: bool colorSensorOk = false;
        230: 
        231: // Kalibrierung: Rohwerte -> 0-255
        232: int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
        233:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        234:   long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw), static_cast<long>(blackVal), static_cast<long>(whiteVal), 0L, 255L);
        235:   value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);
        236:   return static_cast<int>(value);
        237: }
        238: 
        239: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        240:   if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
        241:   if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
        242:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        243:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        244:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        245:   if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
        246:   return "UNBEKANNT";
        247: }

        249: void setupColorSensor() {
        250:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        251:   colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        252:   if (colorSensorOk) {
        253:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
        254:   } else {
        255:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden! (Trotzdem gestartet)");
        256:   }
        257:   colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
        258:   if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        259: }
        260: 
        261: void resetI2CBus() {
        262:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
        263:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
        264:   for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        265:     digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
        266:     pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
        267:     digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
        268:   }
        269:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
        270:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
        271:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        272: }
        273: 
        274: void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
        275:   TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        276:   const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
        277:   int failCount = 0;
        278: 
        279:   while (true) {
        280:     if (colorSensorOk) {
        281:       uint16_t rawR = 0, rawG = 0, rawB = 0, rawC = 0;
        282:       tcs.getRawData(&rawR, &rawG, &rawB, &rawC);
        283:       rawSensorR = rawR; rawSensorG = rawG; rawSensorB = rawB; rawSensorC = rawC;
        284: 
        285:       if (rawR == 0 && rawG == 0 && rawB == 0 && rawC == 0) {
        286:         failCount++;
        287:         if (failCount >= 3) {
        288:           colorSensorOk = false;
        289:         }
        290:       } else {
        291:         failCount = 0;
        292: 
        293:         int r = calibrateColor(rawR, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
        294:         int g = calibrateColor(rawG, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
        295:         int b = calibrateColor(rawB, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        296: 
        297:         const char* detected = detectColorName(r, g, b);
        298: 
        299:         if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, portMAX_DELAY) == pdTRUE) {
        300:           sensorR = r;
        301:           sensorG = g;
        302:           sensorB = b;
        303:           strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detected, sizeof(sensorName));
        304:           xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        305:         }
        306:       }
        307:     } else {
        308:       Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
        309:       resetI2CBus();
        310:       colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        311:       if (colorSensorOk) {
        312:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
        313:         failCount = 0;
        314:       }
        315:       vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
        316:     }
        317:     vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
        318:   }
        319: }

        416: void handleCommand(String cmd) {
        417:   cmd.trim();
        418:   cmd.toUpperCase();
        419:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        420: 
        421:   Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        422: 
        423:   if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
        424:     String data = cmd.substring(5);
        425:     if (data.length() >= 4) {
        426:       keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
        427:       keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
        428:       keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
        429:       keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
        430:     }
        431:     return;
        432:   }
        433: 
        434:   if (cmd == "STOP") {
        435:     hardStop();
        436:     return;
        437:   }
        438: 
        439:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        440:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        441:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        442:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        443:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        444:       prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        445:       prefs.end();
        446:       sendStatus((String("MAX=") + String(config.maxSpeed)).c_str());
        447:     }
        448:     return;
        449:   }
        450: 
        451:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        452:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        453:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        454:       config.turnFactor = t;
        455:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        456:       prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        457:       prefs.end();
        458:       sendStatus((String("TURN=") + String(config.turnFactor)).c_str());
        459:     }
        460:     return;
        461:   }
        462: 
        463:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        464:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        465:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        466:       config.accelRate = a;
        467:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        468:       prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        469:       prefs.end();
        470:       sendStatus((String("ACC=") + String(config.accelRate)).c_str());
        471:     }
        472:     return;
        473:   }
        474: 
        475:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        476:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        477:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        478:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        479:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        480:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        481:     prefs.end();
        482:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        483:     return;
        484:   }
        485: 
        486:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        487:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        488:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        489:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        490:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        491:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        492:     prefs.end();
        493:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        494:     return;
        495:   }
        496: 
        497:   sendStatus((String("UNKNOWN:") + cmd).c_str());
        498: }

        515: class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
        516:   void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* characteristic) override {
        517:     std::string rxValue = characteristic->getValue().c_str();
        518:     if (!rxValue.empty()) {
        519:       BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_COMMAND, "" };
        520:       strlcpy(evt.cmd, rxValue.c_str(), sizeof(evt.cmd));
        521:       if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
        522:     }
        523:   }
        524: };
        525: 
        526: // =====================================================
        527: // EVENT-VERARBEITUNG (wird in loop() aufgerufen)
        528: // =====================================================
        529: 
        530: void processBleEvents() {
        531:   BleEvent evt;
        532:   while (bleEventQueue && xQueueReceive(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0) == pdTRUE) {
        533:     switch (evt.type) {
        534:       case BLE_EVT_CONNECTED:
        535:         deviceConnected = true;
        536:         lastCommandTime = millis();
        537:         Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
        538:         sendStatus("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
        539:         break;
        540:       case BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED:
        541:         deviceConnected = false;
        542:         clearKeys();
        543:         speedL = 0.0;
        544:         speedR = 0.0;
        545:         stopMotors();
        546:         Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt - Werbung gestartet");
        547:         BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        548:         break;
        549:       case BLE_EVT_COMMAND:
        550:         handleCommand(String(evt.cmd));
        551:         break;
        552:     }
        553:   }
        554: }
        555: 
        556: // =====================================================
        557: // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        558: // =====================================================
        559: 
        560: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        561:   float diff = target - current;
        562:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        563:     return target;
        564:   }
        565:   float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
        566:   if (diff > 0) {
        567:     current += maxChange;
        568:     if (current > target) current = target;
        569:   } else {
        570:     current -= maxChange;
        571:     if (current < target) current = target;
        572:   }
        573:   return current;
        574: }
        575: 
        576: // =====================================================
        577: // FAHRLOGIK
        578: // =====================================================
        579: 
        580: void updateDrive() {
        581:   float targetL = 0.0;
        582:   float targetR = 0.0;
        583: 
        584:   bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
        585:   bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
        586:   bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
        587:   bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        588: 
        589:   if (forward) {
        590:     targetL = config.maxSpeed;
        591:     targetR = config.maxSpeed;
        592:   } else if (backward) {
        593:     targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
        594:     targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
        595:   }
        596: 
        597:   if (forward || backward) {
        598:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        599:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
        600:   }
        601: 
        602:   if (!forward && !backward) {
        603:     if (left) {
        604:       targetL = 0;
        605:       targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        606:     } else if (right) {
        607:       targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        608:       targetR = 0;
        609:     }
        610:   }
        611: 
        612:   // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
        613:   if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
        614:     targetL = 0.0;
        615:     targetR = 0.0;
        616:     if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
        617:       speedL = 0.0;
        618:       speedR = 0.0;
        619:       clearKeys();
        620:       stopMotors();
        621:     }
        622:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        623:     return;
        624:   }
        625: 
        626:   unsigned long now = micros();
        627:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        628:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        629:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        630: 
        631:   float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
        632:   if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
        633:     speedL = newSpeedL;
        634:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        635:   }
        636: 
        637:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
        638:   if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
        639:     speedR = newSpeedR;
        640:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        641:   }
        642: }
        643: 
        644: // =====================================================
        645: // NVS-VALIDIERUNG
        646: // =====================================================
        647: 
        648: void validateConfig() {
        649:   bool changed = false;
        650:   if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        651:     config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
        652:   }
        653:   if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
        654:     config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        655:   }
        656:   if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
        657:     config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        658:   }
        659:   if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
        660:     config.blackR = 152; config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
        661:     config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
        662:     changed = true;
        663:   }
        664:   if (changed) {
        665:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        666:     prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        667:     prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        668:     prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        669:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        670:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        671:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        672:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        673:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        674:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        675:     prefs.end();
        676:     Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");
        677:   }
        678: }
        679:

        46: // PIN-KONFIGURATION (Xiao ESP32-S3)
        47: // =====================================================
        48: // DRV8834 Anschlüsse:
        49: //   STEP_L  -> GPIO 4
        50: //   DIR_L   -> GPIO 3
        51: //   STEP_R  -> GPIO 2
        52: //   DIR_R   -> GPIO 1
        53: //   ENABLE  -> GPIO 7 (optional, LOW = aktiv)
        54: // TCS34725  -> I2C (SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO6)
        55: 
        56: #define PIN_DIR_L      3
        57: #define PIN_STEP_L     4
        58: #define PIN_DIR_R      1
        59: #define PIN_STEP_R     2
        60: #define PIN_ENABLE     7
        61: 
        62: #define STEP_BIT_L     (1UL << PIN_STEP_L)
        63: #define STEP_BIT_R     (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)
        64: portMUX_TYPE stepperMux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
        65: #define SDA_PIN        5
        66: #define SCL_PIN        6
        67: 
        68: // =====================================================
        69: // KONSTANTEN
        70: // =====================================================
        71: constexpr unsigned long BAUD_RATE = 115200;
        72: constexpr const char* FIRMWARE_VERSION = "EduBot V1.3";
        73: constexpr int STACK_COLOR_SENSOR = 8192;
        74: constexpr int BLE_QUEUE_LENGTH = 16;
        75: constexpr int TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR = 2;

        85: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MAX = 2500;

        122: // =====================================================
        123: // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        124: // =====================================================
        125: // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        126: // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        127: // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        128: // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        129: 
        130: uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        131: uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        132: uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        133: uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        134: uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        135: uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        136: 
        137: static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        138: static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        139: 
        140: bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
        141:   if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
        142:   if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        143: 
        144:   if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
        145:     stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
        146:     if (stepFracAccumL >= FRAC_SCALE) {
        147:       stepFracAccumL -= FRAC_SCALE;
        148:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
        149:       stepPhaseL = 1;
        150:     }
        151:   } else {
        152:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        153:   }
        154: 
        155:   if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
        156:     stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
        157:     if (stepFracAccumR >= FRAC_SCALE) {
        158:       stepFracAccumR -= FRAC_SCALE;
        159:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
        160:       stepPhaseR = 1;
        161:     }
        162:   } else {
        163:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        164:   }
        165:   return false;
        166: }
        167: 
        168: void initStepperTimer() {
        169:   timer_config_t cfg = {};
        170:   cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
        171:   cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
        172:   cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
        173:   cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
        174:   cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
        175:   cfg.divider = 80;
        176: 
        177:   timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
        178:   timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
        179:   timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
        180:   timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        181:   timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
        182:   timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        183: }

        185: // =====================================================
        186: // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)
        187: // =====================================================
        188: 
        189: void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
        190:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        191:   const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
        192:   const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        193: 
        194:   float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        195: 
        196:   if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
        197:     digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
        198:   } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
        199:     digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
        200:     actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
        201:   } else {
        202:     if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
        203:     else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
        204:     GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
        205:     portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        206:     return;
        207:   }
        208: 
        209:   uint32_t interval;
        210:   uint32_t actualSpeedInt = static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        211:   if (actualSpeedInt < 1) actualSpeedInt = 1;
        212:   interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / actualSpeedInt;
        213:   if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
        214:   if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MAX_STEP_INTERVAL;
        215: 
        216:   uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * FRAC_SCALE) / interval;
        217: 
        218:   if (motorIdx == 0) {
        219:     stepIntervalL = interval;
        220:     stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
        221:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        222:   } else {
        223:     stepIntervalR = interval;
        224:     stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
        225:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        226:   }
        227:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        228: }
        229: 
        230: void stopMotors() {
        231:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        232:   stepIntervalL = 0;
        233:   stepIntervalR = 0;
        234:   stepFracAddL = 0;
        235:   stepFracAddR = 0;
        236:   stepFracAccumL = 0;
        237:   stepFracAccumR = 0;
        238: 
        239:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        240:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        241: }
        242: 
        243: // =====================================================
        244: // FARBSENSOR (TCS34725)
        245: // =====================================================
        246: 
        247: Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(
        248:   TCS34725_INTEGRATIONTIME_50MS,
        249:   TCS34725_GAIN_4X
        250: );
        251: 
        252: volatile int sensorR = 0;
        253: volatile int sensorG = 0;
        254: volatile int sensorB = 0;
        255: volatile uint16_t rawSensorR = 0, rawSensorG = 0, rawSensorB = 0, rawSensorC = 0;
        256: volatile char sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
        257: 
        258: SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        259: bool colorSensorOk = false;
        260: 
        261: // Kalibrierung: Rohwerte -> 0-255
        262: int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
        263:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        264:   float value = (static_cast<float>(raw) - blackVal) * 255.0f / (whiteVal - blackVal);
        265:   if (value < 0.0f) value = 0.0f;
        266:   if (value > 255.0f) value = 255.0f;
        267:   return static_cast<int>(value + 0.5f);
        268: }
        269: 
        270: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        271:   if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
        272:   if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
        273:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        274:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        275:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        276:   if (r > config.yellowRmin && g > config.yellowGmin && b < config.yellowBmax) return "GELB";
        277:   return "UNBEKANNT";
        278: }
        279: 
        280: void setupColorSensor() {
        281:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        282:   delay(1000); // Mehr Zeit zum Initialisieren
        283:   
        284:   if (tcs.begin()) {
        285:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
        286:     colorSensorOk = true;
        287:   } else {
        288:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden!");
        289:     colorSensorOk = false;
        290:   }
        291:   colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
        292:   if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        293: }
        294: 
        295: void resetI2CBus() {
        296:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
        297:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
        298:   for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        299:     digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
        300:     pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
        301:     digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
        302:   }
        303:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
        304:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
        305:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        306: }
        307: 
        308: void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
        309:   TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        310:   const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
        311:   int failCount = 0;
        312: 
        313:   while (true) {
        314:     if (colorSensorOk) {
        315:       uint16_t r, g, b, c;
        316:       tcs.getRawData(&r, &g, &b, &c);
        317: 
        318:       if (r == 0 && g == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0) {
        319:         failCount++;
        320:         if (failCount >= 3) {
        321:           colorSensorOk = false;
        322:           Serial.println("[SENSOR] 3x Null-Daten -> Sensor als offline markiert");
        323:         }
        324:       } else {
        325:         failCount = 0;
        326:         rawSensorR = r; rawSensorG = g; rawSensorB = b; rawSensorC = c;
        327: 
        328:         if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) == pdTRUE) {
        329:           int calR = calibrateColor(r, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
        330:           int calG = calibrateColor(g, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
        331:           int calB = calibrateColor(b, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        332: 
        333:           sensorR = calR; sensorG = calG; sensorB = calB;
        334:           strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detectColorName(calR, calG, calB), sizeof(sensorName));
        335:           xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        336:         }
        337:       }
        338:     } else {
        339:       Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
        340:       resetI2CBus();
        341:       if (tcs.begin()) {
        342:         colorSensorOk = true;
        343:         failCount = 0;
        344:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
        345:       } else {
        346:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery fehlgeschlagen");
        347:       }
        348:       vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
        349:       lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        350:       continue;
        351:     }
        352:     vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
        353:   }
        354: }

        361: #define CMD_UUID     "beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8"
        362: #define STATUS_UUID  "a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef"

        372:   BLE_EVT_CONNECTED,
        373:   BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED,

        413: void sendColorToWebsite() {
        414:   int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
        415:   char name[16] = {};
        416: 
        417:   if (colorSem == nullptr) return;
        418:   if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
        419:     r = sensorR;
        420:     g = sensorG;
        421:     b = sensorB;
        422:     strlcpy(name, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(name));
        423:     xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        424:   } else {
        425:     return;
        426:   }
        427: 
        428:   char msg[64];
        429:   snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "COLOR:%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name);
        430:   sendStatus(msg);
        431: }

        435: // =====================================================

        437: void clearKeys() {
        438:   keyW = false;
        439:   keyA = false;
        440:   keyS = false;
        441:   keyD = false;
        442: }
        443: 
        444: void hardStop() {
        445:   clearKeys();
        446:   speedL = 0.0;
        447:   speedR = 0.0;
        448:   stopMotors();
        449:   sendStatus("STOP");
        450: }
        451: 
        452: void handleCommand(String cmd) {
        453:   cmd.trim();
        454:   cmd.toUpperCase();
        455:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        456: 
        457:   Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        458: 
        459:   if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
        460:     String data = cmd.substring(5);
        461:     if (data.length() >= 4) {
        462:       keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
        463:       keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
        464:       keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
        465:       keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
        466:     }
        467:     return;
        468:   }
        469: 
        470:   if (cmd == "STOP") {
        471:     hardStop();
        472:     return;
        473:   }
        474: 
        475:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        476:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        477:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        478:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        479:       configDirty = true;
        480:       char buf[32];
        481:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "MAX=%.0f", config.maxSpeed);
        482:       sendStatus(buf);
        483:     }
        484:     return;
        485:   }
        486: 
        487:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        488:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        489:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        490:       config.turnFactor = t;
        491:       configDirty = true;
        492:       char buf[32];
        493:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "TURN=%.2f", config.turnFactor);
        494:       sendStatus(buf);
        495:     }
        496:     return;
        497:   }
        498: 
        499:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        500:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        501:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        502:       config.accelRate = a;
        503:       configDirty = true;
        504:       char buf[32];
        505:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "ACC=%.0f", config.accelRate);
        506:       sendStatus(buf);
        507:     }
        508:     return;
        509:   }
        510: 
        511:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        512:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        513:     configDirty = true;
        514:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        515:     return;
        516:   }
        517: 
        518:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        519:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        520:     configDirty = true;
        521:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        522:     return;
        523:   }
        524: 
        525:   char buf[80];
        526:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "UNKNOWN:%s", cmd.c_str());
        527:   sendStatus(buf);
        528: }
        529: 
        530: // =====================================================
        531: // BLE CALBACKS
        532: // =====================================================
        533: 
        534: class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
        535:   void onConnect(BLEServer* server) override {
        536:     BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_CONNECTED, "" };
        537:     if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
        538:   }
        539:   void onDisconnect(BLEServer* server) override {
        540:     BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED, "" };
        541:     if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
        542:   }
        543: };
        544: 
        545: class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
        546:   void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* characteristic) override {
        547:     std::string rxValue = characteristic->getValue().c_str();
        548:     if (!rxValue.empty()) {
        549:       BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_COMMAND, "" };
        550:       strlcpy(evt.cmd, rxValue.c_str(), sizeof(evt.cmd));
        551:       if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
        552:     }
        553:   }
        554: };
        555: 
        556: // =====================================================
        557: // EVENT-VERARBEITUNG (wird in loop() aufgerufen)
        558: // =====================================================
        559: 
        560: void processBleEvents() {
        561:   BleEvent evt;
        562:   while (bleEventQueue && xQueueReceive(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0) == pdTRUE) {
        563:     switch (evt.type) {
        564:       case BLE_EVT_CONNECTED:
        565:         deviceConnected = true;
        566:         lastCommandTime = millis();
        567:         Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
        568:         char buf[48];
        569:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s bereit", FIRMWARE_VERSION);
        570:         sendStatus(buf);
        571:         break;
        572:       case BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED:
        573:         deviceConnected = false;
        574:         clearKeys();
        575:         speedL = 0.0;
        576:         speedR = 0.0;
        577:         stopMotors();
        578:         Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt -> Werbung neu gestartet");
        579:         BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        580:         break;
        581:       case BLE_EVT_COMMAND:
        582:         handleCommand(String(evt.cmd));
        583:         break;
        584:     }
        585:   }
        586: }
        587: 
        588: // =====================================================
        589: // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        590: // =====================================================
        591: 
        592: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        593:   float diff = target - current;
        594:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        595:     return target;
        596:   }
        597:   float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
        598:   if (diff > 0) {
        599:     current += maxChange;
        600:     if (current > target) current = target;
        601:   } else {
        602:     current -= maxChange;
        603:     if (current < target) current = target;
        604:   }
        605:   return current;
        606: }
        607: 
        608: // =====================================================
        609: // FAHRLOGIK
        610: // =====================================================
        611: 
        612: void updateDrive() {
        613:   float targetL = 0.0;
        614:   float targetR = 0.0;
        615: 
        616:   bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
        617:   bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
        618:   bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
        619:   bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        620: 
        621:   if (forward) {
        622:     targetL = config.maxSpeed;
        623:     targetR = config.maxSpeed;
        624:   } else if (backward) {
        625:     targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
        626:     targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
        627:   }
        628: 
        629:   if (forward || backward) {
        630:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        631:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
        632:   }
        633: 
        634:   if (!forward && !backward) {
        635:     if (left) {
        636:       targetL = 0;
        637:       targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        638:     } else if (right) {
        639:       targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        640:       targetR = 0;
        641:     }
        642:   }
        643: 
        644:   // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
        645:   if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
        646:     targetL = 0.0;
        647:     targetR = 0.0;
        648:     if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
        649:       speedL = 0.0;
        650:       speedR = 0.0;
        651:       clearKeys();
        652:       stopMotors();
        653:     }
        654:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        655:     return;
        656:   }
        657: 
        658:   unsigned long now = micros();
        659:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        660:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        661:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        662: 
        663:   float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
        664:   if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
        665:     speedL = newSpeedL;
        666:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        667:   }
        668: 
        669:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
        670:   if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
        671:     speedR = newSpeedR;
        672:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        673:   }
        674: }
        675: 
        676: void validateConfig() {
        677:   bool changed = false;
        678: 
        679:   if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        680:     config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
        681:   }
        682:   if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
        683:     config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        684:   }
        685:   if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
        686:     config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        687:   }
        688:   if (config.turnOnlySpeed < 50.0f || config.turnOnlySpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        689:     config.turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f; changed = true;
        690:   }
        691:   if (config.leftSign != -1 && config.leftSign != 1) {
        692:     config.leftSign = -1; changed = true;
        693:   }
        694:   if (config.rightSign != -1 && config.rightSign != 1) {
        695:     config.rightSign = -1; changed = true;
        696:   }
        697:   if (config.commandTimeoutMs < 100 || config.commandTimeoutMs > 10000) {
        698:     config.commandTimeoutMs = 500; changed = true;
        699:   }
        700:   if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
        701:     config.blackR = 152;  config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
        702:     config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
        703:     changed = true;
        704:   }
        705: 
        706:   if (changed) {
        707:     configDirty = true;
        708:     Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");
        709:   }
        710: }
        711: 
        712: void saveConfigIfDirty() {
        713:   if (configDirty) {
        714:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        715:     prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        716:     prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        717:     prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        718:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        719:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        720:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        721:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        722:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        723:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        724:     prefs.end();
        725:     configDirty = false;
        726:     Serial.println("[NVS] Config saved");
        727:   }
        728: }

        731: // SETUP
        732: // =====================================================
        733: 
        734: void setup() {
        735:   Serial.begin(BAUD_RATE);
        736:   vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));
        737:   Serial.println("\n======================================");
        738:   Serial.println("EduBot V1.3 – Xiao ESP32-S3 + DRV8834");
        739:   Serial.println("======================================");
        740: 
        741:     // esp_task_wdt_config_t wdt_config = {
        742:   //   .timeout_ms = 10000,
        743:   //   .idle_core_mask = (1 << CONFIG_NUM_CORES) - 1, 
        744:   //   .trigger_panic = true,
        745:   // };
        746:   // esp_task_wdt_init(&wdt_config);
        747:   // esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        748:   
        749:   esp_task_wdt_init(20, true);
        750:   esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
        751: 
        752:   // NVS-Konfiguration laden und validieren
        753:   prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        754:   config.maxSpeed      = prefs.getFloat("maxSpeed", static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT));
        755:   config.turnFactor    = prefs.getFloat("turnFactor", TURN_DEFAULT);
        756:   config.turnOnlySpeed = prefs.getFloat("turnOnlySpeed", 550.0f);
        757:   config.accelRate     = prefs.getFloat("accelRate", ACCEL_DEFAULT);
        758:   config.blackR        = prefs.getUShort("blackR", 152);
        759:   config.blackG        = prefs.getUShort("blackG", 137);
        760:   config.blackB        = prefs.getUShort("blackB", 98);
        761:   config.whiteR        = prefs.getUShort("whiteR", 4143);
        762:   config.whiteG        = prefs.getUShort("whiteG", 4258);
        763:   config.whiteB        = prefs.getUShort("whiteB", 3036);
        764:   Serial.printf("[NVS] maxSpeed=%.0f accelRate=%.0f turnFactor=%.2f\n", config.maxSpeed, config.accelRate, config.turnFactor);
        765:   validateConfig();
        766:   saveConfigIfDirty();
        767:   prefs.end();
        768: 
        769:   // Pins initialisieren
        770:   pinMode(PIN_DIR_L, OUTPUT);
        771:   pinMode(PIN_STEP_L, OUTPUT);
        772:   pinMode(PIN_DIR_R, OUTPUT);
        773:   pinMode(PIN_STEP_R, OUTPUT);
        774:   pinMode(PIN_ENABLE, OUTPUT);
        775: 
        776:   digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_L, LOW);
        777:   digitalWrite(PIN_STEP_R, LOW);
        778:   digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_L, LOW);
        779:   digitalWrite(PIN_DIR_R, LOW);
        780:   digitalWrite(PIN_ENABLE, LOW); // DRV8834 aktivieren
        781: 
        782:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        783: 
        784:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        785:   lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        786: 
        787:   // Hardware-Timer starten
        788:   initStepperTimer();
        789:   Serial.println("[TIMER] Hardware-Timer gestartet (10 µs)");
        790: 
        791:   // Farbsensor
        792:   setupColorSensor();
        793:   if (colorSensorOk) {
        794:     xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(
        795:       colorSensorTask,
        796:       "ColorSensor",
        797:       STACK_COLOR_SENSOR,
        798:       NULL,
        799:       TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR,
        800:       NULL,
        801:       CORE_SENSOR
        802:     );
        803:     Serial.println("[TASK] ColorSensor-Task gestartet (Core 0)");
        804:   }
        805: 
        806:   // BLE-Queue

    [TOOL: write | completed]
