[ASSISTANT]: Build erfolgreich. Die Fixes:  1. **`Edu_V1.3.cpp`**: `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)` **vor** `BLEDevice::init()` (Zeile 1088) — WiFi ist aktiv bevor BLE startet 2. **`mesh.cpp`**: `WiFi.mode()` entfernt — wurde nach BLE aufgerufen und hat den BT-Controller resettet 3. Die alten `stopAdvertising/startAdvertising` um den mesh-Init entfernt — nicht mehr nötig  **Ursache**: Auf ESP32-S3 mit Arduino Core 3.0.x teilen sich WiFi und BLE denselben Radio-Controller. Wenn `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)` **nach** `BLEDevice::init()` aufgerufen wird (wie in mesh.cpp passiert), wird der BT-Controller zurückgesetzt und BLE funktioniert nicht mehr.  Soll ich die Firmware flashen?

[USER]: die komplette webseite ist unvollständig die aufgaben funktionieren nicht und das design ist ncoht gut auch die bluetooth verbindung funktioneuirt nicht update alles kompeltt

[ASSISTANT]: Der Frust ist absolut verständlich. Die Bluetooth-Koexistenz auf dem ESP32-S3 ist tückisch, und eine instabile Verbindung zieht die gesamte Nutzererfahrung runter.  Ich werde das **komplette Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS)** auf eine moderne, robuste Basis stellen und die BLE-Verbindungslogik so anpassen, dass sie verständlicheres Feedback gibt.  ### Der Plan:  1.  **Frontend-Redesign**: Sauberes, modernes Grid-Layout, klarere Status-Anzeigen und eine modulare JavaScript-Struktur, die besser mit Verbindungsabbrüchen umgeht. 2.  **BLE-Robustheit**: Ich baue eine `Auto-Retry`-Logik für die Verbindung ein und bessere Fehlerbehandlung. 3.  **Spiel-Logik**: Ich werde die Spiellogik (Mathe-Rennen, Farben-Quiz) kapseln, damit sie auch bei kurzzeitigen Verbindungsschwankungen nicht komplett abstürzt.  Ich starte jetzt mit dem vollständigen Rewrite der `Edu_V1.3.html`. Danach biete ich dir an, die Firmware erneut zu flashen, um sicherzugehen, dass alles perfekt aufeinander abgestimmt ist.         <script>
            const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
            const CMD_UUID = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
            const STATUS_UUID = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
            
            let cmdChar, statusChar, connected = false;
            let keys = {w:0, a:0, s:0, d:0};
        
            async function connect() {
                try {
                    const device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({ filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }], optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID] });
                    const server = await device.gatt.connect();
                    const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
                    cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
                    statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
                    await statusChar.startNotifications();
                    statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => handleStatus(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value)));
                    
                    connected = true;
                    document.getElementById('status').textContent = 'Verbunden';
                    document.getElementById('status').classList.add('connected');
                } catch(e) { console.error(e); alert('Verbindung fehlgeschlagen'); }
            }
        
            function handleStatus(msg) {
                if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:')) document.getElementById('meshChatLog').innerHTML += '<div>' + msg.substring(9) + '</div>';
                if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:RESULT:')) alert('Quiz Ergebnis: ' + msg);
            }
        
            async function sendCommand(cmd) { if(connected) await cmdChar.writeValue(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd)); }
            function sendKey(k,v) { keys[k]=v; sendCommand('KEYS:'+keys.w+keys.a+keys.s+keys.d); }
            function nav(id) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
                document.getElementById('view-'+id).classList.add('active');
            }
        
            document.getElementById('btnConnect').onclick = connect;
        
            // Quiz Logic
            let cqAnswers = [];
            document.getElementById('btnCqStart').onclick = () => { cqAnswers = []; nav('quiz'); document.getElementById('cq-choices').classList.remove('hidden'); document.getElementById('btnCqNext').classList.remove('hidden'); document.getElementById('btnCqStart').classList.add('hidden'); };
            document.querySelectorAll('.color-choice').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { cqAnswers.push(b.dataset.color); if(cqAnswers.length >= 10) { document.getElementById('btnCqNext').classList.add('hidden'); document.getElementById('btnCqCheck').classList.remove('hidden'); } });
            document.getElementById('btnCqCheck').onclick = () => sendCommand('QUIZ:CHECK:' + cqAnswers.join(','));
        </script>

Phase 4: Farben-Quiz mit Roboter-Korrektur - Ablauf: 1. Du siehst am Bildschirm eine Frage (z.B. 2+2 = ? Optionen: 3, 4, 5, 6). 2. Du tippst die richtige Farbe (z.B. Blau für 4) an. 3. Du legst für jede der 10 Aufgaben das entsprechende Farbplättchen auf den Boden (Reihenfolge der Antworten). 4. Am Ende drückst du "Korrektur starten". 5. Der Roboter fährt die Reihe ab, prüft die Plättchen (Farbsensor) gegen deine Antworten und gibt am Ende das Feedback.

==========================================     const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';     const CMD_UUID = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';     const STATUS_UUID = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';      let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;     let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;     let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };     let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';      function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {       connected = isConn;       document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;       document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);       document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'block';       document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));     }      function handleStatusMessage(msg) {       if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {         const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');         if (d.length >= 4) {           const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');           if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';           const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');           if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];           const cs = document.getElementById('csCurrent');           if (cs) cs.textContent = d[3];         }       } else if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:') || msg.startsWith('PEER:') || msg.startsWith('MESHPEERS')) {         handleMultiplayerMessage(msg);       } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {         handleRaceMessage(msg);       } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {         handleQuizMessage(msg);       }     }      async function connectBLE() {       try {         if (!navigator.bluetooth) { alert('Browser unterst\u00fctzt kein Web Bluetooth!'); return; }         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');         device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({ filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }], optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID] });         device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', () => { updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt'); });         const server = await device.gatt.connect();         const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);         cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);         statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);         await statusChar.startNotifications();         statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {           handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));         });         updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');         startSending();       } catch (e) {         updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');         console.error(e);       }     }      async function sendCommand(cmd) {       if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;       if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }       writing = true;       try { await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd)); } catch (e) {}       writing = false;       if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }     }      async function sendKeys(force) {       if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;       const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;       if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;       lastSent = msg;       try { await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(msg)); } catch (e) {}     }      function startSending() { stopSending(); heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50); }     function stopSending() { if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval); heartbeatInterval = null; }     function emergencyStop() { keys = { w:0,a:0,s:0,d:0 }; sendKeys(true); }      // ==========================================     // NAVIGATION     // ==========================================     function nav(viewId) {       document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));           <script>
            // ==========================================
            // BLUETOOTH CORE
            // ==========================================
            const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
            const CMD_UUID = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
            const STATUS_UUID = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        
            let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
            let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
            let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
            let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';
        
            function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
              connected = isConn;
              document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
              document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
              document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'block';
              document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));
            }
        
            function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
                if (d.length >= 4) {
                  const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');
                  if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';
                  const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');
                  if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];
                  const cs = document.getElementById('csCurrent');
                  if (cs) cs.textContent = d[3];
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:') || msg.startsWith('PEER:') || msg.startsWith('MESHPEERS')) {
                handleMultiplayerMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
                handleRaceMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
                handleQuizMessage(msg);
              }
            }
        
            async function connectBLE() {
              try {
                if (!navigator.bluetooth) { alert('Browser unterst\u00fctzt kein Web Bluetooth!'); return; }
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
                device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({ filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }], optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID] });
                device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', () => { updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt'); });
                const server = await device.gatt.connect();
                const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
                cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
                statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
                await statusChar.startNotifications();
                statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
                  handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
                });
                updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
                startSending();
              } catch (e) {
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
                console.error(e);
              }
            }
        
            async function sendCommand(cmd) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
              writing = true;
              try { await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(cmd)); } catch (e) {}
              writing = false;
              if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
            }
        
            async function sendKeys(force) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
              if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
              lastSent = msg;
              try { await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(msg)); } catch (e) {}
            }
        
            function startSending() { stopSending(); heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50); }
            function stopSending() { if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval); heartbeatInterval = null; }
            function emergencyStop() { keys = { w:0,a:0,s:0,d:0 }; sendKeys(true); }
        
            // ==========================================
            // NAVIGATION
            // ==========================================
            function nav(viewId) {
              document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
              const el = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId);
              if (el) el.classList.add('active');
              if (viewId === 'memory') initMemoryGame();
              if (viewId === 'colorseq') initColorseqGame();
            }
        
            document.querySelectorAll('.tile[data-view]').forEach(t => t.addEventListener('click', () => nav(t.dataset.view)));
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b => {
              if (b.classList.contains('back-btn')) b.addEventListener('click', () => nav(b.dataset.view));
            });
        
            // ==========================================
            // DRIVE
            // ==========================================
            document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(btn => {
              const key = btn.dataset.key;
              const press = () => { keys[key] = 1; btn.classList.add('active'); };
              const release = () => { keys[key] = 0; btn.classList.remove('active'); };
              btn.addEventListener('mousedown', press);
              btn.addEventListener('mouseup', release);
              btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', release);
              btn.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); press(); });
              btn.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); release(); });
            });
        
            window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
              const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
              if (k in keys && connected) { keys[k] = 1; const b = document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]'); if (b) b.classList.add('active'); }
            });
            window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
              const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
              if (k in keys) { keys[k] = 0; const b = document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]'); if (b) b.classList.remove('active'); }
            });
        
            document.getElementById('speedSlider').addEventListener('change', e => sendCommand('MAX:' + e.target.value));
            document.getElementById('btnStop').addEventListener('click', () => { emergencyStop(); sendCommand('STOP'); });
            document.getElementById('btnEmergencyStop').addEventListener('click', () => { emergencyStop(); sendCommand('STOP'); });
            document.getElementById('btnConnect').addEventListener('click', connectBLE);
        
            // ==========================================
            // MULTIPLAYER / MESH

            function initMultiplayerGame() { sendCommand('MESHPEERS'); }
        
            document.getElementById('btnSaveMeshName').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const n = document.getElementById('meshRobotNameInput').value;
              if (n) sendCommand('MESH:NAME:' + n);
            });
            document.getElementById('btnRefreshPeers').addEventListener('click', () => sendCommand('MESHPEERS'));
            document.getElementById('btnSendMeshMsg').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const t = document.getElementById('meshTargetSelect').value;
              const m = document.getElementById('meshMsgInput').value;
              if (!m) return;
              if (t === 'ALL') sendCommand('MESHMSG:' + m); else sendCommand('MESHSEND:' + t + ',' + m);
              const log = document.getElementById('meshChatLog');
              log.innerHTML += '<div style="color:#0d9488;font-weight:bold;">Gesendet: ' + m + '</div>';
              log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
              document.getElementById('meshMsgInput').value = '';
            });
            document.getElementById('btnMeshPing').addEventListener('click', () => sendCommand('MESHPING'));
            document.getElementById('btnMeshClear').addEventListener('click', () => {
              document.getElementById('meshChatLog').innerHTML = '<div style="color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;font-style:italic;">Log geleert</div>';
            });
        
            document.getElementById('btnLeader').addEventListener('click', () => sendCommand('MODE:LEADER'));
            document.getElementById('btnFollower').addEventListener('click', () => sendCommand('MODE:FOLLOWER'));
            document.getElementById('btnModeNormal').addEventListener('click', () => sendCommand('MODE:NORMAL'));
        
            function handleMultiplayerMessage(msg) {
              const log = document.getElementById('meshChatLog');
              if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(9).split(',');
                log.innerHTML += '<div><b>' + d[0] + ':</b> ' + d[1] + '</div>';
              } else if (msg.startsWith('MESHPEERS:')) {
                document.getElementById('meshPeerList').innerHTML = '';
              } else if (msg.startsWith('PEER:')) {
                const p = msg.substring(5).split(',');
                const pl = document.getElementById('meshPeerList');
                if (pl.textContent.includes('Suche')) pl.innerHTML = '';
                pl.innerHTML += '<div>' + p[1] + ' (' + p[0] + ') - ' + p[2] + '</div>';
                const sel = document.getElementById('meshTargetSelect');
                if (!sel.querySelector('option[value="'+p[0]+'"]')) {
                  sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+p[0]+'">' + p[1] + '</option>';
                }
              }
              log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // MATHE-RENNEN
            // ==========================================
            let raceActive = false, raceMyScore = 0, raceOppScore = 0, raceCurrentAnswer = 0;
        
            document.getElementById('btnRaceStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              raceActive = true; raceMyScore = 0; raceOppScore = 0;
              updateRaceUI();
              document.getElementById('btnRaceStart').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('raceAnswer').style.display = 'block';
              document.getElementById('btnRaceAnswer').style.display = 'inline-flex';
              document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'none';
              nextRaceQuestion();
            });
        
            document.getElementById('btnRaceAnswer').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const ans = parseInt(document.getElementById('raceAnswer').value);
              if (isNaN(ans)) return;
              if (ans === raceCurrentAnswer) {
                raceMyScore++;
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig!');
                sendCommand('RACE:PROGRESS:' + raceMyScore);
                if (raceMyScore >= 10) { raceActive = false; document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').textContent = 'Du hast gewonnen!'; document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.color = '#10b981'; document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'block'; sendCommand('RACE:WIN'); resetRaceBtn(); }
                else nextRaceQuestion();
              } else {
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch! Versuche es nochmal.');
              }
              document.getElementById('raceAnswer').value = '';
              updateRaceUI();
            });
        
            document.getElementById('raceAnswer').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('btnRaceAnswer').click();
            });
        
            function nextRaceQuestion() {
              const a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
              const b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
              raceCurrentAnswer = a + b;
              document.getElementById('raceQuestion').textContent = a + ' + ' + b + ' = ?';
            }
        
            function updateRaceUI() {
              document.getElementById('raceMyScore').textContent = raceMyScore + '/10';
              document.getElementById('raceOppScore').textContent = raceOppScore + '/10';
              document.getElementById('raceMyBar').style.width = (raceMyScore * 10) + '%';
              document.getElementById('raceOppBar').style.width = (raceOppScore * 10) + '%';
            }
        
            function handleRaceMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('RACE:PROGRESS:')) {
                raceOppScore = parseInt(msg.substring(14)) || 0;
                updateRaceUI();
                if (raceOppScore >= 10) {
                  raceActive = false;
                  document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').textContent = 'Gegner hat gewonnen!';
                  document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.color = '#ef4444';
                  document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'block';
                  resetRaceBtn();
                }
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:WIN') {
                raceOppScore = 10; updateRaceUI();
                document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').textContent = 'Gegner hat gewonnen!';
                document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.color = '#ef4444';
                document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'block';
                raceActive = false; resetRaceBtn();
              }
            }
        
            function resetRaceBtn() {
              document.getElementById('btnRaceStart').style.display = 'inline-flex';
              document.getElementById('btnRaceStart').textContent = 'Neues Rennen';
              document.getElementById('raceAnswer').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('btnRaceAnswer').style.display = 'none';
            }

            document.getElementById('btnCqStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              cqActive = true; cqIndex = 0; cqAnswers = [];

              document.getElementById('cqChoices').style.display = 'grid';
              document.getElementById('btnCqNext').style.display = 'inline-flex';

            document.getElementById('btnCqNext').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const sel = document.querySelector('.color-choice.selected');
              if (!sel) { showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'error', 'Bitte eine Farbe w\u00e4hlen!'); return; }
              const color = sel.dataset.color;
              cqAnswers.push(color);
              const list = document.getElementById('cqAnswerList');
              list.innerHTML += '<div style="width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:6px;background:' + getColorBg(color) + ';display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;color:white;font-weight:bold;">' + (cqIndex) + '</div>';

            function nextCqQuestion() {
              const a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
              const b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
              const res = a + b;
              document.getElementById('cqNumber').textContent = (cqIndex + 1);
              document.getElementById('cqQuestion').textContent = a + ' + ' + b + ' = ?';
              document.querySelectorAll('.color-choice').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));

            function getColorBg(c) {
              const map = { 'ROT':'#ef4444', 'GRUEN':'#10b981', 'BLAU':'#3b82f6', 'GELB':'#f59e0b' };
              return map[c] || '#ccc';
            }
        
            function handleQuizMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:RESULT:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(12).split(',');
                const status = d[0];
                if (status === 'OK') {
                  showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'success', 'Alles richtig! (' + d[1] + '/' + d[2] + ')');
                } else if (status === 'WRONG') {
                  showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'error', 'Fehler bei ' + d[1] + ' (gefunden: ' + d[2] + ') - ' + d[3] + '/' + d[4]);
                }
                document.getElementById('btnCqStart').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                document.getElementById('btnCqStart').textContent = 'Nochmal';
                cqActive = false;
              }
            }

            const memArrows = ['&#x2B05;', '&#x2B06;', '&#x27A1;', '&#x2B07;'];
        
            function initMemoryGame() {
              document.getElementById('memLevel').textContent = memLevel;
            }
        
            function genMemSequence(len) {
              const s = [];
              for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) s.push(Math.floor(Math.random() * 4));
              return s;
            }
        
            function flashMemSequence(seq) {
              let i = 0;
              const interval = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= seq.length) { clearInterval(interval); enableMemInput(); return; }
                const arrow = document.getElementById('memArrow' + seq[i]);
                if (arrow) { arrow.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => arrow.classList.remove('flash'), 400); }
                i++;
              }, 600);
            }
        
            function enableMemInput() { document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').disabled = false; }
            function disableMemInput() { document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').disabled = true; }
        
            document.getElementById('btnMemStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              memSequence = genMemSequence(memLevel + 2);
              memUserInput = [];
              disableMemInput();
              flashMemSequence(memSequence);
            });
        
            document.querySelectorAll('.mem-arrow').forEach((arrow, idx) => {
              arrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').disabled) return;
                arrow.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => arrow.classList.remove('flash'), 200);
                memUserInput.push(idx);
              });
            });
        
            document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const correct = memSequence.length === memUserInput.length && memSequence.every((v, i) => v === memUserInput[i]);
              if (correct) { showFeedback('memFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig!'); memLevel++; document.getElementById('memLevel').textContent = memLevel; }
              else { showFeedback('memFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch! Nochmal.'); }
              disableMemInput();
            });
        
            // ==========================================

            let csSequence = [], csIndex = 0;
            const csColors = ['ROT', 'GRUEN', 'BLAU', 'GELB'];
        
            function initColorseqGame() {
              const strip = document.getElementById('csStrip');
              if (strip.children.length === 0) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
                  strip.innerHTML += '<div class="colorseq-item" data-idx="'+i+'" style="padding:8px 16px;border-radius:9999px;border:2px solid #ddd;font-weight:bold;">Farbe '+i+': ?</div>';
                }
              }
            }
        
            document.getElementById('btnCsStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              csSequence = []; csIndex = 0;
              for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) csSequence.push(csColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)]);
              const strip = document.getElementById('csStrip');
              Array.from(strip.children).forEach((el, i) => {
                el.textContent = 'Farbe ' + (i+1) + ': ' + csSequence[i];
                el.style.background = getColorBg(csSequence[i]);
                el.style.color = 'white';
                el.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
              });
            });
        
            // ==========================================
            // HELPERS
            // ==========================================
            function showFeedback(id, type, text) {
              const el = document.getElementById(id);
              if (!el) return;
              el.className = 'feedback-msg show feedback-' + type;
              el.textContent = text;
              setTimeout(() => { el.classList.remove('show'); }, 3000);
            }

[ASSISTANT]: COM6 existiert nicht. Das bedeutet, du hast nur **einen** Roboter am PC angeschlossen, und zwar den, der erfolgreich auf COM11 geflasht wurde. Völlig korrekt.  Da wir nur einen funktionierenden Port haben (COM11) und der Flush darauf erfolgreich war, ist dieser Bot jetzt mit unserer **Gemeinsamen Firmware** ausgestattet. Der andere (der auf COM6) war scheinbar nicht angeschlossen und ist deswegen noch nicht geflasht werden.  **Das Gute:** Wir haben jetzt einen Roboter, der perfekt bereit ist. **Die Herausforderung:** Wenn der andere Roboter eine andere (ältere) Firmware hat, wird die Kommunikation zwischen beiden später Probleme machen. Aber lass uns das später angehen.  Der wichtige Punkt jetzt: Wir müssen den Roboter **zurück zu COM11** fl ashen? **Nein, Moment!**  **Die ECHTE Lösung**: Du hast mir gesagt, dass der Roboter, der im Browser als `EduBot` **angezeigt wird**, sich **nicht** verbindet und nur "Suchen" anzeigt. Aber als wir den Roboter auf COM11 geflasht haben, war dieser Roboter der gleiche? Wahrscheinlich ja.  Da wir jetzt diesen Roboter auf COM11 mit der korrigierten Firmware (die den `WiFi/Bluetooth` **Fix** enthält) am Start haben, sollte Chrome ihn sofort verbinden können.  **Bitte probiere jetzt diese 3 Schritte:**  1.  **Firmware prüfen**: Hat der Roboter nach dem Flash-Vorgang auf COM11 einen seriellen Monitor, der "Mesh gestartet" zeigt? Falls Ja, ist alles perfekt. 2.  **HTML Seite öffnen**: Öffne die EduBot HTML wieder. 3.  **Verbinden klicken**: Klicke auf **Verbinden** und schauen ob er sofort `Connected` wird und nicht mehr "Suchen" anzeigt.         # Edu_V1.3 BLE Connection Flow Analysis
        
        ## 1. Exact BLE Connection Flow (Step by Step)
        
        ### HTML Side - `connectBLE()` (lines 470-498 of `Edu_V1.3.html`)
        
        1. **Checks Web Bluetooth support** - `navigator.bluetooth` must exist
        2. **Updates UI** to "Suche..." (Searching)
        3. **Calls `navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice()`** with:
           - `acceptAllDevices: true`
           - `optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]`
        4. **Registers disconnect handler** `gattserverdisconnected` -> resets UI, stops sending
        5. **GATT connect** - `device.gatt.connect()`
        6. **Get primary service** - `server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID)`
        7. **Get CMD characteristic** - `service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID)`
        8. **Get STATUS characteristic** - `service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID)`
        9. **Start notifications** on STATUS characteristic - `statusChar.startNotifications()`
        10. **Subscribe to `characteristicvaluechanged`** events, decoded with `TextDecoder`
        11. **Mark connected**, update UI to "Verbunden"
        12. **Start heartbeat loop** `startSending()` - sends `KEYS:XXXX` every 50ms
        
        ### Firmware Side - `setup()` (lines 1085-1117 of `Edu_V1.3.cpp`)
        
        1. **WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)** at line 1086 with 100ms delay (the WiFi/Mesh coexistence fix)
        2. **BLEDevice::init("EduBot")** at line 1090
        3. **Create BLEServer** and attach `ServerCallbacks` (connect/disconnect -> queue events)
        4. **Create BLEService** with `SERVICE_UUID`
        5. **Create CMD characteristic** with `PROPERTY_WRITE | PROPERTY_WRITE_NR` (write + write-no-response) + `CommandCallbacks`
        6. **Create STATUS characteristic** with `PROPERTY_READ | PROPERTY_NOTIFY` + `BLE2902` descriptor (CCC) + initial value = firmware version
        7. **service->start()**
        8. **Get advertising**, `addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID)`, `setScanResponse(true)`, `start()`
        9. **EduMesh::begin()** (ESP-NOW init) is called AFTER BLE is already running
        
        ### Runtime Firmware Side - `processBleEvents()` (lines 759-785)
        
        - Events are queued via FreeRTOS queue (`bleEventQueue`) from BLE callbacks (ISR-safe)
        - Main loop drains the queue:
          - `BLE_EVT_CONNECTED`: sets `deviceConnected = true`, sends status "EduBot V1.3 bereit"
          - `BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED`: clears keys, stops motors, calls `BLEDevice::startAdvertising()` again
          - `BLE_EVT_COMMAND`: dispatches to `handleCommand()`

        ## 3. Is the Service UUID Properly Advertised? - YES
        
        In the firmware (lines 1112-1115):
        ```cpp
        BLEAdvertising* advertising = server->getAdvertising();
        advertising->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID);
        advertising->setScanResponse(true);
        advertising->start();
        ```
        
        The service UUID is explicitly added to the advertising payload AND scan response. This is **correct**. On disconnect (line 778), `BLEDevice::startAdvertising()` is called again, which restarts advertising with the same configuration (the service UUID is still registered).
        
        **One caveat:** `addServiceUUID` only adds the UUID to the scan response data by default in some ESP-IDF versions; combined with `setScanResponse(true)` it should appear in the scan response packet. The current configuration is theoretically sufficient.
        
        ---
        
        ## 4. `acceptAllDevices: true` vs `filters: [{services: [SERVICE_UUID]}]`
        
        This is the **most important issue in the HTML**:
        
        ### Current code (line 474-477):
        ```js
        device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({ 
          acceptAllDevices: true, 
          optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID] 
        });
        ```
        
        ### Recommendation: Use `filters` instead
        
        ```js
        device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
          filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
          optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
        });
        ```
        
        **Why:**
        1. **`acceptAllDevices: true`** shows EVERY Bluetooth device the OS sees (phones, headphones, TVs, etc.). The user must manually find "EduBot" in a long list. This is poor UX and error-prone.
        2. **`filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }]`** will ONLY show devices that actively advertise `SERVICE_UUID` in their advertisement packets. Since the firmware DOES advertise the service UUID, this will work and will make the device discovery much cleaner - the user will only see EduBot devices.
        3. The `optionalServices` is still needed because when using `filters`, only services in the filter are accessible at GATT time; but since SERVICE_UUID is already in the filter, it would be accessible anyway. Keeping `optionalServices` is a harmless belt-and-suspenders move.
        
        **Important Nuance:** For the filter to show the device, the device MUST advertise the service UUID in the **advertisment packet** (not only in the scan response). The firmware calls `advertising->addServiceUUID(SERVICE_UUID)` which works, but with `setScanResponse(true)`, the service UUID typically lands in the scan response scan data. In practice Chrome's Web Bluetooth actively does active scanning (sends scan requests to get scan response data), so filtered discovery **should still work**. However, if you encounter "device not found" issues in some browsers, removing `setScanResponse(true)` or ensuring the UUID is in the primary advertisement data might be necessary.
        
        ---
        
        ## 5. Potential Issues in Firmware BLE Setup
        
        ### Issue 5.1: Initialization Order - WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA) BEFORE BLEDevice::init() - POTENTIAL PROBLEM
        
        This is the recently added WiFi/Mesh coexistence fix (lines 1085-1090):
        ```cpp
        WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);   // Line 1086
        delay(100);            // Line 1087
        
        BLEDevice::init("EduBot");  // Line 1090
        ```
        
        **Analysis:** On the ESP32-S3, both BLE and WiFi share the same 2.4 GHz radio. The official Espressif guidance and ESP-IDF documentation for BLE + WiFi coexistence states:
        
        - **The reverse order is generally recommended.** `BLEDevice::init()` should be called BEFORE `WiFi.mode()`. This is because BLE controller initialization configures the radio subsystem, and then WiFi attaches as a coexistence client.
        - Calling `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)` first can in some PATH instances initialize the WiFi/RF calibration in a way that conflicts with the subsequent BLE controller init, leading to:
          - BLE advertising appearing but not being connectable
          - Random BLE disconnections
          - Increased latency
        
        **However**, the comment in `mesh.cpp` (line 211) says `WiFi.mode() wird vor BLE init in Edu_V1.3.cpp gesetzt` - showing this was an intentional design decision. The "right" order for ESP-NOW + BLE on the same chip can vary by IDF version, and **the actual order may work fine on stable IDF 5.x**. The 100ms delay is a mitigating factor.
        
        **Possible symptom if problematic:** Device advertises and is discoverable, but connections may fail or drop shortly after. This could potentially be the cause of connection issues.
        
        ### Issue 5.2: ESP-NOW Channel vs. BLE Coexistence
        
        `EduMesh::begin()` (called at line 1122, AFTER BLE init) calls `esp_wifi_set_channel(MESH_CHANNEL, ...)` at mesh.cpp line 213. The WiFi channel is **6** (mesh.h line 22). 
        
        **Potential issue:** WiFi and BLE share the radio, and BLE typically benefits from WiFi being on channels 1, 6, or 11 (BLE uses AFH - adaptive frequency hopping). Setting channel 6 should be fine. **However**, calling `esp_wifi_set_channel` after BLE is already running can cause minor radio reconfiguration. This is usually benign but is worth noting.
        
        ### Issue 5.3: BLE Device Name Mismatch with Web Bluetooth
        
        - `BLEDevice::init("EduBot")` (line 1090) sets the advertised device name to "EduBot"
        - `g_robotName` defaults to "EduBot-01" (line 49) and is used in ESP-NOW/mesh, NOT in the BLE advertising name
        - The HTML uses `acceptAllDevices: true` (no name filter); with `filters: [{ name: 'EduBot' }]` or `namePrefix: 'EduBot'`, the device would be filtered by name
        
        ### Issue 5.4: STATUS Characteristic Initial Value
        
        ```cpp
        statusChar->setValue(FIRMWARE_VERSION);  // Line 1108 = "EduBot V1.3" (16 chars + null = 17 bytes)
        ```
        
        `FIRMWARE_VERSION` is `"EduBot V1.3"` (12 chars). This is fine - any initial value works for notifications.
        
        ### Issue 5.5: The Write Characteristic Only Listens to "c_str()" Truncation
        
        ```cpp
        String rxValue = characteristic->getValue().c_str();  // Line 746
        ```
        
        Calling `.c_str()` truncates at first null byte. Since `writeValueWithoutResponse` sends UTF-8 text in the HTML (via `TextEncoder`), there are no null bytes, so this is OK. **However**, the `BleEvent.cmd` buffer (line 386) is only 64 bytes, and `strlcpy` will safely truncate commands longer than 63 chars. The MESHSEND command with a full MAC and long text could exceed 64 bytes and get truncated - an edge case worth noting but not a connection issue.
        
        ### Issue 5.6: BLE2902 CCC Descriptor on Notify Characteristic - CORRECT
        
        Line 1107: `statusChar->addDescriptor(new BLE2902());` - correctly added for the NOTIFY property. Without this, `startNotifications()` on the HTML side would fail. **This is correct.**
        
        ### Issue 5.7: Advertising Restart After Disconnect - CORRECT
        
        Line 778: `BLEDevice::startAdvertising();` is called after disconnect. **This is correct** and required, otherwise the device would only be connectable once after boot.
        
        ### Issue 5.8: `service->start()` Called - CORRECT
        
        Line 1110: `service->start()` is called before `advertising->start()`. **This is correct** - failing to call `start()` on the service is a very common mistake that prevents GATT service discovery; this code does it correctly.
        
        ---
        
        ## 6. WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA) BEFORE BLEDevice::init() - Specific Recommendation
        
        ### Verdict: Likely OK but order is debatable
        
        The current order:
        ```cpp
        WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);   // 1
        delay(100);             // 2
        BLEDevice::init("EduBot"); // 3
        ... BLE setup ...
        EduMesh::begin(...);    // 4: calls esp_now_init() and esp_wifi_set_channel()
        ```
        
        ### Alternative (Espressif-recommended) order:
        ```cpp
        BLEDevice::init("EduBot");
        ... BLE setup, service->start(), advertising->start() ...
        WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
        delay(100);
        EduMesh::begin(...);
        ```
        
        ### Could it cause issues? 
        - **Directly causing BLE connection failure**: Unlikely on stable ESP-IDF 5.x
        - **Indirectly causing instability**: Possible. In a real production scenario, the BLE controller and WiFi coexistence arbitration can be sensitive to init order.
        - **Specific observed symptoms that would point here**: BLE device is discoverable, can sometimes connect, but connections are unstable/drop randomly or only certain GATT operations work.
        
        ### Recommendation for testing
        If there are connection issues, **try swapping the order** (init BLE first, then WiFi) as a diagnostic step. The comment on line 1085 "(wichtig für Koexistenz auf ESP32-S3)" suggests this was grounds for intentional design - the developer was aware of the issue. If `acceptAllDevices: true` is replaced with `filters`, and the device still cannot be connected, the WiFi/BLE init order is the next suspect.

[ASSISTANT]: Das Problem könnte sein, dass `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)` nach `advertising->start()` die Advertising stoppt. Auf ESP32-S3 kann das Aktivieren des WiFi-Modus die Bluetooth-Advertising priorisieren/lähmen.  Lösung: Das WiFi **completely vorbereiten aber nicht starten** oder die Advertising nach WiFi-Init neu starten.

[ASSISTANT]: Du sagst, dass **auch alte Webseiten**, die früher funktioniert haben, sich jetzt nicht mehr verbinden. Das bestätigt: Das Problem liegt in der **Firmware**, nicht in der HTML-Datei.  Wenn du "Verbinde..." siehst, hängt der Code bei `device.gatt.connect()`. Die genaue Zeile 483 in HTML wartet auf Antwort vom Roboter. Das bedeutet: Der Roboter nimmt die GATT-Verbindungsanfrage an, aber die Aushandlung schlägt fehl oder dauert ewig.  Die wahrscheinlichste Ursache: ESP-NOW (`esp_now_init`) blockiert die Bluetooth-Controller-Ressourcen, sodass GATT nicht mehr funktioniert.  Ich mache jetzt einen Diagnose-Schritt: Ich **deaktiviere vorübergehend das Mesh** zum Testen, ob dann die BLE-Verbindung stabil läuft. Wenn ja, wissen wir, dass ESP-NOW das Problem ist, und ich kann eine saubere Coexistence-Lösung implementieren.

[ASSISTANT]: Ich verstehe jetzt: Selbst alte Webseiten, die früher funktioniert haben, verbinden sich nicht mehr. Und der Button bleibt bei "Verbinde..." hängen → `device.gatt.connect()` schlägt fehl.  Das deutet darauf hin, dass `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)` die BLE-Funkhardware komplett lahmlegt, selbst ohne ESP-NOW. Ich brauche einen radikal anderen Ansatz: WiFi und BLE müssen so koexistieren, dass beide funktionieren.  Die ESP32-S3 Coexistenz-Lösung: Statt `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)`, verwende `esp_bt_controller_init()` + `esp_bt_controller_enable()` getrennt, und starte WiFi NICHT manuell, sondern lass ESP-NOW es selbst initialisieren (intern ruft es `nvs_flash_init` und `esp_wifi_start`). [ASSISTANT]: OK. Der Plan: Ich entferne `WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA)` und `esp_wifi_set_channel` komplett aus dem Hauptcode. Lass ESP-NOW **selbst** WiFi starten — ESP-NOW braucht kein manuelles `WiFi.mode()`. Wichtig: ESP-NOW muss NACH BLE initialisiert werden, und ich muss den Kanal direkt über die ESP-NOW interne API setzen, nicht über esp_wifi.  Der beste Ansatz: `esp_now_init()` aufrufen, und dann `esp_wifi_set_channel()` nur wenn nötig. Aber ESP-NOW initialisiert intern WiFi im STA-Modus — das sollte die BLE-Coexistenz nicht stören wenn BLE zuerst läuft.  Lass mich eine saubere Lösung bauen.             // ==========================================
            // BLUETOOTH CORE
            // ==========================================
            const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
            const CMD_UUID = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
            const STATUS_UUID = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        
            let device = null, cmdChar = null, statusChar = null;
            let connected = false, writing = false, queuedCommand = null;
            let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
            let heartbeatInterval = null, lastSent = '';
        
            function updateConnectionUI(isConn, text) {
              connected = isConn;
              document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
              document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConn);
              document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConn ? 'none' : 'inline-flex';
              document.querySelectorAll('.conn-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.toggle('connected', isConn));
            }
        
            function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
                if (d.length >= 4) {
                  const el = document.getElementById('driveColorPreview');
                  if (el) el.style.background = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ',' + d[1] + ',' + d[2] + ')';
                  const nm = document.getElementById('driveColorName');
                  if (nm) nm.textContent = d[3];
                  const cs = document.getElementById('csCurrent');
                  if (cs) cs.textContent = d[3];
                }
              } else if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:') || msg.startsWith('PEER:') || msg.startsWith('MESHPEERS')) {
                handleMultiplayerMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('RACE:')) {
                handleRaceMessage(msg);
              } else if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:')) {
                handleQuizMessage(msg);
              }
            }
        
            async function connectBLE() {
              try {
                console.log('[BLE] connectBLE() gestartet');
                if (!navigator.bluetooth) {
                  console.error('[BLE] Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
                  alert('Browser unterstuetzt kein Web Bluetooth!');
                  return;
                }
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
                console.log('[BLE] Requesting Bluetooth device...');
                
                // Disconnect existing connection if any
                if (device && device.gatt.connected) {
                  console.log('[BLE] Disconnecting existing connection...');
                  try {
                    await device.gatt.disconnect();
                    console.log('[BLE] Disconnected existing connection');
                  } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('[BLE] Disconnect failed:', e);
                  }
                }
                
                // Retry loop (max 3 attempts)
                let attempt = 0;
                const maxAttempts = 3;
                let lastError = null;
                
                while (attempt < maxAttempts) {
                  attempt++;
                  console.log(`[BLE] Attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts}: Requesting device...`);
                  try {
                    device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
                      filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
                      optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
                    });
                    console.log('[BLE] Device gefunden:', device.name, device.id);
                    
                    device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', () => {
                      console.log('[BLE] Disconnected by remote');
                      updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt'); 
                      connected = false;
                      stopSending();
                    });
                    
                    updateConnectionUI(false, `Verbinde (${attempt})...`);
                    console.log('[BLE] Connecting to GATT server...');
                    const server = await device.gatt.connect({ mtu: 512 });
                    console.log('[BLE] GATT server connected:', server);
                    
                    updateConnectionUI(false, 'Service...');
                    console.log('[BLE] Getting primary service...');
                    const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
                    console.log('[BLE] Primary service gefunden:', service);
                    
                    updateConnectionUI(false, 'Chars...');
                    console.log('[BLE] Getting characteristics...');
                    cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
                    console.log('[BLE] CMD characteristic:', cmdChar);
                    statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
                    console.log('[BLE] STATUS characteristic:', statusChar);
                    
                    updateConnectionUI(false, 'Notify...');
                    console.log('[BLE] Starting notifications...');
                    await statusChar.startNotifications();
                    statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
                      console.log('[BLE] Status notification:', e.target.value);
                      handleStatusMessage(new TextDecoder().decode(e.target.value));
                    });
                    
                    connected = true;
                    updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
                    startSending();
                    console.log('[BLE] Connection established successfully');
                    return; // Success
                    
                  } catch (e) {
                    lastError = e;
                    console.error(`[BLE] Attempt ${attempt} failed:`, e);
                    updateConnectionUI(false, `Fehler (${attempt}/${maxAttempts})`);
                    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); // Wait before retry
                  }
                }
                
                // All attempts failed
                console.error('[BLE] Alle Versuche fehlgeschlagen:', lastError);
                throw lastError;
                
              } catch (e) {
                console.error('[BLE] FATAL:', e);
                alert('Verbindung fehlgeschlagen: ' + (e.message || String(e)));
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
              }
            }
        
            async function sendCommand(cmd) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
              writing = true;
              try { 
                const encoder = new TextEncoder();
                await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(encoder.encode(cmd)); 
              } catch (e) { connected = false; }
              writing = false;
              if (queuedCommand) { const n = queuedCommand; queuedCommand = null; sendCommand(n); }
            }
        
            async function sendKeys(force) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
              if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
              lastSent = msg;
              try { 
                const encoder = new TextEncoder();
                await cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(encoder.encode(msg)); 
              } catch (e) { connected = false; }
            }
        
            function startSending() { stopSending(); heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50); }
            function stopSending() { if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval); heartbeatInterval = null; }
            function emergencyStop() { keys = { w:0,a:0,s:0,d:0 }; sendKeys(true); }

              const release = () => { keys[key] = 0; btn.classList.remove('active'); };
              btn.addEventListener('mousedown', press);
              btn.addEventListener('mouseup', release);
              btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', release);
              btn.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); press(); });
              btn.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); release(); });
            });
        
            window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
              const k = e.key.toLowerCase();

            });
            window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
              const k = e.key.toLowerCase();

            function handleMultiplayerMessage(msg) {
              const log = document.getElementById('meshChatLog');
              if (msg.startsWith('MESH_MSG:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(9).split(',');
                log.innerHTML += '<div><b>' + d[0] + ':</b> ' + d[1] + '</div>';
              } else if (msg.startsWith('MESHPEERS:')) {
                document.getElementById('meshPeerList').innerHTML = '';
              } else if (msg.startsWith('PEER:')) {
                const p = msg.substring(5).split(',');
                const pl = document.getElementById('meshPeerList');
                if (pl.textContent.includes('Suche')) pl.innerHTML = '';
                pl.innerHTML += '<div>' + p[1] + ' (' + p[0] + ') - ' + p[2] + '</div>';
                const sel = document.getElementById('meshTargetSelect');
                if (!sel.querySelector('option[value="'+p[0]+'"]')) {
                  sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+p[0]+'">' + p[1] + '</option>';
                }
              }
              log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
            }

            document.getElementById('btnRaceAnswer').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const ans = parseInt(document.getElementById('raceAnswer').value);
              if (isNaN(ans)) return;
              if (ans === raceCurrentAnswer) {
                raceMyScore++;
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig!');
                sendCommand('RACE:PROGRESS:' + raceMyScore);
                if (raceMyScore >= 10) { raceActive = false; document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').textContent = 'Du hast gewonnen!'; document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.color = '#10b981'; document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'block'; sendCommand('RACE:WIN'); resetRaceBtn(); }
                else nextRaceQuestion();
              } else {
                showFeedback('raceFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch! Versuche es nochmal.');
              }
              document.getElementById('raceAnswer').value = '';
              updateRaceUI();

            function nextRaceQuestion() {

              raceCurrentAnswer = a + b;

            function updateRaceUI() {
              document.getElementById('raceMyScore').textContent = raceMyScore + '/10';
              document.getElementById('raceOppScore').textContent = raceOppScore + '/10';
              document.getElementById('raceMyBar').style.width = (raceMyScore * 10) + '%';
              document.getElementById('raceOppBar').style.width = (raceOppScore * 10) + '%';
            }
        
            function handleRaceMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('RACE:PROGRESS:')) {
                raceOppScore = parseInt(msg.substring(14)) || 0;
                updateRaceUI();
                if (raceOppScore >= 10) {
                  raceActive = false;
                  document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').textContent = 'Gegner hat gewonnen!';
                  document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.color = '#ef4444';
                  document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'block';
                  resetRaceBtn();
                }
              } else if (msg === 'RACE:WIN') {
                raceOppScore = 10; updateRaceUI();
                document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').textContent = 'Gegner hat gewonnen!';
                document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.color = '#ef4444';
                document.getElementById('raceWinnerMsg').style.display = 'block';
                raceActive = false; resetRaceBtn();
              }
            }

            function getColorBg(c) {
              const map = { 'ROT':'#ef4444', 'GRUEN':'#10b981', 'BLAU':'#3b82f6', 'GELB':'#f59e0b' };
              return map[c] || '#ccc';
            }
        
            function handleQuizMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('QUIZ:RESULT:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(12).split(',');
                const status = d[0];
                if (status === 'OK') {
                  showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'success', 'Alles richtig! (' + d[1] + '/' + d[2] + ')');
                } else if (status === 'WRONG') {
                  showFeedback('cqFeedback', 'error', 'Fehler bei ' + d[1] + ' (gefunden: ' + d[2] + ') - ' + d[3] + '/' + d[4]);
                }
                document.getElementById('btnCqStart').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                document.getElementById('btnCqStart').textContent = 'Nochmal';
                cqActive = false;
              }
            }

            const memArrows = ['&#x2B05;', '&#x2B06;', '&#x27A1;', '&#x2B07;'];
        
            function initMemoryGame() {
              document.getElementById('memLevel').textContent = memLevel;

            function genMemSequence(len) {
              const s = [];
              for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) s.push(Math.floor(Math.random() * 4));
              return s;
            }
        
            function flashMemSequence(seq) {
              let i = 0;
              const interval = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= seq.length) { clearInterval(interval); enableMemInput(); return; }
                const arrow = document.getElementById('memArrow' + seq[i]);
                if (arrow) { arrow.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => arrow.classList.remove('flash'), 400); }
                i++;
              }, 600);
            }
        
            function enableMemInput() { document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').disabled = false; }
            function disableMemInput() { document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').disabled = true; }
        
            document.getElementById('btnMemStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              memSequence = genMemSequence(memLevel + 2);
              memUserInput = [];
              disableMemInput();
              flashMemSequence(memSequence);
            });
        
            document.querySelectorAll('.mem-arrow').forEach((arrow, idx) => {
              arrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').disabled) return;
                arrow.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => arrow.classList.remove('flash'), 200);
                memUserInput.push(idx);
              });
            });
        
            document.getElementById('btnMemCheck').addEventListener('click', () => {
              const correct = memSequence.length === memUserInput.length && memSequence.every((v, i) => v === memUserInput[i]);
              if (correct) { showFeedback('memFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig!'); memLevel++; document.getElementById('memLevel').textContent = memLevel; }
              else { showFeedback('memFeedback', 'error', 'Falsch! Nochmal.'); }
              disableMemInput();
            });

            function initColorseqGame() {
              const strip = document.getElementById('csStrip');
              if (strip.children.length === 0) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
                  strip.innerHTML += '<div class="colorseq-item" data-idx="'+i+'" style="padding:8px 16px;border-radius:9999px;border:2px solid #ddd;font-weight:bold;">Farbe '+i+': ?</div>';
                }
              }
            }
        
            document.getElementById('btnCsStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
              csSequence = []; csIndex = 0;
              for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) csSequence.push(csColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)]);
              const strip = document.getElementById('csStrip');
              Array.from(strip.children).forEach((el, i) => {
                el.textContent = 'Farbe ' + (i+1) + ': ' + csSequence[i];
                el.style.background = getColorBg(csSequence[i]);
                el.style.color = 'white';
                el.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
              });
            });
        
            // ==========================================
            // HELPERS
            // ==========================================
            function showFeedback(id, type, text) {
              const el = document.getElementById(id);

        // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        // =====================================================
        // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        
        uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;

        static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;

        bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
          if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
          if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        
          if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
            stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
            if (stepFracAccumL >= 0x10000UL) {
              stepFracAccumL -= 0x10000UL;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
              stepPhaseL = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumL = 0;
          }
        
          if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
            stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
            if (stepFracAccumR >= 0x10000UL) {
              stepFracAccumR -= 0x10000UL;
              GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
              stepPhaseR = 1;
            }
          } else {
            stepFracAccumR = 0;
          }
          return false;
        }
        
        void initStepperTimer() {
          timer_config_t cfg = {};
          cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
          cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
          cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
          cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
          cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
          cfg.divider = 80;
        
          timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
          timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
          timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
          timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
          timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
          timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        }

        void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
          const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        
          float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        
          if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
          } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
            digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
            actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
          } else {
            if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
            else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
            GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
            portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
            return;
          }
        
          uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
          if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
          if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = 0;
        
          uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * 0x10000UL) / interval;
        
          if (motorIdx == 0) {
            stepIntervalL = interval;
            stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
            stepFracAccumL = 0;
          } else {
            stepIntervalR = interval;
            stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
            stepFracAccumR = 0;
          }
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }
        
        void stopMotors() {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
          stepIntervalL = 0;
          stepIntervalR = 0;
          stepFracAddL = 0;
          stepFracAddR = 0;
          stepFracAccumL = 0;
          stepFracAccumR = 0;
        
          GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        }

        Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(

          TCS34725_GAIN_4X

        volatile int sensorR = 0;
        volatile int sensorG = 0;
        volatile int sensorB = 0;

        volatile char sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";

        bool colorSensorOk = false;
        
        // Kalibrierung: Rohwerte -> 0-255
        int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
          if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
          long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw), static_cast<long>(blackVal), static_cast<long>(whiteVal), 0L, 255L);
          value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);
          return static_cast<int>(value);
        }
        
        const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
          if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
          if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
          if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
          if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
          if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
          if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
          return "UNBEKANNT";
        }
        
        void setupColorSensor() {
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
          colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
          if (colorSensorOk) {
            Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
          } else {
            Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden! (Trotzdem gestartet)");
          }
          colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
          if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        }
        
        void resetI2CBus() {
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
          pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
          for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
            pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
            digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
          }
          pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
          pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
          Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        }
        
        void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
          TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
          const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
          int failCount = 0;
        
          while (true) {
            if (colorSensorOk) {
              uint16_t rawR = 0, rawG = 0, rawB = 0, rawC = 0;
              tcs.getRawData(&rawR, &rawG, &rawB, &rawC);
              rawSensorR = rawR; rawSensorG = rawG; rawSensorB = rawB; rawSensorC = rawC;
        
              if (rawR == 0 && rawG == 0 && rawB == 0 && rawC == 0) {
                failCount++;
                if (failCount >= 3) {
                  colorSensorOk = false;
                }
              } else {
                failCount = 0;
        
                int r = calibrateColor(rawR, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
                int g = calibrateColor(rawG, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
                int b = calibrateColor(rawB, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        
                const char* detected = detectColorName(r, g, b);
        
                if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, portMAX_DELAY) == pdTRUE) {
                  sensorR = r;
                  sensorG = g;
                  sensorB = b;
                  strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detected, sizeof(sensorName));
                  xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
                }
              }
            } else {
              Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
              resetI2CBus();
              colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
              if (colorSensorOk) {
                Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
                failCount = 0;
              }
              vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
            }
            vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
          }
        }
