          <script>
            'use strict';
        
            // ==========================================
            // GLOBAL STATE & GAMIFICATION
            // ==========================================
            const textDecoder = new TextDecoder();
            let xp = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('edubot_xp') || '0');
        
            function addXP(amount) {
              xp += amount;
              localStorage.setItem('edubot_xp', xp);
              const display = document.getElementById('xpDisplay');
              display.textContent = xp + ' XP';
              display.style.transform = 'scale(1.2)';
              setTimeout(() => { display.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; }, 300);
              saveGameState();
            }
        
            function showFeedback(id, type, text) {
              const fb = document.getElementById(id);
              fb.textContent = text;
              let cls = 'feedback-msg show ';
              cls += type === 'success' ? 'feedback-success' : type === 'error' ? 'feedback-error' : 'feedback-warning';
              fb.className = cls;
              setTimeout(() => { fb.className = 'feedback-msg'; }, 3000);
              playBeep(type);
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // SOUND EFFECTS (lazy init on first user gesture)
            // ==========================================
            let audioCtx = null;
        
            function initAudio() {
              if (!audioCtx) {
                try {
                  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
                } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
              }
            }
        
            function playBeep(type) {
              if (!audioCtx) return;
              try {
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                if (type === 'success') { osc.frequency.value = 880; gain.gain.value = 0.15; } 
                else if (type === 'error') { osc.frequency.value = 220; gain.gain.value = 0.12; } 
                else { osc.frequency.value = 440; gain.gain.value = 0.1; }
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.15);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.15);
              } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // LOCALSTORAGE PERSISTENCE
            // ==========================================
            function saveGameState() {
              try {
                localStorage.setItem('edubot_xp', xp);
                localStorage.setItem('edubot_traffic_best', trafficBestTime);
                localStorage.setItem('edubot_mem_level', memLevel);
              } catch (e) { /* quota exceeded */ }
            }
        
            function loadGameState() {
              try {
                const savedXp = localStorage.getItem('edubot_xp');
                if (savedXp !== null) { xp = parseInt(savedXp) || 0; document.getElementById('xpDisplay').textContent = xp + ' XP'; }
                const savedTraffic = localStorage.getItem('edubot_traffic_best');
                if (savedTraffic !== null) { trafficBestTime = parseInt(savedTraffic) || null; updateTrafficBest(); }
                const savedMem = localStorage.getItem('edubot_mem_level');
                if (savedMem !== null) memLevel = parseInt(savedMem) || 1;
              } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
            }
        
            function updateTrafficBest() {
              document.getElementById('trafficBestDisplay').textContent = trafficBestTime ? 'Best: ' + trafficBestTime + 'ms' : 'Best: --';
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // NAVIGATION
            // ==========================================
            let mathInitialized = false;
        
            function nav(viewId) {
              if (viewId === 'drive' && !connected) { alert('Bitte zuerst mit dem EduBot verbinden!'); return; }
        
              document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
              const target = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId);
              if (target) target.classList.add('active');
        
              if (viewId === 'math' && !mathInitialized) { mathInitialized = true; setMathLevel(1); }
              if (viewId === 'word' && wordExpected === '') generateWord();
              if (viewId === 'english' && englishExpected === '') generateEnglish();
              if (viewId === 'geo' && geoExpected === '') generateGeo();
              if (viewId === 'color' && colorTarget === '') generateColorTarget();
              if (viewId === 'traffic') resetTrafficLight();
              if (viewId === 'geometry') setupGeometry();
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // BLUETOOTH CORE & HELPER LOGIC
            // ==========================================
            const SERVICE_UUID = '4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b';
            const CMD_UUID = 'beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8';
            const STATUS_UUID = 'a9b1c2d3-1111-2222-3333-abcdefabcdef';
        
            let device = null;
            let cmdChar = null;
            let statusChar = null;
            let connected = false;
            let heartbeatInterval = null;
            let lastSent = '';
            let writing = false;
            let queuedCommand = null;
            let isBotBusy = false;
            let keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
            let reconnectAttempts = 0;
            let reconnectTimer = null;
        
            function updateConnectionUI(isConnected, text) {
              connected = isConnected;
              document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = text;
              document.getElementById('statusDot').classList.toggle('connected', isConnected);
              document.getElementById('btnConnect').style.display = isConnected ? 'none' : 'block';
              document.querySelectorAll('.gv-dot').forEach(dot => dot.classList.toggle('connected', isConnected));
              const banner = document.getElementById('reconnectBanner');
              banner.classList.remove('show');
            }
        
            function updateReconnectBanner(visible) {
              const banner = document.getElementById('reconnectBanner');
              banner.classList.toggle('show', visible);
            }
        
            function handleStatusMessage(msg) {
              if (msg.startsWith('COLOR:')) {
                const d = msg.substring(6).split(',');
                if (d.length >= 4) {
                  const rgbStr = 'rgb(' + d[0] + ', ' + d[1] + ', ' + d[2] + ')';
                  document.getElementById('driveColorPreview').style.background = rgbStr;
                  document.getElementById('driveColorName').textContent = d[3];
                  document.getElementById('gameColorPreviewView').style.background = rgbStr;
                  document.getElementById('gameColorNameView').textContent = d[3];
                  if (!isBotBusy) checkColorQuest(d[3]);
                }
              }
            }
        
            async function connectBLE() {
              try {
                if (!navigator.bluetooth) { alert('Browser unterstützt kein Web Bluetooth!'); return; }
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Suche...');
                reconnectAttempts = 0;
                device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({
                  filters: [{ services: [SERVICE_UUID] }],
                  optionalServices: [SERVICE_UUID]
                });
                device.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected', onDisconnected);
                const server = await device.gatt.connect();
                const service = await server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUID);
                cmdChar = await service.getCharacteristic(CMD_UUID);
                statusChar = await service.getCharacteristic(STATUS_UUID);
                await statusChar.startNotifications();
                statusChar.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged', e => {
                  handleStatusMessage(textDecoder.decode(e.target.value));
                });
                updateConnectionUI(true, 'Verbunden');
                await sendCommand('MAX:900');
                await sendCommand('TURN:0.25');
                startSending();
                await sendKeys(true);
              } catch (e) {
                if (e.name !== 'NotFoundError') console.error(e);
                updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
              }
            }
        
            function scheduleReconnect() {
              if (reconnectAttempts >= 5) { reconnectAttempts = 0; return; }
              const delayMs = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, reconnectAttempts), 16000);
              updateReconnectBanner(true);
              reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => reconnect(), delayMs);
            }
        
            async function reconnect() {
              if (connected) { reconnectAttempts = 0; return; }
              reconnectAttempts++;
              try {
                await connectBLE();
                reconnectAttempts = 0;
                updateReconnectBanner(false);
              } catch (e) {
                scheduleReconnect();
              }
            }
        
            function onDisconnected() {
              cmdChar = null;
              statusChar = null;
              stopSending();
              keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
              updateConnectionUI(false, 'Getrennt');
              scheduleReconnect();
            }
        
            function writeToBLE(cmd) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              const data = new TextEncoder().encode(cmd);
              try {
                if (cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse) cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(data);
                else cmdChar.writeValue(data);
              } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
            }
        
            async function sendCommand(cmd) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              if (writing) { queuedCommand = cmd; return; }
              writing = true;
              try { writeToBLE(cmd); } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
              writing = false;
              if (queuedCommand !== null) {
                const next = queuedCommand;
                queuedCommand = null;
                sendCommand(next);
              }
            }
        
            async function sendKeys(force) {
              if (!connected || !cmdChar) return;
              const msg = 'KEYS:' + keys.w + keys.a + keys.s + keys.d;
              if (!force && msg === lastSent) return;
              lastSent = msg;
              try { cmdChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(new TextEncoder().encode(msg)); } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
            }
        
            function startSending() { stopSending(); heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => sendKeys(true), 50); }
        
            function stopSending() {
              if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
              heartbeatInterval = null;
            }
        
            async function emergencyStop() {
              keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
              updateKeyUI();
              if (connected && cmdChar) { writeToBLE('STOP'); sendKeys(true); }
            }
        
            const delay = ms => new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, ms));
        
            async function botActionAsync(w, a, s, d, ms) {
              if (!connected) { await delay(ms); return; }
              keys = { w, a, s, d };
              updateKeyUI();
              await sendKeys(true);
              await delay(ms);
              keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
              updateKeyUI();
              await sendKeys(true);
              await delay(100);
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // MANUAL CONTROLS (Drive View)
            // ==========================================
            function updateKeyUI() {
              ['W', 'A', 'S', 'D'].forEach(k => {
                const el = document.getElementById('btn' + k);
                if (el) el.classList.toggle('active', keys[k.toLowerCase()] === 1);
              });
            }
        
            function setKey(k, val) {
              if (isBotBusy || !(k in keys)) return;
              const v = val ? 1 : 0;
              if (keys[k] === v) return;
              keys[k] = v;
              updateKeyUI();
              sendKeys(false);
            }
        
            document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
              if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
              let k = e.key;
              if (k === 'ArrowUp') k = 'w';
              else if (k === 'ArrowDown') k = 's';
              else if (k === 'ArrowLeft') k = 'a';
              else if (k === 'ArrowRight') k = 'd';
              if (['w', 'a', 's', 'd'].includes(k.toLowerCase()) && !e.repeat) setKey(k.toLowerCase(), 1);
            });
        
            document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
              if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
              let k = e.key;
              if (k === 'ArrowUp') k = 'w';
              else if (k === 'ArrowDown') k = 's';
              else if (k === 'ArrowLeft') k = 'a';
              else if (k === 'ArrowRight') k = 'd';
              if (['w', 'a', 's', 'd'].includes(k.toLowerCase())) setKey(k.toLowerCase(), 0);
            });
        
            // Touch-Steuerung für Mobilgeräte
            document.querySelectorAll('.touch-btn[data-key]').forEach(el => {
              const k = el.dataset.key;
              const start = e => { e.preventDefault(); setKey(k, 1); el.classList.add('active'); };
              const end = e => { e.preventDefault(); setKey(k, 0); el.classList.remove('active'); };
              el.addEventListener('touchstart', start, { passive: false });
              el.addEventListener('touchend', end, { passive: false });
              el.addEventListener('touchcancel', end, { passive: false });
              el.addEventListener('mousedown', start);
              el.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
              el.addEventListener('mouseleave', end);
            });
        
            // Touch-Joystick
            const touchArea = document.getElementById('touchArea');
            if (touchArea) {
              let touchActive = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
        
              function handleTouchDir(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const rect = touchArea.getBoundingClientRect();
                const x = e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
                const y = e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
                let newKeys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
                if (Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y)) {
                  if (x > 15) newKeys.d = 1;
                  else if (x < -15) newKeys.a = 1;
                } else {
                  if (y > 15) newKeys.s = 1;
                  else if (y < -15) newKeys.w = 1;
                }
                const nk = newKeys.w + '' + newKeys.a + newKeys.s + newKeys.d;
                const tk = touchActive.w + '' + touchActive.a + touchActive.s + touchActive.d;
                if (nk !== tk) {
                  touchActive = newKeys;
                  keys = { ...newKeys };
                  updateKeyUI();
                  sendKeys(true);
                }
              }
        
              function handleTouchEnd() {
                touchActive = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
                keys = { w: 0, a: 0, s: 0, d: 0 };
                updateKeyUI();
                sendKeys(true);
              }
        
              touchArea.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchDir, { passive: false });
              touchArea.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchDir, { passive: false });
              touchArea.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
              touchArea.addEventListener('touchcancel', handleTouchEnd);
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // GAMES LOGIC
            // ==========================================
        
            // ---------- 1. MATH ----------
            let mathLevel = 1;
            let mathExpected = 0;
        
            function setMathLevel(lvl) {
              mathLevel = lvl;
              document.querySelectorAll('#mathLevels .level-btn').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(el.dataset.math) === lvl));
              generateMath();
            }
        
            function generateMath() {
              let a, b, sign;
              if (mathLevel === 1) { a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; sign = '+'; mathExpected = a + b; } 
              else if (mathLevel === 2) {
                sign = Math.random() > 0.5 ? '+' : '-';
                if (sign === '+') { a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 1; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 1; mathExpected = a + b; } 
                else { a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 10; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; mathExpected = a - b; }
              } else if (mathLevel === 3) { sign = 'x'; a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1; mathExpected = a * b; } 
              else if (mathLevel === 4) {
                sign = ':' ; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9) + 2; a = b * (Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1); mathExpected = a / b;
              } else {
                const r = Math.random();
                if (r < 0.25) { a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; sign = '+'; mathExpected = a + b; } 
                else if (r < 0.5) { a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 10; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; sign = '-'; mathExpected = a - b; } 
                else if (r < 0.75) { sign = 'x' ; a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1; mathExpected = a * b; } 
                else { sign = ':' ; b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9) + 2; a = b * (Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1); mathExpected = a / b; }
              }
              document.getElementById('mathQuestion').textContent = a + ' ' + sign + ' ' + b + ' = ?';
              document.getElementById('mathInput').value = '';
            }
        
            async function checkMath() {
              if (isBotBusy) return;
              const input = document.getElementById('mathInput').value;
              if (input === '') return;
              const val = Number(input);
              if (isNaN(val) || !Number.isInteger(val)) { showFeedback('mathFeedback', 'error', 'Bitte eine ganze Zahl eingeben!'); return; }
              if (val === mathExpected) {
                showFeedback('mathFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig!');
                addXP(mathLevel * 10);
                isBotBusy = true;
                document.getElementById('mathBusy').classList.add('active');
                await botActionAsync(1, 0, 0, 0, 1000);
                isBotBusy = false;
                document.getElementById('mathBusy').classList.remove('active');
                generateMath();
              } else {
                showFeedback('mathFeedback', 'error', 'Probiere es nochmal!');
              }
            }

            // ---------- 6+8. CODE & GEOMETRY SEQUENCES ----------
            let codeSeq = [];
            let geoCodeSeq = [];
        
            function renderSequence(areaId, seq) {
              const area = document.getElementById(areaId);
              if (seq.length === 0) {
                area.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic;">' + (areaId === 'codeSequenceArea' ? 'Klicke auf die Bl\u00F6cke...' : 'Code hier...') + '</div>';
                return;
              }
              area.innerHTML = '';
              seq.forEach((cmd, i) => {
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.className = 'seq-item ' + blockMap[cmd].class;
                d.innerHTML = '<span>' + (i + 1) + '.</span> ' + blockMap[cmd].name;
                area.appendChild(d);
              });
            }
        
            function addToSeq(seq, arr, max, areaId) {
              return function(cmd) {
                if (arr.length >= max) { alert('Maximal ' + max + ' Befehle!'); return; }
                arr.push(cmd);
                renderSequence(areaId, arr);
              };
            }
        
            function clearSeq(arr, areaId) {
              return function() {
                arr.length = 0;
                renderSequence(areaId, arr);
              };
            }
        
            const addCode = addToSeq('code', codeSeq, 12, 'codeSequenceArea');
            const clearCode = clearSeq(codeSeq, 'codeSequenceArea');
            const addGeoCode = addToSeq('geo', geoCodeSeq, 10, 'geoSequenceArea');
            const clearGeoCode = clearSeq(geoCodeSeq, 'geoSequenceArea');
        
            async function runCode() {
              if (codeSeq.length === 0 || isBotBusy) return;
              if (!connected) { alert('Bitte erst verbinden!'); return; }
              isBotBusy = true;
              document.getElementById('codeBusy').classList.add('active');
              const prog = document.getElementById('codeProgress');
              for (let i = 0; i < codeSeq.length; i++) {
                prog.textContent = 'Befehl ' + (i + 1) + '/' + codeSeq.length + ': ' + blockMap[codeSeq[i]].name;
                await blockMap[codeSeq[i]].func();
              }
              prog.textContent = 'Fertig!';
              addXP(codeSeq.length * 5);
              await delay(1000);
              isBotBusy = false;
              document.getElementById('codeBusy').classList.remove('active');
              clearCode();
            }
        
            // ---------- 7. MEMORY ----------
            let memSeq = [];
            let memUserSeq = [];
            let memAnimating = false;
            let memLevel = 1;
        
            async function startMemory() {
              if (isBotBusy || memAnimating) return;
              document.getElementById('btnMemStart').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('memoryInputArea').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('memLevelDisplay').textContent = 'Level ' + memLevel;
              memUserSeq = [];
              document.getElementById('memoryUserDisplay').textContent = '';
        
              const dirs = ['F', 'B', 'L', 'R'];
              const length = Math.min(memLevel + 2, 8);
              memSeq = Array.from({ length }, () => dirs[Math.floor(Math.random() * dirs.length)]);
        
              memAnimating = true;
              for (let i = 0; i < memSeq.length; i++) {
                const elId = memSeq[i] === 'F' ? 'memArrow1' : memSeq[i] === 'B' ? 'memArrow2' : memSeq[i] === 'L' ? 'memArrow3' : 'memArrow4';
                const el = document.getElementById(elId);
                el.classList.add('flash');
                await delay(600);
                el.classList.remove('flash');
                await delay(300);
              }
              memAnimating = false;
              document.getElementById('memoryInputArea').style.display = 'block';
            }
        
            async function inputMemory(dir) {
              if (memAnimating || isBotBusy) return;
              memUserSeq.push(dir);
              const symbol = dir === 'F' ? '\u2B06\uFE0F' : dir === 'B' ? '\u2B07\uFE0F' : dir === 'L' ? '\u2B05\uFE0F' : '\u27A1\uFE0F';
              document.getElementById('memoryUserDisplay').textContent += symbol;
        
              if (memUserSeq.length === memSeq.length) {
                if (JSON.stringify(memUserSeq) === JSON.stringify(memSeq)) {
                  showFeedback('memoryFeedback', 'success', 'Richtig gemerkt!');
                  addXP(30 + memLevel * 5);
                  memLevel++;
                  saveGameState();
                  document.getElementById('memoryInputArea').style.display = 'none';
                  isBotBusy = true;
                  document.getElementById('memoryBusy').classList.add('active');
                  for (let cmd of memSeq) { await blockMap[cmd].func(); }
                  isBotBusy = false;
                  document.getElementById('memoryBusy').classList.remove('active');
                } else {
                  showFeedback('memoryFeedback', 'error', 'Falsche Reihenfolge. Level zurückgesetzt auf 1.');
                  memLevel = 1;
                  saveGameState();
                  document.getElementById('memoryInputArea').style.display = 'none';
                }
                document.getElementById('btnMemStart').style.display = 'inline-block';
              }
            }
        
            // ---------- 8. GEOMETRY ----------
            let geometryShape = 'QUADRAT';
        
            function setupGeometry() {
              geoCodeSeq = [];
              renderSequence('geoSequenceArea', geoCodeSeq);
              const keys = Object.keys(shapePatterns);
              geometryShape = keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)];
              const shape = shapePatterns[geometryShape];
              document.getElementById('geometryGoal').textContent = shape.name;
              document.getElementById('geometryDesc').textContent = 'Tipp: ' + shape.desc;
            }
        
            async function checkGeometry() {
              if (geoCodeSeq.length === 0 || isBotBusy) return;
              const codeStr = geoCodeSeq.join('');
              const shape = shapePatterns[geometryShape];
              if (shape && shape.check(codeStr)) {
                showFeedback('geometryFeedback', 'success', 'Perfektes ' + shape.name + '!');
                addXP(shape.xp);
                isBotBusy = true;
                document.getElementById('geoCodeBusy').classList.add('active');
                if (connected) {
                  for (let cmd of geoCodeSeq) { await blockMap[cmd].func(); }
                } else {
                  await delay(2000);
                }
                isBotBusy = false;
                document.getElementById('geoCodeBusy').classList.remove('active');
                clearGeoCode();
                setupGeometry();
              } else {
                showFeedback('geometryFeedback', 'warning', 'Das ist kein vollst\u00E4ndiges ' + shape.name + '. ' + shape.desc);
              }
            }
        
            // ---------- 9. TRAFFIC ----------
            let trafficState = 'off';
            let trafficTimeout = null;
            let trafficStartMs = 0;
            let trafficBestTime = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('edubot_traffic_best')) || null;
            let trafficLevel = 1;
        
            function setTrafficLevel(lvl) {
              trafficLevel = lvl;
              document.querySelectorAll('#trafficLevels .level-btn').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(el.dataset.traffic) === lvl));
            }
        
            function resetTrafficLight() {
              trafficState = 'off';
              clearTimeout(trafficTimeout);
              document.getElementById('tlRed').classList.remove('on');
              document.getElementById('tlYellow').classList.remove('on');
              document.getElementById('tlGreen').classList.remove('on');
              const btn = document.getElementById('btnTrafficAction');
              btn.textContent = 'Warten...';
              btn.className = 'btn btn-traffic';
            }
        
            function setTrafficLight(color) {
              document.getElementById('tlRed').classList.toggle('on', color === 'red');
              document.getElementById('tlYellow').classList.toggle('on', color === 'yellow');
              document.getElementById('tlGreen').classList.toggle('on', color === 'green');
            }
        
            function startTrafficGame() {
              if (isBotBusy || trafficState !== 'off') return;
              trafficState = 'red';
              setTrafficLight('red');
              document.getElementById('trafficFeedback').className = 'feedback-msg';
              document.getElementById('trafficPenaltyText').textContent = '';
              let minW, maxW;
              if (trafficLevel === 1) { minW = 2500; maxW = 4500; } 
              else if (trafficLevel === 2) { minW = 1000; maxW = 3000; } 
              else { minW = 500; maxW = 1500; }
              const waitTime = Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxW - minW)) + minW;
              trafficTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                trafficState = 'green';
                setTrafficLight('green');
                trafficStartMs = Date.now();
                const btn = document.getElementById('btnTrafficAction');
                btn.textContent = 'LOS!';
                btn.className = 'btn btn-success';
              }, waitTime);
            }
        
            async function trafficClick() {
              if (trafficState === 'off') return;
              if (trafficState === 'red') {
                clearTimeout(trafficTimeout);
                resetTrafficLight();
                showFeedback('trafficFeedback', 'error', 'Zu fr\u00FCh! Rote Ampel ignoriert.');
                xp = Math.max(0, xp - 10);
                addXP(0);
                document.getElementById('trafficPenaltyText').textContent = 'Zu fr\u00FCh! Strafe...';
                isBotBusy = true;
                document.getElementById('trafficBusy').classList.add('active');
                await botActionAsync(0, 1, 1, 0, 500);
                await botActionAsync(0, 0, 1, 1, 500);
                isBotBusy = false;
                document.getElementById('trafficBusy').classList.remove('active');
              } else if (trafficState === 'green') {
                clearTimeout(trafficTimeout);
                const reactTime = Date.now() - trafficStartMs;
                resetTrafficLight();
                if (trafficBestTime === null || reactTime < trafficBestTime) {
                  trafficBestTime = reactTime;
                  localStorage.setItem('edubot_traffic_best', trafficBestTime);
                  saveGameState();
                }
                updateTrafficBest();
                showFeedback('trafficFeedback', 'success', reactTime + 'ms! Best: ' + trafficBestTime + 'ms');
                addXP(20);
                document.getElementById('trafficPenaltyText').textContent = 'Gute Fahrt!';
                isBotBusy = true;
                document.getElementById('trafficBusy').classList.add('active');
                await botActionAsync(1, 0, 0, 0, 1500);
                isBotBusy = false;
                document.getElementById('trafficBusy').classList.remove('active');
              }
            }
        
            // ==========================================
            // EVENT LISTENER INIT
            // ==========================================
            function initEventListeners() {
              // Audio on first user gesture
              document.addEventListener('click', initAudio, { once: true });
              document.addEventListener('touchstart', initAudio, { once: true });
        
              // Dashboard tiles
              document.getElementById('tileGrid').addEventListener('click', e => {
                const tile = e.target.closest('.tile');
                if (tile && tile.dataset.view) nav(tile.dataset.view);
              });
        
              // Back buttons
              document.querySelectorAll('.back-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => nav(btn.dataset.view));
              });
        
              // BLE Connect / Disconnect
              document.getElementById('btnConnect').addEventListener('click', connectBLE);
              document.getElementById('btnEmergencyStop').addEventListener('click', emergencyStop);
        
              // Speed slider
              const speedSlider = document.getElementById('speedSlider');
              speedSlider.addEventListener('input', e => document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent = e.target.value);
              speedSlider.addEventListener('change', e => sendCommand('MAX:' + e.target.value));
        
              // Math
              document.getElementById('mathLevels').addEventListener('click', e => {
                const btn = e.target.closest('.level-btn');
                if (btn && btn.dataset.math) setMathLevel(parseInt(btn.dataset.math));
              });

        46: // =====================================================
        47: // DRV8834 Anschlüsse:
        48: //   STEP_L  -> GPIO 4
        49: //   DIR_L   -> GPIO 3
        50: //   STEP_R  -> GPIO 2
        51: //   DIR_R   -> GPIO 1
        52: //   ENABLE  -> GPIO 7 (optional, LOW = aktiv)
        53: // TCS34725  -> I2C (SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO6)
        54: 
        55: #define PIN_DIR_L      3
        56: #define PIN_STEP_L     4
        57: #define PIN_DIR_R      1
        58: #define PIN_STEP_R     2
        59: #define PIN_ENABLE     7
        60: 
        61: #define STEP_BIT_L     (1UL << PIN_STEP_L)
        62: #define STEP_BIT_R     (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)
        63: portMUX_TYPE stepperMux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
        64: #define SDA_PIN        5
        65: #define SCL_PIN        6
        66: 
        67: // =====================================================
        68: // KONSTANTEN
        69: // =====================================================
        70: constexpr unsigned long BAUD_RATE = 115200;
        71: constexpr int STACK_COLOR_SENSOR = 8192;
        72: constexpr int BLE_QUEUE_LENGTH = 16;
        73: constexpr int TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR = 2;
        74: constexpr int CORE_SENSOR = 0;
        75: 
        76: constexpr uint16_t COLOR_LOW = 40;
        77: constexpr uint16_t COLOR_HIGH = 200;
        78: constexpr float RATIO_RED = 1.35f;
        79: constexpr float RATIO_GB = 1.25f;
        80: 
        81: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT = 900;
        82: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MIN = 200;
        83: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MAX = 2500;
        84: constexpr float TURN_DEFAULT = 0.25f;
        85: constexpr float TURN_MIN = 0.0f;
        86: constexpr float TURN_MAX = 0.9f;
        87: constexpr float ACCEL_DEFAULT = 5000.0f;
        88: constexpr float ACCEL_MIN = 100.0f;
        89: constexpr float ACCEL_MAX = 10000.0f;
        90: 
        91: constexpr uint32_t STEP_TIMER_US = 10;
        92: constexpr uint32_t MIN_STEP_INTERVAL = 50;
        93: constexpr uint32_t MAX_STEP_INTERVAL = 50000;
        94: constexpr uint32_t STEP_PERIOD_US = 1000000UL;
        95: 
        96: constexpr unsigned long COLOR_NOTIFY_MS = 200;
        97: constexpr uint32_t LOOP_DELAY_MS = 5;
        98: 
        99: // =====================================================
        100: // KONFIGURATION (wird in NVS gespeichert)
        101: // =====================================================
        102: struct Config {
        103:   float maxSpeed = 900.0f;
        104:   float turnFactor = 0.25f;
        105:   float turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f;
        106:   int8_t leftSign = -1;
        107:   int8_t rightSign = -1;
        108:   float accelRate = 5000.0f;
        109:   uint32_t commandTimeoutMs = 500;
        110:   uint16_t blackR = 152, blackG = 137, blackB = 98;
        111:   uint16_t whiteR = 4143, whiteG = 4258, whiteB = 3036;
        112: };
        113: 
        114: Config config;
        115: Preferences prefs;
        116: 
        117: // =====================================================
        118: // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        119: // =====================================================
        120: // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        121: // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        122: // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        123: // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        124: 
        125: uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        126: uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        127: uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        128: uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        129: uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        130: uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        131: 
        132: static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        133: static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        134: 
        135: bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
        136:   if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
        137:   if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        138: 
        139:   if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
        140:     stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
        141:     if (stepFracAccumL >= 0x10000UL) {
        142:       stepFracAccumL -= 0x10000UL;
        143:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
        144:       stepPhaseL = 1;
        145:     }
        146:   } else {
        147:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        148:   }
        149: 
        150:   if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
        151:     stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
        152:     if (stepFracAccumR >= 0x10000UL) {
        153:       stepFracAccumR -= 0x10000UL;
        154:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
        155:       stepPhaseR = 1;
        156:     }
        157:   } else {
        158:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        159:   }
        160:   return false;
        161: }
        162: 
        163: void initStepperTimer() {
        164:   timer_config_t cfg = {};
        165:   cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
        166:   cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
        167:   cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
        168:   cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
        169:   cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
        170:   cfg.divider = 80;
        171: 
        172:   timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
        173:   timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
        174:   timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
        175:   timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        176:   timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
        177:   timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        178: }
        179: 
        180: // =====================================================
        181: // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)
        182: // =====================================================
        183: 
        184: void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
        185:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        186:   const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
        187:   const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        188: 
        189:   float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        190: 
        191:   if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
        192:     digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
        193:   } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
        194:     digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
        195:     actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
        196:   } else {
        197:     if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
        198:     else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
        199:     GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
        200:     portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        201:     return;
        202:   }
        203: 
        204:   uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        205:   if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
        206:   if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = 0;
        207: 
        208:   uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * 0x10000UL) / interval;
        209: 
        210:   if (motorIdx == 0) {
        211:     stepIntervalL = interval;
        212:     stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
        213:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        214:   } else {
        215:     stepIntervalR = interval;
        216:     stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
        217:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        218:   }
        219:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        220: }
        221: 
        222: void stopMotors() {
        223:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        224:   stepIntervalL = 0;
        225:   stepIntervalR = 0;
        226:   stepFracAddL = 0;
        227:   stepFracAddR = 0;
        228:   stepFracAccumL = 0;
        229:   stepFracAccumR = 0;
        230: 
        231:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        232:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        233: }

        235: // =====================================================
        236: // FARBSENSOR (TCS34725)
        237: // =====================================================
        238: 
        239: Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(
        240:   TCS34725_INTEGRATIONTIME_50MS,
        241:   TCS34725_GAIN_4X
        242: );
        243: 
        244: volatile int sensorR = 0;
        245: volatile int sensorG = 0;
        246: volatile int sensorB = 0;
        247: volatile uint16_t rawSensorR = 0, rawSensorG = 0, rawSensorB = 0, rawSensorC = 0;
        248: volatile char sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
        249: 
        250: SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        251: bool colorSensorOk = false;
        252: 
        253: // Kalibrierung: Rohwerte -> 0-255
        254: int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
        255:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        256:   long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw), static_cast<long>(blackVal), static_cast<long>(whiteVal), 0L, 255L);
        257:   value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);
        258:   return static_cast<int>(value);
        259: }
        260: 
        261: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        262:   if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
        263:   if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
        264:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        265:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        266:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        267:   if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
        268:   return "UNBEKANNT";
        269: }
        270: 
        271: void setupColorSensor() {
        272:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        273:   colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        274:   if (colorSensorOk) {
        275:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
        276:   } else {
        277:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden! (Trotzdem gestartet)");
        278:   }
        279:   colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
        280:   if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        281: }
        282: 
        283: void resetI2CBus() {
        284:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
        285:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
        286:   for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        287:     digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
        288:     pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
        289:     digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
        290:   }
        291:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
        292:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
        293:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        294: }
        295: 
        296: void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
        297:   TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        298:   const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
        299:   int failCount = 0;
        300: 
        301:   while (true) {
        302:     if (colorSensorOk) {
        303:       uint16_t rawR = 0, rawG = 0, rawB = 0, rawC = 0;
        304:       tcs.getRawData(&rawR, &rawG, &rawB, &rawC);
        305:       rawSensorR = rawR; rawSensorG = rawG; rawSensorB = rawB; rawSensorC = rawC;
        306: 
        307:       if (rawR == 0 && rawG == 0 && rawB == 0 && rawC == 0) {
        308:         failCount++;
        309:         if (failCount >= 3) {
        310:           colorSensorOk = false;
        311:         }
        312:       } else {
        313:         failCount = 0;
        314: 
        315:         int r = calibrateColor(rawR, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
        316:         int g = calibrateColor(rawG, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
        317:         int b = calibrateColor(rawB, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        318: 
        319:         const char* detected = detectColorName(r, g, b);
        320: 
        321:         if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, portMAX_DELAY) == pdTRUE) {
        322:           sensorR = r;
        323:           sensorG = g;
        324:           sensorB = b;
        325:           strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detected, sizeof(sensorName));
        326:           xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        327:         }
        328:       }
        329:     } else {
        330:       Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
        331:       resetI2CBus();
        332:       colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        333:       if (colorSensorOk) {
        334:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
        335:         failCount = 0;
        336:       }
        337:       vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
        338:     }
        339:     vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
        340:   }
        341: }

        399: void sendColorToWebsite() {
        400:   int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
        401:   char name[16] = {};
        402: 
        403:   if (colorSem == nullptr) return;
        404:   if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
        405:     r = sensorR;
        406:     g = sensorG;
        407:     b = sensorB;
        408:     strlcpy(name, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(name));
        409:     xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        410:   } else {
        411:     return;
        412:   }
        413: 
        414:   char msg[64];
        415:   snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "COLOR:%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name);
        416:   sendStatus(msg);
        417: }

        430: void hardStop() {

        437: 
        438: void handleCommand(String cmd) {
        439:   cmd.trim();
        440:   cmd.toUpperCase();
        441:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        442: 
        443:   Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        444: 
        445:   if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
        446:     String data = cmd.substring(5);
        447:     if (data.length() >= 4) {
        448:       keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
        449:       keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
        450:       keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
        451:       keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
        452:     }
        453:     return;
        454:   }
        455: 
        456:   if (cmd == "STOP") {
        457:     hardStop();
        458:     return;
        459:   }
        460: 
        461:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        462:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        463:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        464:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        465:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        466:       prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        467:       prefs.end();
        468:       sendStatus((String("MAX=") + String(config.maxSpeed)).c_str());
        469:     }
        470:     return;
        471:   }
        472: 
        473:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        474:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        475:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        476:       config.turnFactor = t;
        477:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        478:       prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        479:       prefs.end();
        480:       sendStatus((String("TURN=") + String(config.turnFactor)).c_str());
        481:     }
        482:     return;
        483:   }
        484: 
        485:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        486:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        487:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        488:       config.accelRate = a;
        489:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        490:       prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        491:       prefs.end();
        492:       sendStatus((String("ACC=") + String(config.accelRate)).c_str());
        493:     }
        494:     return;
        495:   }
        496: 
        497:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        498:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        499:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        500:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        501:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        502:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        503:     prefs.end();
        504:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        505:     return;
        506:   }
        507: 
        508:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        509:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        510:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        511:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        512:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        513:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        514:     prefs.end();
        515:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        516:     return;
        517:   }
        518: 
        519:   sendStatus((String("UNKNOWN:") + cmd).c_str());
        520: }

        522: // =====================================================

        525: 
        526: class ServerCallbacks : public BLEServerCallbacks {
        527:   void onConnect(BLEServer* server) override {
        528:     server->updateConnParams(6, 12, 0, 100); // Request fast connection interval (7.5ms - 15ms)
        529:     BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_CONNECTED, "" };
        530:     if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0);
        531:   }
        532:   void onDisconnect(BLEServer* server) override {
        533:     BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED, "" };
        534:     if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0);
        535:   }
        536: };
        537: 
        538: class CommandCallbacks : public BLECharacteristicCallbacks {
        539:   void onWrite(BLECharacteristic* characteristic) override {
        540:     std::string rxValue = characteristic->getValue().c_str();
        541:     if (!rxValue.empty()) {
        542:       BleEvent evt = { BLE_EVT_COMMAND, "" };
        543:       strlcpy(evt.cmd, rxValue.c_str(), sizeof(evt.cmd));
        544:       if (bleEventQueue) xQueueSend(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0);
        545:     }
        546:   }
        547: };
        548: 
        549: // =====================================================
        550: // EVENT-VERARBEITUNG (wird in loop() aufgerufen)
        551: // =====================================================
        552: 
        553: void processBleEvents() {
        554:   BleEvent evt;
        555:   while (bleEventQueue && xQueueReceive(bleEventQueue, &evt, 0) == pdTRUE) {
        556:     switch (evt.type) {
        557:       case BLE_EVT_CONNECTED:
        558:         deviceConnected = true;
        559:         lastCommandTime = millis();
        560:         Serial.println("[BLE] Verbunden");
        561:         sendStatus("EduBot V1.3 bereit");
        562:         break;
        563:       case BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED:
        564:         deviceConnected = false;
        565:         clearKeys();
        566:         speedL = 0.0;
        567:         speedR = 0.0;
        568:         stopMotors();
        569:         Serial.println("[BLE] Getrennt - Werbung gestartet");
        570:         BLEDevice::startAdvertising();
        571:         break;
        572:       case BLE_EVT_COMMAND:
        573:         handleCommand(String(evt.cmd));
        574:         break;
        575:     }
        576:   }
        577: }
        578: 
        579: // =====================================================
        580: // RAMPE (sanftes Beschleunigen)
        581: // =====================================================
        582: 
        583: float rampSpeed(float current, float target, float dt) {
        584:   float diff = target - current;
        585:   if (diff < 1.0f && diff > -1.0f) {
        586:     return target;
        587:   }
        588:   float maxChange = config.accelRate * dt;
        589:   if (diff > 0) {
        590:     current += maxChange;
        591:     if (current > target) current = target;
        592:   } else {
        593:     current -= maxChange;
        594:     if (current < target) current = target;
        595:   }
        596:   return current;
        597: }
        598: 
        599: // =====================================================
        600: // FAHRLOGIK
        601: // =====================================================
        602: 
        603: void updateDrive() {
        604:   float targetL = 0.0;
        605:   float targetR = 0.0;
        606: 
        607:   bool forward  = keyW && !keyS;
        608:   bool backward = keyS && !keyW;
        609:   bool left     = keyA && !keyD;
        610:   bool right    = keyD && !keyA;
        611: 
        612:   if (forward) {
        613:     targetL = config.maxSpeed;
        614:     targetR = config.maxSpeed;
        615:   } else if (backward) {
        616:     targetL = -config.maxSpeed;
        617:     targetR = -config.maxSpeed;
        618:   }
        619: 
        620:   if (forward || backward) {
        621:     if (left)  targetL *= config.turnFactor;
        622:     if (right) targetR *= config.turnFactor;
        623:   }
        624: 
        625:   if (!forward && !backward) {
        626:     if (left) {
        627:       targetL = 0;
        628:       targetR = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        629:     } else if (right) {
        630:       targetL = config.turnOnlySpeed;
        631:       targetR = 0;
        632:     }
        633:   }
        634: 
        635:   // Timeout: Kein BLE-Befehl mehr -> Stop
        636:   if (millis() - lastCommandTime > config.commandTimeoutMs) {
        637:     targetL = 0.0;
        638:     targetR = 0.0;
        639:     if (speedL != 0.0 || speedR != 0.0) {
        640:       speedL = 0.0;
        641:       speedR = 0.0;
        642:       clearKeys();
        643:       stopMotors();
        644:     }
        645:     lastUpdateMicros = micros();
        646:     return;
        647:   }
        648: 
        649:   unsigned long now = micros();
        650:   float dt = (now - lastUpdateMicros) / 1000000.0;
        651:   lastUpdateMicros = now;
        652:   if (dt < 0.0001f || dt > 1.0f) dt = 0.001f;
        653: 
        654:   float newSpeedL = rampSpeed(speedL, targetL, dt);
        655:   if (newSpeedL != speedL) {
        656:     speedL = newSpeedL;
        657:     setMotorSpeed(0, speedL);
        658:   }
        659: 
        660:   float newSpeedR = rampSpeed(speedR, targetR, dt);
        661:   if (newSpeedR != speedR) {
        662:     speedR = newSpeedR;
        663:     setMotorSpeed(1, speedR);
        664:   }
        665: }
        666: 
        667: // =====================================================
        668: // NVS-VALIDIERUNG
        669: // =====================================================
        670: 
        671: void validateConfig() {
        672:   bool changed = false;
        673:   if (config.maxSpeed < MAX_SPEED_MIN || config.maxSpeed > MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        674:     config.maxSpeed = static_cast<float>(MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT); changed = true;
        675:   }
        676:   if (config.turnFactor < TURN_MIN || config.turnFactor > TURN_MAX) {
        677:     config.turnFactor = TURN_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        678:   }
        679:   if (config.accelRate < ACCEL_MIN || config.accelRate > ACCEL_MAX) {
        680:     config.accelRate = ACCEL_DEFAULT; changed = true;
        681:   }
        682:   if (config.blackR >= config.whiteR || config.blackG >= config.whiteG || config.blackB >= config.whiteB) {
        683:     config.blackR = 152; config.blackG = 137; config.blackB = 98;
        684:     config.whiteR = 4143; config.whiteG = 4258; config.whiteB = 3036;
        685:     changed = true;
        686:   }
        687:   if (changed) {
        688:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        689:     prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        690:     prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        691:     prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        692:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        693:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        694:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        695:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        696:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        697:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        698:     prefs.end();
        699:     Serial.println("[NVS] Invalid config corrected");
        700:   }
        701: }

[ASSISTANT]: Die Fehler entstehen durch Inkompatibilitäten zwischen deinem Code und der aktuellen ESP32-Framework-Version (insbesondere `ArduinoBLE` und `ESP-IDF` WDT-API).  Hier sind die Korrekturen:  1.  **WDT (Watchdog Timer):** Die neue `esp_task_wdt_config_t` Struktur und `CONFIG_NUM_CORES` verursachen Fehler, wenn sie nicht korrekt eingebunden sind. Ich habe die Initialisierung auf die stabilere `esp_task_wdt_init(timeout, panic)`-Syntax umgestellt. 2.  **BLE-Fehler:** Die `ArduinoBLE` Bibliothek für ESP32 hat sich geändert. Methoden wie `BLEDevice::startAdvertising()` sind oft nicht direkt verfügbar oder benötigen andere Zugriffe über den Server. Ich habe den Code so angepasst, dass er über `server->getAdvertising()` funktioniert, was in aktuellen Versionen der Standard ist.  **Empfehlung:** Da `IntelliSense` oft falsche Fehler anzeigt, wenn die Projekteinstellungen in PlatformIO nicht vollständig geladen sind, kompiliere das Projekt bitte einmal neu (`pio run`), nachdem du diese Änderungen übernommen hast. Die echten Fehler werden dann im Build-Protokoll angezeigt.  Hier sind die vorgenommenen Änderungen in `Edu_V1.3.cpp`:  ```cpp // 1. WDT Initialisierung angepasst (Zeilen 714-720)   // Ersetzt durch:   esp_task_wdt_init(10, true);   esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);  // 2. BLE Server Callbacks angepasst (Zeilen 527-536)   void onConnect(BLEServer* server) override {     server->getAdvertising()->start(); // Alternativer Weg   }   void onDisconnect(BLEServer* server) override {     server->getAdvertising()->start();   } ```  Bitte prüfe, ob nach einem neuen Build (`pio run`) weiterhin Fehler bestehen. Wenn ja, kopiere bitte das **Build-Log** (nicht die IntelliSense-Meldungen), damit ich die tatsächlichen Compiler-Fehler sehe.

        43: 
        44: // =====================================================
        45: // PIN-KONFIGURATION (Xiao ESP32-S3)
        46: // =====================================================
        47: // DRV8834 Anschlüsse:
        48: //   STEP_L  -> GPIO 4
        49: //   DIR_L   -> GPIO 3
        50: //   STEP_R  -> GPIO 2
        51: //   DIR_R   -> GPIO 1
        52: //   ENABLE  -> GPIO 7 (optional, LOW = aktiv)
        53: // TCS34725  -> I2C (SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO6)
        54: 
        55: #define PIN_DIR_L      3
        56: #define PIN_STEP_L     4
        57: #define PIN_DIR_R      1
        58: #define PIN_STEP_R     2
        59: #define PIN_ENABLE     7
        60: 
        61: #define STEP_BIT_L     (1UL << PIN_STEP_L)
        62: #define STEP_BIT_R     (1UL << PIN_STEP_R)
        63: portMUX_TYPE stepperMux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
        64: #define SDA_PIN        5
        65: #define SCL_PIN        6
        66: 
        67: // =====================================================
        68: // KONSTANTEN
        69: // =====================================================
        70: constexpr unsigned long BAUD_RATE = 115200;
        71: constexpr int STACK_COLOR_SENSOR = 8192;
        72: constexpr int BLE_QUEUE_LENGTH = 16;
        73: constexpr int TASK_PRIORITY_SENSOR = 2;
        74: constexpr int CORE_SENSOR = 0;
        75: 
        76: constexpr uint16_t COLOR_LOW = 40;
        77: constexpr uint16_t COLOR_HIGH = 200;
        78: constexpr float RATIO_RED = 1.35f;
        79: constexpr float RATIO_GB = 1.25f;
        80: 
        81: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_DEFAULT = 900;
        82: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MIN = 200;
        83: constexpr uint32_t MAX_SPEED_MAX = 2500;
        84: constexpr float TURN_DEFAULT = 0.25f;
        85: constexpr float TURN_MIN = 0.0f;
        86: constexpr float TURN_MAX = 0.9f;
        87: constexpr float ACCEL_DEFAULT = 5000.0f;
        88: constexpr float ACCEL_MIN = 100.0f;
        89: constexpr float ACCEL_MAX = 10000.0f;
        90: 
        91: constexpr uint32_t STEP_TIMER_US = 10;
        92: constexpr uint32_t MIN_STEP_INTERVAL = 50;
        93: constexpr uint32_t MAX_STEP_INTERVAL = 50000;
        94: constexpr uint32_t STEP_PERIOD_US = 1000000UL;
        95: 
        96: constexpr unsigned long COLOR_NOTIFY_MS = 200;
        97: constexpr uint32_t LOOP_DELAY_MS = 5;
        98: 
        99: // =====================================================
        100: // KONFIGURATION (wird in NVS gespeichert)
        101: // =====================================================
        102: struct Config {
        103:   float maxSpeed = 900.0f;
        104:   float turnFactor = 0.25f;
        105:   float turnOnlySpeed = 550.0f;
        106:   int8_t leftSign = -1;
        107:   int8_t rightSign = -1;
        108:   float accelRate = 5000.0f;
        109:   uint32_t commandTimeoutMs = 500;
        110:   uint16_t blackR = 152, blackG = 137, blackB = 98;
        111:   uint16_t whiteR = 4143, whiteG = 4258, whiteB = 3036;
        112: };
        113: 
        114: Config config;
        115: Preferences prefs;
        116: 
        117: // =====================================================
        118: // HARDWARE-TIMER FÜR STEPPER (Bresenham)
        119: // =====================================================
        120: // Timer läuft mit 1 MHz (APB 80 MHz / 80 = 1 MHz)
        121: // ISR feuert alle STEP_TIMER_US = 10 µs
        122: // Q16.16 Bresenham-Akkumulator für maximale Präzision
        123: // ISR setzt STEP HIGH, nächster Aufruf cleared → Pulsbreite = 10 µs
        124: 
        125: uint32_t stepFracAddL = 0;
        126: uint32_t stepFracAddR = 0;
        127: uint32_t stepFracAccumL = 0;
        128: uint32_t stepFracAccumR = 0;
        129: uint32_t stepIntervalL = 0;
        130: uint32_t stepIntervalR = 0;
        131: 
        132: static uint8_t stepPhaseL = 0;
        133: static uint8_t stepPhaseR = 0;
        134: 
        135: bool IRAM_ATTR stepperTimerISR(void *arg) {
        136:   if (stepPhaseL == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L; stepPhaseL = 0; }
        137:   if (stepPhaseR == 1) { GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_R; stepPhaseR = 0; }
        138: 
        139:   if (stepIntervalL > 0) {
        140:     stepFracAccumL += stepFracAddL;
        141:     if (stepFracAccumL >= 0x10000UL) {
        142:       stepFracAccumL -= 0x10000UL;
        143:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_L;
        144:       stepPhaseL = 1;
        145:     }
        146:   } else {
        147:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        148:   }
        149: 
        150:   if (stepIntervalR > 0) {
        151:     stepFracAccumR += stepFracAddR;
        152:     if (stepFracAccumR >= 0x10000UL) {
        153:       stepFracAccumR -= 0x10000UL;
        154:       GPIO.out_w1ts = STEP_BIT_R;
        155:       stepPhaseR = 1;
        156:     }
        157:   } else {
        158:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        159:   }
        160:   return false;
        161: }
        162: 
        163: void initStepperTimer() {
        164:   timer_config_t cfg = {};
        165:   cfg.alarm_en = TIMER_ALARM_EN;
        166:   cfg.counter_en = TIMER_PAUSE;
        167:   cfg.intr_type = TIMER_INTR_LEVEL;
        168:   cfg.counter_dir = TIMER_COUNT_UP;
        169:   cfg.auto_reload = TIMER_AUTORELOAD_EN;
        170:   cfg.divider = 80;
        171: 
        172:   timer_init(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, &cfg);
        173:   timer_set_counter_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, 0);
        174:   timer_set_alarm_value(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, STEP_TIMER_US);
        175:   timer_enable_intr(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        176:   timer_isr_callback_add(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0, stepperTimerISR, NULL, ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM);
        177:   timer_start(TIMER_GROUP_0, TIMER_0);
        178: }
        179: 
        180: // =====================================================
        181: // MOTOR-ANSTEUERUNG (DRV8834)
        182: // =====================================================
        183: 
        184: void setMotorSpeed(int motorIdx, float speed) {
        185:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        186:   const int dirPin = (motorIdx == 0) ? PIN_DIR_L : PIN_DIR_R;
        187:   const int sign = (motorIdx == 0) ? config.leftSign : config.rightSign;
        188: 
        189:   float actualSpeed = speed * static_cast<float>(sign);
        190: 
        191:   if (actualSpeed > 0.5f) {
        192:     digitalWrite(dirPin, HIGH);
        193:   } else if (actualSpeed < -0.5f) {
        194:     digitalWrite(dirPin, LOW);
        195:     actualSpeed = -actualSpeed;
        196:   } else {
        197:     if (motorIdx == 0) { stepIntervalL = 0; stepFracAddL = 0; stepFracAccumL = 0; }
        198:     else { stepIntervalR = 0; stepFracAddR = 0; stepFracAccumR = 0; }
        199:     GPIO.out_w1tc = (motorIdx == 0) ? STEP_BIT_L : STEP_BIT_R;
        200:     portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        201:     return;
        202:   }
        203: 
        204:   uint32_t interval = STEP_PERIOD_US / static_cast<uint32_t>(actualSpeed);
        205:   if (interval < MIN_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = MIN_STEP_INTERVAL;
        206:   if (interval > MAX_STEP_INTERVAL) interval = 0;
        207: 
        208:   uint32_t fracAdd = (STEP_TIMER_US * 0x10000UL) / interval;
        209: 
        210:   if (motorIdx == 0) {
        211:     stepIntervalL = interval;
        212:     stepFracAddL = fracAdd;
        213:     stepFracAccumL = 0;
        214:   } else {
        215:     stepIntervalR = interval;
        216:     stepFracAddR = fracAdd;
        217:     stepFracAccumR = 0;
        218:   }
        219:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        220: }
        221: 
        222: void stopMotors() {
        223:   portENTER_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        224:   stepIntervalL = 0;
        225:   stepIntervalR = 0;
        226:   stepFracAddL = 0;
        227:   stepFracAddR = 0;
        228:   stepFracAccumL = 0;
        229:   stepFracAccumR = 0;
        230: 
        231:   GPIO.out_w1tc = STEP_BIT_L | STEP_BIT_R;
        232:   portEXIT_CRITICAL(&stepperMux);
        233: }
        234: 
        235: // =====================================================
        236: // FARBSENSOR (TCS34725)
        237: // =====================================================
        238: 
        239: Adafruit_TCS34725 tcs = Adafruit_TCS34725(
        240:   TCS34725_INTEGRATIONTIME_50MS,
        241:   TCS34725_GAIN_4X
        242: );
        243: 
        244: volatile int sensorR = 0;
        245: volatile int sensorG = 0;
        246: volatile int sensorB = 0;
        247: volatile uint16_t rawSensorR = 0, rawSensorG = 0, rawSensorB = 0, rawSensorC = 0;
        248: volatile char sensorName[16] = "UNBEKANNT";
        249: 
        250: SemaphoreHandle_t colorSem = nullptr;
        251: bool colorSensorOk = false;
        252: 
        253: // Kalibrierung: Rohwerte -> 0-255
        254: int calibrateColor(uint16_t raw, uint16_t blackVal, uint16_t whiteVal) {
        255:   if (whiteVal <= blackVal) return 0;
        256:   long value = map(static_cast<long>(raw), static_cast<long>(blackVal), static_cast<long>(whiteVal), 0L, 255L);
        257:   value = constrain(value, 0L, 255L);
        258:   return static_cast<int>(value);
        259: }
        260: 
        261: const char* detectColorName(int r, int g, int b) {
        262:   if (r < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && g < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW) && b < static_cast<int>(COLOR_LOW)) return "SCHWARZ";
        263:   if (r > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && g > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH) && b > static_cast<int>(COLOR_HIGH)) return "WEISS";
        264:   if (r > g * RATIO_RED && r > b * RATIO_RED) return "ROT";
        265:   if (g > r * RATIO_GB && g > b * RATIO_GB) return "GRUEN";
        266:   if (b > r * RATIO_GB && b > g * RATIO_GB) return "BLAU";
        267:   if (r > 160 && g > 120 && b < 120) return "GELB";
        268:   return "UNBEKANNT";
        269: }
        270: 
        271: void setupColorSensor() {
        272:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        273:   colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        274:   if (colorSensorOk) {
        275:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 gefunden");
        276:   } else {
        277:     Serial.println("[SENSOR] TCS34725 NICHT gefunden! (Trotzdem gestartet)");
        278:   }
        279:   colorSem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
        280:   if (colorSem) xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        281: }
        282: 
        283: void resetI2CBus() {
        284:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, OUTPUT);
        285:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT);
        286:   for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        287:     digitalWrite(SDA_PIN, LOW);
        288:     pinMode(SCL_PIN, OUTPUT); digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(5);
        289:     digitalWrite(SCL_PIN, LOW); delayMicroseconds(5);
        290:   }
        291:   pinMode(SDA_PIN, INPUT);
        292:   pinMode(SCL_PIN, INPUT);
        293:   Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
        294: }
        295: 
        296: void colorSensorTask(void* parameter) {
        297:   TickType_t lastWakeTime = xTaskGetTickCount();
        298:   const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(120);
        299:   int failCount = 0;
        300: 
        301:   while (true) {
        302:     if (colorSensorOk) {
        303:       uint16_t rawR = 0, rawG = 0, rawB = 0, rawC = 0;
        304:       tcs.getRawData(&rawR, &rawG, &rawB, &rawC);
        305:       rawSensorR = rawR; rawSensorG = rawG; rawSensorB = rawB; rawSensorC = rawC;
        306: 
        307:       if (rawR == 0 && rawG == 0 && rawB == 0 && rawC == 0) {
        308:         failCount++;
        309:         if (failCount >= 3) {
        310:           colorSensorOk = false;
        311:         }
        312:       } else {
        313:         failCount = 0;
        314: 
        315:         int r = calibrateColor(rawR, config.blackR, config.whiteR);
        316:         int g = calibrateColor(rawG, config.blackG, config.whiteG);
        317:         int b = calibrateColor(rawB, config.blackB, config.whiteB);
        318: 
        319:         const char* detected = detectColorName(r, g, b);
        320: 
        321:         if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, portMAX_DELAY) == pdTRUE) {
        322:           sensorR = r;
        323:           sensorG = g;
        324:           sensorB = b;
        325:           strlcpy((char*)sensorName, detected, sizeof(sensorName));
        326:           xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        327:         }
        328:       }
        329:     } else {
        330:       Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovery attempt...");
        331:       resetI2CBus();
        332:       colorSensorOk = tcs.begin();
        333:       if (colorSensorOk) {
        334:         Serial.println("[SENSOR] Recovered!");
        335:         failCount = 0;
        336:       }
        337:       vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(5000));
        338:     }
        339:     vTaskDelayUntil(&lastWakeTime, period);
        340:   }
        341: }

        354: // =====================================================
        355: // BLE EVENT-QUEUE (ISR-sicher)
        356: // =====================================================
        357: 
        358: enum BleEventType : uint8_t {
        359:   BLE_EVT_CONNECTED,
        360:   BLE_EVT_DISCONNECTED,
        361:   BLE_EVT_COMMAND
        362: };
        363: 
        364: typedef struct {
        365:   BleEventType type;
        366:   char cmd[64];
        367: } BleEvent;
        368: 
        369: QueueHandle_t bleEventQueue = nullptr;

        388: // BLE-NACHRICHTEN
        389: // =====================================================
        390: 
        391: void sendStatus(const char* msg) {
        392:   Serial.printf("[BLE] %s\n", msg);
        393:   if (statusChar != nullptr && deviceConnected) {
        394:     statusChar->setValue(msg);
        395:     statusChar->notify();
        396:   }
        397: }
        398: 
        399: void sendColorToWebsite() {
        400:   int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
        401:   char name[16] = {};
        402: 
        403:   if (colorSem == nullptr) return;
        404:   if (xSemaphoreTake(colorSem, pdMS_TO_TICKS(5)) == pdTRUE) {
        405:     r = sensorR;
        406:     g = sensorG;
        407:     b = sensorB;
        408:     strlcpy(name, (const char*)sensorName, sizeof(name));
        409:     xSemaphoreGive(colorSem);
        410:   } else {
        411:     return;
        412:   }
        413: 
        414:   char msg[64];
        415:   snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "COLOR:%d,%d,%d,%s", r, g, b, name);
        416:   sendStatus(msg);
        417: }

        430: void hardStop() {

        433:   speedR = 0.0;

        435:   sendStatus("STOP");
        436: }
        437: 
        438: void handleCommand(String cmd) {
        439:   cmd.trim();
        440:   cmd.toUpperCase();
        441:   lastCommandTime = millis();
        442: 
        443:   Serial.printf("[CMD] %s\n", cmd.c_str());
        444: 
        445:   if (cmd.startsWith("KEYS:")) {
        446:     String data = cmd.substring(5);
        447:     if (data.length() >= 4) {
        448:       keyW = (data.charAt(0) == '1');
        449:       keyA = (data.charAt(1) == '1');
        450:       keyS = (data.charAt(2) == '1');
        451:       keyD = (data.charAt(3) == '1');
        452:     }
        453:     return;
        454:   }
        455: 
        456:   if (cmd == "STOP") {
        457:     hardStop();
        458:     return;
        459:   }
        460: 
        461:   if (cmd.startsWith("MAX:")) {
        462:     float v = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        463:     if (v >= MAX_SPEED_MIN && v <= MAX_SPEED_MAX) {
        464:       config.maxSpeed = v;
        465:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        466:       prefs.putFloat("maxSpeed", config.maxSpeed);
        467:       prefs.end();
        468:       sendStatus((String("MAX=") + String(config.maxSpeed)).c_str());
        469:     }
        470:     return;
        471:   }
        472: 
        473:   if (cmd.startsWith("TURN:")) {
        474:     float t = cmd.substring(5).toFloat();
        475:     if (t >= TURN_MIN && t <= TURN_MAX) {
        476:       config.turnFactor = t;
        477:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        478:       prefs.putFloat("turnFactor", config.turnFactor);
        479:       prefs.end();
        480:       sendStatus((String("TURN=") + String(config.turnFactor)).c_str());
        481:     }
        482:     return;
        483:   }
        484: 
        485:   if (cmd.startsWith("ACC:")) {
        486:     float a = cmd.substring(4).toFloat();
        487:     if (a >= ACCEL_MIN && a <= ACCEL_MAX) {
        488:       config.accelRate = a;
        489:       prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        490:       prefs.putFloat("accelRate", config.accelRate);
        491:       prefs.end();
        492:       sendStatus((String("ACC=") + String(config.accelRate)).c_str());
        493:     }
        494:     return;
        495:   }
        496: 
        497:   if (cmd == "CAL:BLACK") {
        498:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        499:     config.blackR = rawSensorR; config.blackG = rawSensorG; config.blackB = rawSensorB;
        500:     prefs.putUShort("blackR", config.blackR);
        501:     prefs.putUShort("blackG", config.blackG);
        502:     prefs.putUShort("blackB", config.blackB);
        503:     prefs.end();
        504:     sendStatus("CAL:BLACK OK");
        505:     return;
        506:   }
        507: 
        508:   if (cmd == "CAL:WHITE") {
        509:     prefs.begin("edubot", false);
        510:     config.whiteR = rawSensorR; config.whiteG = rawSensorG; config.whiteB = rawSensorB;
        511:     prefs.putUShort("whiteR", config.whiteR);
        512:     prefs.putUShort("whiteG", config.whiteG);
        513:     prefs.putUShort("whiteB", config.whiteB);
        514:     prefs.end();
        515:     sendStatus("CAL:WHITE OK");
        516:     return;
        517:   }
        518: 
        519:   sendStatus((String("UNKNOWN:") + cmd).c_str());
        520: }
